-- Weather (ServerScriptService.CC_CoreServer), v4 P4 run 2: the server's weather schedule (concept LOCKED #13:
-- dynamic day/night + weather with mobile quality tiers, only after a measured cost test; numbers PROPOSED,
-- CoreConfig WEATHER). The server owns the state; CC_WeatherClient draws it (lighting, particles by quality tier).
-- * Day/night: deterministic from server time (workspace attribute CC_DayStart): every client computes the same
--   ClockTime, nothing streams per frame. Day 5:30 -> 19:30 takes most of the cycle, the night the rest.
-- * Weather: clear / mist / snow / gust, each held minHold..maxHold s; workspace attributes CC_Weather + CC_WeatherAt.
--   Weather.current() is the hook for weather-linked mutations (master.md §0.7) when that system lands.
-- * CC_WeatherOff (workspace attribute, Studio dev action "weather") freezes it for perf comparisons.
local Weather = {}
local ctx, C
local rng = Random.new()

function Weather.current()
	return workspace:GetAttribute("CC_Weather") or "clear"
end

local function set(state)
	workspace:SetAttribute("CC_Weather", state)
	workspace:SetAttribute("CC_WeatherAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
end

function Weather.init(c)
	ctx = c
	C = c.C
	local W = C.WEATHER
	-- the day starts mid-morning at server start (first players see daylight)
	workspace:SetAttribute("CC_DayStart", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - W.dayMinutes * 60 * 0.25)
	set("clear")
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(rng:NextNumber(W.minHold, W.maxHold))
			if not workspace:GetAttribute("CC_WeatherOff") then
				-- clear half the time, the rest split between the others; never the same twice in a row
				local cur = Weather.current()
				local pick
				repeat
					local r = rng:NextNumber()
					pick = (r < 0.45) and "clear" or W.states[rng:NextInteger(2, #W.states)]
				until pick ~= cur
				set(pick)
			end
		end
	end)
	if ctx.devHandlers then
		-- Studio only: { state = "snow", clock = 22, off = true/false }
		ctx.devHandlers.weather = function(_, p)
			if type(p.state) == "string" and table.find(W.states, p.state) then
				set(p.state)
			end
			if type(p.clock) == "number" then
				-- shift the day start so ClockTime reads p.clock now
				local cyc = W.dayMinutes * 60
				local dayShare = W.dayShare
				local h = p.clock
				local phase
				if h >= W.nightTo and h < W.nightFrom then
					phase = (h - W.nightTo) / (W.nightFrom - W.nightTo) * dayShare
				else
					local hn = (h - W.nightFrom) % 24
					phase = dayShare + hn / (24 - (W.nightFrom - W.nightTo)) * (1 - dayShare)
				end
				workspace:SetAttribute("CC_DayStart", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - phase * cyc)
			end
			if p.off ~= nil then
				workspace:SetAttribute("CC_WeatherOff", p.off == true)
			end
		end
	end
end

return Weather
sources.src/world/SplineKit.luau:
-- SplineKit (v5 P1, 2026-10-21): world pieces for a v5 spline route (after the terrain is written).
--   SplineKit.build(Kit, Gen, name)  -> report string. Rebuild-safe: replaces Workspace.World.Routes.<name>, its
--   checkpoint triggers (Route = name) and ReplicatedStorage.CC_Track.<name>.
-- Pieces: tread parts on every tight segment (crisp 2-5 stud edges; the terrain under them sits 1.1 lower), rope
-- rails on drops (rail = "rope"), ladders (steel rails + rungs + an invisible Climbable grip, rock face behind),
-- boulder-stair blocks, log / rope bridges over gap segments, cleft boulders, rests (pavilion low / tent mid-high:
-- RestZone + checkpoint), cairns (terrain + checkpoint), guide flags (GuideOrder for CC_ClimbClient's Guide).
-- Colours: design/v5-tokens.md only (references-intel swatches). Placements PROPOSED.
local HS = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local T = workspace.Terrain
local MARK = Enum.Material.Asphalt -- CoreConfig.CLIMB.terrainMaterial: marked (climbable) rock
local SK = {}

local function hex(h)
	return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(h:sub(2, 3), 16), tonumber(h:sub(4, 5), 16), tonumber(h:sub(6, 7), 16))
end
SK.COL = {
	dirtPath = hex("#8a5a3a"),
	gullyRock = hex("#6e7273"),
	moss = hex("#6d6a3f"),
	fogRock = hex("#7d8079"),
	snowRock = hex("#4a4d52"),
	snowLit = hex("#e0e3e6"),
	rope = hex("#a86a2e"),
	ropeBright = hex("#d9722a"),
	darkWood = hex("#4a2d22"),
	lakeMoss = hex("#a9b83a"),
	tentRed = hex("#b0221d"),
	ladderStrip = hex("#e0a21e"),
}
local COL = SK.COL
local UP = Vector3.yAxis

local function V(p)
	return Vector3.new(p[1], p[3], p[2])
end
local function flat(v)
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end

-- tread look by altitude (references: img3 dirt low, img3 rock mid, img4 dark rock high)
local function treadLook(y)
	if y < 1100 then
		return Enum.Material.Ground, COL.dirtPath
	elseif y < 1900 then
		return Enum.Material.Slate, COL.gullyRock
	end
	return Enum.Material.Slate, COL.snowRock
end

function SK.build(Kit, Gen, name)
	local P = _G.CC_PATHS
	local R = P.routes[name]
	assert(R and R.v5, "not a v5 route: " .. tostring(name))
	local SG = require(script.Parent.SplineGen)
	local def = R.def
	local pts, ty, wd, S = R.pts, R.ty, R.w, R.S
	local n = #pts
	local root = Kit.folder(Kit.folder(workspace, "World"), "Routes")
	local old = root:FindFirstChild(name)
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local f = Kit.folder(root, name)
	local cps = Kit.folder(Kit.folder(workspace, "World"), "Checkpoints")
	for _, t in ipairs(cps:GetChildren()) do
		if t:GetAttribute("Route") == name then
			t:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local cnt = { tread = 0, rail = 0, ladders = 0, stair = 0, bridges = 0, rests = 0, cairns = 0, flags = 0, cleft = 0 }
	local function P_(parent, props)
		return Kit.part(parent, props)
	end
	local function D_(parent, props)
		return Kit.decor(Kit.part(parent, props))
	end
	local function outward(i)
		local nx, nz, tx, tz = SG.normal(R, i)
		return Vector3.new(nx, 0, nz), Vector3.new(tx, 0, tz)
	end

	------------------------------------------------ tread parts: OFF by default (user 2026-10-21: the trail is the
	-- mountain's own rock / earth, no plank or flooring layer); def.treadParts = true brings the old layer back
	local tf = Kit.folder(f, "Tread")
	local TREAD = def.treadParts and { ledge = true, slot = true, ridge = true } or {}
	local i = 1
	while i < n do
		local t = ty[i]
		if TREAD[t] then
			-- grow the run while the heading and grade stay close and the run is <= 14 studs
			local a = V(pts[i])
			local j = i + 1
			local d0 = flat(V(pts[j]) - a).Unit
			local g0 = (pts[j][3] - pts[i][3]) / math.max(0.1, S[j] - S[i])
			while j < n and ty[j] == t and wd[j] == wd[i] and S[j + 1] - S[i] <= 14 do
				local dj = flat(V(pts[j + 1]) - V(pts[j]))
				if dj.Magnitude < 0.05 then
					break
				end
				local gj = (pts[j + 1][3] - pts[j][3]) / math.max(0.1, S[j + 1] - S[j])
				if dj.Unit:Dot(d0) < 0.995 or math.abs(gj - g0) > 0.06 then
					break
				end
				j += 1
			end
			local b = V(pts[j])
			local len = (b - a).Magnitude
			if len > 0.2 then
				local mat, col = treadLook(a.Y)
				local w = wd[i] or 4
				local cf = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b) * CFrame.new(0, -0.8, 0)
				local p = P_(tf, { Name = "Tread", Size = Vector3.new(w, 1.6, len + 0.6), CFrame = cf, Material = mat, Color = col })
				p.CastShadow = false
				cnt.tread += 1
			end
			i = j
		else
			i += 1
		end
	end

	------------------------------------------------ rope rails on drops (outer side; ridges both sides)
	if def.rail == "rope" then
		local rf = Kit.folder(f, "Rails")
		local function railRun(side)
			local run = {}
			local function flush()
				if #run >= 4 then
					local m = Kit.model(rf, "RopeRail")
					local last
					for k = 1, #run do
						if k == 1 or k == #run or (run[k].s - run[1].s) % 20 < 2.1 then
							local q = run[k].p
							D_(m, { Name = "Post", Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 4, 0.45), CFrame = CFrame.new(q + Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.darkWood })
							if last then
								local A, B = last + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0), q + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)
								D_(m, { Name = "Rope", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new((B - A).Magnitude + 0.1, 0.28, 0.28), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((A + B) / 2, B) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = COL.rope })
							end
							last = q
						end
					end
					cnt.rail += 1
				end
				run = {}
			end
			for k = 3, n - 3, 1 do
				local t = ty[k]
				local want = (t == "ridge") or (t == "ledge" and side > 0)
				if want then
					local o = outward(k)
					local p = V(pts[k])
					local e = p + o * side * ((wd[k] or 4) / 2 - 0.35)
					local far = p + o * side * ((wd[k] or 4) / 2 + 4)
					local drop = p.Y - Gen.heightAt(far.X, far.Z)
					if drop > 5 then
						run[#run + 1] = { p = e, s = S[k] }
						if S[k] - run[1].s > 60 then
							local keep = run[#run]
							flush()
							run[1] = keep
						end
					else
						flush()
					end
				else
					flush()
				end
			end
			flush()
		end
		railRun(1)
		railRun(-1)
	end

	------------------------------------------------ pieces
	local pf = Kit.folder(f, "Pieces")
	local track = {}
	local order = 0
	local cpOrder = 0
	local function trigger(key, pos, label, camp)
		cpOrder += 1
		local t = Instance.new("Part")
		t.Name = "CP_" .. name .. "_" .. key
		t.Anchored, t.CanCollide, t.CanQuery = true, false, false
		t.Transparency = 1
		t.Size = Vector3.new(16, 14, 16)
		t.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0))
		for k, v in pairs({ Checkpoint = name .. "_" .. key, Label = label, Route = name, Order = cpOrder, Camp = false }) do
			t:SetAttribute(k, v)
		end
		t.Parent = cps
		return t
	end
	local function flag(pos, o)
		order += 1
		local m = Kit.model(pf, "GuideFlag_" .. order)
		local g = Vector3.new(pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z)
		D_(m, { Name = "Pole", Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 6, 0.3), CFrame = CFrame.new(g + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.darkWood })
		local fl = D_(m, { Name = "GuideFlag", Size = Vector3.new(0.12, 1.3, 2.2), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(g + Vector3.new(0, 5.3, 0) + o * 1.1, g + Vector3.new(0, 5.3, 0) + o * 1.1 + o:Cross(UP)), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = COL.ladderStrip })
		fl:SetAttribute("GuideOrder", order)
		fl:SetAttribute("GuideRoute", name)
		cnt.flags += 1
		return fl
	end
	local restN, cairnN = 0, 0
	local rests = {}
	for _, pc in ipairs(R.pieces) do
		local k = math.clamp(pc.i, 1, n)
		local p = V(pts[k])
		local o, dir = outward(k)
		local w = wd[k] or 4
		local spec = pc.spec or {}
		if pc.kind == "ladder" then
			-- foot sample k, top = k + 1. Face: a rock block from just past the ladder up to the top landing.
			local top = V(pts[k + 1])
			local d = flat(top - p).Unit
			local rise = top.Y - p.Y
			local lm = Kit.model(pf, "Ladder_" .. k)
			-- ladder plane: 1.2 ahead of the foot, or at the inner tread edge for an inward ladder (the trail turns at it)
			local off = spec.inward and (w / 2 - 0.2) or 1.2
			local base = p + d * off
			-- the face block reaches from just behind the ladder to the top landing (inward turns run ~w + 4)
			local FACE_OFF = 3 -- rock face 3 behind the ladder plane: rendered voxels bulge ~2 proud (v4: 3.6)
			local faceD = math.max(4.4, flat(top - p).Magnitude - off - FACE_OFF + 2)
			-- the block's top is the rock landing at the top of the ladder (no landing plank, user 2026-10-21)
			local faceC = base + d * (FACE_OFF + faceD / 2) + Vector3.new(0, (rise + 1.8) / 2 - 2, 0)
			T:FillBlock(CFrame.lookAt(faceC, faceC + d), Vector3.new(w + 6, rise + 1.8, faceD), Enum.Material.Rock)
			-- clear rock between the foot and the ladder plane (rendered voxels bulge, CLAUDE.md gotcha)
			local airC = p + d * (off + FACE_OFF / 2 - 1) + Vector3.new(0, rise / 2 + 2.5, 0)
			T:FillBlock(CFrame.lookAt(airC, airC + d), Vector3.new(w + 2, rise + 3, FACE_OFF + 2), Enum.Material.Air)
			local right = d:Cross(UP)
			local H = rise + 3.2
			for _, sg in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
				D_(lm, { Name = "Rail", Size = Vector3.new(0.3, H, 0.3), CFrame = CFrame.new(base + right * 1.2 * sg + Vector3.new(0, H / 2, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, Color = COL.snowRock })
			end
			for y = 1, H - 0.5, 2 do
				D_(lm, { Name = "Rung", Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 0.2, 0.2), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(base + Vector3.new(0, y, 0), base + Vector3.new(0, y, 0) + d), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, Color = COL.snowRock })
			end
			-- grip ends 1 above the top: the controller mantles only when nothing is in front of the head
			local GH = rise + 1
			local gc = base + d * 0.3 + Vector3.new(0, GH / 2, 0)
			local grip = P_(lm, { Name = "LadderGrip", Size = Vector3.new(6, GH, 0.4), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(gc, gc - d), Transparency = 1, Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic })
			grip.CastShadow = false
			grip:SetAttribute("Climbable", true)
			flag(top + d * 3 + d:Cross(UP) * (w / 2 + 0.6), o)
			cnt.ladders += 1
			track[#track + 1] = {
				id = "L" .. k,
				s0 = S[math.max(1, k - 3)],
				s1 = S[math.min(n, k + 4)],
				-- approach along the trail (an inward ladder turns the trail: "behind the foot" is off the ledge), leave
				-- along the trail past the top landing
				nodes = {
					{ k = "walk", p = { pts[math.max(1, k - 3)][1], pts[math.max(1, k - 3)][3] + 3, pts[math.max(1, k - 3)][2] } },
					{ k = "walk", p = { p.X, p.Y + 3, p.Z } },
					{ k = "climb", into = { d.X, 0, d.Z }, label = "L" .. k },
					{ k = "walk", p = { pts[math.min(n, k + 4)][1], pts[math.min(n, k + 4)][3] + 3, pts[math.min(n, k + 4)][2] } },
				},
			}
		elseif pc.kind == "rest" then
			restN += 1
			-- platform on the outer side (pavilion: stilts + roof, low band; tent: small A-frame, mid/high)
			local c = p + o * (w / 2 + 4)
			local rm = Kit.model(pf, "Rest_" .. restN)
			local deckY = p.Y
			local deckCF = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(c.X, deckY - 0.6, c.Z), Vector3.new(c.X, deckY - 0.6, c.Z) + dir)
			P_(rm, { Name = "Deck", Size = Vector3.new(8, 1.2, 10), CFrame = deckCF, Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.darkWood })
			if spec.style == "pavilion" then
				for _, q in ipairs({ { -3.5, -4.5 }, { 3.5, -4.5 }, { -3.5, 4.5 }, { 3.5, 4.5 } }) do
					local pp = (deckCF * CFrame.new(q[1], 0, q[2])).Position
					local gy = Gen.heightAt(pp.X, pp.Z)
					local top = deckY + 7
					local bot = math.min(gy, deckY - 1) - 1
					P_(rm, { Name = "Post", Size = Vector3.new(0.7, top - bot, 0.7), CFrame = CFrame.new(pp.X, (top + bot) / 2, pp.Z), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.darkWood })
				end
				P_(rm, { Name = "Roof", Size = Vector3.new(9.5, 0.6, 11.5), CFrame = deckCF * CFrame.new(0, 7.6, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(6), 0, 0), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.darkWood })
			else
				local tc = deckCF * CFrame.new(0, 0.6, 1.5)
				for _, sg in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
					D_(rm, { Name = "Tent", Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 4.6, 6), CFrame = tc * CFrame.new(sg * 1.55, 2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-sg * 34)), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = COL.tentRed })
				end
			end
			local z = P_(rm, { Name = "RestZone", Size = Vector3.new(10, 8, 12), CFrame = deckCF * CFrame.new(0, 4, 0), Transparency = 1 })
			z.CanCollide, z.CanQuery, z.CanTouch, z.CastShadow = false, false, false, false
			z:SetAttribute("RestZone", true)
			trigger("R" .. restN, p, (spec.style == "pavilion") and "Pavilion rest" or "Tent rest")
			flag(p + o * (w / 2 + 0.6) - dir * 2, o)
			rests[#rests + 1] = { at = S[k] - 10, len = 30 }
			cnt.rests += 1
		elseif pc.kind == "cairn" then
			cairnN += 1
			local c = p - o * (w / 2 + 1.8)
			local gy = math.max(Gen.heightAt(c.X, c.Z), p.Y - 1)
			for s = 0, 3 do
				T:FillBall(Vector3.new(c.X, gy + 0.8 + s * 1.5, c.Z), 1.5 - s * 0.25, Enum.Material.Slate)
			end
			trigger("C" .. cairnN, p, "Cairn")
			flag(Vector3.new(c.X, gy + 5.5, c.Z), o)
			cnt.cairns += 1
		elseif pc.kind == "log" or pc.kind == "ropebridge" then
			-- span the gap segment from its first sample to the next node
			local k1 = k
			while k1 < n and (ty[k1] == "gap" or ty[k1] == "log") do
				k1 += 1
			end
			local a = V(pts[math.max(1, k - 1)])
			local b = V(pts[k1])
			local L = (b - a).Magnitude
			local bm = Kit.model(pf, (pc.kind == "log") and "Log" or "RopeBridge")
			local cf = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b)
			if pc.kind == "log" then
				D_(bm, { Name = "Log", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(L + 4, 3.2, 3.2), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, -1.6, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.darkWood })
				D_(bm, { Name = "Moss", Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 0.25, L * 0.6), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0.4, 0.02, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Grass, Color = COL.lakeMoss })
				P_(bm, { Name = "LogWalk", Size = Vector3.new(2.6, 0.6, L + 5), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, -0.3, 0), Transparency = 1 }).CastShadow = false
			else
				P_(bm, { Name = "Planks", Size = Vector3.new(3.2, 0.5, L + 2), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, -0.25, 0), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.darkWood })
				local right = cf.RightVector
				for _, sg in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
					local A, B = a + right * 1.9 * sg + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), b + right * 1.9 * sg + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
					D_(bm, { Name = "Handrope", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new((B - A).Magnitude, 0.3, 0.3), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((A + B) / 2, B) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = COL.rope })
					for _, e in ipairs({ a, b }) do
						P_(bm, { Name = "Post", Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 4.2, 0.6), CFrame = CFrame.new(e + right * 1.9 * sg + Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.darkWood })
					end
				end
			end
			cnt.bridges += 1
		elseif pc.kind == "cleft" then
			-- boulders + leaning slabs at the slot sides (img3), moss tops; never on the tread line
			local cm = Kit.model(pf, "Cleft_" .. k)
			for q = 0, 5 do
				local kk = math.min(n, k + q * 6)
				local pq = V(pts[kk])
				local oq = outward(kk)
				local sd = (q % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1
				local bp = pq + oq * sd * ((wd[kk] or 4) / 2 + 2.6)
				local sz = Vector3.new(3.5 + (q % 3), 5 + (q % 2) * 3, 4 + (q % 2))
				P_(cm, { Name = "Boulder", Size = sz, CFrame = CFrame.new(bp + Vector3.new(0, sz.Y / 2 - 1.5, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0.15 * sd, q * 0.9, 0.12), Material = Enum.Material.Rock, Color = COL.gullyRock })
				D_(cm, { Name = "Moss", Size = Vector3.new(sz.X * 0.8, 0.3, sz.Z * 0.8), CFrame = CFrame.new(bp + Vector3.new(0, sz.Y - 1.35, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0.15 * sd, q * 0.9, 0.12), Material = Enum.Material.Grass, Color = COL.moss })
			end
			cnt.cleft += 1
		elseif pc.kind == "stairs" then
			cnt.stair += 1 -- blocks below
		elseif pc.kind == "pitch" or pc.kind == "chimney" then
			-- v6: a marked rock face (terrain Asphalt = climbable, CoreConfig.CLIMB.terrainMaterial) from the foot up to the
			-- top landing; chimney = the same face between two rock side walls. Cue: a fixed rope down one side.
			local top = V(pts[k + 1])
			local d = flat(top - p).Unit
			local rise = top.Y - p.Y
			local pm = Kit.model(pf, (pc.kind == "chimney" and "Chimney_" or "Pitch_") .. k)
			local off = spec.inward and (w / 2 - 0.2) or 1.2
			local base = p + d * off
			-- face front this far behind the grab plane; the face fill (after the air clear) overlaps the clear's far end, so
			-- the marked rock wins the shared voxels (FRONT 1.4 left natural rock in front where a gorge wall stood close).
			-- Chimney: the face stands 2.5 back in a 10-wide recess cut into the cliff, whose own rock is the slot's sides
			-- (built side walls rasterized wider than their boxes and wedged the climber, v6)
			local FRONT = (pc.kind == "chimney") and 2.5 or 0.6
			local faceD = math.max(4.4, flat(top - p).Magnitude - off - FRONT + 2)
			local faceC = base + d * (FRONT + faceD / 2) + Vector3.new(0, (rise + 1.8) / 2 - 2, 0)
			local fw = (pc.kind == "chimney") and 11 or (w + 6)
			local clearD = FRONT + 3
			-- clear from 1 above the foot to 10 above the top (a recess roofed by the cliff above its top blocked the mantle)
			local clearH = rise + ((pc.kind == "chimney") and 10 or 3)
			local airC = p + d * (off + FRONT - clearD / 2) + Vector3.new(0, 1 + clearH / 2, 0)
			T:FillBlock(CFrame.lookAt(airC, airC + d), Vector3.new(fw - 1, clearH, clearD), Enum.Material.Air)
			T:FillBlock(CFrame.lookAt(faceC, faceC + d), Vector3.new(fw, rise + 1.8, faceD), MARK)
			local right = d:Cross(UP)
			-- fixed rope (cue only): anchored at the top edge, hanging down the face's right side
			local rx = right * ((pc.kind == "chimney") and 1.6 or (fw / 2 - 1.2))
			local A_ = base + d * (FRONT - 0.3) + rx + Vector3.new(0, rise + 1.2, 0)
			local B_ = base + d * (FRONT - 0.5) + rx + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0)
			D_(pm, { Name = "FixedRope", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new((A_ - B_).Magnitude, 0.25, 0.25), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((A_ + B_) / 2, A_) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = COL.ropeBright })
			for _, q in ipairs({ A_, B_:Lerp(A_, 0.5) }) do
				D_(pm, { Name = "Piton", Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.9), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(q - d * 0.2, q + d), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, Color = COL.snowRock })
			end
			flag(top + d * 3 + right * (w / 2 + 0.6), o)
			cnt.pitches = (cnt.pitches or 0) + 1
			cnt.climbRise = (cnt.climbRise or 0) + rise
			track[#track + 1] = {
				id = (pc.kind == "chimney" and "C" or "P") .. k,
				s0 = S[math.max(1, k - 3)],
				s1 = S[math.min(n, k + 4)],
				nodes = {
					{ k = "walk", p = { pts[math.max(1, k - 3)][1], pts[math.max(1, k - 3)][3] + 3, pts[math.max(1, k - 3)][2] } },
					{ k = "walk", p = { p.X, p.Y + 3, p.Z } },
					{ k = "walk", p = { p.X + d.X * (off + FRONT - 1.2), p.Y + 3, p.Z + d.Z * (off + FRONT - 1.2) } },
					{ k = "climb", into = { d.X, 0, d.Z }, label = pc.kind .. k },
					{ k = "walk", p = { pts[math.min(n, k + 4)][1], pts[math.min(n, k + 4)][3] + 3, pts[math.min(n, k + 4)][2] } },
				},
			}
		elseif pc.kind == "steps" then
			-- v6: rock blocks to jump up (or step down) between the foot and the top landing; the terrain under them is
			-- the lower end's height (SplineGen), so the blocks are the only way
			local top = V(pts[k + 1])
			local dv = flat(top - p)
			local L = dv.Magnitude
			local d = dv.Unit
			local rise = top.Y - p.Y
			local nB = math.ceil(math.abs(rise) / SG.STEP_H)
			local hs = rise / nB
			local floorY = math.min(p.Y, top.Y)
			local sm = Kit.model(pf, "Steps_" .. k)
			local nodes = { { k = "walk", p = { p.X - d.X * 3, p.Y + 3, p.Z - d.Z * 3 } }, { k = "walk", p = { p.X, p.Y + 3, p.Z } } }
			local up = rise > 0
			local stepLen = up and (L - 0.5) / nB or L / nB
			for j = 1, up and nB or (nB - 1) do
				local along = up and (0.5 + (j - 0.5) * stepLen) or ((j - 0.5) * stepLen)
				local ty_ = p.Y + j * hs
				local bot = floorY - 3
				local c = p + d * along
				local jit = ((k * 7 + j * 13) % 5 - 2) * 0.15
				local sz = Vector3.new(w + 1 + jit, ty_ - bot, stepLen + 0.5)
				if up and j == nB then
					-- the last block reaches 3 on into the top landing (the cells between the steps' floor and the landing
					-- are neither: a 10-deep hole after the last block, east-bank steps, v6)
					sz = Vector3.new(sz.X, sz.Y, sz.Z + 3)
					c = c + d * 1.5
				end
				local b = P_(sm, { Name = "Step", Size = sz, CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(c.X, bot + sz.Y / 2, c.Z), Vector3.new(c.X, bot + sz.Y / 2, c.Z) + d) * CFrame.Angles(0, jit * 0.1, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Rock, Color = (j % 2 == 0) and COL.fogRock or COL.gullyRock })
				b.CastShadow = false
				nodes[#nodes + 1] = { k = up and "jump" or "walk", p = { c.X, ty_ + 3, c.Z } }
			end
			-- ascending: on past the top edge; descending: the bottom itself (a gorge floor leaves no room to overshoot)
			local over = up and 2 or 0
			nodes[#nodes + 1] = { k = up and "jump" or "walk", p = { top.X + d.X * over, top.Y + 3, top.Z + d.Z * over } }
			nodes[#nodes + 1] = { k = "walk", p = { pts[math.min(n, k + 4)][1], pts[math.min(n, k + 4)][3] + 3, pts[math.min(n, k + 4)][2] } }
			cnt.steps = (cnt.steps or 0) + 1
			track[#track + 1] = { id = "S" .. k, s0 = S[math.max(1, k - 2)], s1 = S[math.min(n, k + 4)], nodes = nodes }
		end
	end

	------------------------------------------------ v6 segment pieces: jump gaps, hand traverses, stepping stones
	do
		local gf = Kit.folder(f, "Gaps")
		local k = 1
		while k < n do
			local t = ty[k]
			if t == "jump" or t == "traverse" or t == "ford" then
				local k1 = k
				while k1 < n and ty[k1] == t do
					k1 += 1
				end
				-- span: from the node sample where the run starts to the first sample after it
				local A = V(pts[k])
				local B = V(pts[k1])
				local d = flat(B - A).Unit
				local L = flat(B - A).Magnitude
				local w = wd[k] or 4
				local o = outward(k)
				local y = A.Y
				local right = d:Cross(UP)
				if t == "jump" or t == "traverse" then
					-- the gap itself is open in the field (SplineGen); here only a shallow clean-up of voxel rounding between
					-- the lips, never inward of the tread (deeper carves went through the terrain shell, v6)
					local mid = (A + B) / 2
					local cc = Vector3.new(mid.X, y - 2.5, mid.Z) + o * 2
					T:FillBlock(CFrame.lookAt(cc, cc + d), Vector3.new(w + 4, 6, math.max(1, L - 1)), Enum.Material.Air)
					-- rock lips: crisp take-off and landing edges
					local lm = Kit.model(gf, ((t == "jump") and "Jump_" or "Traverse_") .. k)
					for _, e in ipairs({ { A - d * 1.1, "Takeoff" }, { B + d * 1.1, "Landing" } }) do
						local c = e[1] + o * 0.6
						local lp = P_(lm, { Name = e[2], Size = Vector3.new(w + 2.5, 3, 2.6), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(c.X, y - 1.35, c.Z), Vector3.new(c.X, y - 1.35, c.Z) + d), Material = Enum.Material.Rock, Color = COL.gullyRock })
						lp.CastShadow = false
					end
					if t == "jump" then
						cnt.jumps = (cnt.jumps or 0) + 1
						track[#track + 1] = {
							id = "J" .. k,
							s0 = S[math.max(1, k - 3)],
							s1 = S[math.min(n, k1 + 3)],
							nodes = {
								{ k = "walk", p = { A.X - d.X * 4, y + 3, A.Z - d.Z * 4 } },
								{ k = "jump", p = { B.X + d.X * 2.5, y + 3, B.Z + d.Z * 2.5 } },
								{ k = "walk", p = { pts[math.min(n, k1 + 3)][1], pts[math.min(n, k1 + 3)][3] + 3, pts[math.min(n, k1 + 3)][2] } },
							},
						}
					else
						-- marked slab on the inner side (the climber's root hangs ~1.55 from its face), 4 past each end (a
						-- walker stopping a little short of the gap still has it beside them)
						local inner = -o
						local sc = (A + B) / 2 + inner * (1.55 + 2) + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
						local slab = P_(lm, { Name = "TraverseSlab", Size = Vector3.new(4, 11, L + 8), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(sc, sc + d), Material = Enum.Material.Slate, Color = COL.gullyRock })
						slab:SetAttribute("Climbable", true)
						-- cue: a handline of fixed rope along the slab
						local a2, b2 = A - d * 2 + inner * 1.4 + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0), B + d * 2 + inner * 1.4 + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)
						D_(lm, { Name = "FixedRope", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new((b2 - a2).Magnitude, 0.25, 0.25), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((a2 + b2) / 2, b2) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = COL.ropeBright })
						cnt.traverses = (cnt.traverses or 0) + 1
						track[#track + 1] = {
							id = "T" .. k,
							s0 = S[math.max(1, k - 3)],
							s1 = S[math.min(n, k1 + 3)],
							nodes = {
								{ k = "walk", p = { A.X - d.X * 0.6, y + 3, A.Z - d.Z * 0.6 } },
								{ k = "climb", into = { inner.X, 0, inner.Z }, dir = { d.X, 0, d.Z }, label = "traverse" .. k },
								{ k = "walk", p = { pts[math.min(n, k1 + 3)][1], pts[math.min(n, k1 + 3)][3] + 3, pts[math.min(n, k1 + 3)][2] } },
							},
						}
					end
				else
					-- ford: stepping stones every ~4.2 studs over the stream (tops at the line height)
					local sm = Kit.model(gf, "Ford_" .. k)
					local ns = math.max(1, math.floor(L / 4.2))
					local nodes = { { k = "walk", p = { A.X - d.X * 2, y + 3, A.Z - d.Z * 2 } } }
					for j = 1, ns do
						local c = A:Lerp(B, j / (ns + 1))
						local cy = A.Y + (B.Y - A.Y) * j / (ns + 1)
						local st = P_(sm, { Name = "Stone", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(6, 3.2, 3.2), CFrame = CFrame.new(c.X, cy - 3, c.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Material = Enum.Material.Rock, Color = COL.gullyRock })
						st.CastShadow = false
						D_(sm, { Name = "Moss", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 2.2, 2.2), CFrame = CFrame.new(c.X, cy + 0.05, c.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Material = Enum.Material.Grass, Color = COL.moss })
						nodes[#nodes + 1] = { k = "jump", p = { c.X, cy + 3, c.Z } }
					end
					-- (no jump to the far bank: a pitch foot stands right there and a jump at it grabbed the face; the next
					-- track segment walks on from the last stone)
					cnt.fords = (cnt.fords or 0) + 1
					track[#track + 1] = { id = "F" .. k, s0 = S[math.max(1, k - 2)], s1 = S[math.min(n, k1 + 2)], nodes = nodes }
				end
				k = k1
			else
				k += 1
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(track, function(a, b)
		return a.s0 < b.s0
	end)

	------------------------------------------------ boulder-stair blocks (every stair sample run of ~2.4 studs)
	local sf = Kit.folder(f, "Stair")
	local lastS = -1e9
	for k = 1, n - 1 do
		if ty[k] == "stair" and S[k] - lastS >= 2.4 then
			lastS = S[k]
			local p = V(pts[k])
			local _, dir = outward(k)
			local w = wd[k] or 4
			local gy = Gen.heightAt(p.X, p.Z)
			local bot = math.min(gy, p.Y - 2) - 2
			local h = p.Y - bot
			local b = P_(sf, { Name = "Block", Size = Vector3.new(w + 1, h, 2.8), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(p.X, bot + h / 2, p.Z), Vector3.new(p.X, bot + h / 2, p.Z) + dir) * CFrame.Angles(0, (k % 3 - 1) * 0.05, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Rock, Color = COL.fogRock })
			b.CastShadow = false
		end
	end

	------------------------------------------------ guide flags along the line (every ~180 studs) + track export
	local nextS = 90
	for k = 1, n do
		if S[k] >= nextS and (ty[k] == "ledge" or ty[k] == "slot" or ty[k] == "ridge") then
			nextS = S[k] + 180
			local o = outward(k)
			local p = V(pts[k])
			flag(p - o * ((wd[k] or 4) / 2 + 0.5), o)
		end
	end
	local tf2 = RS:FindFirstChild("CC_Track") or Instance.new("Folder")
	tf2.Name = "CC_Track"
	tf2.Parent = RS
	local sv = tf2:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new("StringValue")
	sv.Name = name
	sv.Value = HS:JSONEncode(track)
	sv.Parent = tf2
	R.rests = rests
	local parts = 0
	for _, d in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			parts += 1
		end
	end
	return string.format("%s: %d instances (%d parts) | tread %d, rails %d, ladders %d, stairs %d, bridges %d, rests %d, cairns %d, flags %d, clefts %d | v6: pitches %d (rise %d), steps %d, jumps %d, traverses %d, fords %d",
		name, #f:GetDescendants(), parts, cnt.tread, cnt.rail, cnt.ladders, cnt.stair, cnt.bridges, cnt.rests, cnt.cairns, cnt.flags, cnt.cleft,
		cnt.pitches or 0, cnt.climbRise or 0, cnt.steps or 0, cnt.jumps or 0, cnt.traverses or 0, cnt.fords or 0)
end

return SK

-- Store (ServerScriptService.CC_CoreServer): persistence adapter. Profile code only sees this interface:
--   store:read(key)        -> ok, value|nil, err
--   store:update(key, fn)  -> ok, value|nil, err   fn(old) returns the new value, or nil to cancel the write
--                            (UpdateAsync semantics: fn may run more than once; keep it free of side effects
--                            other than setting locals the caller resets before each call).
-- Two implementations:
--   Store.datastore(name)  real DataStoreService (UNVERIFIED: the place is unpublished, PlaceId = 0)
--   Store.memory(opts)     in-memory mock for Studio + tests. Values round-trip through JSON like a DataStore,
--                          so non-serializable data fails here too. Failure injection: failNext (n calls),
--                          failAll (bool), latency (s), conflicts (n: run fn twice to mimic a retried write).
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local Store = {}

---------------------------------------------------------------- memory mock
local Memory = {}
Memory.__index = Memory

function Store.memory(opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	return setmetatable({
		kind = "memory",
		backend = opts.backend or {}, -- share one backend between two "servers" in tests
		failNext = 0,
		failAll = false,
		latency = opts.latency or 0,
		conflicts = 0,
		failAfterCommit = 0, -- response lost AFTER durable write; exercises uncertain outcome replay
		calls = { read = 0, update = 0, failed = 0 },
	}, Memory)
end

function Memory:_gate(kind)
	self.calls[kind] += 1
	if self.latency > 0 then
		task.wait(self.latency)
	end
	if self.failAll then
		self.calls.failed += 1
		return false, "mock: store unavailable (failAll)"
	end
	if self.failNext > 0 then
		self.failNext -= 1
		self.calls.failed += 1
		return false, "mock: store request failed (failNext)"
	end
	return true
end

function Memory:read(key)
	local ok, err = self:_gate("read")
	if not ok then
		return false, nil, err
	end
	local raw = self.backend[key]
	return true, raw and HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) or nil, nil
end

function Memory:update(key, fn)
	local ok, err = self:_gate("update")
	if not ok then
		return false, nil, err
	end
	local runs = 1 + math.max(0, self.conflicts)
	self.conflicts = 0
	local new
	for _ = 1, runs do
		local raw = self.backend[key]
		local old = raw and HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) or nil
		local okFn, res = pcall(fn, old)
		if not okFn then
			return false, nil, "transform error: " .. tostring(res)
		end
		new = res
	end
	if new == nil then
		local raw = self.backend[key]
		return true, raw and HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) or nil, "cancelled"
	end
	local okEnc, enc = pcall(HttpService.JSONEncode, HttpService, new)
	if not okEnc then
		return false, nil, "serialize: " .. tostring(enc)
	end
	self.backend[key] = enc
	if self.failAfterCommit > 0 then
		self.failAfterCommit -= 1
		return false, nil, "mock: response lost after commit"
	end
	return true, HttpService:JSONDecode(enc), nil
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- real DataStore (UNVERIFIED in Studio)
local DS = {}
DS.__index = DS

function Store.datastore(name)
	local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
	local ok, ds = pcall(DataStoreService.GetDataStore, DataStoreService, name)
	return setmetatable({ kind = "datastore", ds = ok and ds or nil, initErr = (not ok) and tostring(ds) or nil, service = DataStoreService }, DS)
end

function DS:_budget(reqType)
	-- wait (bounded) for request budget instead of letting the request throttle
	for _ = 1, 20 do
		local okB, b = pcall(self.service.GetRequestBudgetForRequestType, self.service, reqType)
		if not okB or b > 0 then
			return
		end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
end

function DS:read(key)
	if not self.ds then
		return false, nil, self.initErr
	end
	self:_budget(Enum.DataStoreRequestType.GetAsync)
	local ok, res = pcall(self.ds.GetAsync, self.ds, key)
	if not ok then
		return false, nil, tostring(res)
	end
	return true, res, nil
end

function DS:update(key, fn)
	if not self.ds then
		return false, nil, self.initErr
	end
	self:_budget(Enum.DataStoreRequestType.UpdateAsync)
	local cancelled = false
	local ok, res = pcall(self.ds.UpdateAsync, self.ds, key, function(old)
		local new = fn(old)
		cancelled = new == nil
		return new
	end)
	if not ok then
		return false, nil, tostring(res)
	end
	return true, res, cancelled and "cancelled" or nil
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- choice
-- Real DataStore only in a published place; Studio with PlaceId 0 cannot reach DataStores at all.
function Store.default(name)
	if game.PlaceId ~= 0 then
		return Store.datastore(name)
	end
	return Store.memory()
end

return Store

-- Profile (ServerScriptService.CC_CoreServer): persistent player profile, schema v2, behind the
-- Store adapter. Server-authoritative; the client never writes it.
-- Stored envelope per key:  { data = <profile>, lock = { job, session, at } | nil, meta = { lastSession, saves, updated } }
-- Session lock: load takes the lock with UpdateAsync; a live lock held by another server (refreshed by its
-- autosave within lockTTL) blocks the load (retried, then reported as "locked"). A stale lock is taken over.
-- Ownership check on every save: meta.lastSession must still be this session, otherwise another server has
-- loaded the profile since; this session is then marked lost and never writes again (no overwrite, no dupes).
-- Writes: autosave every 60 s (dirty sessions), on leave (lock released), on shutdown; retry with backoff.
-- Schema extensions beyond §3.9 (PROPOSED, logged): heartstones[].species/region, lockers, tx, flags,
-- lastTrip, stats, timers, quarantine.
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local C = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("CC_Core"):WaitForChild("CoreConfig"))
local Clock = require(script.Parent.Clock)
local H = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").CC_Core:WaitForChild("HomeConfig"))

local CommerceRules = require(script.Parent.CommerceRules)
local P = {}
P.__index = P
P.VERSION = 3

---------------------------------------------------------------- schema
function P.default()
	return {
		version = P.VERSION,
		commerce = CommerceRules.default(),
		coins = 0,
		xp = 0,
		level = 1,
		slots = C.SLOTS_BASE,
		bank = {}, -- { creatureId, species, rarity, mutation, acquiredAt, source }
		codex = {}, -- [speciesId] = count
		heartstones = {}, -- banked storage: { id, tier, species, mutation, progress, required, ready, discovery }
		habitats = { { id = "h1", slots = { "", "", "" } } }, -- LOCKED start: 1 habitat x 3 slots
		tents = {}, -- [campName] = tier (missing = 1)
		highestCamp = 0,
		dailyGoal = { day = 0, id = "", done = false },
		streak = 0,
		lastSeen = 0,
		cosmetics = {},
		-- extensions (PROPOSED)
		lockers = {}, -- [campName] = { item, ... } safe from falls, not banked
		tx = {}, -- last C.PERSIST.txKeep deposit transaction ids
		flags = { tutorial = 0, tutorialV = 0, firstBankAt = 0, netTier = "cloth", parachuteIntroduced = false, parachutePractice = false },
		lastTrip = { left = 0, at = 0 },
		stats = { banked = 0, falls = 0, shaken = 0, recovered = 0, lost = 0, hits = 0 },
		timers = {}, -- [key] = epoch seconds: per-player spawn claims, nest/pup respawns (rejoin can't reset them)
		quarantine = {}, -- entries that failed validation (kept, never silently deleted)
		cargo = {}, -- durable backpack; ownership transfers use transact
		drops = {}, -- durable recovery manifests, reconstructed after reconnect
		receipts = {}, -- durable transaction results; item discovery ledger outlives receipt trimming
		discoveryCredited = {},
		memories = {},
		journal = {},
		expedition = {},
		settings = { textScale = 1, reducedMotion = false, timingAssist = true, headlampMode = "auto" },
		home = { decorations = {}, decorEquipped = {}, nests = { "", "" }, upgrade = 0, assigned = {}, favorites = {}, companion = "", uncollected = 0, settledAt = Clock.now() },
		-- v4 P4 (run 2, PROPOSED): Summit Points, owned / equipped cosmetics, earned kit, canisters, Training Yard,
		-- summits by route. Older profiles load with these defaults (no migration needed: sanitize fills them).
		gear = {
			points = 0,
			owned = {}, -- [shopId] = true
			equipped = { head = "", eyes = "", body = "" },
			kit = {}, -- [kitId] = true (bought at the Forge; level unlocks are computed, not stored)
			canisters = 0,
			training = { level = 0, lastAt = 0, unlocked = {}, completed = {} },
			summits = {}, -- [route] = count
		},
	}
end

local function deepCopy(t)
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return t
	end
	local o = {}
	for k, v in pairs(t) do
		o[k] = deepCopy(v)
	end
	return o
end
P.deepCopy = deepCopy

local function num(v, d)
	return (type(v) == "number" and v == v and v ~= math.huge and v ~= -math.huge) and v or d
end
local function str(v, d)
	return type(v) == "string" and v or d
end

function P.discovery(it, fallbackId)
	local v = type(it.discovery) == "table" and it.discovery or {}
	local source = str(it.source, "")
	if source == "" then source = "Unknown original location" end
	return {
		id = str(v.id, fallbackId or it.uid or it.id or it.creatureId or ""),
		place = str(v.place, source),
		method = str(v.method, (it.kind == "heartstone" or it.tier ~= nil or it.source == "heartstone") and "heartstone" or "encounter"),
		at = num(v.at, num(it.acquiredAt, num(it.startedAt, 0))),
	}
end

-- an unbanked item (locker contents): rebuilt from validated fields only, or nil if malformed
function P.cleanItem(it)
	if type(it) ~= "table" or type(it.uid) ~= "string" or type(it.species) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	if it.kind == "heartstone" then
		if not C.RIPEN_SECONDS[it.tier] then
			return nil
		end
	elseif it.kind ~= "creature" or not C.RANK[it.rarity] then
		return nil
	end
	return {
		uid = it.uid,
		kind = it.kind,
		species = it.species,
		rarity = it.kind == "creature" and it.rarity or nil,
		tier = it.kind == "heartstone" and it.tier or nil,
		mutation = str(it.mutation, ""),
		region = num(it.region, 1),
		slots = it.kind == "heartstone" and C.HEARTSTONE_SLOTS or 1,
		acquiredAt = num(it.acquiredAt, 0),
		source = str(it.source, ""),
		discovery = P.discovery(it, it.uid),
		travel = type(it.travel) == "table" and deepCopy(it.travel) or nil,
	}
end

-- Keep every valid field, fill missing ones, move malformed list entries to quarantine (never delete).
function P.sanitize(d)
	local def = P.default()
	if type(d) ~= "table" then
		return def, 1
	end
	local fixes = 0
	local out = def
	out.version = P.VERSION
	out.commerce = CommerceRules.sanitize(d.commerce)
	out.coins = math.max(0, math.floor(num(d.coins, 0)))
	out.xp = math.max(0, math.floor(num(d.xp, 0)))
	out.level = math.clamp(math.floor(num(d.level, 1)), 1, #C.LEVEL_XP)
	out.slots = math.clamp(math.floor(num(d.slots, C.SLOTS_BASE)), C.SLOTS_BASE, C.SLOTS_MAX)
	out.highestCamp = math.clamp(math.floor(num(d.highestCamp, 0)), 0, #C.RESUME_CAMPS)
	out.streak = math.max(0, math.floor(num(d.streak, 0)))
	out.lastSeen = num(d.lastSeen, 0)
	local q = type(d.quarantine) == "table" and d.quarantine or {}
	local seen = {}
	for _, b in ipairs(type(d.bank) == "table" and d.bank or {}) do
		if type(b) == "table" and type(b.creatureId) == "string" and type(b.species) == "string" and not seen[b.creatureId] then
			seen[b.creatureId] = true
			out.bank[#out.bank + 1] = { creatureId = b.creatureId, species = b.species, rarity = str(b.rarity, "Common"), mutation = str(b.mutation, ""), acquiredAt = num(b.acquiredAt, 0), source = str(b.source, ""), discovery = P.discovery(b, b.creatureId) }
		else
			q[#q + 1] = { where = "bank", value = b }
			fixes += 1
		end
	end
	for k, v in pairs(type(d.codex) == "table" and d.codex or {}) do
		if type(k) == "string" and type(v) == "number" then
			out.codex[k] = math.max(0, math.floor(v))
		end
	end
	local hsSeen = {}
	for _, h in ipairs(type(d.heartstones) == "table" and d.heartstones or {}) do
		if type(h) == "table" and type(h.id) == "string" and H.stoneProgress[h.tier] and not hsSeen[h.id] and not seen[h.id] then
			hsSeen[h.id] = true
			local required = math.max(1, num(h.required, H.stoneProgress[h.tier]))
			local progress = math.clamp(num(h.progress, 0), 0, required)
			out.heartstones[#out.heartstones + 1] = { id = h.id, tier = h.tier, mutation = str(h.mutation, ""), species = str(h.species, ""), region = num(h.region, 1), progress = progress, required = required, ready = h.ready == true or progress >= required, acquiredAt = num(h.acquiredAt, num(h.startedAt, 0)), source = str(h.source, ""), discovery = P.discovery(h, h.id) }
		else
			q[#q + 1] = { where = "heartstones", value = h }
			fixes += 1
		end
	end
	if type(d.habitats) == "table" and #d.habitats > 0 then
		out.habitats = {}
		for i, h in ipairs(d.habitats) do
			if type(h) == "table" and type(h.slots) == "table" then
				local slots = {}
				for _, s in ipairs(h.slots) do
					slots[#slots + 1] = str(s, "")
				end
				out.habitats[#out.habitats + 1] = { id = str(h.id, "h" .. i), slots = slots }
			end
		end
		if #out.habitats == 0 then
			out.habitats = def.habitats
		end
	end
	for k, v in pairs(type(d.tents) == "table" and d.tents or {}) do
		if type(k) == "string" and type(v) == "number" then
			out.tents[k] = math.clamp(math.floor(v), 1, 3)
		end
	end
	if type(d.dailyGoal) == "table" then
		out.dailyGoal = { day = num(d.dailyGoal.day, 0), id = str(d.dailyGoal.id, ""), done = d.dailyGoal.done == true }
	end
	for _, c in ipairs(type(d.cosmetics) == "table" and d.cosmetics or {}) do
		if type(c) == "string" then
			out.cosmetics[#out.cosmetics + 1] = c
		end
	end
	for camp, items in pairs(type(d.lockers) == "table" and d.lockers or {}) do
		if type(camp) == "string" and type(items) == "table" then
			local list = {}
			for _, it in ipairs(items) do
				local clean = P.cleanItem(it)
				if clean then
					list[#list + 1] = clean
				else
					q[#q + 1] = { where = "locker:" .. camp, value = it }
					fixes += 1
				end
			end
			out.lockers[camp] = list
		end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(type(d.tx) == "table" and d.tx or {}) do
		if type(t) == "string" then
			out.tx[#out.tx + 1] = t
		end
	end
	if type(d.flags) == "table" then
		out.flags.tutorial = math.max(0, math.floor(num(d.flags.tutorial, 0)))
		out.flags.tutorialV = math.max(0, math.floor(num(d.flags.tutorialV, 0)))
		out.flags.firstBankAt = num(d.flags.firstBankAt, 0)
		out.flags.netTier = C.NET_TIERS[d.flags.netTier] and d.flags.netTier or "cloth"
		out.flags.parachuteIntroduced = d.flags.parachuteIntroduced == true
		out.flags.parachutePractice = d.flags.parachutePractice == true
	end
	if type(d.lastTrip) == "table" then
		out.lastTrip = { left = math.max(0, math.floor(num(d.lastTrip.left, 0))), at = num(d.lastTrip.at, 0) }
	end
	for k, v in pairs(type(d.timers) == "table" and d.timers or {}) do
		if type(k) == "string" and #k <= 64 and type(v) == "number" then
			out.timers[k] = v
		end
	end
	if type(d.stats) == "table" then
		for k in pairs(out.stats) do
			out.stats[k] = math.max(0, math.floor(num(d.stats[k], 0)))
		end
	end
	if type(d.gear) == "table" then
		local g, og = d.gear, out.gear
		og.points = math.max(0, math.floor(num(g.points, 0)))
		local shop = {}
		for _, it in ipairs(C.SHOP or {}) do
			shop[it.id] = it
		end
		for id, v in pairs(type(g.owned) == "table" and g.owned or {}) do
			if shop[id] and v == true then
				og.owned[id] = true
			end
		end
		for _, slot in ipairs({ "head", "eyes", "body" }) do
			local id = type(g.equipped) == "table" and g.equipped[slot]
			og.equipped[slot] = (type(id) == "string" and og.owned[id] and shop[id].slot == slot) and id or ""
		end
		for id, v in pairs(type(g.kit) == "table" and g.kit or {}) do
			if C.KIT and C.KIT[id] and v == true then
				og.kit[id] = true
			end
		end
		og.canisters = math.clamp(math.floor(num(g.canisters, 0)), 0, C.CANISTER and C.CANISTER.max or 3)
		if type(g.training) == "table" then
			og.training.level = math.clamp(math.floor(num(g.training.level, 0)), 0, C.TRAINING and #C.TRAINING.gains or 5)
			og.training.lastAt = num(g.training.lastAt, 0)
			og.training.unlocked = type(g.training.unlocked) == "table" and deepCopy(g.training.unlocked) or {}
			og.training.completed = type(g.training.completed) == "table" and deepCopy(g.training.completed) or {}
		end
		for route, n in pairs(type(g.summits) == "table" and g.summits or {}) do
			if type(route) == "string" and #route <= 24 and type(n) == "number" then
				og.summits[route] = math.max(0, math.floor(n))
			end
		end
	end
	-- Persistent cargo and recovery state. One identity can occupy only one container.
	local owned = {}
	for id in pairs(seen) do owned[id] = true end
	for id in pairs(hsSeen) do owned[id] = true end
	local function cleanList(list, where)
		local result = {}
		for _, it in ipairs(type(list) == "table" and list or {}) do
			local clean = P.cleanItem(it)
			if clean and not owned[clean.uid] then
				owned[clean.uid] = true
				result[#result + 1] = clean
			else
				q[#q + 1] = { where = where, value = it }
				fixes += 1
			end
		end
		return result
	end
	-- Lockers were parsed above; apply the cross-container identity check here.
	for camp, list in pairs(out.lockers) do out.lockers[camp] = cleanList(list, "locker:" .. camp) end
	out.cargo = cleanList(d.cargo, "cargo")
	local dropSeen = {}
	for _, drop in ipairs(type(d.drops) == "table" and d.drops or {}) do
		if type(drop) == "table" and type(drop.id) == "string" and not dropSeen[drop.id]
			and type(drop.items) == "table" and num(drop.expiresAt, nil) and drop.expiresAt >= 0
			and type(drop.pos) == "table" and num(drop.pos.x, nil) and num(drop.pos.y, nil) and num(drop.pos.z, nil) then
			dropSeen[drop.id] = true
			local copied = deepCopy(drop)
			copied.items = cleanList(drop.items, "drop:" .. drop.id)
			out.drops[#out.drops + 1] = copied
		else
			q[#q + 1] = { where = "drops", value = drop }
			fixes += 1
		end
	end
	for _, receipt in ipairs(type(d.receipts) == "table" and d.receipts or {}) do
		if type(receipt) == "table" and type(receipt.id) == "string" and type(receipt.result) == "table" then
			out.receipts[#out.receipts + 1] = deepCopy(receipt)
		end
	end
	for id, value in pairs(type(d.discoveryCredited) == "table" and d.discoveryCredited or {}) do
		if type(id) == "string" and value == true then out.discoveryCredited[id] = true end
	end
	for _, entry in ipairs(out.bank) do out.discoveryCredited[entry.discovery.id] = true end
	for _, entry in ipairs(out.heartstones) do out.discoveryCredited[entry.discovery.id] = true end
	for species, memory in pairs(type(d.memories) == "table" and d.memories or {}) do
		if type(species) == "string" and type(memory) == "table" then out.memories[species] = P.discovery({ discovery = memory }) end
	end
	for _, entry in ipairs(out.bank) do
		if not out.memories[entry.species] then out.memories[entry.species] = deepCopy(entry.discovery) end
	end
	out.journal = type(d.journal) == "table" and deepCopy(d.journal) or {}
	out.expedition = type(d.expedition) == "table" and deepCopy(d.expedition) or {}
	if type(d.settings) == "table" then
		out.settings.textScale = math.clamp(num(d.settings.textScale, 1), 0.9, 1.4)
		out.settings.reducedMotion = d.settings.reducedMotion == true
		out.settings.timingAssist = d.settings.timingAssist ~= false
		out.settings.headlampMode = table.find({ "auto", "on", "off" }, d.settings.headlampMode) and d.settings.headlampMode or "auto"
	end
	if type(d.home) == "table" then
		local home = d.home
		out.home.decorations.lamp = type(home.decorations) == "table" and home.decorations.lamp == true or nil
		out.home.decorEquipped.lamp = out.home.decorations.lamp and type(home.decorEquipped) == "table" and home.decorEquipped.lamp == true or nil
		out.home.upgrade = math.clamp(math.floor(num(home.upgrade, 0)), 0, H.maxUpgrade)
		out.home.uncollected = math.max(0, num(home.uncollected, 0))
		out.home.settledAt = num(home.settledAt, num(d.lastSeen, Clock.now()))
		local nestSeen, assignmentSeen = {}, {}
		for i = 1, H.nestCount do
			local id = type(home.nests) == "table" and home.nests[i]
			if type(id) == "string" and hsSeen[id] and not nestSeen[id] then out.home.nests[i], nestSeen[id] = id, true end
		end
		for i = 1, H.baseSpaces + out.home.upgrade do
			local id = type(home.assigned) == "table" and home.assigned[i]
			out.home.assigned[i] = type(id) == "string" and seen[id] and not assignmentSeen[id] and id or ""
			if out.home.assigned[i] ~= "" then assignmentSeen[id] = true end
		end
		for id, fav in pairs(type(home.favorites) == "table" and home.favorites or {}) do
			if seen[id] and fav == true then out.home.favorites[id] = true end
		end
		out.home.companion = seen[home.companion] and home.companion or ""
	end
	out.quarantine = q
	return out, fixes
end

-- version migrations: MIGRATIONS[v] upgrades a v-profile to v+1 (v0 = pre-schema / missing version)
local MIGRATIONS = {
	[2] = function(d) d.commerce = CommerceRules.sanitize(d.commerce); d.version = 3; return d end,
	[0] = function(d)
		d.version = 1
		return d
	end,
	[1] = function(d)
		local now = Clock.now()
		for _, stone in ipairs(type(d.heartstones) == "table" and d.heartstones or {}) do
			if type(stone) == "table" and H.stoneProgress[stone.tier] then
				local total = C.RIPEN_SECONDS[stone.tier]
				local readyAt = num(stone.readyAt, now + total)
				local startedAt = num(stone.startedAt, readyAt - total)
				local fraction = math.clamp((now - startedAt) / math.max(1, readyAt - startedAt), 0, 1)
				stone.required = H.stoneProgress[stone.tier]
				stone.progress = math.max(num(stone.progress, 0), fraction * stone.required)
				stone.ready = stone.ready == true or readyAt <= now or stone.progress >= stone.required
				stone.discovery = P.discovery(stone, stone.id)
			end
		end
		d.version = 2
		return d
	end,
}
function P.migrate(d)
	if type(d) ~= "table" then
		return P.default()
	end
	local v = math.floor(num(d.version, 0))
	while v < P.VERSION do
		local m = MIGRATIONS[v]
		if not m then
			break
		end
		d = m(d)
		v = math.floor(num(d.version, v + 1))
	end
	return d
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- service
-- P.new(store, { jobId = string, now = fn }) -> profile service (one per server; tests make two to act as two servers)
function P.new(store, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	return setmetatable({
		store = store,
		jobId = opts.jobId or ((game.JobId ~= "" and game.JobId) or ("studio-" .. HttpService:GenerateGUID(false))),
		loadTries = opts.loadTries or C.PERSIST.loadTries,
		lockWait = opts.lockWait or C.PERSIST.lockWait,
		saveTries = opts.saveTries or C.PERSIST.saveTries,
		backoff = opts.backoff or 1,
		lockTTL = opts.lockTTL or C.PERSIST.lockTTL,
		active = {}, -- [userId] = live session on this server
		log = {},
	}, P)
end

function P:_log(s)
	self.log[#self.log + 1] = s
	if #self.log > 200 then
		table.remove(self.log, 1)
	end
end

function P:key(userId)
	return C.PERSIST.keyPrefix .. tostring(userId)
end

-- load(userId) -> session | nil, reason ("locked" | "store" | "error"), detail
function P:load(userId)
	local key = self:key(userId)
	local sessionId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local lastErr, lockedBy = nil, nil
	for attempt = 1, self.loadTries do
		local blocked, fixes, newer = nil, 0, false
		local now = Clock.now()
		local ok, env, err = self.store:update(key, function(old)
			blocked, newer = nil, false
			old = type(old) == "table" and old or {}
			-- a profile written by a newer build: never downgrade or strip it on an older server
			if type(old.data) == "table" and num(old.data.version, 0) > P.VERSION then
				newer = true
				return nil
			end
			local lock = old.lock
			-- a live lock blocks, unless it is this server's own lock and that session is no longer active here
			-- (fast rejoin after a release that failed to reach the store)
			local ownDead = type(lock) == "table" and lock.job == self.jobId and not self.active[userId]
			if type(lock) == "table" and lock.session ~= sessionId and type(lock.at) == "number" and now - lock.at < self.lockTTL and not ownDead then
				blocked = lock
				return nil
			end
			local data, f = P.sanitize(P.migrate(old.data))
			fixes = f
			local meta = type(old.meta) == "table" and old.meta or {}
			return {
				data = data,
				lock = { job = self.jobId, session = sessionId, at = now },
				meta = { lastSession = sessionId, saves = num(meta.saves, 0), updated = num(meta.updated, 0), stoleFrom = (type(lock) == "table" and lock.session) or nil },
			}
		end)
		if ok and not blocked and type(env) == "table" and type(env.meta) == "table" and env.meta.lastSession == sessionId then
			local s = {
				owner = self,
				userId = userId,
				key = key,
				sessionId = sessionId,
				data = env.data,
				outcomePending = #(env.data.expedition.outcomes or {}) > 0,
				loadedAt = now,
				dirty = fixes > 0,
				lost = false,
				released = false,
				saving = false,
				lastSave = now,
				fixes = fixes,
				stoleLock = env.meta.stoleFrom ~= nil,
			}
			self:_log(string.format("load %s ok attempt %d fixes %d stole %s", key, attempt, fixes, tostring(s.stoleLock)))
			self.active[userId] = s
			return s
		end
		if ok and newer then
			self:_log(string.format("load %s refused: stored schema is newer than v%d", key, P.VERSION))
			return nil, "newer"
		end
		if ok and blocked then
			lockedBy = blocked
			self:_log(string.format("load %s blocked by live lock %s (attempt %d)", key, tostring(blocked.job), attempt))
			task.wait(self.lockWait)
		else
			lastErr = err
			self:_log(string.format("load %s store error (attempt %d): %s", key, attempt, tostring(err)))
			task.wait(math.min(8, self.backoff * 2 ^ (attempt - 1)))
		end
	end
	if lockedBy then
		return nil, "locked", lockedBy
	end
	return nil, "store", lastErr
end

-- save(session, release) -> ok, reason. release = clear the lock (leave/shutdown). Never writes after loss.
function P:save(session, release)
	if session.lost then return false, "lost" end
	if session.pending then
		local recovered = self:recover(session)
		if not recovered.ok then return false, recovered.reason or "store" end
	end
	if session.lost then
		return false, "lost"
	end
	if session.released then
		return true, "released"
	end
	-- one write at a time per session (no cap: two overlapping writes could commit an older snapshot last)
	while session.saving do
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
	-- re-check: the write we waited on may have released or lost the profile
	if session.lost then
		return false, "lost"
	end
	if session.released then
		return true, "released"
	end
	session.saving = true
	session.data.lastSeen = Clock.now()
	local snapshot = deepCopy(session.data)
	local okSize, enc = pcall(HttpService.JSONEncode, HttpService, snapshot)
	if not okSize or #enc > C.PERSIST.maxBytes then
		session.saving = false
		self:_log("save refused: profile not serializable or too large")
		return false, "size"
	end
	local lastErr
	for attempt = 1, (release and self.saveTries or 1) do
		local lostTo = nil
		local now = Clock.now()
		local ok, _, err = self.store:update(session.key, function(old)
			lostTo = nil
			old = type(old) == "table" and old or {}
			local meta = type(old.meta) == "table" and old.meta or {}
			if meta.lastSession ~= session.sessionId then
				lostTo = meta.lastSession or "?"
				return nil
			end
			return {
				data = snapshot,
				lock = (not release) and { job = self.jobId, session = session.sessionId, at = now } or nil,
				meta = { lastSession = session.sessionId, saves = num(meta.saves, 0) + 1, updated = now },
			}
		end)
		if ok and lostTo then
			session.lost = true
			session.saving = false
			if self.active[session.userId] == session then
				self.active[session.userId] = nil
			end
			self:_log(string.format("save %s: ownership lost to session %s; not writing", session.key, tostring(lostTo)))
			return false, "lost"
		end
		if ok then
			session.saving = false
			session.lastSave = now
			-- Gameplay can mark a session dirty while an autosave yields. Do not erase that work.
			local okCurrent, current = pcall(HttpService.JSONEncode, HttpService, session.data)
			session.dirty = not okCurrent or current ~= enc
			if release then
				session.released = true
				if self.active[session.userId] == session then
					self.active[session.userId] = nil
				end
			end
			return true
		end
		lastErr = err
		self:_log(string.format("save %s failed (attempt %d): %s", session.key, attempt, tostring(err)))
		if attempt < (release and self.saveTries or 1) then
			task.wait(math.min(8, self.backoff * 2 ^ (attempt - 1)))
		end
	end
	session.saving = false
	return false, "store", lastErr
end

local function receipt(data, id)
	for _, r in ipairs(data.receipts or {}) do
		if r.id == id then return r.result end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Physical outcomes can occur while a store request yields. Keep their identities in both live/candidate
-- outboxes, then merge at confirmation; an unavailable store never turns a fall into a free cargo shield.
function P.queueOutcome(session, outcome)
	local function append(data)
		data.expedition = data.expedition or {}
		data.expedition.outcomes = data.expedition.outcomes or {}
		for _, old in ipairs(data.expedition.outcomes) do if old.id == outcome.id then return end end
		data.expedition.outcomes[#data.expedition.outcomes + 1] = deepCopy(outcome)
	end
	append(session.data)
	if session.pending then append(session.pending.candidate) end
	session.outcomePending, session.dirty = true, true
end

-- Returning to the mountain can interrupt a pending home mutation. A replayed durable receipt must not
-- restore an obsolete home doorway after that physical return has already happened.
function P.clearHomeReturn(session)
	session.data.expedition.homeReturn = nil
	if session.pending then
		session.pending.candidate.expedition.homeReturn = nil
		session.clearedHomeReturn = true
	end
	session.dirty = true
end

local function resultCopy(result, duplicate)
	local out = deepCopy(result)
	out.ok = true
	if duplicate then out.dup = true end
	return out
end

-- A transaction's candidate and receipt are ONE UpdateAsync write. A timeout may mean the write committed;
-- hold its candidate and block ownership changes until replay resolves that exact receipt. Never roll back an
-- uncertain result or create a new transaction id for it. Transform executes once locally, before any yield.
function P:transact(session, txId, transform)
	if not session or session.owner ~= self or session.lost or session.released or session.closing then
		return { ok = false, reason = "unavailable" }
	end
	if type(txId) ~= "string" or #txId < 4 or #txId > 128 or type(transform) ~= "function" then
		return { ok = false, reason = "badtx" }
	end
	if session.pending then
		if session.pending.id ~= txId then return { ok = false, reason = "pending", pending = true, txId = session.pending.id } end
		return self:recover(session)
	end
	while session.saving do task.wait(0.02) end
	if session.pending then return { ok = false, reason = "pending", pending = true, txId = session.pending.id } end
	if session.lost or session.released or session.closing then return { ok = false, reason = "unavailable" } end
	local prior = receipt(session.data, txId)
	if prior then return resultCopy(prior, true) end
	local candidate = deepCopy(session.data)
	local okFn, res = pcall(transform, candidate)
	if not okFn then
		self:_log("transaction transform failed: " .. tostring(res))
		return { ok = false, reason = "invalid" }
	end
	res = type(res) == "table" and res or { ok = true }
	if res.ok == false then return res end
	res.ok, res.txId = true, txId
	candidate.receipts = candidate.receipts or {}
	candidate.receipts[#candidate.receipts + 1] = { id = txId, result = deepCopy(res), at = Clock.now() }
	while #candidate.receipts > 96 do table.remove(candidate.receipts, 1) end
	candidate.lastSeen = Clock.now()
	local okEnc, enc = pcall(HttpService.JSONEncode, HttpService, candidate)
	if not okEnc or #enc > C.PERSIST.maxBytes then return { ok = false, reason = "size" } end
	session.pending = { id = txId, candidate = candidate, result = res }
	return self:recover(session)
end

function P:recover(session)
	if session and session.lost then return { ok = false, reason = "lost" } end
	if not session or session.released then return { ok = false, reason = "unavailable" } end
	while session.saving do task.wait(0.02) end
	local pending = session.pending
	if not pending then return { ok = true, recovered = false } end
	session.saving, session.committing = true, true
	for attempt = 1, self.saveTries do
		local lost, replayed = false, false
		local now = Clock.now()
		local ok, env, err = self.store:update(session.key, function(old)
			lost, replayed = false, false
			local meta = type(old) == "table" and old.meta
			if type(meta) ~= "table" or meta.lastSession ~= session.sessionId then lost = true; return nil end
			if receipt(old.data or {}, pending.id) then replayed = true; return old end
			return {
				data = pending.candidate,
				lock = { job = self.jobId, session = session.sessionId, at = now },
				meta = { lastSession = session.sessionId, saves = num(meta.saves, 0) + 1, updated = now },
			}
		end)
		if ok and lost then
			session.lost, session.saving, session.committing = true, false, false
			if self.active[session.userId] == session then self.active[session.userId] = nil end
			return { ok = false, reason = "lost" }
		end
		local saved = ok and type(env) == "table" and type(env.data) == "table" and receipt(env.data, pending.id)
		if saved then
			local changed = false
			local outcomes = session.data.expedition and session.data.expedition.outcomes or {}
			-- For an outcome transaction, its chosen record was deliberately consumed in the candidate.
			local consumed = pending.result.outcomeId
			local target = env.data.expedition.outcomes or {}
			for _, outcome in ipairs(outcomes) do
				local exists = false
				for _, stored in ipairs(target) do if stored.id == outcome.id then exists = true; break end end
				if not exists and outcome.id ~= consumed then target[#target + 1] = deepCopy(outcome); changed = true end
			end
			env.data.expedition.outcomes = target
			if session.departurePosition then env.data.expedition.returnPos = deepCopy(session.departurePosition); changed = true end
			if session.clearedHomeReturn then env.data.expedition.homeReturn = nil; changed = true end
			if (session.data.highestCamp or 0) > (env.data.highestCamp or 0) then env.data.highestCamp = session.data.highestCamp; changed = true end
			for _, flag in ipairs({ "parachuteIntroduced", "parachutePractice" }) do
				if session.data.flags[flag] and not env.data.flags[flag] then env.data.flags[flag] = true; changed = true end
			end
			session.data = env.data
			session.clearedHomeReturn = nil
			if not session.leaving then session.departurePosition = nil end
			session.pending, session.saving, session.committing = nil, false, false
			session.outcomePending = #target > 0
			session.dirty, session.lastSave = changed, now
			local res = resultCopy(saved, false)
			res.reconciled = replayed
			return res
		end
		self:_log("transaction " .. pending.id .. " uncertain: " .. tostring(err))
		if attempt < self.saveTries then task.wait(math.min(4, self.backoff * 2 ^ (attempt - 1))) end
	end
	session.saving, session.committing = false, false
	return { ok = false, reason = "store", pending = true, txId = pending.id }
end

-- peek (tests/tools): the stored envelope, read-only
function P:peek(userId)
	return self.store:read(self:key(userId))
end

return P

local function want(p)
	if not only then
		return true
	end
	for _, q in ipairs(only) do
		if q == p then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end
local function resolve(path)
	local inst = game
	for seg in string.gmatch(path, "[^/]+") do
		local nxt = inst:FindFirstChild(seg)
		if not nxt then
			if inst == game then
				nxt = game:GetService(seg)
			else
				nxt = Instance.new("Folder")
				nxt.Name = seg
				nxt.Parent = inst
			end
		end
		inst = nxt
	end
	return inst
end
local function ck(src)
	src = src:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
	local lines = {}
	for l in (src .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
		lines[#lines + 1] = (l:gsub("%s+$", ""))
	end
	src = table.concat(lines, "\n"):gsub("%s+$", "")
	local h = 0
	for i = 1, #src do
		h = (h * 31 + string.byte(src, i)) % 2147483647
	end
	return h, #src
end
return function(list)
only = list
local out = {}
HS.HttpEnabled = true
local ok, err = pcall(function()
	for _, m in ipairs(MAN) do
		if want(m[1]) then
			local src = HS:GetAsync(BASE .. m[1], true)
			local parent = resolve(m[2])
			local inst = parent:FindFirstChild(m[3])
			if inst and inst.ClassName ~= m[4] then
				inst:Destroy()
				inst = nil
			end
			if not inst then
				inst = Instance.new(m[4])
				inst.Name = m[3]
				inst.Parent = parent
			end
			inst.Source = src
			local h, n = ck(inst.Source)
			out[#out + 1] = m[1] .. "\t" .. h .. "\t" .. n
		end
	end
end)
HS.HttpEnabled = false
if not ok then
	return "SYNC ERROR: " .. tostring(err) .. "\n" .. table.concat(out, "\n")
end
return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

-- TrainingYard (v4 P4, run 2): the stamina-training annex OUTSIDE the frozen Foothold (concept LOCKED #10).
-- Placement PROPOSED: the flattest spot 380-470 studs from the Foothold centre that is >= 60 studs from every route
-- path (searched, deterministic). A small practice crag: start arch -> three marked practice walls (10 / 16 / 22)
-- with decks between them -> a bell on the top deck -> stairs back down. Parts only (~60). Colors = Kit.COL tokens.
-- Server logic: CC_CoreServer.Training (StartGate / Bell touches, capped gains).
--   require(ServerStorage.CC_Generators:Clone().BuildAll).trainingYard()     (after the terrain + routes)
local TY = {}

local function flat(v)
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end

function TY.site(Gen, C)
	local center = Vector3.new(0, 0, 2160) -- CoreConfig FOOTHOLD_SAFE.center (xz)
	local paths = _G.CC_PATHS and _G.CC_PATHS.routes or {}
	local function nearRoute(p)
		for _, R in pairs(paths) do
			for i = 1, #R.pts, 4 do
				local q = R.pts[i]
				local dx, dz = q[1] - p.X, q[2] - p.Z
				if dx * dx + dz * dz < 60 * 60 then
					return true
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	local best, bestScore
	for deg = 0, 355, 5 do
		local a = math.rad(deg)
		for _, r in ipairs({ 380, 420, 470 }) do
			local p = center + Vector3.new(math.sin(a), 0, math.cos(a)) * r
			if not nearRoute(p) then
				local lo, hi = math.huge, -math.huge
				for dx = -24, 24, 8 do
					for dz = -24, 24, 8 do
						local h = Gen.heightAt(p.X + dx, p.Z + dz)
						lo, hi = math.min(lo, h), math.max(hi, h)
					end
				end
				local score = hi - lo
				if not bestScore or score < bestScore then
					best, bestScore = p, score
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best, bestScore
end

function TY.build(Kit, Gen)
	local COL = Kit.COL
	local world = workspace:WaitForChild("World")
	local old = world:FindFirstChild("TrainingYard")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local root = Kit.folder(world, "TrainingYard")
	local site, rough = TY.site(Gen)
	assert(site, "no site")
	local y0 = Gen.heightAt(site.X, site.Z)
	-- face the Foothold: the walls stand on the far side, climbers face away from the base
	local toBase = flat(Vector3.new(0, 0, 2160) - site).Unit
	local base = Vector3.new(site.X, y0, site.Z)
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(base, base - toBase) -- LookVector points away from the Foothold (into the walls)
	-- pad: level terrain (camp-pad material) so the yard sits flat
	workspace.Terrain:FillBlock(cf * CFrame.new(0, -3, -8), Vector3.new(56, 6, 64), Enum.Material.Cobblestone)
	workspace.Terrain:FillBlock(cf * CFrame.new(0, 12, -8), Vector3.new(56, 24, 64), Enum.Material.Air)
	local floorY = y0 + 2 -- rendered pad surface (fills render ~2 proud)
	local function at(x, y, z)
		return cf * CFrame.new(x, floorY - y0 + y, z)
	end
	local n = 0
	local function P(props)
		n += 1
		return Kit.part(root, props)
	end
	-- three stepped blocks (marked, climbable): block k's front at z_k = -6 - 8(k-1), 8 deep, rising to the running
	-- total height; the exposed band of each front is one practice wall (10 / 16 / 22), its top the deck for the next
	local walls = { 10, 16, 22 }
	local top = 0
	for k, h in ipairs(walls) do
		local z = -6 - (k - 1) * 8
		top += h
		local w = P({ Name = "PracticeWall", Size = Vector3.new(14, top, 8), CFrame = at(0, top / 2, z - 4), Material = Enum.Material.Slate, Color = COL.rock })
		w:SetAttribute("Climbable", true)
		-- rope + pitons on the exposed band: the marked-face cue used on the routes
		local y0b = top - h
		P({ Name = "Rope", Size = Vector3.new(0.3, h, 0.3), CFrame = at(-4, y0b + h / 2, z + 0.25), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = COL.lantern, CanCollide = false })
		for y = 3, h - 1, 6 do
			P({ Name = "Piton", Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 1), CFrame = at(-4, y0b + y, z + 0.3), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, Color = COL.slate, CanCollide = false })
		end
	end
	-- the bell on the top deck (block 3's top: z -22 .. -30)
	local deckZ = -26
	P({ Name = "BellPost", Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 7, 0.6), CFrame = at(4, top + 3.5, deckZ - 2), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
	local bell = P({ Name = "BellVisual", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 2.4, 2.4), CFrame = at(4, top + 6, deckZ - 0.6), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, Color = COL.golden })
	bell.CanCollide = false
	-- the touch volume the server listens to: the whole top deck (a lap ends on arrival)
	P({ Name = "Bell", Size = Vector3.new(14, 6, 8), CFrame = at(0, top + 3, deckZ), Transparency = 1, CanCollide = false })
	-- stairs back down beside the blocks (no climbing needed to leave): 1.2 down per 1.6 out, toward the base
	local steps = math.ceil(top / 1.2)
	for i = 1, steps do
		P({ Name = "Step", Size = Vector3.new(5, 1.2, 2.2), CFrame = at(9.5, top - i * 1.2 + 0.6, deckZ + i * 1.6), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
	end
	P({ Name = "Landing", Size = Vector3.new(5, 1, 6), CFrame = at(9.5, top - 0.5, deckZ - 1), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
	-- start arch at the foot of wall 1 (walk through it to start a lap)
	for _, sx in ipairs({ -8, 8 }) do
		P({ Name = "ArchPost", Size = Vector3.new(1, 9, 1), CFrame = at(sx, 4.5, 6), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
	end
	P({ Name = "ArchBeam", Size = Vector3.new(17, 1, 1), CFrame = at(0, 9.5, 6), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
