-- One native dispatcher. Prompt completion is never evidence of a developer-product grant.
local RS, Run, Players, Http = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"),game:GetService("RunService"),game:GetService("Players"),game:GetService("HttpService")
local Market=game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local C,R,Clock= require(RS.CC_Core.CommerceConfig),require(script.Parent.CommerceRules),require(script.Parent.Clock)
local Commerce={testAdapterSupported=Run:IsStudio()}; local Engine={};Engine.__index=Engine
function Commerce.new() return setmetatable({},Engine) end
local function ready(s) return s and not s.lost and not s.released and not s.closing and not s.outcomePending end
function Engine:grantReceipt(s,purchaseId,offerId)
 local o=C.offers[offerId]
 if not ready(s) or not o or o.kind~="product" or type(purchaseId)~="string" or #purchaseId<1 or #purchaseId>100 then return {ok=false,reason="unavailable"} end
 local tx="receipt:"..purchaseId
 -- transact checks ownership and serialization, and recovers exactly this uncertain write.
 return s.owner:transact(s,tx,function(d)
  if d.commerce.processedPurchases[purchaseId] then return {duplicate=true} end
  d.coins+=o.coins
  d.commerce.processedPurchases[purchaseId]=true
  d.commerce.pendingReveals[tx]={offerId=offerId,grantId=tx}
  return {coins=o.coins,grantId=tx}
 end)
end
function Engine:grantPasses(s,verified)
 if not ready(s) then return {ok=false,reason="unavailable"} end
 local changed=false
 for id,v in pairs(verified) do if v==true and C.offers[id] and C.offers[id].kind=="pass" and not s.data.commerce.passOwned[id] then changed=true end end
 if not changed then return {ok=true} end
 return s.owner:transact(s,"passes:"..Http:GenerateGUID(false),function(d)
  -- Settle old-rate income BEFORE applying any effective tier change (same atomic write).
  require(script.Parent.Home).settle(d,Clock.now())
  for id,v in pairs(verified) do
   local o=C.offers[id]
   if v==true and o and o.kind=="pass" and not d.commerce.passOwned[id] then
    local previous=R.offerState(d,id).status
    d.commerce.passOwned[id]=true
    if previous~="owned" then local grant="pass:"..id; d.commerce.pendingReveals[grant]={offerId=id,grantId=grant} end
   end
  end
  R.applyOwnership(d)
  return {tier=d.commerce.tier}
 end)
end
function Engine:ack(s,id)
 if not ready(s) or type(id)~="string" or #id>120 then return {ok=false} end
 if not s.data.commerce.pendingReveals[id] then return {ok=true} end
 return s.owner:transact(s,"reveal:"..Http:GenerateGUID(false),function(d) d.commerce.pendingReveals[id]=nil;return {} end)
end
local ctx, engine= nil, Commerce.new()
local pending, cooldown, metadata, reconciles = {},{},{},{}
local function refreshed(plr)
 if ctx.CommerceCosmetics then ctx.CommerceCosmetics.refresh(plr) end
 if ctx.Home and ctx.Home.refreshCommerce then ctx.Home.refreshCommerce(plr) end
 ctx.push(plr)
end
local injectedSafe
local function safe(plr)
 if injectedSafe then return injectedSafe(plr) end
 local ch=plr.Character;local hum=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local traversal=ch and ch:GetAttribute("CC_TraversalState")
 return hum and hum.Health>0 and hum.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air and (traversal==nil or traversal=="ground")
end
local function info(id,o)
 if o.platformId<=0 then return nil end
 local now=os.clock();local old=metadata[id]
 if old and now-old.at<60 then return old.value end
 local ok,v=pcall(Market.GetProductInfoAsync,Market,o.platformId,o.kind=="pass" and Enum.InfoType.GamePass or Enum.InfoType.Product)
 v=ok and type(v)=="table" and v.IsForSale~=false and type(v.PriceInRobux)=="number" and v or nil
 metadata[id]={at=now,value=v};return v
end
function Commerce.reconcile(plr)
 local s=ctx.sessions[plr];if not ready(s) or reconciles[plr] then return false end
 reconciles[plr]=true
 local verified,failed={},false
 for _,id in ipairs(C.order) do
  local o=C.offers[id]
  if o.kind=="pass" and o.platformId>0 then
   local ok,owns=pcall(Market.UserOwnsGamePassAsync,Market,plr.UserId,o.platformId)
   if ok and owns then verified[id]=true elseif not ok then failed=true end
  end
 end
 if ctx.sessions[plr]~=s or not ready(s) then reconciles[plr]=nil;return false end
 local r=engine:grantPasses(s,verified)
 reconciles[plr]=nil
 if r.ok then refreshed(plr) end
 return r.ok and not failed
end
function Commerce.purchase(plr,payload)
 local id=payload.offerId;local o=type(id)=="string" and C.offers[id]
 local s=ctx.sessions[plr]
 if not o or not ready(s) or s.pending or s.saving or s.busy or pending[plr] or not safe(plr) then return {ok=false,reason="unavailable"} end
 if os.clock()-(cooldown[plr] or -100)<2 then return {ok=false,reason="rate"} end
 cooldown[plr]=os.clock()
 -- Reserve before metadata / ownership calls yield: duplicate clicks cannot open two prompts.
 local token={id=id,session=s}; pending[plr]=token
 local function release(reason) if pending[plr]==token then pending[plr]=nil end;ctx.push(plr);return {ok=false,reason=reason} end
 if o.platformId<=0 then ctx.toast(plr,"Checkout unavailable: product setup is pending.","info");return release("unconfigured") end
 if not Commerce.reconcile(plr) then return release("ownership") end
 local product=info(id,o)
 if ctx.sessions[plr]~=s or not ready(s) or s.pending or s.saving or pending[plr]~=token or not safe(plr) then return release("changed") end
 local state=R.offerState(s.data,id)
 if state.status~="available" and state.status~="next" then return release(state.status) end
 if not product then return release("price") end
 local ok=pcall(function()
  if o.kind=="pass" then Market:PromptGamePassPurchase(plr,o.platformId) else Market:PromptProductPurchase(plr,o.platformId) end
 end)
 if not ok then return release("prompt") end
 ctx.push(plr)
 task.delay(90,function() if pending[plr]==token then pending[plr]=nil;ctx.push(plr) end end)
 return {ok=true}
end
function Commerce.processReceipt(receipt)
 local unresolved=Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
 if type(receipt)~="table" then return unresolved end
 local plr=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receipt.PlayerId)
 local s=plr and ctx.sessions[plr]
 local offer
 for _,id in ipairs(C.order) do local o=C.offers[id];if o.kind=="product" and o.platformId>0 and o.platformId==receipt.ProductId then offer=id;break end end
 if not offer or not ready(s) then return unresolved end
 local r=engine:grantReceipt(s,receipt.PurchaseId,offer)
 if not r.ok then ctx.push(plr);return unresolved end
 refreshed(plr)
 return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
end
function Commerce.init(c,deps)
 if deps then
  assert(Run:IsStudio() and game.PlaceId==0,"test services forbidden outside unpublished Studio")
  Market=assert(deps.market);C=assert(deps.catalogue);Players=assert(deps.players);injectedSafe=assert(deps.safe)
 end
 ctx=c
 Market.ProcessReceipt=Commerce.processReceipt
 ctx.handlers.commercePurchase=Commerce.purchase
 ctx.handlers.commerceRevealAck=function(plr,p) local r=engine:ack(ctx.sessions[plr],p.grantId);ctx.push(plr);return r end
 ctx.handlers.commerceEquip=function(plr,p)
  if type(p.id)~="string" or not C.cosmetics[p.id] or type(p.enabled)~="boolean" then return end
  return ctx.transaction(plr,"equip:"..Http:GenerateGUID(false),function(d)
   if not d.commerce.owned[p.id] then return {ok=false,reason="unowned"} end
   d.commerce.equipped[p.id]=p.enabled or nil;return {}
  end,function() refreshed(plr) end)
 end
 Market.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(plr,passId,bought)
  local token=pending[plr];local o=token and C.offers[token.id]
  if not o or o.kind~="pass" or o.platformId~=passId then return end
  if not bought then pending[plr]=nil;ctx.push(plr);return end
  task.spawn(function()
   for _,delay in ipairs({0,1,2,4,8,16}) do
    if delay>0 then task.wait(delay) end
    if ctx.sessions[plr]~=token.session then break end
    Commerce.reconcile(plr)
    if token.session.data.commerce.passOwned[token.id] then break end
   end
   if pending[plr]==token then pending[plr]=nil end
   ctx.push(plr)
  end)
 end)
 Market.PromptProductPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(userId,productId,_bought)
  local plr=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId);local token=plr and pending[plr];local o=token and C.offers[token.id]
  if o and o.kind=="product" and o.platformId==productId then pending[plr]=nil;ctx.push(plr) end
 end)
 -- These injected grants exist ONLY in a disposable unpublished Studio server, never UI or production.
 if Run:IsStudio() and game.PlaceId==0 and ctx.devHandlers then
  ctx.devHandlers.commerceTestGrant=function(plr,p)
   local s=ctx.sessions[plr];local o=C.offers[p.offerId];if not o then return {ok=false} end
   local result=o.kind=="product" and engine:grantReceipt(s,p.purchaseId or ("studio-"..Http:GenerateGUID(false)),p.offerId) or engine:grantPasses(s,{[p.offerId]=true})
   if result.ok then refreshed(plr) end;return result
  end
 end
end
function Commerce.onLoaded(plr,s)
 task.spawn(function()
  for _,waitTime in ipairs({0,2,8,30}) do
   if waitTime>0 then task.wait(waitTime) end
   if ctx.sessions[plr]~=s then return end
   if Commerce.reconcile(plr) then return end
  end
 end)
end
function Commerce.onLeave(plr) pending[plr],cooldown[plr],reconciles[plr]=nil,nil,nil end
function Commerce.state(plr,st)
 local s=ctx.sessions[plr];if not s then return end
 local d=s.data;local view={tier=d.commerce.tier,multiplier=R.multiplier(d),owned=d.commerce.owned,equipped=d.commerce.equipped,offers={},pendingReveals=d.commerce.pendingReveals,checkout=pending[plr] and pending[plr].id}
 for _,id in ipairs(C.order) do local v=R.offerState(d,id);v.configured=C.offers[id].platformId>0;view.offers[id]=v end
 st.commerce=view
end
return Commerce

 if id:match("^upgrade") then

local function reward(w)

 text(body,"RewardTitle","A little more adventure.",0,0,w,55,28,gold)
 local pending=offer(reveal.offerId).status=="pending"
 text(body,"Confirmed",pending and "Pass saved. Earlier tiers are required before activation." or "It's yours! Every reward shown is guaranteed.",0,56,w,50,16,Color3.new(1,1,1))
 local ids=o.items or {reveal.offerId};local cell=(w-12*(#ids-1))/#ids
 for i,id in ipairs(ids) do
  local f=panel(body,"Reward_"..id,Color3.fromRGB(145,89,190),(i-1)*(cell+12),116,cell,250);border(f)
  picture(f,id,10,8,cell-20,156);text(f,"RewardName",C.offers[id].name,12,168,cell-24,48,19,gold)

render=function(reset)

 local scroll=reset and 0 or body.CanvasPosition.Y
 local focus=GuiService.SelectedObject;local focusName=focus and focus.Name
 GuiService.SelectedObject=nil
 body:ClearAllChildren();sections={}
 local w=math.max(250,body.AbsoluteSize.X-12)
 local h=reveal and reward(w) or selected and detail(w) or catalogue(w,shell.AbsoluteSize.Y<500 or w<800)
 body.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,h);body.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,scroll)
 for _,b in ipairs(nav:GetChildren()) do if b:IsA("GuiButton") then b.Visible=not selected and not reveal end end

fit=function()
 local s=root.AbsoluteSize;local w,h=math.min(1080,s.X-16),math.min(760,s.Y-12)
 shell.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h);shell.Position=UDim2.fromOffset((s.X-w)/2,(s.Y-h)/2)
 local narrow=w<720
 heading.Size=UDim2.new(1,narrow and -70 or -290,0,52);heading.TextSize=math.floor((narrow and 18 or 25)*((state.settings or {}).textScale or 1))
 wallet.Visible=not narrow;wallet.Position=UDim2.new(1,-278,0,8);wallet.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(210,44)
 body.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,112);body.Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,1,-140)
 local cw=(w-28-18)/4
 for i,b in ipairs(nav:GetChildren()) do if b:IsA("GuiButton") then b.Position=UDim2.fromOffset((i-1)*(cw+6),0);b.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(cw,44) end end
 if hud then
  local phone=s.Y<500
  hud.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(phone and 286 or 134,phone and 48 or 120)

function U.open(id)

function U.dismiss()

end
function U.close()

 shell.Visible=false;opt.onModalChanged(false)
 local valid=previousFocus and previousFocus.Parent and previousFocus:IsA("GuiObject") and previousFocus.Selectable
 local a=previousFocus;while valid and a do if a:IsA("GuiObject") and not a.Visible then valid=false end;a=a.Parent end
 GuiService.SelectedObject=valid and previousFocus or nil
end
function U.isOpen() return shell and shell.Visible end
function U.fx(p) if p.kind=="commerceOpen" then U.open(p.offerId) end end
function U.update(s)
 local old=state;state=s
 local signature=game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({s.commerce,s.coins,s.settings,s.saveState})
 if signature~=lastSignature and shell and shell.Visible then render() end
 lastSignature=signature
 for _,entry in pairs(labels) do if entry.gui.Parent then
  local id=entry.id=="next" and "upgrade"..math.min(s.commerce and s.commerce.tier or 0,5) or entry.id
  entry.text.Text=C.offers[id].name.."\n"..caption(id)

end
function U.tick()
 if not shell then return end
 local safe=opt.safe() and state.saveState=="ok"
 if shell.Visible and not safe then U.close() end
 hud.Visible=safe and not shell.Visible and not opt.otherOpen()
 shopButton.Visible=hud.Visible
 if hud.Visible then
  local first=nextId();local second=offer("bundle").status=="available" and "bundle" or "coins100"
  hud.First.Text=(C.offers[first].tier and C.offers[first].tier*2 .."× earnings" or C.offers[first].name).."\n"..caption(first);hud.Second.Text=C.offers[second].name.."\n"..caption(second)
  hud.First.TextSize=math.floor(12*((state.settings or {}).textScale or 1));hud.Second.TextSize=hud.First.TextSize
 end
 if safe and not shell.Visible and not opt.otherOpen() and state.commerce then
  for id,r in pairs(state.commerce.pendingReveals) do if not seen[id] then
   opt.closeOtherPanels();reveal=r;selected=nil;shell.Visible=true;opt.onModalChanged(true);fit();render(true);GuiService.SelectedObject=closeButton;break
  end end
 end
end
function U.init(options)
 opt=options
 root=make("Frame",opt.parent,{Name="CommerceRoot",BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),ZIndex=60})
 shell=panel(root,"Exchange",purple,0,0,900,620);shell.Visible=false;shell.ClipsDescendants=true;border(shell,gold,3)
 local header=make("Frame",shell,{Name="GoldHeader",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,62),BackgroundColor3=gold,BorderSizePixel=0});gradient(header,Color3.fromRGB(255,237,162),Color3.fromRGB(241,181,48))
 heading=text(header,"Heading","▲ FOOTHOLD EXCHANGE",14,4,600,52,25)
 wallet=text(header,"Wallet","",0,8,210,44,16)
 closeButton=button(header,"CloseExchange","×",0,6,48,48,U.dismiss,Color3.fromRGB(240,121,166));closeButton.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0);closeButton.Position=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,6)
 nav=make("Frame",shell,{Name="Categories",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,66),Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,44),BackgroundTransparency=1})
 for i,n in ipairs({"Featured","Upgrades","Coins","Cosmetics"}) do button(nav,n,({"Featured","↗ Upgrades","● Coin packs","Cosmetics"})[i],0,0,150,44,function() body.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,sections[n] or 0) end,Color3.fromRGB(179,145,218)) end
 body=make("ScrollingFrame",shell,{Name="Catalogue",BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=5,ScrollBarImageColor3=gold,ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,CanvasSize=UDim2.new(),AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.None})
 local footer=text(shell,"Footer","Guaranteed rewards · permanent cosmetics & upgrades",14,0,800,24,11,Color3.fromRGB(237,216,255));footer.Position=UDim2.new(0,14,1,-26);footer.Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,24)
 hud=panel(root,"Offers",deep,0,0,134,120);hud.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0);hud.Position=UDim2.new(1,-10,0,68);hud.BackgroundTransparency=1
 button(hud,"First","",0,0,134,56,function() U.open(nextId()) end,Color3.fromRGB(182,226,143))
 button(hud,"Second","",0,64,134,56,function() U.open(offer("bundle").status=="available" and "bundle" or "coins100") end,Color3.fromRGB(216,184,244))
 shopButton=button(root,"OpenShop","SHOP",0,0,134,46,function() U.open() end,gold);shopButton.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0);shopButton.Position=UDim2.new(1,-10,0,196)
 root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fit)
 UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed)
  if not processed and not (state.commerce and state.commerce.checkout) and shell.Visible and (input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB) then U.dismiss() end
 end)
 task.spawn(function() while root.Parent do refreshPrices();task.wait(5) end end)
 local function display(m)
  if not m:IsA("Model") or not m:GetAttribute("CommerceOffer") or labels[m] then return end
  local p=m:FindFirstChild("Plinth");if not p then return end
  local g=make("BillboardGui",p,{Name="LocalCommerceLabel",Size=UDim2.fromOffset(240,72),StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,4.6,0),MaxDistance=45,AlwaysOnTop=false})
  local l=text(g,"Label","",0,0,240,72,16,gold);l.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center;l.TextStrokeTransparency=0.3
  labels[m]={gui=g,text=l,id=m:GetAttribute("CommerceOffer")}
 end
 local world=workspace:WaitForChild("World");local displays=world:WaitForChild("CommerceDisplays",20)
 if displays then for _,m in ipairs(displays:GetChildren()) do display(m) end;displays.ChildAdded:Connect(function(m) task.defer(display,m) end) end
 if game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() then
  local bridge=make("BindableFunction",root,{Name="Review"})
  bridge.OnInvoke=function(action,value)
   if action=="open" then U.open(value) elseif action=="close" then U.dismiss()
   elseif action=="section" then selected=nil;reveal=nil;render(true);body.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,sections[value] or 0)
   elseif action=="scroll" then body.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,value) end
   local small,overflow,outside={},{},{}
   for _,v in ipairs(shell:GetDescendants()) do
    if v:IsA("GuiObject") then

     local inView=visible and not v:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("SurfaceGui") and p.Y+z.Y>bp.Y and p.Y<bp.Y+bz.Y
     if inView and v:IsA("GuiButton") and (z.X<44 or z.Y<44) then table.insert(small,v.Name) end
     if inView and (v:IsA("TextLabel") or v:IsA("TextButton")) and (v.TextBounds.X>z.X+1 or v.TextBounds.Y>z.Y+1) then table.insert(overflow,v.Name) end
     if inView and (p.X<shell.AbsolutePosition.X-1 or p.X+z.X>shell.AbsolutePosition.X+shell.AbsoluteSize.X+1) then table.insert(outside,v.Name) end
    end
   end
   return {viewport=tostring(root.AbsoluteSize),shop=tostring(shell.AbsoluteSize),small=small,overflow=overflow,outside=outside,scroll=body.CanvasPosition.Y,canvas=body.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y,view=body.AbsoluteSize.Y,selected=selected,reveal=reveal and reveal.offerId}

 end

end

-- Visuals (ServerScriptService.CC_CoreServer): runtime models for creatures, guardians, Heartstones, drop packs and
-- the carried-Heartstone glow. Creature/guardian looks are Codex's track (Phase C): if ServerStorage.CC_Creatures
-- holds a Model named after the species id it is cloned read-only; otherwise a neutral STUB stands in (a plain ball
-- + rarity pips), deliberately not species art. Rarity reads by pips first, tint second (LOCKED); particle
-- richness rises per tier and only Legendary gets a world beam (LOCKED). Colors are existing world tokens.
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SS = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local C = require(RS:WaitForChild("CC_Core"):WaitForChild("CoreConfig"))
local Species = require(RS.CC_Core:WaitForChild("Species"))

local V = {}
local TOK = {
	slate = Color3.fromRGB(62, 66, 76),
	golden = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 150),
	moon = Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 255),
	lantern = Color3.fromRGB(255, 178, 72),
	timber = Color3.fromRGB(140, 96, 60),
	timberDark = Color3.fromRGB(98, 66, 42),
	aurora = Color3.fromRGB(156, 92, 246),
	ice = Color3.fromRGB(196, 232, 255),
}
V.TOK = TOK
local SIZE = { Common = 2.2, Uncommon = 2.6, Rare = 3.0, Epic = 3.0, Legendary = 4.0 }

local function part(parent, props)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.TopSurface, p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth, Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	for k, v in pairs(props) do
		p[k] = v
	end
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

local function pips(rarity)
	return string.rep("◆", C.RANK[rarity] or 1) .. string.rep("◇", 5 - (C.RANK[rarity] or 1))
end
V.pips = pips

local function tag(parent, adornee, top, bottom, color, maxDist)
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Name = "Tag"
	bb.Adornee = adornee
	bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 44)
	bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, adornee.Size.Y / 2 + 1.6, 0)
	bb.MaxDistance = maxDist or 70
	bb.LightInfluence = 0
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.Name = "Top"
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	t.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
	t.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	t.TextScaled = true
	t.TextColor3 = color
	t.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
	t.Text = top
	t.Parent = bb
	local b = t:Clone()
	b.Name = "Bottom"
	b.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5)
	b.TextColor3 = TOK.moon
	b.Text = bottom
	b.Parent = bb
	bb.Parent = parent
	return bb
end

local function codexModel(speciesId)
	local lib = SS:FindFirstChild("CC_Creatures") -- Codex's library: read-only, never modified here
	local m = lib and lib:FindFirstChild(speciesId)
	if m and m:IsA("Model") then
		local c = m:Clone()
		for _, d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") then
				d.Anchored = true
			end
		end
		return c
	end
	return nil
end

-- creature at pos; returns model with PrimaryPart "Body" (prompt attaches there)
function V.creature(speciesId, pos)
	local e = Species.get(speciesId)
	local rarity = e and e.rarity or "Common"
	local m = codexModel(speciesId)
	if m then
		m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos))
		if not m.PrimaryPart then
			m.PrimaryPart = m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		end
	else
		m = Instance.new("Model")
		m.Name = speciesId
		local s = SIZE[rarity] or 2.4
		local body = part(m, { Name = "Body", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * s, CFrame = CFrame.new(pos), Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Color = C.RARITY_TINT[rarity], CanQuery = true })
		m.PrimaryPart = body
		m:SetAttribute("Stub", true)
	end
	local body = m.PrimaryPart
	tag(m, body, pips(rarity), (e and e.name or speciesId), C.RARITY_TINT[rarity], 60)
	if (C.RANK[rarity] or 1) >= 3 then
		local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		pe.Name = "RarityGlint"
		pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(C.RARITY_TINT[rarity])
		pe.LightEmission = 0.6
		pe.Rate = 2 + (C.RANK[rarity] - 3) * 4
		pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.4)
		pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.2)
		pe.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.35, 0)
		pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		pe.Parent = body
	end
	if rarity == "Legendary" then
		local a0, a1 = Instance.new("Attachment"), Instance.new("Attachment")
		a0.Parent, a1.Parent = body, body
		a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, 120, 0)
		local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
		beam.Attachment0, beam.Attachment1 = a0, a1
		beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(C.RARITY_TINT.Legendary)
		beam.Width0, beam.Width1 = 1.6, 0.4
		beam.LightEmission = 1
		beam.FaceCamera = true
		beam.Parent = body
	end
	m:SetAttribute("Species", speciesId)
	m:SetAttribute("Rarity", rarity)
	return m
end

-- guardian (nest NPC). Stub: a dark ball sized by its traits; Codex model by id when it exists.
function V.guardian(speciesId, pos, scale)
	local e = Species.get(speciesId)
	local m = codexModel(speciesId)
	if m then
		m:ScaleTo(scale)
		m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos))
	else
		m = Instance.new("Model")
		m.Name = speciesId
		local s = 6 * scale
		local body = part(m, { Name = "Body", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * s, CFrame = CFrame.new(pos), Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Color = TOK.slate, CanQuery = false })
		m.PrimaryPart = body
		-- facing marker so players can read where a stub is looking (gameplay readability, not species art)
		local nose = part(m, { Name = "Facing", Size = Vector3.new(s * 0.3, s * 0.3, s * 0.35), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.new(0, s * 0.08, -s * 0.5), Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Color = TOK.lantern, CanQuery = false })
		local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		w.Part0, w.Part1 = body, nose
		w.Parent = nose
		m:SetAttribute("Stub", true)
	end
	local body = m.PrimaryPart
	tag(m, body, "Guardian", (e and e.name or speciesId), TOK.lantern, 90)
	-- the tell: a "!" shown by every client while State == "Alert" (brief §3.3: visible tell >= 1.5 s)
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Name = "Tell"
	bb.Adornee = body
	bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
	bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 60)
	bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, body.Size.Y / 2 + 4, 0)
	bb.Enabled = false
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	t.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	t.TextScaled = true
	t.TextColor3 = TOK.lantern
	t.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	t.Text = "!"
	t.Parent = bb
	bb.Parent = m
	-- "checking its nest" cue (Patrol pause): the moment it can see the nest centre
	local wb = bb:Clone()
	wb.Name = "Watch"
	wb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44)
	wb.TextLabel.Text = "◉"
	wb.TextLabel.TextColor3 = TOK.moon
	wb.Parent = m
	m:SetAttribute("Species", speciesId)
	return m
end

-- Heartstone on a nest cradle: aurora-crystal core (LOCKED wording) with a soft light
function V.heartstone(pos, tier)
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = "Heartstone"
	local core = part(m, { Name = "Core", Size = Vector3.new(1.8, 2.4, 1.8), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), math.rad(12)), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = TOK.aurora, CanQuery = true })
	part(m, { Name = "Shell", Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 3.0, 2.4), CFrame = core.CFrame, Material = Enum.Material.Glass, Color = TOK.ice, Transparency = 0.55 })
	local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
	l.Color = TOK.aurora
	l.Range = 12
	l.Brightness = 1.4
	l.Parent = core
	m.PrimaryPart = core
	tag(m, core, tier .. " Heartstone", "bank, then place in a home nest", TOK.aurora, 60)
	return m
end

-- drop pack (owner-only recovery; countdown text is written by the owner's client)
function V.dropPack(pos)
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = "DropPack"
	local box = part(m, { Name = "Pack", Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 2.8, 1.6), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0.15, 0.4, 0.1), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = TOK.timber, CanQuery = true })
	part(m, { Name = "Strap", Size = Vector3.new(2.5, 0.4, 1.7), CFrame = box.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.6, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = TOK.lantern })
	local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
	l.Color = TOK.lantern
	l.Range = 10
	l.Brightness = 1
	l.Parent = box
	m.PrimaryPart = box
	local bb = tag(m, box, "Drop pack", "", TOK.lantern, 200)
	bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
	return m
end

-- carried Heartstone glow on the character's back (others see cargo value, LOCKED); server-owned, replicated
function V.setCarryGlow(character, tierOrNil)
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local old = character:FindFirstChild("CC_CarryGlow")
	if not tierOrNil then
		if old then
			old:Destroy()
		end
		return
	end
	if old and old:GetAttribute("Tier") == tierOrNil then
		return
	end
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local torso = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	if not torso then
		return
	end
	local g = Instance.new("Part")
	g.Name = "CC_CarryGlow"
	g.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1.4, 1)
	g.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	g.Color = TOK.aurora
	g.CanCollide, g.CanTouch, g.CanQuery, g.Massless = false, false, false, true
	g.CastShadow = false
	g.CFrame = torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.2, 0.9) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0)
	local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	w.Part0, w.Part1 = torso, g
	w.Parent = g
	local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
	l.Color = TOK.aurora
	l.Range = 10 + (C.HEARTSTONE_VALUE[tierOrNil] or 30) / 10
	l.Brightness = 1.6
	l.Parent = g
	g:SetAttribute("Tier", tierOrNil)
	g.Parent = character
end

return V

-- Tutorial (ServerScriptService.CC_CoreServer): the ~10-min diegetic onboarding (LOCKED: companion + short prompts,
-- skippable on return, guardian-free Rare by minute 5, cliffhanger ~min 10). Beats follow brief §3.6 (PROPOSED):
--   1 look around · 2 claim a common · 3 bank it at the campfire · 4 Shepherd's Road + short rope climb ·
--   5 Rare nook · 6 gentle guardian pup + cloth net · 7 take the Heartstone · 8 bank it (it ripens at home) ·
--   9 while it ripens, claim two finds on the Foothold outskirts · 10 bank them ·
--   11 cliffhanger: the camera finds a bigger guardian on the valley lip while the ripen timer runs · 12 done.
-- Beats 9-10 (B-polish 2026-10-20, PROPOSED) lengthen the onboarding toward ~10 min after the Rare (still <= 5:00)
-- and repeat the claim -> bank loop once on the player's own; they never block (timeout, shared commons).
-- Each step completes on a predicate over server state (not on client claims), checked on events and every 0.5 s,
-- so out-of-order play and mid-tutorial rejoins still progress. The step is saved in profile flags.tutorial.
-- One line per beat, no paragraphs; the companion (glow-wisp, PROPOSED) and objective marker are client visuals.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Tut = {}
local ctx, C, Clock, Inv
local started = {} -- [plr] = { t, pos }
local cliff = {} -- [plr] = os.clock() when the cliffhanger began
local round = {} -- [plr] = { n = claims during beat 9, t = os.clock() at entry, banked = beat 10 bank seen }
local CLIFF, DONE = 11, 12
local VERSION = 2 -- step numbering (v1: cliffhanger 9, done 10)
local homePortals={}

local function marker(name)
	local core = workspace.World:FindFirstChild("Core")
	local m = core and core:FindFirstChild("Props") and core.Props:FindFirstChild(name)
	return m and m.Position or nil
end
local function hasTimer(s, key)
	return s.data.timers[key] ~= nil
end
local function packHas(plr, kind)
	for _, it in ipairs(Inv.bag(plr.UserId).items) do
		if it.kind == kind then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end
local function near(plr, pos, r)
	local hrp = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return hrp and pos and (hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude < r
end

local STEPS = {
	[1] = {
		line = "Welcome to the Foothold. Look around, then follow me.",
		done = function(plr)
			local st = started[plr]
			local hrp = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			return st and (os.clock() - st.t > 8 or (hrp and (hrp.Position - st.pos).Magnitude > 12))
		end,
	},
	[2] = {
		line = "A creature! Walk up and hold to claim it.",
		target = function()
			return ctx.Claims.spawnPos("tut_common"), "Creature"
		end,
		done = function(plr, s)
			return hasTimer(s, "spawn:tut_common")
		end,
	},
	[3] = {
		line = "Finds are only safe once banked. Bank at the campfire.",
		target = function()
			return ctx.Camps.bankPart and ctx.Camps.bankPart.Position, "Bank"
		end,
		done = function(plr, s)
			return s.data.flags.firstBankAt > 0
		end,
	},
	[4] = {
		line = "Follow Shepherd's Road. Clip the anchor, then alternate left and right.",
		target = function()
			return marker("RopeBase"), "Rope"
		end,
		done = function(plr, s)
			return near(plr, marker("NookTop"), 9) or hasTimer(s, "spawn:nook_rare_r1")
		end,
	},
	[5] = {
		line = "Something rare hides up here. Hold to claim it.",
		target = function()
			return ctx.Claims.spawnPos("nook_rare_r1"), "Rare"
		end,
		done = function(plr, s)
			return hasTimer(s, "spawn:nook_rare_r1")
		end,
	},
	[6] = {
		line = "Ring the wind chimes, then hold to net the guardian's pup.",
		target = function(plr)
			local s=ctx.sessions[plr]
			if not (s and s.data.expedition.puzzles and s.data.expedition.puzzles.nest_r1_hollow) then
				return ctx.Nests.distractionPos("nest_r1_hollow"), "Wind chimes"
			end
			return ctx.Nests.pupPos("nest_r1_hollow"), "Pup"
		end,
		done = function(plr, s)
			-- netting is the lesson, but taking the Heartstone first must not soft-lock the tutorial
			return hasTimer(s, "pup:nest_r1_hollow") or hasTimer(s, "nest:nest_r1_hollow") or packHas(plr, "heartstone")
		end,
	},
	[7] = {
		line = "Take the Heartstone from the nest, then head home.",
		target = function()
			return ctx.Nests.hsPos("nest_r1_hollow"), "Heartstone"
		end,
		done = function(plr, s)
			return hasTimer(s, "nest:nest_r1_hollow") or packHas(plr, "heartstone")
		end,
	},
	[8] = {
		line = "Bank the Heartstone, then place it in a nest at your home.",
		target = function()
			return ctx.Camps.bankPart and ctx.Camps.bankPart.Position, "Bank"
		end,
		done = function(plr, s)
			if #s.data.heartstones > 0 then
				return true -- banked and ripening
			end
			-- nothing left to bank (shaken loose and the pack faded): move on instead of soft-locking
			if packHas(plr, "heartstone") then
				return false
			end
			for _, p in pairs(ctx.DropPacks._packs) do
				if p.ownerId == plr.UserId then
					for _, it in ipairs(p.items) do
						if it.kind == "heartstone" then
							return false
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return true
		end,
	},
	[9] = {
		line = "Claim two more finds. Newly banked discoveries advance occupied nests.",
		target = function(plr)
			-- nearest outskirts find that is still there (shared commons: someone else may have claimed one)
			local hrp = plr and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local best, bd
			for _, id in ipairs(C.TUT_OUTSKIRTS) do
				local sp = ctx.Claims._spawns[id]
				if sp and sp.available then
					local d = hrp and (sp.pos - hrp.Position).Magnitude or 0
					if not bd or d < bd then
						best, bd = sp.pos, d
					end
				end
			end
			return best, "Creature"
		end,
		done = function(plr,s)
			local r = round[plr]
			if #s.data.heartstones>0 and (s.data.home.nests[1] or "")=="" and (s.data.home.nests[2] or "")=="" then return false end
			return r and (r.n >= 2 or os.clock() - r.t > C.TUT_OUTSKIRTS_TIMEOUT or Inv.free(plr.UserId) < 1)
		end,
	},
	[10] = {
		line = "Bank them at the campfire.",
		target = function()
			return ctx.Camps.bankPart and ctx.Camps.bankPart.Position, "Bank"
		end,
		done = function(plr)
			local r = round[plr]
			return (r and r.banked) or (Inv.used(plr.UserId) == 0 and #ctx.DropPacks.ownedBy(plr.UserId) == 0)
		end,
	},
	[11] = {
		line = "Up on the lip, a bigger guardian keeps a richer nest.",
		done = function(plr)
			return cliff[plr] and os.clock() - cliff[plr] > 7
		end,
	},
}

local function current(plr)
	local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
	return s and s.data.flags.tutorial or DONE
end

local function enter(plr, s, step)
	s.data.flags.tutorial = step
	s.dirty = true
	plr:SetAttribute("CC_Tutorial", step)
	plr:SetAttribute("CC_TutorialAt", os.clock())
	if step == 9 then
		round[plr] = { n = 0, t = os.clock(), banked = false }
	end
	if step == CLIFF and not cliff[plr] then
		cliff[plr] = os.clock()
		local g = ctx.Nests.watch(plr, "nest_r1_lip")
		local focus = ctx.Nests.nestPos("nest_r1_lip")
		ctx.fx(plr, { kind = "cliffhanger", focus = focus and focus + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), secs = 4.5 })
		ctx.emit("cliffhanger", plr, g ~= nil)
	elseif step == DONE then
		ctx.toast(plr, "Place banked Heartstones in your two home nests. New discoveries help both.", "good")
	end
	ctx.push(plr)
end

local function advance(plr)
	local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
	if not s or s.pending or s.busy or s.saving or s.outcomePending then
		return
	end
	local step = s.data.flags.tutorial
	if step <= 0 or step >= DONE then
		return
	end
	-- step 3 with nothing to bank (the first common was lost, e.g. a disconnect): give the first common back
	if step == 3 and s.data.flags.firstBankAt == 0 and Inv.used(plr.UserId) == 0 and #ctx.DropPacks.ownedBy(plr.UserId) == 0 then
		s.data.timers["spawn:tut_common"] = nil
		s.dirty = true
		enter(plr, s, 2)
		return
	end
	local guard = 0
	while step < DONE and STEPS[step] and STEPS[step].done(plr, s) do
		step += 1
		guard += 1
		if guard > DONE or step == CLIFF then
			break -- the cliffhanger always plays
		end
	end
	if step ~= s.data.flags.tutorial then
		enter(plr, s, step)
	end
end
Tut.advance = advance

function Tut.init(c)
	ctx = c
	C, Clock, Inv = c.C, c.Clock, c.Inv
	ctx.Tutorial = Tut
	for _, ev in ipairs({ "claim", "bank", "net", "heartstone" }) do
		ctx.on(ev, function(plr)
			local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
			local step = s and s.data.flags.tutorial
			local r = round[plr]
			if r and ev == "claim" and step == 9 then
				r.n += 1
			elseif r and ev == "bank" and step == 10 then
				r.banked = true
			end
			task.defer(advance, plr)
		end)
	end
	ctx.handlers.tutorialSkip = function(plr)
		local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
		if s and s.data.flags.tutorial < DONE then
			enter(plr, s, DONE)
		end
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.5)
			for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				advance(plr)
			end
		end
	end)
	-- Studio-only: restart the tutorial for bots
	if ctx.devHandlers then
		ctx.devHandlers.tutorialReset = function(plr)
			local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
			if s then
				started[plr] = { t = os.clock(), pos = plr.Character and plr.Character:GetPivot().Position or Vector3.zero }
				cliff[plr] = nil
				round[plr] = nil
				enter(plr, s, 1)
			end
		end
		-- Studio-only: replay the beat-11 shot (same guardian watch + fx) for captures; steps are untouched
		ctx.devHandlers.cliffhanger = function(plr, p)
			local g = ctx.Nests.watch(plr, "nest_r1_lip")
			local focus = ctx.Nests.nestPos("nest_r1_lip")
			ctx.fx(plr, { kind = "cliffhanger", focus = focus and focus + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), secs = p.secs or 4.5 })
			return g ~= nil
		end
	end
end

function Tut.onLoaded(plr, s)
	-- v1 numbering (cliffhanger 9, done 10) -> v2 (outskirts 9, bank 10, cliffhanger 11, done 12)
	if s.data.flags.tutorialV ~= VERSION then
		local old = s.data.flags.tutorial
		if old >= 10 then
			s.data.flags.tutorial = DONE
		elseif old == 9 then
			s.data.flags.tutorial = CLIFF
		end
		s.data.flags.tutorialV = VERSION
		s.dirty = true
	end
	-- new profile -> start; a profile that already banked before the tutorial existed -> skip
	if s.data.flags.tutorial == 0 then
		if s.data.flags.firstBankAt > 0 or #s.data.bank > 0 then
			s.data.flags.tutorial = DONE
			s.dirty = true
		else
			local ch = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
			started[plr] = { t = os.clock(), pos = ch:GetPivot().Position }
			enter(plr, s, 1)
		end
	elseif s.data.flags.tutorial < DONE then
		local ch = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
		started[plr] = { t = os.clock() - 10, pos = ch:GetPivot().Position }
		if s.data.flags.tutorial == CLIFF then
			enter(plr, s, CLIFF - 1) -- replay the cliffhanger after a rejoin
		elseif s.data.flags.tutorial == 9 then
			round[plr] = { n = 0, t = os.clock(), banked = false }
		end
		ctx.push(plr)
	end
	plr:SetAttribute("CC_Tutorial", s.data.flags.tutorial)
end

function Tut.onLeave(plr)
	started[plr] = nil
	cliff[plr] = nil
	round[plr] = nil
end

function Tut.state(plr, st)
	local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
	if not s or s.pending or s.busy or s.saving then
		return
	end
	local step = s.data.flags.tutorial
	if step >= 1 and step < DONE then
		local def = STEPS[step]
		local t = { step = step, total = DONE - 1, line = def and def.line or "" }
		if def and def.target then
			local pos, label = def.target(plr)
			if pos then
				t.target = pos
				t.label = label
			end
		end
		-- a full backpack at the Heartstone: send the player to bank first instead of a refused claim
		if step == 7 and Inv.free(plr.UserId) < C.HEARTSTONE_SLOTS then
			t.line = "Your backpack is full. Bank at the campfire, then come back for the Heartstone."
			t.target = ctx.Camps.bankPart and ctx.Camps.bankPart.Position
			t.label = "Bank"
		end
		if step==9 and #s.data.heartstones>0 and (s.data.home.nests[1] or "")=="" and (s.data.home.nests[2] or "")=="" then
			t.line="Visit a Foothold cabin and place your banked Heartstone in one of your two home nests."
			local p=plr.Character and plr.Character:GetPivot().Position
			local best,dist
			if #homePortals==0 then for _,x in ipairs(workspace.World:GetDescendants()) do if x:IsA("BasePart") and x.Name=="HomePortalStation" then homePortals[#homePortals+1]=x end end end
			for _,x in ipairs(homePortals) do
				if x.Parent and p then
					local d=(x.Position-p).Magnitude if not dist or d<dist then best,dist=x.Position,d end
				end
			end
			t.target=best t.label="Home cabin"
			if plr:GetAttribute("CC_InHome") then t.target=nil t.label="Home station" t.line="Use the home station to place your Heartstone in a nest. Then bank new discoveries to help it grow." end
		end
		st.tut = t
	end
end

return Tut

local Art=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.CC_Core.CommerceArt)
local M={};local ctx;local connections={}
function M.refresh(plr)
 local s,ch=ctx.sessions[plr],plr.Character;if not s or not ch then return end
 local old=ch:FindFirstChild("CC_CommerceCosmetics");if old then old:Destroy() end
 local f=Instance.new("Folder");f.Name="CC_CommerceCosmetics";f.Parent=ch
 local eq=s.data.commerce.equipped
 local torso=ch:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or ch:FindFirstChild("Torso")
 if eq.flag and torso then
  local m=Art.make("flag",f,torso.CFrame*CFrame.new(-0.3,-0.5,0.8),0.6)
  for _,p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Anchored=false;p.Massless=true;local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");w.Part0=torso;w.Part1=p;w.Parent=p end end
 end
 local lamp=ch:FindFirstChild("Headlamp",true)
 if lamp and lamp:IsA("BasePart") then
  if not lamp:GetAttribute("CommerceOriginalColor") then lamp:SetAttribute("CommerceOriginalColor",lamp.Color) end
  lamp.Color=eq.lantern and Color3.fromRGB(255,190,52) or lamp:GetAttribute("CommerceOriginalColor")
  -- Only the casing changes. Light range, brightness, color and automatic activation stay untouched.
  if eq.lantern then
   local casing=Instance.new("Part");casing.Name="SunbeamCasing";casing.Size=Vector3.new(0.48,0.36,0.12);casing.Color=Color3.fromRGB(91,62,151);casing.CFrame=lamp.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,0,0.14);casing.Massless=true;casing.CanCollide=false;casing.CanTouch=false;casing.CanQuery=false;casing.Parent=f
   local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");w.Part0=lamp;w.Part1=casing;w.Parent=casing
  end
 end
 local root=ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if eq.trail and root then
  local a=Instance.new("Attachment");a.Name="TrailAnchor";a.Position=Vector3.new(0,-1,0.7);a.Parent=f
  -- Attachments need a part ancestor; a welded inert carrier keeps cleanup within our own subtree.
  local carrier=Instance.new("Part");carrier.Name="TrailCarrier";carrier.Size=Vector3.new(0.1,0.1,0.1);carrier.Transparency=1;carrier.CFrame=root.CFrame;carrier.Massless=true;carrier.CanCollide=false;carrier.CanTouch=false;carrier.CanQuery=false;carrier.Parent=f;a.Parent=carrier
  local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");w.Part0=root;w.Part1=carrier;w.Parent=carrier
  local p=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter");p.Name="SunbeamSparkles";p.Texture="rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds";p.Rate=5;p.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.45,0.7);p.Speed=NumberRange.new(0,0.4);p.Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.22),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)});p.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255,218,91),Color3.fromRGB(96,221,235));p.LightEmission=0.6;p.Enabled=not s.data.settings.reducedMotion;p.Parent=a
 end
end
function M.home(room,data)
 local old=room.model:FindFirstChild("CommerceDecor");if old then old:Destroy() end
 local f=Instance.new("Folder");f.Name="CommerceDecor";f.Parent=room.model
 if data.commerce.equipped.banner then Art.make("banner",f,CFrame.new(room.center+Vector3.new(-6,0,-23)),1.3) end
 if data.home.decorEquipped.lamp then
  for _,x in ipairs({-9,9}) do Art.make("lamp",f,CFrame.new(room.center+Vector3.new(x,0,-19)),1.2) end
 end
end
function M.init(c) ctx=c end
function M.onCharacter(plr,ch)
 M.onLeave(plr)
 connections[plr]={
  ch.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v) if v.Name=="CC_Gear" then task.defer(function() if plr.Character==ch then M.refresh(plr) end end) end end),
  plr:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CC_ReducedMotion"):Connect(function() M.refresh(plr) end),
 }
 task.delay(1,function() if plr.Character==ch then M.refresh(plr) end end)
end
function M.onLoaded(plr) M.refresh(plr) end
function M.onLeave(plr) for _,c in ipairs(connections[plr] or {}) do c:Disconnect() end;connections[plr]=nil end
return M
-- Authoritative fall/checkpoint and server-movement boundary. Client fall reports are hints only.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SS=game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Run=game:GetService("RunService")
local Rules=require(RS:WaitForChild("CC_Core"):WaitForChild("TraversalRules"))
local FALL_DROP=24
local states={}
local function make(parent,class,name)
 local x=parent:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new(class); x.Name=name; x.Parent=parent; return x
end
local remotes=make(RS,"Folder","CC_Remotes")
local fellEv=make(remotes,"RemoteEvent","Fell")
local cpEv=make(remotes,"RemoteEvent","Checkpoint")
local api=make(SS,"Folder","CC_CheckpointAPI")
local fellBE=make(api,"BindableEvent","Fell")
local campBE=make(api,"BindableEvent","CampReached")
local setCp=make(api,"BindableFunction","SetCheckpoint")
local auth=make(api,"BindableFunction","AuthorizeMove")
local validateMove=make(api,"BindableFunction","ValidateMovement")
local function state(plr) states[plr]=states[plr] or {}; return states[plr] end
local function root(plr)
 local ch=plr.Character; return ch,ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"),ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function safeMode(ch)
 local m=ch:GetAttribute("CC_TraversalState")
 return m=="climb" or m=="rope" or m=="hanging" or m=="flight" or m=="travel"
end
local function resetBaseline(plr,pos)
 local s=state(plr); s.groundY=pos and pos.Y or nil; s.airY=nil; s.prev=pos; s.prevAt=os.clock(); s.grace=os.clock()+0.5
end
local function spawnAt(plr,pos)
 local ch,_,r=root(plr)
 if r then resetBaseline(plr,pos); r.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero; ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos)) end
end
local function validObservedMove(plr)
 local s=state(plr); local _,_,r=root(plr)
 if not r then return false end
 if s.prev and s.prevAt then
  local delta=r.Position-s.prev
  if not Rules.movementAllowed((delta*Vector3.new(1,0,1)).Magnitude,delta.Y,os.clock()-s.prevAt) then
   plr:SetAttribute("CC_MovementInvalidUntil",workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+8)
   s.pending=nil; spawnAt(plr,s.prev); return false
  end
 end
 return true
end
validateMove.OnInvoke=function(plr)
 if workspace:GetServerTimeNow()<(plr:GetAttribute("CC_MovementInvalidUntil") or 0) then return false end
 if not validObservedMove(plr) then return false end
 -- A bank request can arrive between touchdown and the next fall heartbeat.
 -- Keep the cargo carried until that already-measured drop receives its normal outcome.
 local s=state(plr); local _,_,r=root(plr)
 local baseline=s.airY or s.groundY
 return not baseline or baseline-r.Position.Y<=FALL_DROP
end
local function basePosition()
 local sp=workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpawnLocation")
 return sp and sp.Position+Vector3.yAxis*4 or Vector3.new(0,50,2160)
end
local function acceptFall(plr,drop)
 local s=state(plr)
 local ch,_,r=root(plr)
 if not r or not Rules.finite(drop) or drop<FALL_DROP or safeMode(ch) or ch:GetAttribute("CC_HomeVisit") then return end
 if os.clock()-(s.lastFall or -10)<1.5 then return end
 s.lastFall=os.clock(); s.falls=(s.falls or 0)+1
 plr:SetAttribute("CC_Falls",s.falls)
 local landingY=r.Position.Y
 spawnAt(plr,s.pos and s.pos+Vector3.yAxis*4 or basePosition())
 fellBE:Fire(plr,landingY)
end
-- No client-supplied drop is authoritative. The server's measured airborne baseline is required.
fellEv.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(plr)
 local s=state(plr); local _,_,r=root(plr)
 if r and s.airY then acceptFall(plr,s.airY-r.Position.Y) end
end)
auth.OnInvoke=function(plr,pos,kind)
 if typeof(pos)~="Vector3" then return false end
 resetBaseline(plr,pos)
 plr:SetAttribute("CC_LastTravelKind",tostring(kind or "server"))
 plr:SetAttribute("CC_MovementInvalidUntil",nil)
 return true
end
setCp.OnInvoke=function(plr,name)
 local s=state(plr); resetBaseline(plr,nil)
 if name==nil then s.name,s.pos,s.order=nil,nil,nil; plr:SetAttribute("CC_Checkpoint",""); return nil end
 local w=workspace:FindFirstChild("World"); local f=w and w:FindFirstChild("Checkpoints")
 for _,t in ipairs(f and f:GetChildren() or {}) do
  if t:GetAttribute("Checkpoint")==name and t:GetAttribute("Route")~="Ledge" and t:GetAttribute("Route")~="Spire" then
   s.name,s.pos,s.order=name,t.Position-Vector3.yAxis*(t.Size.Y/2-1),t:GetAttribute("Order")
   local idx=tonumber(string.match(name,"^Camp(%d)$")); s.highest=math.max(s.highest or 0,idx or 0)
   plr:SetAttribute("CC_Checkpoint",name); return s.pos
  end
 end
 return nil
end
local function onTouched(t,hit)
 local plr=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
 if not plr then return end
 local s=state(plr); local ch,h,r=root(plr)
	 s.pending=t
 if not h or not r or h.Health<=0 or ch:GetAttribute("CC_HomeVisit") or os.clock()<(s.grace or 0) then return end
	 if workspace:GetServerTimeNow()<(plr:GetAttribute("CC_MovementInvalidUntil") or 0) then return end
	 if not validObservedMove(plr) then return end
 local name=t:GetAttribute("Checkpoint"); local route=t:GetAttribute("Route")
 if type(name)~="string" then return end
 local idx=tonumber(string.match(name,"^Camp(%d)$"))
 if not Rules.checkpointAllowed(ch:GetAttribute("CC_TraversalState"),h.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air,route,idx,s.highest or 0) then return end
 local localPos=t.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(r.Position); local half=t.Size/2+Vector3.new(4,4,4)
 if math.abs(localPos.X)>half.X or math.abs(localPos.Y)>half.Y or math.abs(localPos.Z)>half.Z then s.pending=nil; return end
 if s.name==name then s.pending=nil; return end
 s.name,s.pos,s.order=name,t.Position-Vector3.yAxis*(t.Size.Y/2-1),t:GetAttribute("Order")
 if route~="*" then s.route=route end
 plr:SetAttribute("CC_Checkpoint",name); plr:SetAttribute("CC_Route",s.route or "")

-- One authoritative traversal state machine. Authored holds live in CC_TraversalDefs.
-- No generic wall climbing, altitude equipment, rescue rewards, or client-authored positions.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SS = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Run = game:GetService("RunService")
local HS = game:GetService("HttpService")
local K = require(RS.CC_Core.TraversalConfig)
local Rules = require(RS.CC_Core.TraversalRules)
local T = {}
local ctx, api
local states, sections, ropes, gates, darkZones = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
local closedRouteIndex, openRouteIndex
local function V(a) return Vector3.new(a[1], a[2], a[3]) end
local function actor(plr)
	local ch = plr.Character
	return ch, ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function ray(plr, p, d)
	local rp = RaycastParams.new()
	rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = plr.Character and { plr.Character } or {}
	return workspace:Raycast(p, d, rp)
end
local function grounded(plr)
	local _, h, r = actor(plr)
	if not h or not r or h.Health <= 0 then return false end
	local g = ray(plr, r.Position, Vector3.new(0, -(h.HipHeight + r.Size.Y / 2 + 0.8), 0))
	return g ~= nil and g.Normal.Y > 0.6 and r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y < 7
end
local function get(plr)
	if not states[plr] then states[plr] = { mode = "ground", stamina = plr:GetAttribute("CC_StaminaMax") or 100, hand = "L", nextAt = 0 } end
	return states[plr]
end
local function publish(plr, s)
	local ch = plr.Character
	if not ch then return end
	ch:SetAttribute("CC_TraversalState", s.mode)
	ch:SetAttribute("CC_ClimbState", (s.mode == "climb" or s.mode == "rope") and "climb" or s.mode == "hanging" and "slide" or "none")
	ch:SetAttribute("CC_ClimbS", (s.mode == "climb" or s.mode == "rope") and "climb" or s.mode == "hanging" and "slide" or "none")
	ch:SetAttribute("CC_Stamina", math.floor(s.stamina + 0.5))
	ch:SetAttribute("CC_SectionId", s.section and s.section.id or "")
	ch:SetAttribute("CC_HoldId", s.hold and s.hold.id or "")
	ch:SetAttribute("CC_NextHand", s.hand)
	ch:SetAttribute("CC_HoldIndex", s.index or 0)
	ch:SetAttribute("CC_ClimbDirection", s.direction or 1)
	ch:SetAttribute("CC_Clipped", s.clip ~= nil)
	ch:SetAttribute("CC_CanRecover", s.mode == "hanging" and s.stamina >= K.recoverAt)
	ch:SetAttribute("CC_RhythmAt", s.nextAt or 0)
end
local function detachRope(s)
	if s.rope then s.rope.occupants = math.max(0, s.rope.occupants - 1); s.rope = nil end
end
local function clearHarness(s)
	for _, part in ipairs(s.harness or {}) do part:Destroy() end
	s.harness = nil
end
local function clearFlight(plr)
	local ch, h, r = actor(plr)
	if r then
		for _, name in ipairs({ "CC_FlightVelocity", "CC_FlightAttachment" }) do local x = r:FindFirstChild(name); if x then x:Destroy() end end
	end
	if ch then local canopy = ch:FindFirstChild("CC_Parachute"); if canopy then canopy:Destroy() end end
	if h then h.PlatformStand = false; h.AutoRotate = true end
end
local function leave(plr, mode)
	local s = get(plr)
	detachRope(s)
	clearHarness(s)
	clearFlight(plr)
	local _, h, r = actor(plr)
	if r then r.Anchored = false; pcall(function() r:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto() end) end
	if h then h.PlatformStand = false; h.AutoRotate = true; if mode == "fall" then h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall) end end
	s.mode, s.section, s.hold, s.move, s.clip, s.index = mode or "ground", nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
	s.jumpAt = nil
	publish(plr, s)
end
local function authorize(plr, pos, kind)
	if api and api:FindFirstChild("AuthorizeMove") then api.AuthorizeMove:Invoke(plr, pos, kind) end
end
function T.travel(plr, pos, kind)
	if typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
	local ch, _, r = actor(plr)
	if not r then return false end
	leave(plr, "ground")
	local s = get(plr)
	s.mode = "travel"
	s.travelToken = (s.travelToken or 0) + 1
	local token = s.travelToken
	r.Anchored = true
	publish(plr, s)
	if kind == "homeEnter" or kind == "homeReturn" or kind == "shuttle" or kind == "resume" or kind == "reconnect" then
		-- Keep the avatar safe while the destination streams. Home courts stream atomically.
		local ok, err = pcall(function() plr:RequestStreamAroundAsync(pos, 4) end)
		if not ok then warn("[CC] destination streaming request: " .. tostring(err)) end
	end
	if plr.Character ~= ch or not r.Parent or states[plr] ~= s or s.travelToken ~= token then return false end
	authorize(plr, pos, kind or "travel")
	r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos))
	s.lastGround, s.lastSafe = pos, pos
	s.travelAt, s.travelKind = ctx.Clock.now(), kind
	-- The durable inventory owner persists the receipt with the cargo; no adventure credit is granted here.
	local session = ctx.sessions[plr]
	if session then
		session.data.expedition = session.data.expedition or {}
		session.data.expedition.travel = { kind = kind or "travel", at = ctx.Clock.now(), x = pos.X, y = pos.Y, z = pos.Z }
		session.dirty = true
	end
	ctx.emit("travel", plr, kind, pos)
	ctx.push(plr)
	task.delay(0.45, function()
		if states[plr] == s and s.travelToken == token and plr.Character == ch and r.Parent then
			r.Anchored = false
			pcall(function() r:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto() end)
			s.mode = "ground"
			authorize(plr, r.Position, kind or "travel")
			publish(plr, s)
		end
	end)
	return true
end
function T.isProtected(plr)
	local s = states[plr]
	return s and (s.mode == "climb" or s.mode == "rope" or s.mode == "hanging" or s.mode == "flight") or false
end
function T.canBank(plr)
	local s = get(plr)
	if s.mode~="ground" or not grounded(plr) or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()<(plr:GetAttribute("CC_MovementInvalidUntil") or 0) then return false end
	local validate=api and api:FindFirstChild("ValidateMovement")
	return validate~=nil and validate:Invoke(plr)==true
end
local function location(plr)
	local _, _, r = actor(plr)
	if not r then return nil end
	local best, dist
	for name, cp in pairs(ctx.Camps and ctx.Camps._pads or {}) do
		local d = (r.Position - cp.center).Magnitude
		if d < K.flightLaunchRadius and (not dist or d < dist) then best, dist = { name = name, center = cp.center, order = table.find(ctx.C.RESUME_CAMPS, name) or 0 }, d end
	end
	return best
end
local function canUse(plr, section)
	if not section or not K.launchRoutes[section.route] then return false end
	if section.practice and ctx.Training and ctx.Training.canUseSection then return ctx.Training.canUseSection(plr, section.practice) end
	return true
end
local function nearest(plr, top)
	local _, _, r = actor(plr)
	if not r then return nil end
	local best, distance
	for _, sec in pairs(sections) do
		local d = (r.Position - (top and sec.exit or sec.entry)).Magnitude
		if canUse(plr, sec) and d < (top and K.topRange or K.entryRange) and (not distance or d < distance) then best, distance = sec, d end
	end
	return best
end
local function currentRope(id)
	local rope = ropes[id]
	return rope and not rope.retiring and rope.expires > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() and rope or nil
end
local function moveTo(plr, s, pos, finish)
	local _, _, r = actor(plr)
	if not r then return end
	s.move = { from = r.Position, to = pos, start = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), finish = finish }
end
local function begin(plr, sec, clip, descending)
	local s = get(plr)
	local ch, h, r = actor(plr)
	if s.mode ~= "ground" or not grounded(plr) or not r or not canUse(plr, sec) then return false end
	local start = descending and sec.exit or sec.entry
	if (r.Position - start).Magnitude > K.entryRange + 2 then return false end
	local rope = currentRope(sec.id)
	if sec.protected and not clip and not rope then return false end
	s.section, s.direction, s.hand = sec, descending and -1 or 1, "L"
	s.index = descending and #sec.holds or 1
	s.hold = sec.holds[s.index]
	s.clip = clip and sec.id or nil
	if clip and sec.topAnchor then
		local a = Instance.new("Attachment"); a.Name = "HarnessClip"; a.Position = Vector3.new(0, -0.6, 0); a.Parent = r
		local b = Instance.new("Attachment"); b.Name = "PersonalAnchor"; b.Parent = sec.topAnchor
		local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
		beam.Name, beam.Attachment0, beam.Attachment1 = "PersonalHarnessTether", a, b
		beam.Width0, beam.Width1, beam.FaceCamera, beam.Segments = 0.075, 0.075, true, 1
		beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(224, 173, 105))
		beam.Transparency, beam.LightInfluence, beam.Parent = NumberSequence.new(0.1), 1, a
		s.harness = { a, b }
	end
	s.mode, s.nextAt = rope and "rope" or "climb", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + K.stepSeconds
	s.rope = rope
	if rope then rope.occupants += 1 end
	s.stamina = math.max(10, s.stamina)
	h.PlatformStand, h.AutoRotate = true, false
	r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	pcall(function() r:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end)
	r.Anchored = true
	moveTo(plr, s, s.hold.pos)
	publish(plr, s)
	ctx.toast(plr, rope and "Shared rope attached. Alternate left and right to ascend." or "Harness clipped for this section. Alternate left and right; take your time.")
	return true
end
local function slip(plr, reason)
	local s = get(plr)
	if s.mode ~= "climb" and s.mode ~= "rope" then return end
	if s.clip == s.section.id then
		s.mode = "hanging"
		s.stamina = math.max(0, s.stamina - 5)
		moveTo(plr, s, s.hold.pos - Vector3.yAxis * K.hangDrop)
		ctx.toast(plr, "Harness caught you. Your finds are safe. Rest, then regain your hold.")
		ctx.emit("traversalCatch", plr, s.section.id, reason)
		publish(plr, s)
	else leave(plr, "fall") end
end
local function step(plr, payload)
	local s = get(plr)
	local _, _, r = actor(plr)
	if not s.section or not s.hold or not r or s.move then return end
	if (r.Position - s.hold.pos).Magnitude > K.holdTolerance then slip(plr, "displaced"); return end
	local nextIndex = s.index + s.direction
	local hold = s.section.holds[nextIndex]
	if hold and payload.choice == "stable" and hold.alternative then hold = hold.alternative end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local ok, cost = Rules.step(s, payload.hand, hold or { finish = true }, now, K, plr:GetAttribute("CC_TimingAssist") == true)
	if not ok then
		if cost == "tired" then slip(plr, "stamina")
		elseif (cost == "hand" or cost == "early") and now - (s.lastMistake or 0) > 0.4 then
			s.lastMistake = now
			-- One error never causes a fall; waiting is never an error.
			s.stamina = math.max(1, s.stamina - K.mistakeCost)
			ctx.fx(plr, { kind = "traversalCue", text = cost == "hand" and ("Next: " .. s.hand) or "A gentle rhythm. Try again.", mistake = true })
		end
		publish(plr, s)
		return
	end
	s.stamina -= cost
	s.hand = s.hand == "L" and "R" or "L"
	s.nextAt = now + (plr:GetAttribute("CC_TimingAssist") and K.assistedSeconds or K.stepSeconds)
	if hold then
		s.index, s.hold = nextIndex, hold
		moveTo(plr, s, hold.pos)
	else
		moveTo(plr, s, s.direction > 0 and s.section.exit or s.section.entry, true)
	end
	publish(plr, s)
end
local function deployRope(plr, id)
	local s = get(plr)
	local sec = id and sections[id] or nearest(plr, true)
	local _, _, r = actor(plr)
	if s.mode ~= "ground" or not r or not grounded(plr) or not canUse(plr, sec) or (r.Position - sec.exit).Magnitude > K.topRange then return end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if now - (s.lastRope or -100) < K.ropeCooldown then return end
	if currentRope(sec.id) then ctx.toast(plr, "A shared rope is already ready here."); return end
	local owned = 0
	for _, rope in pairs(ropes) do if rope.owner == plr.UserId then owned += 1 end end
	if owned >= K.ropeLimit then ctx.toast(plr, "Two ropes are already out. Occupied ropes remain safe until everyone leaves."); return end
	-- A retiring occupied rope cannot be replaced under its occupants.
	if ropes[sec.id] then ctx.toast(plr, "This rope is finishing its current climbs."); return end
	local a, b = sec.holds[1].pos, sec.holds[#sec.holds].pos
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name, p.Shape, p.Material = "SharedRope", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Enum.Material.Fabric
	p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch, p.CanQuery, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
	p.Size, p.Color = Vector3.new((b - a).Magnitude, 0.22, 0.22), Color3.fromRGB(244, 192, 105)
	p.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0)
	p.Parent = workspace.World:FindFirstChild("ExpeditionTraversal") or workspace.World
	ropes[sec.id] = { owner = plr.UserId, section = sec.id, expires = now + K.ropeSeconds, occupants = 0, part = p }
	s.lastRope = now
	ctx.toast(plr, "Shared rope deployed. Other climbers attach at the lower anchor.", "good")
end
local function flightLanding(plr, s, pos)
	local base = ctx.C.FOOTHOLD_SAFE
	if ((pos - base.center) * Vector3.new(1,0,1)).Magnitude < base.radius and pos.Y < base.center.Y + 60 then return true end
	for name, cp in pairs(ctx.Camps and ctx.Camps._pads or {}) do
		local order = table.find(ctx.C.RESUME_CAMPS, name) or 0
		if (pos - cp.center).Magnitude < K.flightLandingRadius and Rules.canLand(s.launch.order, order, pos.Y, s.launch.center.Y) then return true end
	end
	return false
end
local function deploy(plr)
	local s = get(plr)
	local ch, h, r = actor(plr)
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if not r or not s.launch or not Rules.canDeploy(s, now, not grounded(plr), r.Position.Y, s.launch.center.Y, K) then return end
	if (r.Position - s.launch.center).Magnitude > K.flightLaunchRadius + 6 then return end
	s.mode, s.flightAt, s.steer = "flight", now, Vector3.zero
	h.PlatformStand, h.AutoRotate = true, false
	pcall(function() r:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end)
	local att = Instance.new("Attachment"); att.Name = "CC_FlightAttachment"; att.Parent = r
	local lv = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	lv.Name, lv.Attachment0, lv.RelativeTo = "CC_FlightVelocity", att, Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	lv.MaxForce, lv.VectorVelocity, lv.Parent = math.huge, Vector3.new(0, -K.flightSink, 0), r
	local canopy = Instance.new("Part")
	canopy.Name, canopy.Shape, canopy.Size = "CC_Parachute", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(11, 2.6, 7)
	canopy.Color, canopy.Material = Color3.fromRGB(194, 139, 73), Enum.Material.Fabric
	canopy.CanCollide, canopy.CanQuery, canopy.CanTouch, canopy.Massless = false, false, false, true
	canopy.CFrame, canopy.Parent = r.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0), ch
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint"); weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.Parent = r, canopy, canopy
	publish(plr, s)
	ctx.toast(plr, "Parachute open. Steer gently toward a camp below or the Foothold. Landing keeps finds in your pack.")
end
function T.rescue(helper, climber)
	local s = states[climber]
	local _, _, a = actor(helper)
	local _, _, b = actor(climber)
	if helper == climber or not s or s.mode ~= "hanging" or not grounded(helper) or not a or not b then return false end
	if (a.Position - b.Position).Magnitude > 14 or a.Position.Y < b.Position.Y + 2 or workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - (s.rescuedAt or 0) < 30 then return false end
	s.rescuedAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	s.stamina = math.min(climber:GetAttribute("CC_StaminaMax") or 100, s.stamina + 30)
	ctx.toast(helper, "You helped them regain their grip.", "good")
	ctx.toast(climber, helper.DisplayName .. " helped you. Regain your hold when ready.", "good")
	return true
end
local function recover(plr)
	local s = get(plr)
	if s.mode ~= "hanging" or s.stamina < K.recoverAt or s.move then return end
	s.mode = s.rope and "rope" or "climb"
	s.nextAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + K.stepSeconds
	moveTo(plr, s, s.hold.pos)
	publish(plr, s)
end
local function handle(plr, p)
	local s = get(plr)
	if not ctx.sessions[plr] or type(p.action) ~= "string" then return end
	if p.action == "step" then step(plr, p)
	elseif p.action == "clip" then begin(plr, nearest(plr, false), true, false)
	elseif p.action == "grab" then local sec = nearest(plr, false); if sec and currentRope(sec.id) then begin(plr, sec, false, false) end
	elseif p.action == "descend" then begin(plr, nearest(plr, true), true, true)
	elseif p.action == "recover" then recover(plr)
	elseif p.action == "release" and (s.mode == "climb" or s.mode == "rope" or s.mode == "hanging") then leave(plr, "fall")
	elseif p.action == "slip" then slip(plr, "hazard")
	elseif p.action == "rope" then deployRope(plr)
	elseif p.action == "jump" and s.mode == "ground" and grounded(plr) then
		local launch = location(plr)
		local _, _, r = actor(plr)
		if launch and r then s.jumpAt, s.jumpY, s.launch, s.jumpAirborne = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), r.Position.Y, launch, false end
	elseif p.action == "parachute" then deploy(plr)
	elseif p.action == "steer" and s.mode == "flight" and Rules.finite(p.x) and Rules.finite(p.z) then
		local v = Vector3.new(p.x, 0, p.z); s.steer = v.Magnitude > 1 and v.Unit or v
		s.steerAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	end
end
local function iceAt(plr, s, r)
	local hit = ray(plr, r.Position, s.section and s.section.into * 5 or Vector3.new(0,-5,0))
	return hit and (hit.Material == Enum.Material.Ice or hit.Material == Enum.Material.Glacier or hit.Instance:GetAttribute("Icy") == true) or false
end
local function isDark(pos, plr)
	local W = ctx.C.WEATHER
	local phase = ((workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - (workspace:GetAttribute("CC_DayStart") or workspace:GetServerTimeNow())) % (W.dayMinutes * 60)) / (W.dayMinutes * 60)
	if phase >= W.dayShare then return true end
	for _, z in ipairs(darkZones) do
		if z.Parent then local p = z.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(pos); local h = z.Size / 2; if math.abs(p.X)<h.X and math.abs(p.Y)<h.Y and math.abs(p.Z)<h.Z then return true end end
	end
	-- Covered stone passages and recesses use actual occlusion, never altitude.
	local roof = ray(plr, pos + Vector3.yAxis * 2, Vector3.yAxis * 18)
	if roof then
		local walls = 0
		for _, d in ipairs({ Vector3.xAxis, -Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.zAxis, -Vector3.zAxis }) do
			if ray(plr, pos + Vector3.yAxis, d * 12) then walls += 1 end
		end
		if walls >= 2 then return true end
	end
	return false
end
local function update(plr, s, dt, now)
	local ch, h, r = actor(plr)
	if not r or not h or h.Health <= 0 then return end
	if s.mode == "travel" then return end
	local maxSt = plr:GetAttribute("CC_StaminaMax") or 100
	if now >= (s.senseAt or 0) then
		s.senseAt = now + 0.5
		s.ice = iceAt(plr, s, r)
		ch:SetAttribute("CC_IceActive", s.ice)
		ch:SetAttribute("CC_AxeActive", s.ice and (s.mode == "climb" or s.mode == "rope"))
		ch:SetAttribute("CC_CramponsActive", s.ice)
		local dark = isDark(r.Position, plr)
		ch:SetAttribute("CC_Dark", dark)
		ch:SetAttribute("CC_HeadlampActive", dark and plr:GetAttribute("CC_HeadlampMode") ~= "off")
	end
	if s.move then
		local m = s.move
		local f = math.clamp((now - m.start) / K.moveSeconds, 0, 1)
		local pos = m.from:Lerp(m.to, f * f * (3 - 2*f))
		r.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + s.section.into)
		if f >= 1 then
			s.move = nil
			if m.finish then
				local id, route, direction = s.section.id, s.section.route, s.direction
				authorize(plr, m.to, "climbLanding")
				leave(plr, "ground")
				if direction > 0 then ctx.emit("traversalSection", plr, id, route) end
			end
		end
	elseif s.mode == "hanging" then s.stamina = math.min(maxSt, s.stamina + K.hangingRegen * dt)
	elseif s.mode == "climb" or s.mode == "rope" then
		if s.hold.stable then s.stamina = math.min(maxSt, s.stamina + K.stableRegen * dt) end
		if (r.Position - s.hold.pos).Magnitude > K.holdTolerance then slip(plr, "displaced") end
	elseif s.mode == "flight" then
		local velocity = r:FindFirstChild("CC_FlightVelocity")
		if now - (s.steerAt or 0) > 0.75 then s.steer = Vector3.zero end
		if velocity then velocity.VectorVelocity = (s.steer or Vector3.zero) * K.flightSpeed + Vector3.new(0, -K.flightSink, 0) end
		local floor = ray(plr, r.Position, Vector3.new(0,-4,0))
		if now - s.flightAt > 0.6 and floor and floor.Normal.Y > 0.6 then
			local pos = floor.Position + Vector3.yAxis * 3
			if flightLanding(plr, s, pos) then
				T.travel(plr, pos, "parachute")
				local session = ctx.sessions[plr]
				if session and not session.data.flags.parachutePractice then
					session.data.flags.parachutePractice = true; session.dirty = true
					plr:SetAttribute("CC_ParachutePractice", true)
					ctx.saveSoon(session)
				end
				ctx.toast(plr, "Landed. Parachute packed; your finds are still in your backpack.", "good")
			else
				T.travel(plr, s.launch.center + Vector3.yAxis * 4, "practiceReturn")
				ctx.toast(plr, "That ledge is outside the landing areas. Returned safely to your launch camp with your finds.")
			end
		elseif now - s.flightAt > K.flightMaxSeconds or r.Position.Y < -100 then
			T.travel(plr, s.launch.center + Vector3.yAxis * 4, "practiceReturn")
		end
	elseif grounded(plr) then
		if s.mode ~= "ground" or not s.groundSince then s.groundSince=now end
		s.mode = "ground"
		if s.jumpAirborne then s.jumpAt, s.jumpAirborne = nil, nil end
		s.stamina = math.min(maxSt, s.stamina + K.groundRegen * dt)
		s.lastGround = r.Position
		-- Actual ice only: counter ground drift when no movement is requested.
		if s.ice and h.MoveDirection.Magnitude < 0.1 then local v=r.AssemblyLinearVelocity; r.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(v.X*0.25,v.Y,v.Z*0.25) end
	else
		-- A grounded jump receipt remains eligible for its short deploy window; walkoffs have no receipt.
		s.mode = "fall"
		s.groundSince=nil
		if s.jumpAt then s.jumpAirborne = true end
	end
	-- Reject access after landing settles, so this never becomes a midair fall rescue.
	if s.mode=="ground" and s.groundSince and now-s.groundSince>=0.25 and not ch:GetAttribute("CC_HomeVisit") and now>=(s.routeCheckAt or 0) then
		s.routeCheckAt=now+0.2
		local closed=closedRouteIndex and Rules.closedRouteAt(closedRouteIndex,openRouteIndex,{r.Position.X,r.Position.Y,r.Position.Z})
		if closed then
			for _,cp in pairs(ctx.Camps and ctx.Camps._pads or {}) do
				if (r.Position-cp.center).Magnitude<80 then closed=nil; break end
			end
		end
		for _, gate in ipairs(gates) do
			local p = gate.cf:PointToObjectSpace(r.Position)
			if closed==gate.route and Rules.closedGateApproach(p.X,p.Y,p.Z) then closed=nil end
			local entrance=math.abs(p.X)<85 and p.Z<-2 and p.Z>-180 and p.Y>-30 and p.Y<150
			if entrance or closed==gate.route then
				T.travel(plr, gate.cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0,3,16)), "closedRoute")
				ctx.toast(plr, gate.route .. " is Coming Soon. Choose Shepherd or Waterfall.")
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if now - (s.pubAt or 0) >= 0.2 then s.pubAt = now; publish(plr, s) end
end
function T.state(plr, st)
	local s = get(plr)
	st.traversal = { mode=s.mode, stamina=s.stamina, maxStamina=plr:GetAttribute("CC_StaminaMax") or 100, section=s.section and s.section.id, hand=s.hand, clipped=s.clip ~= nil }
end
function T.onCharacter(plr, ch)
	local old = states[plr]; if old then detachRope(old); clearHarness(old) end
	states[plr] = nil
	local s = get(plr)
	local h = ch:WaitForChild("Humanoid",10)
	if h then
		h:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing, false)
		h.Died:Connect(function() leave(plr,"fall") end)
	end
	publish(plr,s)
end
function T.onLoaded(plr, session)
	plr:SetAttribute("CC_ParachuteUnlocked", session.data.highestCamp >= 1 or session.data.flags.parachuteIntroduced == true)
	plr:SetAttribute("CC_ParachutePractice", session.data.flags.parachutePractice == true)
end
function T.onLeave(plr)
	local s=states[plr]; if s then detachRope(s); clearHarness(s) end
	states[plr]=nil
	for _, rope in pairs(ropes) do if rope.owner == plr.UserId then rope.retiring=true end end
end
function T.init(c)
	ctx=c; ctx.Traversal=T
	api=SS:WaitForChild("CC_CheckpointAPI",10)
	local folder=RS:WaitForChild("CC_TraversalDefs",10)
	assert(folder,"Missing authored traversal registry; run AuthorTraversal in Edit mode")
	for _, sv in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		local ok,sec=pcall(function() return HS:JSONDecode(sv.Value) end)
		if ok and sec.holds and #sec.holds>=2 and K.launchRoutes[sec.route] then
			sec.entry,sec.exit,sec.into=V(sec.entry),V(sec.exit),V(sec.into)
			for _,hold in ipairs(sec.holds) do hold.pos=V(hold.p); if hold.alternative then hold.alternative.pos=V(hold.alternative.p) end end
			sections[sec.id]=sec
		end
	end
	T.sections, T.states = sections, states
	local world=workspace:WaitForChild("World")
	local old=world:FindFirstChild("ExpeditionTraversal"); if old then old:Destroy() end
	local anchors=Instance.new("Folder"); anchors.Name="ExpeditionTraversal"; anchors.Parent=world
	local Prompts=require(script.Parent.Prompts)
	for _,sec in pairs(sections) do
		for _,top in ipairs({false,true}) do
			local p=Instance.new("Part")
			p.Name=top and "TopAnchor" or "ClipAnchor"
			p.Size=Vector3.new(0.6,0.9,0.6); p.Color=Color3.fromRGB(238,184,98); p.Material=Enum.Material.Metal
			p.Anchored,p.CanCollide,p.CanTouch,p.CanQuery=true,false,false,false
			p.Position=(top and sec.exit or sec.entry)+sec.into:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)*2-Vector3.yAxis*1
			p:SetAttribute("SectionId",sec.id); p.Parent=anchors
			if top then sec.topAnchor = p end
			local prompt=Prompts.make(p,{Name=top and "SharedRopePrompt" or "HarnessPrompt",ActionText=top and "Deploy shared rope" or "Clip & climb",ObjectText=sec.tutorial and "First protected climb" or sec.practice and ("Practice crag "..sec.practice) or "Marked climbing anchor",HoldDuration=0,MaxActivationDistance=7})
			prompt.KeyboardKeyCode=Enum.KeyCode.F; prompt.GamepadKeyCode=Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY
			prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(plr) if Prompts.validate(prompt,plr) then if top then deployRope(plr,sec.id) else begin(plr,sec,true,false) end end end)
		end
	end
	for _,d in ipairs(world:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d:GetAttribute("DarkZone") then darkZones[#darkZones+1]=d end
		if d:IsA("Model") and d:GetAttribute("ComingSoon") then
			local board=d:FindFirstChild("Board")
			if board then gates[#gates+1]={cf=d:GetPivot(),route=d:GetAttribute("Route") or d.Name:gsub("Gate_","")} end
		end
	end
	local closedPaths,openPaths={},{}
	local function append(route,points)
		if #points>=2 then table.insert((route=="Ledge" or route=="Spire") and closedPaths or openPaths,{route=route,points=points}) end
	end
	for _,sv in ipairs((RS:FindFirstChild("CC_Route") and RS.CC_Route:GetChildren()) or {}) do
		if sv:IsA("StringValue") then
			local points={}
			for row in sv.Value:gmatch("[^;]+") do
				local x,y,z=row:match("([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)")
				x,y,z=tonumber(x),tonumber(y),tonumber(z)
				if Rules.finite(x) and Rules.finite(y) and Rules.finite(z) then points[#points+1]={x,y,z} end
			end
			append(sv.Name,points)
		end
	end
	for _,sv in ipairs((RS:FindFirstChild("CC_Track") and RS.CC_Track:GetChildren()) or {}) do
		if sv:IsA("StringValue") then
			local ok,tracks=pcall(function() return HS:JSONDecode(sv.Value) end)
			if ok and type(tracks)=="table" then
				for _,track in ipairs(tracks) do
					local points={}
					for _,node in ipairs(track.nodes or {}) do if node.p then points[#points+1]=node.p end end
					append(sv.Name,points)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _,sec in pairs(sections) do
		local points={{sec.entry.X,sec.entry.Y,sec.entry.Z}}
		for _,hold in ipairs(sec.holds) do points[#points+1]=hold.p end
		points[#points+1]={sec.exit.X,sec.exit.Y,sec.exit.Z}
		append(sec.route,points)
	end
	closedRouteIndex,openRouteIndex=Rules.routeIndex(closedPaths,64),Rules.routeIndex(openPaths,64)
	ctx.handlers.traversal=handle
	ctx.on("hit",function(plr) slip(plr,"guardian") end)
	if api then
		api.CampReached.Event:Connect(function(plr, name)
			local session = ctx.sessions[plr]
			if session and tostring(name):match("^Camp[1-4]$") and not session.data.flags.parachuteIntroduced then
				session.data.flags.parachuteIntroduced = true; session.dirty = true
				plr:SetAttribute("CC_ParachuteUnlocked", true)
				ctx.toast(plr, "Your parachute is ready. Practice here: jump from the camp, then use Open parachute. Landings keep your finds carried.")
				ctx.saveSoon(session)
			end
		end)
	end
	local accumulator=0
	Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		accumulator+=dt; if accumulator<0.05 then return end
		local elapsed=math.min(accumulator,0.2); accumulator=0
		local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		for plr,s in pairs(states) do update(plr,s,elapsed,now) end
		for id,rope in pairs(ropes) do
			if now>=rope.expires then rope.retiring=true end
			if Rules.canRemoveRope(rope,now) then if rope.part then rope.part:Destroy() end; ropes[id]=nil end
		end
	end)
	if ctx.devHandlers then
		ctx.devHandlers.traversal=function(plr,p) handle(plr,p) end
	end
end
return T
