-- Studio server only. require(...TraversalRouteSmoke)(startIndex, count)
-- Runs real section transitions through the live server bridge. Batches stop before 52 seconds.
-- Rest/normal recovery are used; stamina is never written by the test.
return function(startIndex,count)
	assert(game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio())
	local HS=game:GetService("HttpService")
	local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local bridge=game:GetService("ServerStorage"):WaitForChild("CC_DevBridge")
	local plr=game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()[1]
	assert(plr and plr.Character,"player missing")
	local ch=plr.Character
	local root=ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid=ch:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local start=root.Position
	local sections={}
	for _,sv in ipairs(RS.CC_TraversalDefs:GetChildren()) do sections[#sections+1]=HS:JSONDecode(sv.Value) end
	table.sort(sections,function(a,b) return a.id<b.id end)
	startIndex=math.clamp(tonumber(startIndex) or 1,1,#sections)
	count=math.clamp(tonumber(count) or 6,1,8)
	local function call(action,p)
		p=p or {}; p.name=plr.Name
		return HS:JSONDecode(bridge:Invoke(action,p)).result
	end
	local function request(action,p)
		p=p or {}; p.action=action
		return call("request",{action="traversal",payload=p})
	end
	local function move(pos) call("move",{x=pos.X,y=pos.Y,z=pos.Z}) end
	local function mode() return ch:GetAttribute("CC_TraversalState") end
	local function position() local p=root.Position; return {p.X,p.Y,p.Z} end
	local function cargo()
		local st=call("snapshot"); local ids={}
		for _,it in ipairs(st.items or {}) do ids[#ids+1]=it.uid end
		table.sort(ids); return table.concat(ids,",")
	end
	local before=cargo()
	local started=os.clock()
	local rows={}
	local nextIndex=startIndex
	for index=startIndex,math.min(#sections,startIndex+count-1) do
		local sec=sections[index]
		local estimated=#sec.holds*0.52+5
		if #rows>0 and os.clock()-started+estimated>51 then break end
		local row={index=index,id=sec.id,holds=#sec.holds,pass=false}
		local entry,exit=Vector3.new(table.unpack(sec.entry)),Vector3.new(table.unpack(sec.exit))
		local ok,err=pcall(function()
			pcall(function() plr:RequestStreamAroundAsync(entry,2) end)
			move(entry); task.wait(0.95)
			row.entryDelta=(root.Position-entry).Magnitude
			row.entryPosition=position()
			row.floor=humanoid.FloorMaterial.Name
			request("clip"); task.wait(0.4)
			if mode()~="climb" and mode()~="rope" then
				row.reason=sec.practice and sec.practice>1 and "locked practice or unsupported entry" or "clip rejected"
				return
			end
			row.selectedSection=ch:GetAttribute("CC_SectionId")
			if row.selectedSection~=sec.id then row.reason="nearest anchor selected another section"; return end
			local attempts,catches=0,0
			while attempts<#sec.holds+12 and os.clock()-started<50 do
				if mode()=="ground" then break end
				if mode()=="hanging" then
					catches+=1
					task.wait(2.1); request("recover"); task.wait(0.4)
				elseif mode()=="climb" or mode()=="rope" then
					local i=ch:GetAttribute("CC_HoldIndex") or 1
					local h=sec.holds[i]
					if (ch:GetAttribute("CC_Stamina") or 100)<6 and h and (h.stable or h.alternative) then task.wait(2) end
					request("step",{hand=ch:GetAttribute("CC_NextHand"),choice="stable"})
					attempts+=1; task.wait(0.5)
				else break end
			end
			task.wait(0.7)
			row.exitDelta=(root.Position-exit).Magnitude
			row.catches,row.attempts=catches,attempts
			row.pass=mode()=="ground" and humanoid.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air and row.exitDelta<7 and cargo()==before
			if not row.pass then row.reason="landing/state/cargo mismatch" end
		end)
		if not ok then row.reason=tostring(err) end
		row.mode,row.position,row.stamina=mode(),position(),ch:GetAttribute("CC_Stamina")
		rows[#rows+1]=row
		nextIndex=index+1
		if mode()=="ground" and os.clock()-started<47 then task.wait(3) end
	end
	move(start)
	return {rows=rows,nextIndex=nextIndex,total=#sections,done=nextIndex>#sections,elapsed=os.clock()-started,kind="scripted actual rig/section test, not whole-route walking or human feel"}
end
sources.src/runtime/CC_CoreService.server.luau:
-- CC_CoreService (ServerScriptService): boots the core loop (Run 1: A1 persistence + B systems).
-- Owns player sessions: profile load (session lock, retries), autosave every 60 s, release on leave and shutdown,
-- manual Heartstone progress, the bank deposit entry point, state pushes and toasts, the CoreRequest router (rate-limited)
-- and Studio-only test hooks. Gameplay modules in ServerScriptService.CC_CoreServer plug in through ctx:
--   M.init(ctx) · M.onLoaded(plr, session) · M.onLeave(plr, session) · M.onCharacter(plr, char) · M.state(plr, st)
-- Real DataStore only when the place is published (game.PlaceId ~= 0); otherwise the in-memory store (UNVERIFIED
-- real-DataStore behavior, see design/core-run-report.md).
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Run = game:GetService("RunService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local CoreRS = RS:WaitForChild("CC_Core")
local C = require(CoreRS:WaitForChild("CoreConfig"))
local Species = require(CoreRS:WaitForChild("Species"))
local Net = require(CoreRS:WaitForChild("Net"))
local SrvF = script.Parent:WaitForChild("CC_CoreServer")
local Clock = require(SrvF.Clock)
local Store = require(SrvF.Store)
local Profile = require(SrvF.Profile)
local Inv = require(SrvF.Inventory)
local Bank = require(SrvF.Bank)
local Prog = require(SrvF.Progression)

-- Publish builds: Studio dev tools never exist in a live server (user review 2026-10-20: strip them before
-- publishing; Studio keeps them). tools/publish_strip.luau removes them from a publish copy; this is the backstop.
if not Run:IsStudio() then
	local SS = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	for _, pair in ipairs({ { RS, "CC_DevTools" }, { SS, "CC_DevTools" }, { SS, "CC_DevBridge" }, { SS, "CC_Checkpoints" }, { SrvF, "Tests" } }) do
		local inst = pair[1]:FindFirstChild(pair[2])
		if inst then
			inst:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local remotes = Net.serverInit()
local stateEv, toastEv, fxEv, reqEv = remotes.CoreState, remotes.CoreToast, remotes.CoreFx, remotes.CoreRequest

local store = Store.default(C.PERSIST.dataStore)
-- 2 quick attempts per load call; loadLoop keeps retrying every 15 s and shows the safe message meanwhile
local profiles = Profile.new(store, { loadTries = 2 })

local ctx = {
	C = C,
	Species = Species,
	Clock = Clock,
	Inv = Inv,
	Bank = Bank,
	Prog = Prog,
	Profile = Profile,
	profiles = profiles,
	store = store,
	sessions = {}, -- [plr] = session
	saveState = {}, -- [plr] = "loading" | "ok" | "unavailable" | "locked" | "lost"
	handlers = {}, -- [action] = fn(plr, payload)
	modules = {},
	remotes = remotes,
}
_G.CC_CORE_CTX = Run:IsStudio() and ctx or nil

local MESSAGES = {
	loading = "Loading your expedition…",
	unavailable = "Can't reach the save server. Your finds stay in your backpack; banking is paused until it reconnects.",
	locked = "Your profile is still saving on another server. Retrying…",
	lost = "Your profile was opened on another server, so this session stopped saving.",
	outdated = "This server runs an older version than your save. Rejoin to get a newer server.",
	back = "Saving reconnected. Banking is open again.",
	bankPaused = "Banking is paused until saving reconnects. Nothing was lost.",
}

---------------------------------------------------------------- outputs
function ctx.toast(plr, text, kind)
	if plr and plr.Parent then
		toastEv:FireClient(plr, { text = text, kind = kind or "info" })
	end
end
function ctx.fx(plr, payload)
	if plr and plr.Parent then
		fxEv:FireClient(plr, payload)
	end
end
function ctx.fxAll(payload)
	fxEv:FireAllClients(payload)
end

local dirty = {}
function ctx.push(plr)
	dirty[plr] = true
end

-- tiny event bus between gameplay modules: claim, bank, net, heartstone, hit, cliffhanger
local listeners = {}
function ctx.on(name, fn)
	listeners[name] = listeners[name] or {}
	table.insert(listeners[name], fn)
end
function ctx.emit(name, ...)
	for _, fn in ipairs(listeners[name] or {}) do
		task.spawn(fn, ...)
	end
end

-- after any backpack change: carried-Heartstone glow (others see cargo value) + state push
function ctx.invChanged(plr)
	local best
	for _, it in ipairs(Inv.bag(plr.UserId).items) do
		if it.kind == "heartstone" and (not best or (C.HEARTSTONE_VALUE[it.tier] or 0) > (C.HEARTSTONE_VALUE[best] or 0)) then
			best = it.tier
		end
	end
	if ctx.Visuals and plr.Character then
		ctx.Visuals.setCarryGlow(plr.Character, best)
	end
	ctx.push(plr)
end

local function snapshot(plr)
	local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
	local uid = plr.UserId
	local st = {
		saveState = ctx.saveState[plr] or "loading",
		storeKind = store.kind,
		serverNow = Clock.now(),
		items = Inv.view(uid),
		used = Inv.used(uid),
		capacity = Inv.bag(uid).capacity,
	}
	if s then
		local d = s.data
		st.coins, st.xp, st.level, st.slots = d.coins, d.xp, d.level, d.slots
		st.nextXp = Prog.nextLevelXp(d)
		st.levelXp = C.LEVEL_XP[d.level]
		st.bankCount = #d.bank
		st.codexCount = Prog.speciesCount(d)
		st.firstBank = d.flags.firstBankAt > 0
		st.tutorial = d.flags.tutorial
		st.netTier = d.flags.netTier
		st.highestCamp = d.highestCamp
		st.heartstones = {}
		for _, h in ipairs(d.heartstones) do
			st.heartstones[#st.heartstones + 1] = { uid=h.id, id=h.id, tier=h.tier, progress=h.progress, required=h.required, ready=h.ready }
		end
	end
	st.bank = ctx.bankState and ctx.bankState[plr] or {status="idle"}
	st.settings = s and s.data.settings or nil
	st.journal = s and s.data.journal or {}
	for _, m in ipairs(ctx.modules) do
		if m.state then
			local ok, err = pcall(m.state, plr, st)
			if not ok then
				warn("[CC] state hook: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end
	return st
end
ctx.snapshot = snapshot

---------------------------------------------------------------- durable transaction boundary
local completions = {} -- one callback for a pending durable transaction; world changes follow confirmation
local bankState = {}
ctx.bankState=bankState
local function finishCommit(plr,s,r)
 local pending=completions[s]
 if pending and r.ok then
  completions[s]=nil
  if pending.fn then local ok,err=pcall(pending.fn,r) if not ok then warn("[CC] committed effect: "..tostring(err)) end end
  ctx.invChanged(plr)
 end
end
function ctx.transaction(plr,tx,transform,committed)
 local s=ctx.sessions[plr]
 if not s or s.closing or s.lost then return {ok=false,reason="unavailable"} end
 if s.outcomePending and not string.match(tx,"^outcome:") then return {ok=false,reason="busy"} end
 if s.pending or s.busy or s.saving then return {ok=false,reason="busy"} end
 local r=profiles:transact(s,tx,transform)
 if r.ok then
  if committed then local ok,err=pcall(committed,r) if not ok then warn("[CC] committed effect: "..tostring(err)) end end
 elseif r.pending then
  completions[s]={fn=committed,tx=tx}
  ctx.saveState[plr]="unavailable"
  plr:SetAttribute("CC_SaveState","unavailable")
 end
 ctx.push(plr)
 return r
end
local function atBank(plr)
 local part=ctx.Camps and ctx.Camps.bankPart
 local ch=plr.Character
 local hrp=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local hum=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 return part and hrp and hum and hum.Health>0 and (hrp.Position-part.Position).Magnitude<=18
  and (not ctx.Traversal or not ctx.Traversal.canBank or ctx.Traversal.canBank(plr))
end
function ctx.deposit(plr,txId)
 local s=ctx.sessions[plr]
 if not s or not atBank(plr) then return {ok=false,reason="bank_distance"} end
 if s.outcomePending then return {ok=false,reason="outcome_pending"} end
 if type(txId)~="string" or #txId>128 then txId=nil end
 local function complete(r)
  bankState[plr]={status="success",message="Saved at the bank.",retryable=false}
  if not r.dup and ((r.creatures or 0)+(r.heartstones or 0))>0 then
   ctx.toast(plr,string.format("Banked %d creatures and %d Heartstones. Saved.",r.creatures or 0,r.heartstones or 0),"good")
   ctx.fx(plr,{kind="bank",res=r}) ctx.emit("bank",plr,r)
   plr:SetAttribute("CC_FirstBank",s.data.flags.firstBankAt>0)
  end
  ctx.invChanged(plr)
 end
 if s.pending then
  local r=profiles:recover(s)
  if r.ok then
   finishCommit(plr,s,r)
   ctx.saveState[plr]="ok" plr:SetAttribute("CC_SaveState","ok")
  end
  ctx.push(plr)
  return r
 end
 if ctx.saveState[plr]~="ok" or s.busy or s.saving then
  bankState[plr]={status="error",message="Saving is unavailable. Your cargo is safe; retry here.",retryable=true}
  ctx.push(plr) return {ok=false,reason="unavailable"}
 end
 bankState[plr]={status="saving",message="Saving your finds…",retryable=false} ctx.push(plr)
 local tx=txId or HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
 local r=Bank.deposit(s,plr.UserId,tx)
 if r.ok then complete(r)
 elseif r.pending then
  completions[s]={fn=complete,tx=tx}
  bankState[plr]={status="uncertain",message="Confirming the save. Please wait or retry here.",retryable=true}
  ctx.saveState[plr]="unavailable" plr:SetAttribute("CC_SaveState","unavailable")
 else bankState[plr]={status="error",message="Could not bank. Your finds stay in your backpack.",retryable=true} end
 ctx.push(plr)
 return r
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- sessions
local pendingRelease = {} -- [userId] = session whose release has not reached the store yet

-- write a banked deposit right away instead of waiting for the 60-s autosave (shrinks the crash window);
-- if a write is in flight, the 15-s loop picks it up
function ctx.saveSoon(s)
	if s.saving or s.pending or s.busy then
		s.saveAgain = true
		return
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		if s.pending or s.busy then s.saveAgain=true return end
		local plr
		for p, x in pairs(ctx.sessions) do
			if x == s then
				plr = p
			end
		end
		local ok, reason = profiles:save(s, false)
		if not ok and plr and reason ~= "lost" and ctx.sessions[plr] == s then
			ctx.saveState[plr] = "unavailable"
			plr:SetAttribute("CC_SaveState", "unavailable")
			ctx.push(plr)
		end
	end)
end

local function setSave(plr, st)
	local prev = ctx.saveState[plr]
	ctx.saveState[plr] = st
	plr:SetAttribute("CC_SaveState", st)
	-- loading/unavailable/locked are shown by the client's persistent save banner, so no toast for them
	if st ~= prev and st == "lost" then
		ctx.toast(plr, MESSAGES.lost, "warn")
	elseif st == "ok" and (prev == "unavailable" or prev == "locked") then
		ctx.toast(plr, MESSAGES.back, "good")
	end
	ctx.push(plr)
end

-- stub ids retired by the Codex roster (Species `replaces`) are remapped once, so the codex never double-counts
local function remapRetired(d)
	local map = Species.retired
	if not map then
		return false
	end
	local changed = false
	for _, b in ipairs(d.bank) do
		if map[b.species] then
			b.species, changed = map[b.species], true
		end
	end
	for _, h in ipairs(d.heartstones) do
		if map[h.species] then
			h.species, changed = map[h.species], true
		end
	end
	for old, new in pairs(map) do
		if d.codex[old] then
			d.codex[new] = (d.codex[new] or 0) + d.codex[old]
			d.codex[old] = nil
			changed = true
		end
	end
	return changed
end

local function afterLoad(plr, s)
	ctx.sessions[plr] = s
	if remapRetired(s.data) then
		s.dirty = true
	end
	Prog.refresh(s.data)
	Inv.bind(plr.UserId,s)
	Inv.setCapacity(plr.UserId, s.data.slots)
	local away = (s.data.lastSeen > 0) and (Clock.now() - s.data.lastSeen) or 0
 setSave(plr,"ok")
 plr:SetAttribute("CC_Tutorial",s.data.flags.tutorial)
 plr:SetAttribute("CC_FirstBank",s.data.flags.firstBankAt>0)
 for key,attr in pairs({textScale="CC_TextScale",reducedMotion="CC_ReducedMotion",timingAssist="CC_TimingAssist",headlampMode="CC_HeadlampMode"}) do
  plr:SetAttribute(attr,s.data.settings[key])
 end
 ctx.fx(plr,{kind="welcome",away=away,hatched={}})
	for _, m in ipairs(ctx.modules) do
		if m.onLoaded then
			task.spawn(m.onLoaded, plr, s)
		end
	end
end

local loading = {} -- [plr] = true while a loadLoop owns this player (PlayerAdded + startup sweep can overlap)

local function loadLoop(plr)
	if loading[plr] or ctx.sessions[plr] then
		return
	end
	loading[plr] = true
	local uid = plr.UserId
	-- same-server rejoin while the last release is still retrying: reuse that in-memory session (freshest data),
	-- but only once no write is in flight; if that write released the profile meanwhile, load normally.
	local pend = pendingRelease[uid]
	if pend then
		while pend.saving do
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
		if not pend.lost and not pend.released then
			pendingRelease[uid] = nil
			pend.leaving, pend.closing = false, false
			loading[plr] = nil
			afterLoad(plr, pend)
			return
		end
		pendingRelease[uid] = nil
	end
	setSave(plr, "loading")
	while plr.Parent do
		local s, reason = profiles:load(uid)
		if not plr.Parent then
			if s then
				profiles:save(s, true)
			end
			return
		end
		if s then
			loading[plr] = nil
			afterLoad(plr, s)
			return
		end
		setSave(plr, (reason == "locked" and "locked") or (reason == "newer" and "outdated") or "unavailable")
		task.wait(15)
	end
	loading[plr] = nil
end

local function release(plr, s)
	if not s then
		return
	end
	s.leaving, s.closing = true, true -- closing: no deposit can be acknowledged after the release snapshot
	completions[s]=nil -- durable state is reconstructed by onLoaded; old Player callbacks must not survive departure
	local ok = profiles:save(s, true)
	if ok or s.lost then
		return
	end
	-- keep retrying in the background (5 min); a rejoin to this server reuses the session meanwhile
	pendingRelease[s.userId] = s
	task.spawn(function()
		for _ = 1, 20 do
			task.wait(15)
			if pendingRelease[s.userId] ~= s or not s.leaving then
				return
			end
			if profiles:save(s, true) or s.lost then
				pendingRelease[s.userId] = nil
				return
			end
		end
		if pendingRelease[s.userId] == s then
			pendingRelease[s.userId] = nil
			s.lost = true -- never reuse it: the store may hold newer data by now
			if profiles.active[s.userId] == s then
				profiles.active[s.userId] = nil
			end
		end
		warn("[CC] gave up releasing profile " .. s.key .. " after 5 min; data since the last save is lost")
	end)
end

-- one join path for PlayerAdded and the startup sweep (Studio / deferred events can deliver PlayerAdded after the
-- sweep already loaded the player; a second pass must not reset the save state or clear the backpack)
local joined = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local function onJoin(plr)
	if joined[plr] then
		return
	end
	joined[plr] = true
	Inv.clear(plr.UserId)
	ctx.saveState[plr] = "loading"
	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
		task.delay(0.5, function()
			if plr.Parent then
				ctx.invChanged(plr)
			end
		end)
		for _, m in ipairs(ctx.modules) do
			if m.onCharacter then
				task.spawn(m.onCharacter, plr, ch)
			end
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(loadLoop, plr)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
	loading[plr] = nil
	local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
	for _, m in ipairs(ctx.modules) do
		if m.onLeave then
			local ok, err = pcall(m.onLeave, plr, s)
			if not ok then
				warn("[CC] onLeave: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end
	ctx.sessions[plr] = nil
	ctx.saveState[plr] = nil
	dirty[plr] = nil
	Inv.clear(plr.UserId)
	release(plr, s)
end)

-- shutdown: release EVERY session this server still owns, including leave-releases already in flight
-- (those live only in profiles.active); the server waits for BindToClose, not for other threads
game:BindToClose(function()
	local list, seen = {}, {}
	local function add(s)
		if s and not seen[s] then
			seen[s] = true
			list[#list + 1] = s
		end
	end
	for _, s in pairs(ctx.sessions) do
		add(s)
	end
	for _, s in pairs(pendingRelease) do
		add(s)
	end
	for _, s in pairs(profiles.active) do
		add(s)
	end
	local left = #list
	for _, s in ipairs(list) do
		s.closing = true
		task.spawn(function()
			profiles:save(s, true) -- waits for an in-flight write first, then releases (or reports "released")
			left -= 1
		end)
	end
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while left > 0 and os.clock() - t0 < 25 do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end)

-- autosave every 60 s (also refreshes the session lock). While saves fail, banking pauses (safe banner) and the
-- save is retried every 15 s, so no deposit is acknowledged that the store can't take.
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(15)
		for plr, s in pairs(ctx.sessions) do
			local failing = ctx.saveState[plr] == "unavailable"
			if not s.pending and (failing or s.saveAgain or Clock.now() - (s.lastSave or 0) >= C.PERSIST.autosave) and not s.saving then
				s.saveAgain = false
				task.spawn(function()
					local ok, reason = profiles:save(s, false)
					if ok then
						if ctx.saveState[plr] == "unavailable" and ctx.sessions[plr] == s then
							setSave(plr, "ok")
						end
					elseif reason == "lost" then
						setSave(plr, "lost")
						ctx.sessions[plr] = nil
						if not Run:IsStudio() then
							plr:Kick(MESSAGES.lost)
						end
					else
						warn("[CC] autosave failed for " .. s.key .. ": " .. tostring(reason))
						if ctx.sessions[plr] == s then
							setSave(plr, "unavailable")
						end
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
 while true do
  task.wait(3)
  for plr,s in pairs(ctx.sessions) do
   if s.pending and not s.saving and not s.busy then
    local r=profiles:recover(s)
    if r.ok then finishCommit(plr,s,r) setSave(plr,"ok")
    elseif r.reason=="lost" then
     completions[s]=nil setSave(plr,"lost")
     if not Run:IsStudio() then plr:Kick(MESSAGES.lost) end
    end
   end
  end
 end
end)

Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	for plr in pairs(dirty) do
		dirty[plr] = nil
		if plr.Parent then
			stateEv:FireClient(plr, snapshot(plr))
		end
	end
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------- requests (rate-limited)
local buckets = {} -- [plr] = { tokens, t }
local function allow(plr,action)
	local lane=action=="traversal" and "traversal" or "menu"
	buckets[plr]=buckets[plr] or {}
	local b = buckets[plr][lane]
	local cap,rate=lane=="traversal" and 16 or 8,lane=="traversal" and 12 or 4
	local now = os.clock()
	if not b then
		b = { tokens = cap, t = now }
		buckets[plr][lane] = b
	end
	b.tokens = math.min(cap, b.tokens + (now - b.t) * rate)
	b.t = now
	if b.tokens < 1 then
		return false
	end
	b.tokens -= 1
	return true
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
	buckets[plr] = nil
end)

reqEv.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(plr, action, payload)
	if type(action) ~= "string" or #action > 32 or not allow(plr,action) then
		return
	end
	if action == "state" then
		ctx.push(plr)
		return
	end
 local s=ctx.sessions[plr]
 if s and (s.pending or s.busy or s.saving or s.outcomePending) and action~="traversal" and action~="bankRetry" then
  ctx.toast(plr,"Finishing a save. Please try again in a moment.","info") return
 end
 local h = ctx.handlers[action]
 if h then
		local ok, err = pcall(h, plr, type(payload) == "table" and payload or {})
		if not ok then
			warn("[CC] request " .. action .. ": " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
end)

if Run:IsStudio() then
	ctx.devHandlers = {} -- filled by modules (init) and the Studio-only block below
end

ctx.handlers.bankRetry=function(plr)
 local r=ctx.deposit(plr)
 if r.reason=="bank_distance" then ctx.toast(plr,"Return to the Foothold campfire to retry banking.","info") end
end
ctx.handlers.settingsSet=function(plr,p)
 local allowed={textScale="CC_TextScale",reducedMotion="CC_ReducedMotion",timingAssist="CC_TimingAssist",headlampMode="CC_HeadlampMode"}
 if type(p.key)~="string" or not allowed[p.key] then return end
 local v=p.value
 if p.key=="textScale" then if type(v)~="number" or v~=v then return end v=math.clamp(v,0.9,1.3)
 elseif p.key=="headlampMode" then if v~="auto" and v~="on" and v~="off" then return end
 elseif type(v)~="boolean" then return end
 ctx.transaction(plr,"setting:"..HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),function(d) d.settings[p.key]=v return {ok=true} end,function()
  plr:SetAttribute(allowed[p.key],v) ctx.push(plr)
 end)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- gameplay modules (B)
-- v4 P4 (run 2): Gear (shop, kit, canisters, Summit Points), Coop (rescue + party ropes), Training (Yard annex),
-- Weather (day/night + weather states)
for _, name in ipairs({ "Visuals", "Cargo", "DropPacks", "Camps", "Claims", "Nests", "Tutorial", "Gear", "Traversal", "Coop", "Training", "Home", "Discovery", "Weather", "CommerceCosmetics", "CommerceDisplays", "Commerce" }) do
	local m = SrvF:FindFirstChild(name)
	if m then
		local ok, mod = pcall(require, m)
		if ok and type(mod) == "table" then
			ctx[name] = mod
			ctx.modules[#ctx.modules + 1] = mod
		else
			warn("[CC] module " .. name .. " failed: " .. tostring(mod))
		end
	end
end
for _, m in ipairs(ctx.modules) do
	if m.init then
		local ok, err = pcall(m.init, ctx)
		if not ok then
			warn("[CC] init: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- Studio-only test hooks
if Run:IsStudio() then
	local dev = remotes:FindFirstChild("DevRequest")
	dev.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(plr, action, payload)
		local h = ctx.devHandlers[action]
		if h then
			local ok, err = pcall(h, plr, type(payload) == "table" and payload or {})
			if not ok then
				warn("[CC] dev " .. tostring(action) .. ": " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end)
	-- leave + rejoin inside one Play Solo session, through the same release path as PlayerRemoving.
	-- p.failOnJoin: the store goes down after the leave (a join while the store is down).
	-- p.clockOffset: time away before the join (offline gap).
	function ctx.devRejoin(plr, p)
		p = p or {}
		local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
		for _, m in ipairs(ctx.modules) do
			if m.onLeave then
				pcall(m.onLeave, plr, s)
			end
		end
		ctx.sessions[plr] = nil
		Inv.clear(plr.UserId)
		release(plr, s)
		if p.failOnJoin and store.kind == "memory" then
			store.failAll = true
		end
		if type(p.clockOffset) == "number" then
			Clock.offset = p.clockOffset
		end
		task.spawn(loadLoop, plr)
		return s ~= nil and s.released == true
	end
	ctx.devHandlers.rejoin = function(plr, p)
		return ctx.devRejoin(plr, p)
	end
	ctx.devHandlers.storeFail = function(_, p)
		if store.kind == "memory" then
			store.failAll = p.on == true
		end
		return store.failAll
	end
	ctx.devHandlers.clock = function(_, p)
		Clock.offset = tonumber(p.offset) or 0
		return Clock.offset
	end
	ctx.devHandlers.grant = function(plr, p)
		local added = 0
		for _, g in ipairs(p.items or {}) do
			local it
			if g.kind == "heartstone" then
				local sp = Bank.rollHatch(g.tier or "Common", 1)
				it = Inv.newItem("heartstone", { tier = g.tier or "Common", species = sp, region = 1, source = "dev" })
			else
				local e = Species.query({ region = 1, rarity = g.rarity or "Common", kind = "creature" })[1]
				it = Inv.newItem("creature", { species = e.id, rarity = e.rarity, region = 1, source = type(g.source) == "string" and g.source or "dev" })
			end
			if Inv.add(plr.UserId, it) then
				added += 1
			end
		end
		ctx.push(plr)
		return added
	end
	-- fresh profile for repeated tutorial bot runs (keeps the session and its lock; Studio only)
	ctx.devHandlers.resetProfile = function(plr)
		local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
		if not s then
			return false
		end
		Inv.clear(plr.UserId)
		if ctx.DropPacks then
			ctx.DropPacks.clearOwner(plr.UserId)
		end
		for _, name in ipairs({ "Nests", "Camps", "Tutorial" }) do
			local m = ctx[name]
			if m and m.onLeave then
				pcall(m.onLeave, plr, s)
			end
		end
		s.data = Profile.default()
		Inv.bind(plr.UserId,s)
		s.dirty = true
		Prog.refresh(s.data)
		Inv.setCapacity(plr.UserId, s.data.slots)
		Clock.offset = 0
		local api = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild("CC_CheckpointAPI")
		if api then
			api.SetCheckpoint:Invoke(plr, nil)
		end
		local sp = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpawnLocation")
		local ch = plr.Character
		if sp and ch then
			ch:PivotTo(sp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
		end
		ctx.invChanged(plr)
		if ctx.Tutorial then
			ctx.Tutorial.onLoaded(plr, s)
		end
		return true
	end
	-- fast bots (WalkSpeed > 12) scale the bank travel check; Studio only
	ctx.devHandlers.botSpeed = function(_, p)
		ctx.devSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(p.factor) or 1, 1, 6)
		return ctx.devSpeed
	end
	ctx.devHandlers.setCheckpoint = function(plr, p)
		local api = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild("CC_CheckpointAPI")
		return api and api.SetCheckpoint:Invoke(plr, type(p.name) == "string" and p.name or nil)
	end
	ctx.devHandlers.deposit = function(plr, p)
		return ctx.deposit(plr, p.tx)
	end
 ctx.devHandlers.snapshot=function(plr) return ctx.snapshot(plr) end
 ctx.devHandlers.request=function(plr,p) local h=ctx.handlers[p.action] if h then return h(plr,p.payload or {}) end end
 ctx.devHandlers.move=function(plr,p)
  local pos=Vector3.new(p.x,p.y,p.z)
  if ctx.Traversal then ctx.Traversal.travel(plr,pos,"test") else plr.Character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos)) end
  return true
 end
 ctx.devHandlers.status = function()
		local out = { store = store.kind, failAll = store.failAll, clockOffset = Clock.offset, players = {} }
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
			local row = { name = plr.Name, saveState = ctx.saveState[plr], used = Inv.used(plr.UserId), capacity = Inv.bag(plr.UserId).capacity }
			if s then
				row.bank, row.coins, row.xp, row.level = #s.data.bank, s.data.coins, s.data.xp, s.data.level
				row.heartstones, row.highestCamp, row.tutorial = #s.data.heartstones, s.data.highestCamp, s.data.flags.tutorial
				row.firstBank = s.data.flags.firstBankAt > 0
				row.session = s.sessionId:sub(1, 8)
			end
			out.players[#out.players + 1] = row
		end
		out.log = profiles.log
		return out
	end
	-- the MCP's execute_luau runs in its own VM (no shared _G), so tests reach the live server through this
	local bridge = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild("CC_DevBridge") or Instance.new("BindableFunction")
	bridge.Name = "CC_DevBridge"
	bridge.OnInvoke = function(action, p)
		p = type(p) == "table" and p or {}
		local plr = p.name and Players:FindFirstChild(p.name) or Players:GetPlayers()[1]
		local h = ctx.devHandlers[action]
		if not h then
			return "unknown action " .. tostring(action)
		end
		return HttpService:JSONEncode({ result = h(plr, p) })
	end
	bridge.Parent = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
end

for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(onJoin, plr)
end

--   require(ServerStorage.CC_Generators:Clone().LedgeP1).build(require(ServerStorage.CC_Generators.Kit))
-- Needs the terrain with the Ledge route's stampSkip (s 40-640) applied (natural cliff, no stamped trail) and the
-- Ledge route in ReplicatedStorage.CC_Route (B.player). Run after B.camps (camps wipe World.Checkpoints).
-- Output: Workspace.World.LedgeP1 (+ World.Hazards.LedgeP1, two checkpoint triggers in World.Checkpoints).
-- Line (all placements PROPOSED): Ledge gate -> open foothills -> trailhead on the lower bench -> Face B (marked
-- strata face) -> Ledge L1 along the cliff contour with a fixed handline (a knife-ridge stretch standing off the
-- flank, a rest ledge + checkpoint, a rockfall chute crossed on a marked panel) -> the final pillar (ladder pitch,
-- then a marked face) -> the old ledge at s~645. Marked = Climbable attribute (CC_ClimbClient); everything else is
-- plain rock. Colors are existing Kit tokens: slate/sandstone strata (Broken Cliffs words, Ledge route identity =
-- sandstone), lantern ropes/flags (references: orange fixed ropes, glowing route flags), moon mist.
local LP = {}

LP.TH = Vector3.new(-470, 0, 1872) -- trailhead on the lower bench
LP.FACE_B = { x = -488, z = 1863, w = 11, top = 160 } -- bench -> L1
LP.L1 = { x0 = -489, x1 = -712, y0 = 160, y1 = 168, zLo = 1760, zHi = 1930 }
LP.FIN = { a = 0.08, b = 0.47, off = 16, ramp = 16 } -- run 2 fix: ~56 studs at full stand-off (was ~24); a ramp of 8 let walkers cut into air -- knife-ridge stretch (fractions of L1), stand-off from the flank, ramp
LP.REST = 0.50
LP.CHUTE = 0.76
LP.LADDER_TOP = 190 -- ladder from L1's end to here, then a marked face to the exit ledge
LP.EXIT_S = 645 -- Ledge route arc length where the section joins the old ledge
LP.APPROACH = { Vector3.new(-150, 0, 1834), Vector3.new(-300, 0, 1860) } -- flags gate -> trailhead

local terrainOnly = RaycastParams.new()
terrainOnly.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
terrainOnly.FilterDescendantsInstances = { workspace.Terrain }
local function ground(x, z)
	local r = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, 900, z), Vector3.new(0, -1000, 0), terrainOnly)
	return r and r.Position.Y or 0
end
local function flat(v)
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end
-- horizontal unit pointing down-slope at (x, z)
local function outwardAt(x, z)
	local gx = ground(x + 3, z) - ground(x - 3, z)
	local gz = ground(x, z + 3) - ground(x, z - 3)
	local v = Vector3.new(-gx, 0, -gz)
	return v.Magnitude > 1e-3 and v.Unit or Vector3.zAxis
end
-- z where the terrain at x crosses height y (terrain falls toward +z on this flank)
local function contourZ(x, y, zLo, zHi)
	for _ = 1, 22 do
		local m = (zLo + zHi) / 2
		if ground(x, m) > y then
			zLo = m
		else
			zHi = m
		end
	end
	return (zLo + zHi) / 2
end
local function routePoint(name, s)
	local sv = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("CC_Route")
	sv = sv and sv:FindFirstChild(name)
	local best
	for tok in string.gmatch(sv and sv.Value or "", "[^;]+") do
		local x, y, z, ss = tok:match("([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)")
		if tonumber(ss) >= s then
			best = Vector3.new(tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z))
			break
		end
	end
	return best
end

function LP.build(Kit)
	local COL = Kit.COL
	local world = Kit.folder(workspace, "World")
	local old = world:FindFirstChild("LedgeP1")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local root = Kit.folder(world, "LedgeP1")
	local hz = Kit.folder(world, "Hazards")
	local oldH = hz:FindFirstChild("LedgeP1")
	if oldH then
		oldH:Destroy()
	end
	local cps = Kit.folder(world, "Checkpoints")
	for _, n in ipairs({ "CP_LedgeP1_Start", "CP_LedgeP1_Rest" }) do
		local c = cps:FindFirstChild(n)
		if c then
			c:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local report = {}
	local nParts = 0
	local function P(parent, props)
		nParts += 1
		return Kit.part(parent, props)
	end

	-- strata: band heights and colors cycle deterministically (slate / sandstone / slate / lichen rock)
	local rng = Random.new(4207)
	-- run 2 fix (self-review "striped boxes"): faces are one rock mass. Strata differ in texture (Rock / Slate
	-- material) and a small shade step between the lichen-rock and slate tokens, never in hue; sandstone stays on
	-- the walking ledges (Ledge route identity) only.
	local function bandAt()
		local r = rng:NextNumber()
		local mat = (r < 0.6) and Enum.Material.Rock or Enum.Material.Slate
		return { COL.rock:Lerp(COL.slate, 0.08 + rng:NextNumber() * 0.3), mat }
	end

	-- a rock buttress with a vertical front at `front` (bottom-centre point; y ignored) facing `o` (outward):
	-- strata slabs from y0 to y1, each deep enough to reach back into the slope; marked climbable or not
	local function buttress(parent, name, front, o, width, y0, y1, climbable)
		local m = Kit.model(parent, name)
		local right = o:Cross(Vector3.yAxis).Unit
		local y, i = y0, 0
		while y < y1 - 0.01 do
			i += 1
			local band = bandAt()
			local h = math.min(y1 - y, 2.6 + rng:NextNumber() * 3.4)
			if y1 - (y + h) < 1.5 then
				h = y1 - y
			end
			-- depth: back from the front plane until the slope is above the band top (sampled at both edges)
			local depth = 4
			for _, k in ipairs({ -0.45, 0, 0.45 }) do
				local base = front + right * (width * k)
				for d = 0, 60, 1 do
					local q = base - o * d
					if ground(q.X, q.Z) > y + h + 1 then
						depth = math.max(depth, d + 2.5)
						break
					end
					if d == 60 then
						depth = math.max(depth, 60)
					end
				end
			end
			local jit = rng:NextNumber() * 0.5 - 0.2
			local c = Vector3.new(front.X, y + h / 2, front.Z) - o * (depth / 2 - jit)
			local s = P(m, {
				Name = climbable and "MarkedRock" or "Rock",
				Size = Vector3.new(width + rng:NextNumber() * 0.8, h, depth),
				CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(c, c + o) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(rng:NextNumber() * 3 - 1.5), math.rad(rng:NextNumber() * 3 - 1.5)),
				Material = band[2],
				Color = band[1],
			})
			if climbable then
				s:SetAttribute("Climbable", true)
			end
			y += h
		end
		return m, i
	end

	-- fixed rope down a marked face (the cue that this rock is climbable) with pitons
	local function faceRope(parent, front, o, y0, y1)
		local a = Vector3.new(front.X, y0 + 0.5, front.Z) + o * 0.45
		local b = Vector3.new(front.X, y1 + 0.6, front.Z) + o * 0.45
		local r = P(parent, { Name = "FixedRope", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new((b - a).Magnitude, 0.34, 0.34), CFrame = CFrame.new((a + b) / 2) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = COL.lantern })
		Kit.decor(r)
		for y = y0 + 4, y1, 6 do
			Kit.decor(P(parent, { Name = "Piton", Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 1.2), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(front.X, y, front.Z) + o * 0.3, Vector3.new(front.X, y, front.Z) + o * 2), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, Color = COL.slate }))
		end
	end

	-- glowing route flag on a cairn (guidance layer a; GuideOrder feeds the Guide pulse, layer b)
	local function marker(parent, pos, order, outward)
		local m = Kit.model(parent, "Flag_" .. order)
		local g = Vector3.new(pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z)
		for k, sz in ipairs({ 2.2, 1.6, 1.1 }) do
			Kit.decor(P(m, { Name = "Cairn", Size = Vector3.new(sz, sz * 0.6, sz), CFrame = CFrame.new(g + Vector3.new(0.6, (k - 0.6) * sz * 0.6, 0.4)) * CFrame.Angles(0, k * 0.9, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Slate, Color = (k == 2) and COL.sandstone or COL.slate }))
		end
		Kit.decor(P(m, { Name = "Pole", Size = Vector3.new(0.35, 7, 0.35), CFrame = CFrame.new(g + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark }))
		local o = outward or Vector3.xAxis
		local flag = P(m, { Name = "GuideFlag", Size = Vector3.new(0.15, 1.5, 2.6), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(g + Vector3.new(0, 6.2, 0) + o * 1.3, g + Vector3.new(0, 6.2, 0) + o * 1.3 + o:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)), Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Color = COL.lantern })
		Kit.decor(flag)
		-- the glow: a small lamp bead on the pole top (a whole Neon flag blooms into a blob)
		Kit.decor(P(m, { Name = "Lamp", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * 0.55, CFrame = CFrame.new(g + Vector3.new(0, 7.2, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = COL.lantern }))
		flag:SetAttribute("GuideOrder", order)
		flag:SetAttribute("GuideRoute", "Ledge")
		local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
		l.Color = COL.lantern
		l.Range = 12
		l.Brightness = 0.9
		l.Shadows = false
		l.Parent = flag
		return m
	end

	local function trigger(name, pos, attrs)
		local t = Instance.new("Part")
		t.Name = name
		t.Anchored, t.CanCollide, t.CanQuery = true, false, false
		t.Transparency = 1
		t.Size = Vector3.new(16, 14, 16)
		t.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0))
		for k, v in pairs(attrs) do
			t:SetAttribute(k, v)
		end
		t.Parent = cps
		return t
	end

	------------------------------------------------ approach flags (gate -> trailhead, open foothills)
	local appr = Kit.folder(root, "Approach")
	for k, a in ipairs(LP.APPROACH) do
		marker(appr, Vector3.new(a.X, ground(a.X, a.Z), a.Z), k, Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
	end

	------------------------------------------------ trailhead + Face B
	local th = Vector3.new(LP.TH.X, ground(LP.TH.X, LP.TH.Z), LP.TH.Z)
	marker(root, th, 3, Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
	Kit.sign(root, CFrame.lookAt(th + Vector3.new(4, 0, 3), th + Vector3.new(4, 0, 8)), { { "CLIFF LEDGE LINE" }, { "Push into roped rock to climb" }, { "Jump = lunge  ·  X = let go" } }, 9)
	trigger("CP_LedgeP1_Start", th, { Checkpoint = "LedgeP1_Start", Label = "Cliff Ledge Line", Route = "Ledge", Order = 1, Camp = false })
	local FB = LP.FACE_B
	local oB = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
	local fbFront = Vector3.new(FB.x, 0, FB.z)
	local fbBase = ground(FB.x, FB.z + 2) - 2
	local _, nb = buttress(root, "FaceB", fbFront, oB, FB.w, fbBase, FB.top, true)
	faceRope(root, fbFront, oB, fbBase + 2, FB.top)
	report.faceB = string.format("Face B %d strata, %.0f -> %.0f (%.0f studs)", nb, fbBase + 2, FB.top, FB.top - fbBase - 2)

	------------------------------------------------ Ledge L1 along the contour
	local L = LP.L1
	local raw = {}
	for x = L.x0, L.x1, -4 do
		local t = (x - L.x0) / (L.x1 - L.x0)
		local y = L.y0 + (L.y1 - L.y0) * t
		raw[#raw + 1] = Vector3.new(x, y, contourZ(x, y, L.zLo, L.zHi))
	end
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		local sm = { raw[1] }
		for i = 2, #raw - 1 do
			sm[i] = Vector3.new(raw[i].X, raw[i].Y, (raw[i - 1].Z + raw[i].Z * 2 + raw[i + 1].Z) / 4)
		end
		sm[#raw] = raw[#raw]
		raw = sm
	end
	-- resample every 8 studs of arc
	local cum = { 0 }
	for i = 2, #raw do
		cum[i] = cum[i - 1] + (flat(raw[i]) - flat(raw[i - 1])).Magnitude
	end
	local total = cum[#cum]
	local function at(s)
		for i = 2, #raw do
			if cum[i] >= s then
				local k = (s - cum[i - 1]) / math.max(1e-3, cum[i] - cum[i - 1])
				return raw[i - 1]:Lerp(raw[i], k), flat(raw[i] - raw[i - 1]).Unit
			end
		end
		return raw[#raw], flat(raw[#raw] - raw[#raw - 1]).Unit
	end
	local l1 = Kit.folder(root, "L1")
	local SEG = 8
	local nSeg = math.floor(total / SEG)
	local chuteS, restS = total * LP.CHUTE, total * LP.REST
	local finA, finB = total * LP.FIN.a, total * LP.FIN.b
	local function finOff(s)
		if s <= finA or s >= finB then
			return 0
		end
		local k = math.clamp(math.min(s - finA, finB - s) / LP.FIN.ramp, 0, 1)
		return LP.FIN.off * k * k * (3 - 2 * k)
	end
	-- walk centre of segment k (fin decks run between the midpoints of these, so the spur walkway is continuous)
	local function walkCentre(k)
		local s = (math.clamp(k, 0, nSeg - 1) + 0.5) * SEG
		local c, t = at(s)
		local o = outwardAt(c.X, c.Z)
		o = flat(o - t * o:Dot(t)).Unit
		return c + o * (1.6 + finOff(s))
	end
	local pitons = {}
	local restPos, chutePos, chuteO, finStart, chuteEdgeE
	for k = 0, nSeg - 1 do
		local s = (k + 0.5) * SEG
		local c, t = at(s)
		local o = outwardAt(c.X, c.Z)
		o = flat(o - t * o:Dot(t)).Unit -- perpendicular to the ledge
		local cf = function(center)
			return CFrame.lookAt(center, center + t)
		end
		local inChute = math.abs(s - chuteS) < 4
		local off = finOff(s)
		if inChute then
			-- the gap: no floor; a marked traverse panel on the back wall, a scree chute below
			chutePos, chuteO = c, o
			-- 0.4 proud of the back wall so face rays always meet the marked rock first
			-- as tall as the back wall (top 12 above the ledge) so it can't be jumped onto to skip the crossing
			local panel = P(l1, { Name = "MarkedPanel", Size = Vector3.new(2, 15, SEG + 6), CFrame = cf(c - o * 0.6 + Vector3.new(0, 4.5, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Slate, Color = COL.rock:Lerp(COL.slate, 0.4) })
			panel:SetAttribute("Climbable", true)
			-- the chute floor: carve the terrain under the gap and line it with a 63-degree scree plate, so a
			-- dropped climber slides out of the chute (no foothold to stand on or to cross the gap from)
			local TAN = 1.96
			local function plateY(d)
				return c.Y - 1.5 - (d + 0.5) * TAN
			end
			local lo = c + Vector3.new(-22, -44, -22)
			local hi = c + Vector3.new(22, 4, 22)
			local region = Region3.new(lo, hi):ExpandToGrid(4)
			local mats, occ = workspace.Terrain:ReadVoxels(region, 4)
			local sz = mats.Size
			for ix = 1, sz.X do
				for iy = 1, sz.Y do
					for iz = 1, sz.Z do
						local vc = region.CFrame.Position - region.Size / 2 + Vector3.new(ix - 0.5, iy - 0.5, iz - 0.5) * 4
						local rel = Vector3.new(vc.X - c.X, 0, vc.Z - c.Z)
						local al, d = rel:Dot(t), rel:Dot(o)
						if math.abs(al) < 6 and d > -3 and d < 20 and vc.Y > plateY(d) - 2 and vc.Y < c.Y + 3 and occ[ix][iy][iz] > 0 then
							mats[ix][iy][iz], occ[ix][iy][iz] = Enum.Material.Air, 0
						end
					end
				end
			end
			workspace.Terrain:WriteVoxels(region, 4, mats, occ)
			local pa, pb = c + o * -0.5 + Vector3.new(0, plateY(-0.5) - c.Y, 0), c + o * 19 + Vector3.new(0, plateY(19) - c.Y, 0)
			local plate = P(l1, { Name = "ChuteScree", Size = Vector3.new(SEG + 2, 1.2, (pb - pa).Magnitude), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((pa + pb) / 2, pb), Material = Enum.Material.Slate, Color = COL.rock })
			plate.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(2.7, 0.05, 0.1, 100, 1)
		elseif off > 0.5 then
			-- knife-ridge stretch: a rock spur standing off the flank; open drops on both sides, no handline
			local w0, w1, w2 = walkCentre(k - 1), walkCentre(k), walkCentre(k + 1)
			local m1, m2 = (w0 + w1) / 2, (w1 + w2) / 2
			m1, m2 = Vector3.new(m1.X, c.Y - 1, m1.Z), Vector3.new(m2.X, c.Y - 1, m2.Z)
			local dc = (m1 + m2) / 2
			local dcf = CFrame.lookAt(dc, dc + flat(m2 - m1).Unit)
			local len = (flat(m2 - m1)).Magnitude + 1
			local d = w1
			local gB = ground(dc.X, dc.Z)
			P(l1, { Name = "FinDeck", Size = Vector3.new(4.4, 2, len), CFrame = dcf, Material = Enum.Material.Sandstone, Color = COL.sandstone })
			local hBody = (c.Y - 2) - (gB - 3)
			if hBody > 1 then
				local bb = bandAt()
				P(l1, { Name = "FinBody", Size = Vector3.new(4, hBody * 0.7, len - 0.4), CFrame = dcf + Vector3.new(0, -1 - hBody * 0.35, 0), Material = bb[2], Color = bb[1] })
				local rb = bandAt()
				P(l1, { Name = "FinRoot", Size = Vector3.new(6, hBody * 0.3 + 2, len + 0.6), CFrame = dcf + Vector3.new(0, (gB - 3 + (hBody * 0.3 + 2) / 2) - (c.Y - 1), 0), Material = rb[2], Color = rb[1] })
			end
			if not finStart then
				finStart = Vector3.new(d.X, c.Y, d.Z)
			end
		else
			local wide = math.abs(s - restS) < 6
			local w = wide and 8 or 4.2
			local floor = P(l1, { Name = wide and "RestLedge" or "Ledge", Size = Vector3.new(w, 2.2, SEG + 0.6), CFrame = cf(c + o * (w / 2 - 0.5) - Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Sandstone, Color = COL.sandstone })
			if wide then
				floor:SetAttribute("RestLedge", true)
				restPos = c + o * 3.5
			end
			-- the cliff band the ledge is cut into: a tall back wall (ragged top) and rock under the ledge
			local bh = 11 + rng:NextNumber() * 6
			local bb = bandAt()
			P(l1, { Name = "Backing", Size = Vector3.new(3, bh, SEG + 0.8), CFrame = cf(c - o * 1.5 + Vector3.new(0, bh / 2 - 1, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rng:NextNumber() * 4 - 2), 0, math.rad(rng:NextNumber() * 3)), Material = bb[2], Color = bb[1] })
			local ub = bandAt()
			P(l1, { Name = "UnderBand", Size = Vector3.new(3.4, 9, SEG + 0.4), CFrame = cf(c + o * (w - 2.4) - Vector3.new(0, 6.6, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-6 - rng:NextNumber() * 6)), Material = ub[2], Color = ub[1] })
			if k % 2 == 0 and not (s > finA - 6 and s < finB + 6) then
				pitons[#pitons + 1] = c + Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0) + o * 0.1
			end
			if s > chuteS - 12 and s < chuteS - 4 then
				chuteEdgeE = c + o * 1.6
			end
		end
	end
	-- handline between consecutive pitons (skipped over the fin and the chute)
	for i = 1, #pitons do
		local p = pitons[i]
		Kit.decor(P(l1, { Name = "Piton", Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 1.2), CFrame = CFrame.new(p), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, Color = COL.slate }))
		local q = pitons[i + 1]
		if q and (q - p).Magnitude < SEG * 2.6 then
			local sag = (p + q) / 2 - Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
			for _, ab in ipairs({ { p, sag }, { sag, q } }) do
				Kit.decor(P(l1, { Name = "Handline", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new((ab[2] - ab[1]).Magnitude, 0.3, 0.3), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((ab[1] + ab[2]) / 2, ab[2]) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = COL.lantern }))
			end
		end
	end
	local l1Start = at(0)
	local l1End, tEnd = at(nSeg * SEG) -- where the last slab ends (the pillar floor overlaps it)
	report.l1 = string.format("L1 %.0f studs, %d segments, y %.0f -> %.0f", total, nSeg, l1Start.Y, l1End.Y)

	-- markers along L1 + the rest ledge checkpoint
	marker(root, l1Start + outwardAt(l1Start.X, l1Start.Z) * 2.4, 4, outwardAt(l1Start.X, l1Start.Z))
	if finStart then
		marker(root, finStart, 5, outwardAt(finStart.X, finStart.Z))
	end
	if restPos then
		marker(root, restPos + Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), 6, outwardAt(restPos.X, restPos.Z))
		trigger("CP_LedgeP1_Rest", restPos, { Checkpoint = "LedgeP1_Rest", Label = "Ledge rest", Route = "Ledge", Order = 2, Camp = false })
	end
	if chuteEdgeE then
		marker(root, chuteEdgeE, 7, outwardAt(chuteEdgeE.X, chuteEdgeE.Z))
	end

	------------------------------------------------ rockfall chute (tell: dust + pulsing strip; rocks fall past the panel)
	if chutePos then
		local m = Kit.model(Kit.folder(hz, "LedgeP1"), "Rockfall_Chute")
		local top = chutePos + chuteO * 1.8 + Vector3.new(0, 26, 0)
		local bot = chutePos + chuteO * 16 - Vector3.new(0, 26, 0)
		for k, v in pairs({ Kind = "Rockfall", Route = "Ledge", Period = 8, Tell = 3, Offset = 0, Strength = 30, Center = chutePos, TrailDir = tEnd, Outward = chuteO, Top = top, Bottom = bot, Radius = 2.6, Straight = true }) do
			m:SetAttribute(k, v)
		end
		-- the chute itself: a dark groove above the panel (where the rocks come from)
		Kit.decor(P(m, { Name = "ChuteGroove", Size = Vector3.new(1, 22, 6), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(chutePos - chuteO * 1.2 + Vector3.new(0, 15, 0), chutePos + Vector3.new(0, 15, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Slate, Color = COL.slate }))
		report.chute = string.format("chute at (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) period 8 tell 3", chutePos.X, chutePos.Y, chutePos.Z)
	end

	------------------------------------------------ final pillar: ladder pitch, then a marked face to the old ledge
	local exitP = routePoint("Ledge", LP.EXIT_S)
	local oE = outwardAt(l1End.X, l1End.Z)
	oE = flat(oE - tEnd * oE:Dot(tEnd)).Unit
	-- axis ~5 studs past the last slab: with L1 ending at x -712 this lands on the old ledge's walkable start
	local pillarFront = l1End + tEnd * 5 - oE * 0.8
	local exitY = exitP and exitP.Y or 212
	local pil = Kit.model(root, "Pillar")
	local _, np1 = buttress(pil, "PillarLower", pillarFront, oE, 10, l1End.Y - 3, LP.LADDER_TOP, false)
	-- the upper pitch is wider so its top meets the old ledge with room to spare (13 studs)
	local _, np2 = buttress(pil, "PillarUpper", pillarFront, oE, 13, LP.LADDER_TOP, exitY, true)
	-- the floor under the ladder: L1 runs on to the pillar foot
	P(pil, { Name = "Ledge", Size = Vector3.new(4.2, 2.2, 10.5), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(l1End + tEnd * 2.5 + oE * 1.6 - Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 0), l1End + tEnd * 3.5 + oE * 1.6 - Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Sandstone, Color = COL.sandstone })
	-- ladder: steel rails + rungs on the lower pillar, one invisible marked plane behind them
	local lad = Kit.model(pil, "Ladder")
	local lb = Vector3.new(pillarFront.X, l1End.Y, pillarFront.Z) + oE * 0.6
	local right = oE:Cross(Vector3.yAxis).Unit
	local H = LP.LADDER_TOP - l1End.Y + 1
	for _, sgn in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		Kit.decor(P(lad, { Name = "Rail", Size = Vector3.new(0.3, H, 0.3), CFrame = CFrame.new(lb + right * 1.2 * sgn + Vector3.new(0, H / 2, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, Color = COL.slate }))
	end
	for y = 1, H - 0.5, 1.4 do
		Kit.decor(P(lad, { Name = "Rung", Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 0.22, 0.22), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(lb + Vector3.new(0, y, 0), lb + Vector3.new(0, y, 0) + oE), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, Color = COL.slate }))
	end
	-- run 2: 6 wide (a 3-wide grip lost off-centre grabs)
	local plane = P(lad, { Name = "LadderGrip", Size = Vector3.new(6, H, 0.4), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(lb - oE * 0.2 + Vector3.new(0, H / 2, 0), lb - oE * 0.2 + Vector3.new(0, H / 2, 0) + oE), Transparency = 1, Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic })
	plane:SetAttribute("Climbable", true)
	faceRope(pil, pillarFront, oE, LP.LADDER_TOP + 1, exitY)
	marker(root, l1End + oE * 2.2, 8, oE)
	if exitP then
		marker(root, exitP + flat(exitP - pillarFront).Unit * -1, 9, oE)
	end
	report.pillar = string.format("pillar ladder %.0f -> %d, face -> %.0f (%d + %d strata); exit (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)", l1End.Y, LP.LADDER_TOP, exitY, np1, np2, exitP and exitP.X or 0, exitY, exitP and exitP.Z or 0)

	------------------------------------------------ atmosphere (static): cloud layer below L1, light shafts on the hero view
	local atm = Kit.folder(root, "Atmosphere")
	-- cloud layer below L1: three soft-particle volumes (engine smoke texture, ~15 particles each), no hard edges
	for k, c in ipairs({ Vector3.new(-560, 112, 1950), Vector3.new(-650, 108, 1965), Vector3.new(-740, 115, 1945) }) do
		local host = P(atm, { Name = "MistVolume", Size = Vector3.new(90, 8, 70), CFrame = CFrame.new(c), Transparency = 1 })
		host.CanCollide, host.CanQuery, host.CanTouch, host.CastShadow = false, false, false, false
		local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		pe.Name = "Mist"
		pe.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
		pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(COL.moon)
		pe.LightInfluence = 0.7
		pe.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 34), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 52) })
		pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, 0.72), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, 0.78), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
		pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(26, 34)
		pe.Rate = 0.5
		pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.9)
		pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 8)
		pe.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
		pe.Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box
		pe.ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume
		pe.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
		pe.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-2, 2)
		pe.Parent = host
	end
	local sun = Vector3.new(-0.45, -0.8, 0.4).Unit
	local hero = restPos or l1Start
	for k = 1, 3 do
		local foot = hero + Vector3.new(-20 + k * 15, -30, 30 + k * 6)
		local len = 170
		local sh = P(atm, { Name = "LightShaft", Size = Vector3.new(4 + k, len, 0.4), CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(foot - sun * len / 2, sun:Cross(Vector3.zAxis).Unit, -sun), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = COL.golden, Transparency = 0.955 })
		sh.CanCollide, sh.CanQuery, sh.CanTouch, sh.CastShadow = false, false, false, false
	end

	------------------------------------------------ v4 P2 fix: the cliff above the bench reads as rock, not foothill earth
	-- (P1 self-review: "rock structures on an earth cliff"); terrain Mud / Salt -> Rock (lichen rock token) in the box
	-- 8-stud bands with ragged east/west ends, so the edge of the repaint is not a straight seam
	for yb = 104, 248, 8 do
		local e = -430 + math.noise(yb * 0.07, 1.3) * 60
		local w = -770 + math.noise(yb * 0.07, 7.9) * 40
		local cliff = Region3.new(Vector3.new(w, yb, 1784), Vector3.new(e, yb + 8, 1912)):ExpandToGrid(4)
		workspace.Terrain:ReplaceMaterial(cliff, 4, Enum.Material.Mud, Enum.Material.Rock)
		workspace.Terrain:ReplaceMaterial(cliff, 4, Enum.Material.Salt, Enum.Material.Rock)
	end

	report.parts = string.format("%d parts, %d instances in World.LedgeP1", nParts, #root:GetDescendants())
	return report
end

return LP

-- Prompts (ServerScriptService.CC_CoreServer): server-created ProximityPrompts with hold validation.
-- A prompt's Triggered is accepted only if the server saw PromptButtonHoldBegan from the same player, the hold
-- lasted at least HoldDuration (minus a small network tolerance), the character is within range, alive, and was
-- not hit (staggered) after the hold began. Mobile: tap-and-hold works on the same prompt, no aiming needed.
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local C = require(RS:WaitForChild("CC_Core"):WaitForChild("CoreConfig"))

local Prompts = {}
local holds = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) -- [prompt] = { [player] = os.clock() at hold start }
local lastHit = {} -- [player] = os.clock() of the last guardian hit

function Prompts.noteHit(plr)
	lastHit[plr] = os.clock()
end
function Prompts.forget(plr)
	lastHit[plr] = nil
end

function Prompts.make(parent, props)
	local p = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	p.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	p.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	p.GamepadKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX
	p.MaxActivationDistance = C.CLAIM_RANGE
	for k, v in pairs(props) do
		p[k] = v
	end
	holds[p] = {}
	p.PromptButtonHoldBegan:Connect(function(plr)
		holds[p][plr] = os.clock()
	end)
	p.PromptButtonHoldEnded:Connect(function(plr)
		-- keep the start time briefly: Triggered can arrive just after HoldEnded
		local t0 = holds[p][plr]
		task.delay(0.5, function()
			if holds[p] and holds[p][plr] == t0 then
				holds[p][plr] = nil
			end
		end)
	end)
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

-- validate(prompt, plr) -> ok, reason
function Prompts.validate(prompt, plr)
	local ch = plr.Character
	local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
		return false, "nochar"
	end
	local anchorPart = prompt.Parent
	local pos = anchorPart and (anchorPart:IsA("BasePart") and anchorPart.Position or anchorPart:IsA("Attachment") and anchorPart.WorldPosition)
	if not pos or (hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude > prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4 then
		return false, "range"
	end
	local t0 = holds[prompt] and holds[prompt][plr]
	if prompt.HoldDuration > 0 then
		if not t0 or os.clock() - t0 < prompt.HoldDuration - C.HOLD_TOLERANCE then
			return false, "hold"
		end
	end
	if t0 and lastHit[plr] and lastHit[plr] >= t0 then
		return false, "hit"
	end
	if holds[prompt] then
		holds[prompt][plr] = nil
	end
	return true
end

return Prompts

-- Read-only Studio probe. Returns existing stable ground on closed corridors and shared controls.
-- Does not move players, create objects, alter metadata, or write terrain.
return function()
	local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local HS=game:GetService("HttpService")
	local Rules=require(RS.CC_Core.TraversalRules)
	local world=workspace:WaitForChild("World")
	local closedPaths,openPaths,closedSamples={}, {}, {}
	local gates,pads={},{}
	local function append(route,points)
		local closed=route=="Ledge" or route=="Spire"
		if #points>=2 then table.insert(closed and closedPaths or openPaths,{route=route,points=points}) end
		if closed then
			for i=1,#points,3 do closedSamples[#closedSamples+1]={route=route,p=points[i]} end
		end
	end
	for _,sv in ipairs(RS.CC_Route:GetChildren()) do
		if sv:IsA("StringValue") then
			local points={}
			for row in sv.Value:gmatch("[^;]+") do
				local x,y,z=row:match("([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)")
				x,y,z=tonumber(x),tonumber(y),tonumber(z)
				if Rules.finite(x) and Rules.finite(y) and Rules.finite(z) then points[#points+1]={x,y,z} end
			end
			append(sv.Name,points)
		end
	end
	for _,sv in ipairs(RS.CC_Track:GetChildren()) do
		if sv:IsA("StringValue") then
			local ok,tracks=pcall(function() return HS:JSONDecode(sv.Value) end)
			if ok then
				for _,track in ipairs(tracks) do
					local points={}
					for _,node in ipairs(track.nodes or {}) do if node.p then points[#points+1]=node.p end end
					append(sv.Name,points)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _,sv in ipairs(RS.CC_TraversalDefs:GetChildren()) do
		local sec=HS:JSONDecode(sv.Value)
		local points={sec.entry}
		for _,hold in ipairs(sec.holds) do points[#points+1]=hold.p end
		points[#points+1]=sec.exit
		append(sec.route,points)
	end
	for _,d in ipairs(world:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Model") and d:GetAttribute("ComingSoon") and d:FindFirstChild("Board") then gates[d:GetAttribute("Route") or d.Name:gsub("Gate_","")]=d:GetPivot() end
	end
	for _,part in ipairs(world.Checkpoints:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and tostring(part:GetAttribute("Checkpoint")):match("^Camp%d$") then pads[#pads+1]=part.Position-Vector3.yAxis*part.Size.Y/2 end
	end
	local closed,open=Rules.routeIndex(closedPaths,64),Rules.routeIndex(openPaths,64)
	local empty=Rules.routeIndex({},64)
	local rp=RaycastParams.new()
	rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	rp.FilterDescendantsInstances={world,workspace.Terrain}
	rp.RespectCanCollide=true
	local function arr(v) return {math.round(v.X*100)/100,math.round(v.Y*100)/100,math.round(v.Z*100)/100} end
	local rows,found={},{}
	local function add(key,row)
		if not found[key] then found[key]=true; row.case=key; rows[#rows+1]=row end
	end
	for _,sample in ipairs(closedSamples) do
		local v=Vector3.new(table.unpack(sample.p))
		local hit=workspace:Raycast(v+Vector3.yAxis*12,Vector3.new(0,-36,0),rp)
		if hit and hit.Normal.Y>=0.76 then
			local pos=hit.Position+Vector3.yAxis*3
			local p={pos.X,pos.Y,pos.Z}
			local raw=Rules.closedRouteAt(closed,empty,p)
			local guarded=Rules.closedRouteAt(closed,open,p)
			local gate=gates[sample.route]
			if raw and gate then
				local localP=gate:PointToObjectSpace(pos)
				local entrance=math.abs(localP.X)<85 and localP.Z<-2 and localP.Z>-180 and localP.Y>-30 and localP.Y<150
				local atCamp=false
				for _,pad in ipairs(pads) do if (pos-pad).Magnitude<80 then atCamp=true; break end end
				local row={route=sample.route,position=arr(pos),normal=hit.Normal.Y,gateLocal=arr(localP),sourcePosition=sample.p,expected=guarded and not atCamp and "return to closed gate" or "remain on open/shared ground"}
				if guarded==sample.route and not atCamp then
					if not entrance and (pos-gate.Position).Magnitude>220 then add(sample.route..":outsideEntranceBox",row) end
					if (pos-gate.Position).Magnitude>1000 then add(sample.route..":farAlongPath",table.clone(row)) end
				elseif (not guarded or atCamp) and not entrance then add("sharedOpenControl",row) end
			end
		end
	end
	local missing={}
	for _,route in ipairs({"Ledge","Spire"}) do if not found[route..":outsideEntranceBox"] then missing[#missing+1]=route..": no supported isolated closed-path sample found; do not invent terrain" end end
	return {rows=rows,missing=missing,closedSegments=closed.segments,openSegments=open.segments,readOnly=true}
end

-- Earned cosmetic equipment and automatic surface-aware climbing kit. No commerce or consumables.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local SS = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local Gear = {}
local ctx, C
local shopById = {}
local sites = {} -- { part, kind = "Market" | "Forge" }
local openSite = {} -- [plr] = "Market" | "Forge"
local trip = {} -- [plr] = { camps = { [name] = true }, refills = { [name] = true } }

for _, it in ipairs(require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("CC_Core"):WaitForChild("CoreConfig")).SHOP) do
	shopById[it.id] = it
end

local function rgb(t)
	return Color3.fromRGB(t[1], t[2], t[3])
end

local function g(s)
	return s.data.gear
end

-- kit owned: level unlock or a Forge purchase
function Gear.hasKit(_,id)
 return id=="headlamp" or id=="axe" or id=="crampons"
end

local function atSite(plr, kind)
	local ch = plr.Character
	local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then
		return false
	end
	for _, st in ipairs(sites) do
		if (not kind or st.kind == kind) and st.part.Parent and (hrp.Position - st.part.Position).Magnitude < 22 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- avatar (cosmetics + visible kit)
local watched = {}
local function weld(part, to, cf)
	part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.Massless = false, false, false, false, true
	part.CFrame = to.CFrame * cf
	local w = Instance.new("Weld")
	w.Name = "KitWeld"
	w.Part0, w.Part1 = to, part
	w.C0 = cf
	w.Parent = part
	part.Parent = to.Parent:FindFirstChild("CC_Gear") or to.Parent
end

function Gear.refreshKit(plr)
 local ch=plr.Character local f=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("CC_Gear")
 local torso=ch and (ch:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or ch:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
 if not f or not torso then return end
 local hand=ch:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or ch:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
 local active=ch:GetAttribute("CC_AxeActive")==true and hand~=nil
 for _,p in ipairs(f:GetChildren()) do
  if p.Name=="AxeShaft" or p.Name=="AxeHead" then
   local w=p:FindFirstChild("KitWeld")
   if w then
    w.Part0=active and hand or torso
    if active then
     w.C0=CFrame.new(0,p.Name=="AxeHead" and 1.25 or 0.1,-0.35)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(-12))
    else
     w.C0=CFrame.new(torso.Size.X*0.25+(p.Name=="AxeHead" and 0.55 or 0),p.Name=="AxeHead" and 1.15 or 0,torso.Size.Z*0.62)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(25))
    end
   end
  elseif p.Name=="Crampon" then p.Transparency=ch:GetAttribute("CC_CramponsActive")==true and 0 or 1 end
 end
end

local function piece(name, size, color, material, shape)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	if shape then
		p.Shape = shape
	end
	p.CastShadow = false
	return p
end

function Gear.dress(plr)
	local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
	local ch = plr.Character
	if not (s and ch) then
		return
	end
	local old = ch:FindFirstChild("CC_Gear")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = "CC_Gear"
	f.Parent = ch
	local head = ch:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local torso = ch:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or ch:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	local eq = g(s).equipped
	if head then
		local it = shopById[eq.head]
		if it then
			local hs = head.Size
			if it.id == "cap_trail" then
				weld(piece("Cap", Vector3.new(hs.X * 1.05, hs.Y * 0.3, hs.Z * 1.05), rgb(it.color), Enum.Material.Fabric), head, CFrame.new(0, hs.Y * 0.42, 0))
				weld(piece("Brim", Vector3.new(hs.X * 0.9, 0.08, hs.Z * 0.45), rgb(it.color2), Enum.Material.Fabric), head, CFrame.new(0, hs.Y * 0.3, -hs.Z * 0.6))
			else
				weld(piece("Helmet", Vector3.new(hs.X * 1.18, hs.Y * 0.6, hs.Z * 1.18), rgb(it.color), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball), head, CFrame.new(0, hs.Y * 0.3, 0))
				weld(piece("Stripe", Vector3.new(hs.X * 0.2, 0.1, hs.Z * 1.1), rgb(it.color2), Enum.Material.Neon), head, CFrame.new(0, hs.Y * 0.6, 0))
			end
		end
		local gg = shopById[eq.eyes]
		if gg then
			local hs = head.Size
			weld(piece("GoggleBand", Vector3.new(hs.X * 1.08, hs.Y * 0.16, hs.Z * 1.08), rgb(gg.color2), Enum.Material.Fabric), head, CFrame.new(0, hs.Y * 0.12, 0))
			for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
				weld(piece("Lens", Vector3.new(hs.X * 0.3, hs.Y * 0.22, 0.12), rgb(gg.color), Enum.Material.Glass), head, CFrame.new(sx * hs.X * 0.2, hs.Y * 0.12, -hs.Z * 0.55))
			end
		end
		if Gear.hasKit(s, "headlamp") then
			local hs = head.Size
			local lamp = piece("Headlamp", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.25, 0.2), rgb({ 255, 214, 150 }), Enum.Material.Neon) -- goldenDaylight
			weld(lamp, head, CFrame.new(0, hs.Y * 0.32, -hs.Z * 0.55))
			local light = Instance.new("SpotLight")
			light.Name = "HeadlampLight"
			light.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
			light.Angle = 70
			light.Range = 34
			light.Brightness = 2.2
			light.Color = rgb({ 255, 214, 150 })
			light.Shadows = false
			light.Enabled = false -- traversal client uses actual darkness + player preference
			light.Parent = lamp
		end
	end
	if torso then
		local it = shopById[eq.body]
		local ts = torso.Size
		if it then
			weld(piece("Jacket", Vector3.new(ts.X * 1.1, ts.Y * 0.95, ts.Z * 1.25), rgb(it.color), Enum.Material.Fabric), torso, CFrame.new(0, -ts.Y * 0.02, 0))
			weld(piece("Collar", Vector3.new(ts.X * 0.7, ts.Y * 0.18, ts.Z * 1.3), rgb(it.color2), Enum.Material.Fabric), torso, CFrame.new(0, ts.Y * 0.45, 0))
		end
		if Gear.hasKit(s, "axe") then
			weld(piece("AxeShaft", Vector3.new(0.18, 2.6, 0.18), rgb({ 62, 66, 76 }), Enum.Material.Metal), torso, CFrame.new(ts.X * 0.25, 0, ts.Z * 0.62) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(25)))
			weld(piece("AxeHead", Vector3.new(1.1, 0.2, 0.2), rgb({ 196, 232, 255 }), Enum.Material.Metal), torso, CFrame.new(ts.X * 0.25 + 0.55, 1.15, ts.Z * 0.62) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(25)))
		end
	end
	if Gear.hasKit(s, "crampons") then
		for _, foot in ipairs({ {"LeftFoot","Left Leg"}, {"RightFoot","Right Leg"} }) do
			local fp = ch:FindFirstChild(foot[1]) or ch:FindFirstChild(foot[2])
			if fp then
				weld(piece("Crampon", Vector3.new(fp.Size.X * 1.05, 0.12, fp.Size.Z * 1.05), rgb({ 62, 66, 76 }), Enum.Material.Metal), fp, CFrame.new(0, -fp.Size.Y / 2, 0))
			end
		end
	end
	for id in pairs(C.KIT) do
		ch:SetAttribute("CC_Kit_" .. id, Gear.hasKit(s, id))
	end
	plr:SetAttribute("CC_StaminaMax", Gear.staminaMax(s))
 if not watched[plr] or watched[plr].character~=ch then
  if watched[plr] then for _,c in ipairs(watched[plr].connections) do c:Disconnect() end end
  watched[plr]={character=ch,connections={
   ch:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CC_AxeActive"):Connect(function() Gear.refreshKit(plr) end),
   ch:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CC_CramponsActive"):Connect(function() Gear.refreshKit(plr) end)
  }}
 end
 Gear.refreshKit(plr)
end

function Gear.trainingBonus(s)
 local tr=g(s).training
 local legacy=0 for i=1,tr.level or 0 do legacy+=C.TRAINING.gains[i] or 0 end
 local practiced=0 for i,gain in ipairs(C.PRACTICE.gains) do if tr.completed and tr.completed[tostring(i)] then practiced+=gain end end
 return math.max(legacy,practiced)
end
function Gear.staminaMax(s)
 return math.min(C.PRACTICE.staminaCap,C.CLIMB.stamina+math.max(0,s.data.level-1)*3+Gear.trainingBonus(s))
end
function Gear.state(plr,st)
 local s=ctx.sessions[plr] if not s then return end
 local gs=g(s)
 st.gear={points=gs.points,owned=gs.owned,equipped=gs.equipped,summits=gs.summits,kit={headlamp={owned=true},axe={owned=true},crampons={owned=true}},training={level=gs.training.level,max=3,bonus=Gear.trainingBonus(s)},staminaMax=Gear.staminaMax(s)}
end
function Gear.init(c)
 ctx=c C=c.C ctx.Gear=Gear
 -- Currency and owned cosmetics are retained. No shop/refill/purchase handlers or prompts are registered.
 ctx.on("bank",function(plr) Gear.dress(plr) end)
 if ctx.devHandlers then ctx.devHandlers.gearGrant=function(plr,p)
  local s=ctx.sessions[plr] if s then s.data.coins+=math.floor(tonumber(p.coins) or 0) g(s).points+=math.floor(tonumber(p.points) or 0) s.dirty=true ctx.push(plr) end
 end end
end
function Gear.onLoaded(plr) Gear.dress(plr) end
function Gear.onCharacter(plr) task.wait(0.5) Gear.dress(plr) end
function Gear.onLeave(plr)
 if watched[plr] then for _,c in ipairs(watched[plr].connections) do c:Disconnect() end watched[plr]=nil end
end
return Gear
