-- Durable drop ownership. Disconnect preserves cargo and its return location.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local HS=game:GetService("HttpService")
local Profile=require(script.Parent.Profile)
local DP={}
local ctx,folder,Prompts,Visuals
local packs,hist={},{}
local function vec(p) return Vector3.new(p.x or 0,p.y or 0,p.z or 0) end
local function xyz(p) return {x=p.X,y=p.Y,z=p.Z} end
function DP.describe(items)
 local out={} for _,it in ipairs(items) do local e=ctx.Species.get(it.species) table.insert(out,it.kind=="heartstone" and (it.tier.." Heartstone") or (e and e.name or it.species)) end
 return table.concat(out,", ")
end
function DP.lastGround(plr,y,above)
 local h=hist[plr] or {}
 for i=#h,1,-1 do if not y or h[i].Y>=y+(above or 10) then return h[i] end end
 return h[#h] or (plr.Character and plr.Character:GetPivot().Position) or Vector3.zero
end
local function removeVisual(id)
 local p=packs[id] if p and p.model then p.model:Destroy() end packs[id]=nil
end
function DP.recover(plr,pack,prompt)
 if plr.UserId~=pack.ownerId or packs[pack.id]~=pack or not Prompts.validate(prompt,plr) then return end
 local r=ctx.transaction(plr,"recover:"..HS:GenerateGUID(false),function(d)
  local idx,drop
  for i,x in ipairs(d.drops) do if x.id==pack.id then idx,drop=i,x break end end
  if not drop or (drop.expiresAt>0 and drop.expiresAt<=ctx.Clock.now()) then return {ok=false,reason="expired"} end
  local count=0
  for i=#drop.items,1,-1 do local it=drop.items[i]
   if ctx.Cargo.used(d.cargo)+(it.slots or 1)<=d.slots then table.insert(d.cargo,it) table.remove(drop.items,i) count+=1 end
  end
  if count==0 then return {ok=false,reason="full"} end
  d.stats.recovered+=count
  if #drop.items==0 then table.remove(d.drops,idx) end
  return {ok=true,count=count}
 end,function(done)
  DP.refresh(plr) ctx.invChanged(plr)
  ctx.toast(plr,"Recovered "..done.count.." find(s). Original discovery preserved.","good")
  ctx.fx(plr,{kind="recovered",packId=pack.id,left=packs[pack.id] and #packs[pack.id].items or 0})
 end)
 if not r.ok then ctx.toast(plr,r.reason=="full" and "Backpack full. Make room and return here." or "Recovery is waiting for a confirmed save.","warn") end
end
function DP.refresh(plr)
 local s=ctx.sessions[plr] if not s then return end
 local live={}
 for _,d in ipairs(s.data.drops) do
  if d.expiresAt==0 or d.expiresAt>ctx.Clock.now() then
   live[d.id]=true local p=packs[d.id]
   if not p then
    local pos=vec(d.pos)
    local released=d.reason=="released" and d.items[1] and d.items[1].kind=="creature"
    local m=released and Visuals.creature(d.items[1].species,pos) or Visuals.dropPack(pos)
    m.Name=released and "ReturnedCreature" or "DropPack"
    m:SetAttribute("OwnerId",plr.UserId) m:SetAttribute("PackId",d.id)
    p={id=d.id,ownerId=plr.UserId,ownerName=plr.Name,items=d.items,pos=pos,expiresAt=d.expiresAt,model=m,reason=d.reason}
    local pr=Prompts.make(m.PrimaryPart,{Name="RecoverPrompt",ActionText=released and "Reclaim" or "Recover",ObjectText=released and "Your returned find" or "Your expedition pack",HoldDuration=0.6,MaxActivationDistance=10})
    pr.Triggered:Connect(function(who) DP.recover(who,p,pr) end)
    m.Parent=folder packs[d.id]=p
   end
   p.items=d.items p.model:SetAttribute("Count",#d.items) p.model:SetAttribute("ExpiresAt",d.expiresAt)
  end
 end
 for id,p in pairs(packs) do if p.ownerId==plr.UserId and not live[id] then removeVisual(id) end end
end
-- Pure outcome transform: consumes exact preselected identities once, never substitutes later acquisitions.
function DP.applyOutcome(d,id,now,ttl)
 local index,event
 for i,e in ipairs(d.expedition.outcomes or {}) do if e.id==id then index,event=i,e break end end
 if not event then return {ok=true,outcomeId=id,items={},alreadyApplied=true} end
 local items={}
 for i=#d.cargo,1,-1 do if event.selected[d.cargo[i].uid] then table.insert(items,table.remove(d.cargo,i)) end end
 table.remove(d.expedition.outcomes,index)
 local expiry=now+ttl
 if #items>0 then table.insert(d.drops,{id=id,items=items,pos=event.pos,expiresAt=expiry,reason=event.reason}) end
 d.stats.shaken+=#items
 if event.reason=="fall" then d.stats.falls+=1 end
 return {ok=true,outcomeId=id,items=items,reason=event.reason,pos=event.pos,expiresAt=expiry}
end
function DP.processOutcomes(plr)
 local s=ctx.sessions[plr]
 if not s or s.pending or s.saving or s.busy or s.closing or s.lost then return {} end
 local event=(s.data.expedition.outcomes or {})[1]
 s.outcomePending=event~=nil
 if not event then return {} end
 local moved={}
 ctx.transaction(plr,"outcome:"..event.id,function(d) return DP.applyOutcome(d,event.id,ctx.Clock.now(),ctx.C.DROP_PACK_SECONDS) end,function(done)
  moved=done.items or {}
  s.outcomePending=#(s.data.expedition.outcomes or {})>0
  DP.refresh(plr) ctx.invChanged(plr)
  if #moved>0 then
   local visible={} for _,item in ipairs(moved) do visible[#visible+1]=ctx.Cargo.clientItem(item) end
   ctx.fx(plr,{kind="loss",reason=done.reason,lost=visible,keptCount=#s.data.cargo,packId=event.id,packPos=vec(done.pos),expiresAt=done.expiresAt})
  end
 end)
 return moved
end
function DP.shake(plr,n,pos,reason)
 local s=ctx.sessions[plr]
 local effective=s and (s.pending and s.pending.candidate or s.data)
 if not effective or effective.flags.firstBankAt==0 then
  if s and #s.data.cargo>0 then ctx.toast(plr,"Beginner protection kept your finds safe.","info") end return {}
 end
 local rareBanked=false for _,b in ipairs(effective.bank) do if b.source==ctx.C.TUTORIAL_RARE_SOURCE then rareBanked=true end end
 local queued={}
 for _,e in ipairs(effective.expedition.outcomes or {}) do for id in pairs(e.selected or {}) do queued[id]=true end end
 local candidates={}
 for _,it in ipairs(effective.cargo) do if not queued[it.uid] and (rareBanked or it.source~=ctx.C.TUTORIAL_RARE_SOURCE) then table.insert(candidates,it) end end
 local function value(it) return it.kind=="heartstone" and (ctx.C.HEARTSTONE_VALUE[it.tier] or 0) or (ctx.C.RANK[it.rarity] or 1) end
 table.sort(candidates,function(a,b) local av,bv=value(a),value(b); return av>bv or (av==bv and a.uid<b.uid) end)
 local selected={} for i=1,math.min(n,#candidates) do selected[candidates[i].uid]=true end
 if next(selected)==nil then return {} end
 Profile.queueOutcome(s,{id=HS:GenerateGUID(false),selected=selected,pos=xyz(pos or DP.lastGround(plr)),reason=reason or "fall",at=ctx.Clock.now()})
 ctx.push(plr)
 return DP.processOutcomes(plr)
end
function DP.onLoaded(plr)
 DP.refresh(plr) local s=ctx.sessions[plr]
 if s then s.outcomePending=#(s.data.expedition.outcomes or {})>0; DP.processOutcomes(plr) end
 if s and not s.data.expedition.homeReturn and #s.data.cargo>0 and s.data.expedition.returnPos and ctx.Traversal then
  local pos=vec(s.data.expedition.returnPos)
  task.delay(1,function() if ctx.sessions[plr]==s then ctx.Traversal.travel(plr,pos,"reconnect") end end)
 end
end
function DP.onLeave(plr,s)
 if s then
  local ch=plr.Character
  local point=(ch and ch:GetAttribute("CC_HomeVisit")) and s.data.expedition.homeReturn or nil
  point=point or xyz(DP.lastGround(plr))
  s.data.expedition.returnPos=point
	 s.departurePosition=Profile.deepCopy(point)
  if s.pending then s.pending.candidate.expedition.returnPos=Profile.deepCopy(point) end
  s.dirty=true
 end
 for id,p in pairs(packs) do if p.ownerId==plr.UserId then removeVisual(id) end end
 hist[plr]=nil Prompts.forget(plr)
end
function DP.onCharacter(plr,ch)
 local hum=ch:WaitForChild("Humanoid",10)
 if hum then hum.Died:Connect(function()
  local s=ctx.sessions[plr]
  local ret=s and ch:GetAttribute("CC_HomeVisit") and s.data.expedition.homeReturn
  DP.shake(plr,math.huge,ret and vec(ret) or DP.lastGround(plr),"reset")
 end) end
end
function DP.init(c)
 ctx=c Prompts=require(script.Parent.Prompts) Visuals=require(script.Parent.Visuals)
 folder=Instance.new("Folder") folder.Name="ExpeditionDrops" folder.Parent=workspace.World.Core
 local acc=0
 game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  acc+=dt if acc<0.5 then return end acc=0
  for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
   local ch=plr.Character local hrp=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") local hum=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
   local s=ctx.sessions[plr]
   if s and s.outcomePending then DP.processOutcomes(plr) end
   if hrp and hum and hum.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air and (not ch:GetAttribute("CC_TraversalState") or ch:GetAttribute("CC_TraversalState")=="ground") and not ch:GetAttribute("CC_HomeVisit") then
    local h=hist[plr] or {} table.insert(h,hrp.Position) if #h>40 then table.remove(h,1) end hist[plr]=h
    if s and not ctx.Inv.locked(plr.UserId) then s.data.expedition.returnPos=xyz(hrp.Position) end
   end
  end
 end)
 local api=game.ServerStorage:WaitForChild("CC_CheckpointAPI",10)
 if api then api.Fell.Event:Connect(function(plr,y) DP.shake(plr,ctx.C.FALL_SHAKES,DP.lastGround(plr,y,12),"fall") end) end
 task.spawn(function()
  while true do task.wait(3)
   for plr,s in pairs(ctx.sessions) do
    local expired={} for _,d in ipairs(s.data.drops) do if d.expiresAt>0 and d.expiresAt<=ctx.Clock.now() then expired[d.id]=true end end
    if next(expired) and not ctx.Inv.locked(plr.UserId) then
     ctx.transaction(plr,"expire:"..HS:GenerateGUID(false),function(d)
      local n=0 for i=#d.drops,1,-1 do if expired[d.drops[i].id] then n+=#d.drops[i].items table.remove(d.drops,i) end end
      d.stats.lost+=n return {ok=true,count=n}
     end,function(r) DP.refresh(plr) ctx.toast(plr,"A drop pack expired: "..r.count.." unbanked find(s) were lost.","warn") end)
    end
   end
  end
 end)
end
function DP.state(plr,st)
 st.packs={} local s=ctx.sessions[plr] if not s then return end
 for _,d in ipairs(s.data.drops) do table.insert(st.packs,{id=d.id,pos=vec(d.pos),expiresAt=d.expiresAt,count=#d.items,reason=d.reason}) end
end
function DP.ownedBy(uid) local out={} for _,p in pairs(packs) do if p.ownerId==uid then table.insert(out,p) end end return out end
function DP.clearOwner(uid) for id,p in pairs(packs) do if p.ownerId==uid then removeVisual(id) end end end
DP._packs=packs
return DP
sources.tools/b_checks.luau:
-- Phase B scripted checks (dev tool). Lives in Studio as ReplicatedStorage.CC_DevTools.BChecks (needs the
-- Studio-only DevRequest remote). In a playtest, execute_luau on the CLIENT:
--   return require(game.ReplicatedStorage.CC_DevTools.BChecks:Clone())({ realTimePack = true })
-- then poll _G.CC_BCHK. Uses real prompts/movement where it matters (guardian hit, locker, claim refusal) and Studio
-- dev hooks for setup (profile reset, grants, checkpoint, clock offset). Labels: "real time" vs "simulated clock".
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotes = RS:WaitForChild("CC_Remotes")
local dev, reqEv, stateEv, fxEv, toastEv = remotes.DevRequest, remotes.CoreRequest, remotes.CoreState, remotes.CoreFx, remotes.CoreToast

local R = { status = "running", results = {}, log = {} }
local st = {}
stateEv.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(s)
	st = s
end)
local toasts = {}
toastEv.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(p)
	toasts[#toasts + 1] = { t = os.clock(), text = p.text }
end)
local fx = {}
fxEv.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(p)
	fx[#fx + 1] = { t = os.clock(), p = p }
end)

local function char()
	local ch = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	return ch, ch:WaitForChild("Humanoid"), ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function flat(v)
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end
local function waitFor(fn, timeout)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < timeout do
		if fn() then
			return true
		end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	return false
end
local function refresh()
	reqEv:FireServer("state")
	task.wait(0.4)
end
local function toastSince(t0, pat)
	for _, x in ipairs(toasts) do
		if x.t >= t0 and string.find(x.text, pat, 1, true) then
			return x.text
		end
	end
	return nil
end
local function result(name, pass, detail)
	R.results[#R.results + 1] = string.format("[%s] %s — %s", pass and "PASS" or "FAIL", name, detail)
end
local function teleport(pos)
	local ch = char()
	ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)))
	task.wait(0.8)
end
local function hold(prompt)
	local _, _, hrp = char()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local target = prompt.Parent.Position
	local back = flat(hrp.Position - target)
	back = back.Magnitude > 0.1 and back.Unit or Vector3.zAxis
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position + back * 10 + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), target)
	task.wait(0.35)
	prompt:InputHoldBegin()
	task.wait(prompt.HoldDuration + 0.25)
	prompt:InputHoldEnd()
	task.wait(0.4)
end
local function guardianOf(nestId)
	local g = workspace.World.Core:FindFirstChild("Guardians")
	for _, m in ipairs(g and g:GetChildren() or {}) do
		if m:GetAttribute("OwnerId") == plr.UserId and m:GetAttribute("NestId") == nestId then
			return m
		end
	end
end
-- walk into the hollow nest's guardian until a hit lands (stagger fx) or timeout
local function getHit(timeout)
	local _, hum = char()
	teleport(Vector3.new(-1010, 66, 2052))
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < timeout do
		for _, x in ipairs(fx) do
			if x.t > t0 and x.p.kind == "stagger" then
				return true
			end
		end
		local g = guardianOf("nest_r1_hollow")
		if g then
			hum:MoveTo(g:GetPivot().Position)
		end
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	return false
end
local function packCount()
	refresh()
	return #(st.packs or {})
end

local CHECKS = {}

CHECKS[#CHECKS + 1] = function(cfg)
	-- no item shake before the first bank (beginner protection), real guardian hit
	dev:FireServer("resetProfile")
	task.wait(1.5)
	dev:FireServer("grant", { items = { { rarity = "Rare" } } })
	refresh()
	local before = st.used
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local hit = getHit(25)
	task.wait(1)
	refresh()
	local prot = toastSince(t0, "Beginner protection")
	result("no item shake before the first bank", hit and st.used == before and #(st.packs or {}) == 0 and prot ~= nil, string.format("guardian hit %s, pack %d -> %d, drop packs %d, toast '%s'", tostring(hit), before, st.used, #(st.packs or {}), tostring(prot)))
end

CHECKS[#CHECKS + 1] = function(cfg)
	-- after the first bank a hit shakes the most valuable item into a 3-min pack; recover it near the end (real time)
	dev:FireServer("resetProfile")
	task.wait(1.5)
	dev:FireServer("grant", { items = { { rarity = "Common" } } })
	task.wait(0.3)
	dev:FireServer("deposit", { tx = "BCHK-first-bank" })
	task.wait(0.5)
	dev:FireServer("grant", { items = { { rarity = "Common" }, { rarity = "Rare" } } })
	refresh()
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local hit = getHit(25)
	task.wait(1)
	refresh()
	local pack = st.packs and st.packs[1]
	local lossFx
	for _, x in ipairs(fx) do
		if x.t > t0 and x.p.kind == "loss" then
			lossFx = x.p
		end
	end
	local shaken = lossFx and lossFx.lost and lossFx.lost[1]
	local window = pack and (pack.expiresAt - (st.serverNow or 0)) or -1
	result("hit after first bank shakes the most valuable item", hit and shaken ~= nil and shaken.rarity == "Rare" and st.used == 1, string.format("shaken %s, pack window %d s, still carrying %d", shaken and shaken.rarity or "none", window, st.used))
	if not pack then
		result("drop pack recoverable for 3 min", false, "no pack")
		return
	end
	-- leave, then come back at ~2:50 (real time) and recover
	teleport(Vector3.new(-1060, 70, 1980))
	local waitS = cfg.realTimePack and 150 or 0
	if not cfg.realTimePack then
		dev:FireServer("clock", { offset = 168 })
	end
	task.wait(waitS)
	refresh()
	local leftBefore
	waitFor(function()
		local g = guardianOf("nest_r1_hollow")
		return not g or (g:GetAttribute("State") == "Patrol" and (flat(g:GetPivot().Position) - flat(pack.pos)).Magnitude > 22)
	end, 25)
	refresh()
	leftBefore = (st.packs and st.packs[1]) and (st.packs[1].expiresAt - st.serverNow) or -1
	teleport(pack.pos + Vector3.new(4, 0, 4))
	local m
	for _, x in ipairs(workspace.World.Core.DropPacks:GetChildren()) do
		if x:GetAttribute("OwnerId") == plr.UserId then
			m = x
		end
	end
	local pr = m and m:FindFirstChild("RecoverPrompt", true)
	if pr then
		hold(pr)
	end
	refresh()
	result("drop pack recoverable for 3 min (" .. (cfg.realTimePack and "real time" or "simulated clock") .. ")", pr ~= nil and st.used == 2 and #(st.packs or {}) == 0, string.format("recovered with %d s left; carrying %d, packs %d", leftBefore, st.used, #(st.packs or {})))
	dev:FireServer("clock", { offset = 0 })
end

CHECKS[#CHECKS + 1] = function(cfg)
	-- a pack that is not recovered expires after 3 min with a message (simulated clock)
	dev:FireServer("resetProfile")
	task.wait(1.5)
	dev:FireServer("grant", { items = { { rarity = "Common" } } })
	task.wait(0.3)
	dev:FireServer("deposit", { tx = "BCHK-first-bank-2" })
	task.wait(0.5)
	dev:FireServer("grant", { items = { { rarity = "Uncommon" } } })
	local hit = getHit(25)
	teleport(Vector3.new(-1060, 70, 1980))
	local t0 = os.clock()
	dev:FireServer("clock", { offset = 185 })
	task.wait(1.5)
	refresh()
	local faded = toastSince(t0, "faded")
	result("unrecovered pack expires after 3 min with a loss message (simulated clock)", hit and #(st.packs or {}) == 0 and faded ~= nil, string.format("packs %d, toast '%s'", #(st.packs or {}), tostring(faded)))
	dev:FireServer("clock", { offset = 0 })
end

CHECKS[#CHECKS + 1] = function(cfg)
	-- fall after the first bank: respawn at the checkpoint, one item into a pack at the ledge (real fall)
	dev:FireServer("resetProfile")
	task.wait(1.5)
	dev:FireServer("grant", { items = { { rarity = "Common" } } })
	task.wait(0.3)
	dev:FireServer("deposit", { tx = "BCHK-first-bank-3" })
	task.wait(0.5)
	dev:FireServer("grant", { items = { { rarity = "Common" }, { rarity = "Uncommon" } } })
	task.wait(0.5)
	local _, _, hrp = char()
	local rp = RaycastParams.new()
	rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { workspace.Terrain }
	local g = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(-700, 400, 2100), Vector3.new(0, -500, 0), rp)
	dev:FireServer("setCheckpoint", { name = nil })
	teleport(g.Position)
	task.wait(1.5)
	dev:FireServer("setCheckpoint", { name = "Camp1" })
	task.wait(0.5)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local ch = char()
	ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(-700, 200, 2100)) -- ~140-stud drop onto the foothills
	waitFor(function()
		return hrp.Position.Y > 400
	end, 12)
	task.wait(1)
	refresh()
	local lossFall
	for _, x in ipairs(fx) do
		if x.t > t0 and x.p.kind == "loss" and x.p.reason == "fall" then
			lossFall = x.p
		end
	end
	result("fall after the first bank: respawn at checkpoint + 1 item to a pack", hrp.Position.Y > 400 and lossFall ~= nil and lossFall.lost[1].rarity == "Uncommon" and st.used == 1 and #(st.packs or {}) == 1, string.format("respawn y %.0f, shaken %s, carrying %d, packs %d", hrp.Position.Y, lossFall and lossFall.lost[1].rarity or "none", st.used, #(st.packs or {})))
	dev:FireServer("setCheckpoint", { name = nil })
end

CHECKS[#CHECKS + 1] = function(cfg)
	-- Camp Locker: store one item at Camp1, take it back (server-validated, persisted in the profile)
	dev:FireServer("resetProfile")
	task.wait(1.5)
	dev:FireServer("grant", { items = { { rarity = "Rare" } } })
	local locker = workspace.World.Camps:WaitForChild("Camp1"):WaitForChild("CampLocker")
	local box = locker:WaitForChild("Box")
	teleport(box.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, -6))
	local pr = box:WaitForChild("LockerPrompt", 5)
	hold(pr)
	refresh()
	local opened = st.locker ~= nil
	local uid = st.items and st.items[1] and st.items[1].uid
	reqEv:FireServer("lockerStore", { uid = uid })
	task.wait(0.6)
	refresh()
	local stored = st.locker and #st.locker.items == 1 and st.used == 0
	reqEv:FireServer("lockerTake", { uid = uid })
	task.wait(0.6)
	refresh()
	local back = st.locker and #st.locker.items == 0 and st.used == 1
	reqEv:FireServer("lockerClose")
	result("Camp Locker store + take (1 slot at tent tier 1)", opened and stored and back, string.format("opened %s, stored %s, taken back %s", tostring(opened), tostring(stored), tostring(back)))
end

CHECKS[#CHECKS + 1] = function(cfg)
	-- resume at the highest camp: touch Camp1's trigger, leave + rejoin, spawn there; Foothold offer while empty
	dev:FireServer("resetProfile")
	task.wait(1.5)
	local trig = workspace.World.Checkpoints:WaitForChild("CP_Camp1")
	teleport(trig.Position)
	task.wait(1.5)
	refresh()
	local hc = st.highestCamp
	dev:FireServer("rejoin", {})
	task.wait(4)
	local _, _, hrp = char()
	refresh()
	local d = (flat(hrp.Position) - flat(trig.Position)).Magnitude
	result("resume at the highest reached camp", hc == 1 and d < 60 and st.resumeOffer == true, string.format("highestCamp %s, spawn %.0f studs from Camp1, Foothold offer %s", tostring(hc), d, tostring(st.resumeOffer)))
	reqEv:FireServer("resumeFoothold")
	task.wait(1)
	local sp = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpawnLocation")
	local d2 = sp and (flat(hrp.Position) - flat(sp.Position)).Magnitude or -1
	result("'Start at the Foothold' (empty pack, first 60 s)", d2 >= 0 and d2 < 30, string.format("%.0f studs from the Foothold spawn", d2))
end

CHECKS[#CHECKS + 1] = function(cfg)
	-- full backpack: a claim is refused and nothing is lost
	dev:FireServer("resetProfile")
	task.wait(1.5)
	dev:FireServer("grant", { items = { { rarity = "Common" }, { rarity = "Common" }, { rarity = "Common" }, { rarity = "Common" } } })
	refresh()
	local m = workspace.World.Core.Creatures:WaitForChild("Creature_tut_common", 5)
	teleport(m.PrimaryPart.Position + Vector3.new(4, 0, 4))
	local t0 = os.clock()
	hold(m.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("ClaimPrompt"))
	refresh()
	local refused = toastSince(t0, "Backpack full")
	result("full backpack refuses a claim without loss", refused ~= nil and st.used == 4, string.format("toast '%s', pack %d/%d", tostring(refused), st.used, st.capacity))
end

CHECKS[#CHECKS + 1] = function(cfg)
	-- disconnect with unbanked cargo: items go to a 3-min pack on this server, notice on the next join
	dev:FireServer("resetProfile")
	task.wait(1.5)
	dev:FireServer("grant", { items = { { rarity = "Rare" }, { rarity = "Common" } } })
	task.wait(0.4)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	dev:FireServer("rejoin", {})
	task.wait(4)
	refresh()
	local notice = toastSince(t0, "Last trip")
	result("disconnect: unbanked items to a pack + 'last trip' notice", #(st.packs or {}) == 1 and st.used == 0 and notice ~= nil, string.format("packs %d, carrying %d, toast '%s'", #(st.packs or {}), st.used, tostring(notice)))
end

CHECKS[#CHECKS + 1] = function(cfg)
	-- B-polish: the tutorial Rare (source nook_rare_r1) is not shaken loose until it has been banked once
	dev:FireServer("resetProfile")
	task.wait(1.5)
	dev:FireServer("grant", { items = { { rarity = "Common" } } })
	task.wait(0.3)
	dev:FireServer("deposit", { tx = "BCHK-tutrare-first" })
	task.wait(0.5)
	dev:FireServer("grant", { items = { { rarity = "Common" }, { rarity = "Rare", source = "nook_rare_r1" } } })
	refresh()
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local hit = getHit(25)
	task.wait(1)
	refresh()
	local kept = false
	for _, it in ipairs(st.items or {}) do
		if it.rarity == "Rare" then
			kept = true
		end
	end
	local note = toastSince(t0, "protected until you bank it")
	result("tutorial Rare protected until banked once", hit and kept and st.used == 1 and note ~= nil, string.format("hit %s, Rare kept %s, carrying %d, toast '%s'", tostring(hit), tostring(kept), st.used, tostring(note)))
	-- after it has been banked once, a later nook Rare follows the normal rule
	teleport(Vector3.new(-1060, 70, 1980))
	-- the bank travel-time check holds a nook find for ~56 s after its claim: simulate the walk home on the clock
	dev:FireServer("clock", { offset = 120 })
	task.wait(0.3)
	dev:FireServer("deposit", { tx = "BCHK-tutrare-bank" })
	task.wait(0.5)
	dev:FireServer("clock", { offset = 0 })
	task.wait(0.3)
	dev:FireServer("grant", { items = { { rarity = "Rare", source = "nook_rare_r1" } } })
	task.wait(3)
	refresh()
	local t1 = os.clock()
	local hit2 = getHit(25)
	task.wait(1)
	refresh()
	local lossFx
	for _, x in ipairs(fx) do
		if x.t > t1 and x.p.kind == "loss" then
			lossFx = x.p
		end
	end
	local shaken = lossFx and lossFx.lost and lossFx.lost[1]
	result("tutorial Rare shakes normally after it was banked once", hit2 and shaken ~= nil and shaken.rarity == "Rare", string.format("hit %s, shaken %s", tostring(hit2), shaken and shaken.rarity or "none"))
	teleport(Vector3.new(-1060, 70, 1980))
end

return function(cfg)
	cfg = cfg or {}
	_G.CC_BCHK = R
	task.spawn(function()
		for i, fn in ipairs(CHECKS) do
			if cfg.only and not table.find(cfg.only, i) then
				continue
			end
			R.where = "check " .. i
			local ok, err = pcall(fn, cfg)
			if not ok then
				R.results[#R.results + 1] = "[ERROR] check " .. i .. ": " .. tostring(err)
			end
		end
		dev:FireServer("clock", { offset = 0 })
		R.status = "done"
	end)
	return "B checks started (" .. #CHECKS .. ")"
end

-- Net (ReplicatedStorage.CC_Core): RemoteEvents under ReplicatedStorage.CC_Remotes (the folder CC_CheckpointService
-- already uses). The server creates them; clients wait. Core remotes:
--   CoreState   S->C  full state snapshot (backpack, progress, timers, save state)
--   CoreToast   S->C  one-line message { text, kind }
--   CoreFx      S->C  effects { kind = "stagger" | "claim" | "net" | "bank" | ... }
--   CoreRequest C->S  (action, payload) rate-limited and validated on the server
--   DevRequest  C->S  Studio-only test hooks (created only when RunService:IsStudio())
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Run = game:GetService("RunService")

local Net = {}
local NAMES = { "CoreState", "CoreToast", "CoreFx", "CoreRequest" }

local function folder()
	local f = RS:FindFirstChild("CC_Remotes")
	if not f and Run:IsServer() then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = "CC_Remotes"
		f.Parent = RS
	end
	return f or RS:WaitForChild("CC_Remotes")
end

function Net.serverInit()
	local f = folder()
	for _, n in ipairs(NAMES) do
		if not f:FindFirstChild(n) then
			local e = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
			e.Name = n
			e.Parent = f
		end
	end
	if Run:IsStudio() and not f:FindFirstChild("DevRequest") then
		local e = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		e.Name = "DevRequest"
		e.Parent = f
	end
	return f
end

function Net.get(name)
	return folder():WaitForChild(name, 30)
end

return Net
sources.src/runtime/CC_AscentClient.client.luau:
-- CC_AscentClient (StarterPlayerScripts): V3 hazards, knockback/stagger, fall reporting, checkpoint toast.
-- Hazards are deterministic: phase = (GetServerTimeNow() + Offset) % Period, so every client sees the same cycle
-- with no network traffic and no server work. Each client animates hazards locally (within ACTIVE_RANGE) and
-- applies hits only to its own character (character physics is client-owned; hits never grant anything).
-- Cycle: [0, Tell) tell (shake / dust / shadow strip / whipping flags), then the action, then rest.
-- Hits = knockback + short stagger, no HP damage (LOCKED). Falls are reported to CC_CheckpointService.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Run = game:GetService("RunService")

local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local ACTIVE_RANGE = 250
local FALL_DROP = 24
local SLATE = Color3.fromRGB(62, 66, 76) -- charcoalSlate token (shadow strips)
local MOON = Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 255) -- moonlight token (dust, snow)

local remotes = RS:WaitForChild("CC_Remotes", 30)
local terrainOnly = RaycastParams.new()
terrainOnly.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
terrainOnly.FilterDescendantsInstances = { workspace.Terrain }

---------------------------------------------------------------- knockback / stagger
local lastHit = 0
local function knock(dir, strength)
	local ch = plr.Character
	local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hrp or not hum or os.clock() - lastHit < 1.2 then
		return
	end
	lastHit = os.clock()
	-- a climber on a face slips instead (CC_ClimbClient: slide + catch window), no ground knockback
	local cs = ch:GetAttribute("CC_TraversalState")
	if cs == "climb" or cs == "rope" or cs == "hanging" then
		remotes.CoreRequest:FireServer("traversal", { action = "slip" })
		return
	end
	if cs == "flight" then return end
	local d = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
	d = (d.Magnitude > 0.01) and d.Unit or Vector3.zAxis
	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = d * strength + Vector3.new(0, 18, 0)
	hum.PlatformStand = true
	task.delay(0.45, function()
		if hum.Parent then
			hum.PlatformStand = false
		end
	end)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- hazard state
local hazards = {} -- model -> runtime table
local function attr(m, k)
	return m:GetAttribute(k)
end

local function setup(m)
	local h = {
		m = m,
		kind = attr(m, "Kind"),
		period = attr(m, "Period"),
		tell = attr(m, "Tell"),
		offset = attr(m, "Offset") or 0,
		strength = attr(m, "Strength"),
		center = attr(m, "Center"),
		dir = attr(m, "TrailDir"),
		out = attr(m, "Outward"),
	}
	if not h.kind or not h.center then
		return nil
	end
	if h.kind == "TreeFall" then
		h.tree = m:FindFirstChild("FallTree")
		h.hinge = attr(m, "Hinge")
		h.len = attr(m, "FallLen")
		h.rest = h.tree and h.tree:GetPivot()
	elseif h.kind == "Rockfall" or h.kind == "Avalanche" then
		h.top, h.bot, h.radius = attr(m, "Top"), attr(m, "Bottom"), attr(m, "Radius")
		h.straight = attr(m, "Straight") -- authored chutes (v4): the rock follows the top->bottom line, no ground snap
	elseif h.kind == "Gust" then
		h.len, h.half = attr(m, "Length"), attr(m, "HalfWidth")
		h.flags = {}
		for _, c in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do
			if c.Name == "WindFlag" then
				h.flags[#h.flags + 1] = { p = c, cf = c.CFrame }
			end
		end
	end
	return h
end

local function localPart(props)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
	for k, v in pairs(props) do
		p[k] = v
	end
	p.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
	return p
end

-- shadow strip on the trail during the tell (pulses; shape + motion carry the warning, no new color)
local function strip(h, a, b, width)
	if not h.strip then
		h.strip = localPart({ Size = Vector3.new(width, 0.2, 1), Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Color = SLATE, Transparency = 1 })
	end
	local len = (b - a).Magnitude
	h.strip.Size = Vector3.new(width, 0.2, len)
	h.strip.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2 + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0), b + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0))
end

local function hideFx(h)
	if h.strip then
		h.strip.Transparency = 1
	end
	if h.ball then
		h.ball.Transparency = 1
	end
	if h.dust then
		h.dust.Enabled = false
	end
	if h.pebbles then
		h.pebbles.Enabled = false
	end
end

local function step(h, now, hrp, dt)
	local t = (now + h.offset) % h.period
	local tell = h.tell
	local pulse = 0.35 + 0.3 * math.sin(now * 12)
	if h.kind == "TreeFall" and h.tree then
		local fallDir = h.out
		local axis = Vector3.yAxis:Cross(fallDir).Unit
		local ang = 0
		if t < tell then
			ang = math.rad(2.5) * math.sin(now * 18) -- creaking shake
			strip(h, h.hinge, h.hinge + fallDir * h.len, 6)
			h.strip.Transparency = pulse
		elseif t < tell + 0.7 then
			local k = (t - tell) / 0.7
			ang = math.rad(88) * k * k
			h.strip.Transparency = 1
		elseif t < tell + 2.7 then
			ang = math.rad(88)
		elseif t < tell + 3.9 then
			ang = math.rad(88) * (1 - (t - tell - 2.7) / 1.2)
		end
		local hinge = CFrame.new(h.hinge)
		h.tree:PivotTo(hinge * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, ang) * hinge:Inverse() * h.rest)
		-- hit: while the trunk sweeps down (40..88 deg) the character is under its line
		if ang > math.rad(40) and t >= tell and t < tell + 0.8 then
			local rel = hrp.Position - h.hinge
			local along = rel:Dot(fallDir)
			local side = rel:Dot(h.dir)
			if along > 0 and along < h.len and math.abs(side) < 4 and rel.Y < 14 then
				knock(h.dir * ((side >= 0) and 1 or -1), h.strength)
			end
		end
	elseif h.kind == "Rockfall" or h.kind == "Avalanche" then
		local dur = (h.kind == "Avalanche") and 2 or 1.4
		if not h.ball then
			h.ball = localPart({ Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * h.radius * 2, Material = (h.kind == "Avalanche") and Enum.Material.Snow or Enum.Material.Slate, Color = (h.kind == "Avalanche") and MOON or SLATE, Transparency = 1 })
			local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
			local anchor = localPart({ Size = Vector3.one, Transparency = 1, CFrame = CFrame.new(h.top) })
			att.Parent = anchor
			att.WorldPosition = h.top
			local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
			pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(MOON)
			pe.Rate = 30
			pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.4)
			pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 8)
			pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(60, 60)
			pe.Size = NumberSequence.new(1.6, 3)
			pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.3, 1)
			pe.Enabled = false
			pe.Parent = att
			h.dust = pe
			if h.straight then
				-- authored chutes (vertical): the tell is a trickle of pebbles down the chute line plus the dust,
				-- not a ground strip (a strip on a vertical line read as a glass pane, run 2 self-review)
				local pb = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
				pb.Color = ColorSequence.new(SLATE)
				pb.LightInfluence = 1
				pb.Rate = 14
				pb.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.2, 1.8)
				pb.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5)
				pb.Acceleration = (h.bot - h.top).Unit * 40
				pb.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(12, 12)
				pb.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
				pb.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.35, 0.6)
				pb.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
				pb.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-200, 200)
				pb.Enabled = false
				pb.Parent = att
				h.pebbles = pb
			end
		end
		if t < tell then
			if h.straight then
				h.pebbles.Enabled = true
			else
				strip(h, h.top, h.bot, h.radius * 2 + 2)
				h.strip.Transparency = pulse
			end
			h.dust.Enabled = true
			h.ball.Transparency = 1
		elseif t < tell + dur then
			local k = (t - tell) / dur
			local p = h.top:Lerp(h.bot, k)
			-- roll on the ground (the straight top->bottom line can float above or dip below the trail)
			local g = not h.straight and workspace:Raycast(p + Vector3.new(0, 60, 0), Vector3.new(0, -140, 0), terrainOnly)
			if g then
				p = Vector3.new(p.X, g.Position.Y + h.radius * 0.8, p.Z)
			end
			p += Vector3.new(0, math.abs(math.sin(k * math.pi * 3)) * 2, 0)
			h.ball.CFrame = CFrame.new(p) * CFrame.Angles(k * 20, 0, 0)
			h.ball.Transparency = 0
			if h.strip then
				h.strip.Transparency = 1
			end
			if h.pebbles then
				h.pebbles.Enabled = false
			end
			h.dust.Enabled = false
			if (hrp.Position - p).Magnitude < h.radius + 2.5 then
				knock((h.bot - h.top), h.strength)
			end
		else
			hideFx(h)
		end
	elseif h.kind == "Gust" then
		local rel = hrp.Position - h.center
		local inside = math.abs(rel:Dot(h.dir)) < h.len / 2 and math.abs(rel:Dot(h.out)) < h.half and math.abs(rel.Y) < 20
		local whip = 0
		if t < tell then
			whip = math.sin(now * 25) * 0.6 * (t / tell)
		elseif t < tell + 1.6 then
			whip = math.sin(now * 40) * 0.9
			if inside then
				-- sheltered behind a windbreak (between the player and the wind source) = no push
				local rp = RaycastParams.new()
				rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
				rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { h.m }
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position, -h.out * 4, rp)
				if not (hit and hit.Instance.Name == "Windbreak") then
					-- the Humanoid cancels velocity changes while grounded, so the gust nudges the root
					-- (a frame-sized step) unless a fence, wall or slope is in the way
					local step = h.out * h.strength * dt
					local block = RaycastParams.new()
					block.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
					block.FilterDescendantsInstances = { plr.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera }
					if not workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position, step.Unit * (step.Magnitude + 1.5), block) then
						hrp.CFrame += step
					end
				end
			end
		end
		for _, fl in ipairs(h.flags) do
			fl.p.CFrame = fl.cf * CFrame.Angles(0, whip, 0)
		end
	end
end

local function scan()
	local w = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
	local hf = w and w:FindFirstChild("Hazards")
	if not hf then
		return
	end
	for _, m in ipairs(hf:GetDescendants()) do
		if m:IsA("Model") and m:GetAttribute("Kind") and not hazards[m] then
			hazards[m] = setup(m) or false
		end
	end
end

local nextScan = 0
Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	local ch = plr.Character
	local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then
		return
	end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if os.clock() > nextScan then
		nextScan = os.clock() + 1
		scan()
	end
	for m, h in pairs(hazards) do
		if h then
			if not m.Parent then
				hazards[m] = nil
			elseif (hrp.Position - h.center).Magnitude < ACTIVE_RANGE then
				h.active = true
				step(h, now, hrp, dt)
			elseif h.active then
				h.active = false
				hideFx(h)
			end
		end
	end
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------- guardian stagger (Run 1 core loop)
-- CC_CoreService sends CoreFx { kind = "stagger", dir, strength, secs } after a server-validated guardian hit:
-- the same knockback as a hazard, then the character can't walk for `secs` (brief §3.3: stagger 1.2 s).
local fxEv = remotes and remotes:WaitForChild("CoreFx", 30)
if fxEv then
	fxEv.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(p)
		if type(p) ~= "table" or p.kind ~= "stagger" then
			return
		end
		local ch = plr.Character
		local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum then
			return
		end
		lastHit = 0 -- a guardian hit is never swallowed by the hazard cooldown
		knock(typeof(p.dir) == "Vector3" and p.dir or Vector3.zAxis, tonumber(p.strength) or 26)
		local prev = hum.WalkSpeed
		if prev > 0 then
			hum.WalkSpeed = 0
			task.delay(tonumber(p.secs) or 1.2, function()
				if hum.Parent and hum.WalkSpeed == 0 then
					hum.WalkSpeed = prev
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
end

-- Fall outcomes and checkpoint messages are owned by server traversal and the Expedition interface.
sources.src/world/CoreProps.luau:
-- CoreProps (Run 1 phase B): world anchors and props for the Green Valley core loop. Generator, run in edit mode:
--   require(ServerStorage.CC_Generators:Clone().CoreProps).build(require(ServerStorage.CC_Generators.Kit))
-- Output: Workspace.World.Core.{Props, Spawns, Nests}. Rebuild-safe (clears its own folders only).
-- Spawns are invisible anchors; creatures, Heartstones and guardians are spawned at runtime by the server
-- (CC_CoreServer). No species art here: creature visuals are stubs until the Codex roster arrives.
-- Placements (all PROPOSED, logged): first common on the plaza between spawn and the campfire; the guardian-free
-- Rare nook up a short fixed rope on the steep inner bank of Shepherd's Road (~s840); the gentle tutorial nest in
-- the dry-grass hollow south of the road; the cliffhanger "lip nest" on the valley lip above the plaza.
-- Colors are existing Kit tokens only.
local C = require(script.Parent.WorldConfig)
local P = {}

local NAMES = { "Props", "Spawns", "Nests" }
P.TUT_COMMON = Vector3.new(-22, 48, 2125)
P.NEST1 = Vector3.new(-1000, 0, 2080) -- y from terrain
P.NEST2 = Vector3.new(-92, 0, 1632)
P.NOOK_S = 840 -- Shepherd's Road arc length for the rope + nook
-- v5 (2026-10-21): Shepherd is a 5-wide tread between a wall and a drop; commons sit on the terrain strip just
-- inside the wall, every 110 studs up to Camp 1 (leg 1 is ~2,230 studs; v4 was 5,900 with spawns every 230)
P.COMMONS_TO, P.COMMONS_EVERY, P.COMMONS_OFF = 2200, 110, 3.4
-- lip nest access: two short timber stairs over the rock steps between the lower shelf (reached on foot from the
-- road, s~5560) and the nest shelf; bottom -> top, y from terrain (measured profile 2026-10-20: steps ~7 and ~6 studs)
P.LIP_STAIRS = {
	{ Vector3.new(-158, 0, 1641), Vector3.new(-147, 0, 1641) },
	{ Vector3.new(-140, 0, 1640), Vector3.new(-120, 0, 1640) },
}

local terrainOnly = RaycastParams.new()
terrainOnly.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
terrainOnly.FilterDescendantsInstances = { workspace.Terrain }
local function ground(x, z)
	-- v6: the in-memory heightfield when present (raycasts right after the voxel writes of a rebuild still see the
	-- old terrain: the nook rope was placed from stale heights and its truss hung 4 studs up, tutorial regression)
	local G = _G.CC_Gen
	if G and _G.CC_HF then
		local h = G.heightAt(x, z)
		local hx, hz = G.heightAt(x + 2, z) - G.heightAt(x - 2, z), G.heightAt(x, z + 2) - G.heightAt(x, z - 2)
		return h, Vector3.new(-hx / 4, 1, -hz / 4).Unit
	end
	local r = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, 3400, z), Vector3.new(0, -3600, 0), terrainOnly)
	return r and r.Position.Y or 0, r and r.Normal or Vector3.yAxis
end

local function routePts(name)
	local out = {}
	local sv = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("CC_Route")
	sv = sv and sv:FindFirstChild(name)
	for tok in string.gmatch(sv and sv.Value or "", "[^;]+") do
		local x, y, z, s = tok:match("([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)")
		out[#out + 1] = { p = Vector3.new(tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z)), s = tonumber(s) }
	end
	return out
end
local function atS(pts, s)
	for i = 2, #pts do
		if pts[i].s >= s then
			local a, b = pts[i - 1], pts[i]
			local k = (s - a.s) / math.max(1e-3, b.s - a.s)
			return a.p:Lerp(b.p, k), (b.p - a.p) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		end
	end
	return pts[#pts].p, Vector3.xAxis
end

local function anchor(parent, name, pos, attrs)
	local a = Instance.new("Part")
	a.Name = name
	a.Anchored = true
	a.CanCollide, a.CanTouch, a.CanQuery = false, false, false
	a.Transparency = 1
	a.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	a.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
	for k, v in pairs(attrs) do
		a:SetAttribute(k, v)
	end
	a.Parent = parent
	return a
end

local function boulder(Kit, parent, pos, size, yaw, tilt)
	local p = Kit.part(parent, {
		Name = "Boulder",
		Size = size,
		CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(tilt or 0.2, yaw or 0, (tilt or 0.2) * 0.6),
		Material = Enum.Material.Rock,
		Color = Kit.COL.rock,
	})
	return p
end

-- nest: stone ring, aurora crystals (Heartstone = aurora-crystal core, LOCKED), cradle, pup spot, patrol radius
local function nest(Kit, parent, id, center, opts)
	local COL = Kit.COL
	local m = Kit.model(parent, id)
	local y = center.Y
	for i = 1, 10 do
		local a = i / 10 * math.pi * 2
		local s = 1.4 + (i % 3) * 0.35
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "RingStone", Size = Vector3.new(s * 1.3, s, s), CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 6, s * 0.35, math.sin(a) * 6)) * CFrame.Angles(0.15, a, 0.1), Material = Enum.Material.Slate, Color = COL.masonry })
	end
	local cradle = Kit.part(m, { Name = "Cradle", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 4.4, 4.4), CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 0.8, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Material = Enum.Material.Slate, Color = COL.slate })
	cradle.CanCollide = false
	for k = 0, 2 do
		local a = k / 3 * math.pi * 2 + 0.6
		Kit.place(m, "CrystalAurora", center + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 8.5, -0.3, math.sin(a) * 8.5), a, opts.crystalScale or 0.45)
	end
	m:SetAttribute("NestId", id)
	m:SetAttribute("Tier", opts.tier)
	m:SetAttribute("Region", 1)
	m:SetAttribute("Patrol", opts.patrol)
	m:SetAttribute("GuardianScale", opts.guardianScale or 1)
	m:SetAttribute("SenseScale", opts.senseScale or 1)
	m:SetAttribute("Center", center)
	m:SetAttribute("HeartstonePos", center + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0))
	m:SetAttribute("PupPos", center + opts.pupOffset)
	m:SetAttribute("Label", opts.label)
	m.ModelStreamingMode = opts.persistent and Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent or Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Default
	return m
end

function P.build(Kit)
	local COL = Kit.COL
	local world = workspace:WaitForChild("World")
	local core = Kit.folder(world, "Core")
	for _, n in ipairs(NAMES) do
		local f = core:FindFirstChild(n)
		if f then
			f:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local props = Kit.folder(core, "Props")
	local spawns = Kit.folder(core, "Spawns")
	local nests = Kit.folder(core, "Nests")
	local report = {}

	------------------------------------------------ tutorial common (per player, once)
	anchor(spawns, "TutCommon", P.TUT_COMMON + Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0), { SpawnId = "tut_common", Kind = "creature", Rarity = "Common", Ecology = "ground", Region = 1, PerPlayer = true, Respawn = 0 })

	------------------------------------------------ rope + Rare nook on Shepherd's Road
	local shep = routePts("Shepherd")
	local roadP, dir = atS(shep, P.NOOK_S)
	local inward = (-roadP * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Unit
	local along = dir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Unit or inward:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
	local baseXZ = roadP + inward * (C.ROUTES[1].hw + 2.5)
	local gBase = ground(baseXZ.X, baseXZ.Z)
	local shelfXZ = roadP + inward * (C.ROUTES[1].hw + 9)
	local gShelf = ground(shelfXZ.X, shelfXZ.Z)
	local shelfTop = math.max(gShelf + 1.2, gBase + 12)
	local climb = shelfTop - gBase
	local nook = Kit.model(props, "RareNook")
	local face = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(baseXZ.X, 0, baseXZ.Z), Vector3.new(baseXZ.X, 0, baseXZ.Z) - inward) -- looks toward the road
	-- shelf (flat stone ledge pushed into the bank)
	local shelfCF = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(shelfXZ.X, shelfTop - 1, shelfXZ.Z), Vector3.new(shelfXZ.X, shelfTop - 1, shelfXZ.Z) + along)
	Kit.part(nook, { Name = "Shelf", Size = Vector3.new(11, 2, 16), CFrame = shelfCF, Material = Enum.Material.Slate, Color = COL.rock })
	-- the step face under the shelf (so the rope hangs on rock, not on a terrain slope)
	local faceH = climb + 1
	Kit.part(nook, { Name = "StepFace", Size = Vector3.new(16, faceH, 3), CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(baseXZ.X, gBase + faceH / 2 - 0.5, baseXZ.Z) + inward * 2.4) * face.Rotation, Material = Enum.Material.Rock, Color = COL.rock })
	-- climbable truss (invisible) + visible fixed rope with knots and a piton
	local truss = Instance.new("TrussPart")
	truss.Name = "RopeTruss"
	truss.Anchored = true
	truss.Size = Vector3.new(2, math.floor(climb / 2 + 1) * 2, 2)
	truss.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(baseXZ.X, gBase + truss.Size.Y / 2, baseXZ.Z)) * face.Rotation
	truss.Transparency = 1
	truss.Parent = nook
	local ropeTop = Vector3.new(baseXZ.X, shelfTop + 0.6, baseXZ.Z)
	local ropeBot = Vector3.new(baseXZ.X, gBase + 0.4, baseXZ.Z)
	-- vertical rope: a cylinder's axis is X, so roll it 90 deg about Z
	local rope = Kit.part(nook, { Name = "Rope", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new((ropeTop - ropeBot).Magnitude, 0.45, 0.45), CFrame = CFrame.new((ropeTop + ropeBot) / 2) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = COL.lantern })
	Kit.decor(rope)
	for y = gBase + 2, shelfTop - 1, 2.5 do
		local knot = Kit.part(nook, { Name = "Knot", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8), CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(baseXZ.X, y, baseXZ.Z)), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = COL.lantern })
		Kit.decor(knot)
	end
	local piton = Kit.part(nook, { Name = "Piton", Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 1.6), CFrame = CFrame.new(ropeTop) * face.Rotation, Material = Enum.Material.Metal, Color = COL.slate })
	Kit.decor(piton)
	-- boulders + scrub hide the Rare from the road (guardian-free nook, LOCKED)
	local shelfC = Vector3.new(shelfXZ.X, shelfTop, shelfXZ.Z)
	boulder(Kit, nook, shelfC - inward * 3.5 + along * 5, Vector3.new(4, 3.4, 3.6), 0.4, 0.25)
	boulder(Kit, nook, shelfC - inward * 3.2 - along * 5.5, Vector3.new(4.6, 3, 3.2), 1.2, 0.2)
	Kit.place(nook, "Bush", shelfC + along * 2.5 + inward * 3, 0.7, 1.3, C.DRY.scrub)
	Kit.place(nook, "Bush", shelfC - along * 3 + inward * 3.5, 2.1, 1.1, C.DRY.scrub)
	anchor(spawns, "TutRare", shelfC + inward * 0.5 + Vector3.new(0, 1.8, 0), { SpawnId = "nook_rare_r1", Kind = "creature", Rarity = "Rare", Ecology = "hiding", Region = 1, PerPlayer = true, Respawn = 1200 })
	anchor(props, "NookTop", shelfC + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), { Marker = "NookTop" })
	anchor(props, "RopeBase", Vector3.new(baseXZ.X, gBase + 3, baseXZ.Z) - inward * 3, { Marker = "RopeBase" })
	report.nook = string.format("road s%d (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) climb %.1f studs, shelf top %.1f", P.NOOK_S, roadP.X, roadP.Y, roadP.Z, climb, shelfTop)

	------------------------------------------------ nests
	local g1 = ground(P.NEST1.X, P.NEST1.Z)
	local n1c = Vector3.new(P.NEST1.X, g1, P.NEST1.Z)
	-- the tutorial nest's guardian is the first one a player meets: shorter senses (net range 18 is outside them)
	nest(Kit, nests, "nest_r1_hollow", n1c, { tier = "Common", patrol = 14, pupOffset = Vector3.new(-8, 1.4, -19), label = "Hollow nest", crystalScale = 0.45, senseScale = 0.6 })
	-- hide spot east of the nest (off the road-to-nest approach): boulder cluster + scrub, breaks line of sight
	local toRoad = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	local hs = n1c + Vector3.new(26, 0, -6)
	local gh = ground(hs.X, hs.Z)
	local hide = Kit.model(props, "HideSpot_r1")
	boulder(Kit, hide, Vector3.new(hs.X, gh + 3.2, hs.Z), Vector3.new(9, 7, 6), 0.3, 0.12)
	boulder(Kit, hide, Vector3.new(hs.X, gh + 2.2, hs.Z) + toRoad:Cross(Vector3.yAxis) * 6, Vector3.new(6, 5, 5), 1.1, 0.18)
	Kit.place(hide, "Bush", Vector3.new(hs.X, gh, hs.Z) - toRoad:Cross(Vector3.yAxis) * 6, 0.4, 1.8, C.DRY.scrub)
	hide:SetAttribute("HideSpot", true)
	local g2 = ground(P.NEST2.X, P.NEST2.Z)
	local n2c = Vector3.new(P.NEST2.X, g2, P.NEST2.Z)
	nest(Kit, nests, "nest_r1_lip", n2c, { tier = "Rare", patrol = 12, pupOffset = Vector3.new(-8, 1.4, 6), label = "Lip nest", guardianScale = 1.4, crystalScale = 0.6, persistent = true })
	report.nests = string.format("hollow (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) | lip (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) | hide spot (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)", n1c.X, n1c.Y, n1c.Z, n2c.X, n2c.Y, n2c.Z, hs.X, gh, hs.Z)

	------------------------------------------------ lip nest access (B-polish 2026-10-20, PROPOSED)
	-- The on-foot walk goes from Shepherd's Road (s~5560) down to a lower shelf west of the nest; from there a walkable
	-- slope climbs to the nest shelf, broken by two rock steps (~7 and ~6 studs) a player can't jump. A short timber
	-- stair over each step (same kit as the valley stairs) keeps the climb on foot.
	local lipM = Kit.model(props, "LipStairs")
	local rises = {}
	for _, st in ipairs(P.LIP_STAIRS) do
		local a = Vector3.new(st[1].X, (ground(st[1].X, st[1].Z)), st[1].Z)
		-- pick the shortest top point (from 6 studs out to the listed end) whose stair line stays above the ground
		-- across the stair's width, so no step is buried under the rock (the listed end is only the search limit)
		local dirS = Vector3.new(st[2].X - a.X, 0, st[2].Z - a.Z)
		local maxD = dirS.Magnitude
		dirS = dirS.Unit
		local sideS = Vector3.new(-dirS.Z, 0, dirS.X)
		local function gMax(p)
			local m = -math.huge
			for _, k in ipairs({ -2, 0, 2 }) do
				m = math.max(m, (ground(p.X + sideS.X * k, p.Z + sideS.Z * k)))
			end
			return m
		end
		local b, bestBad = nil, math.huge
		for d = 6, maxD, 0.5 do
			local tp = a + dirS * d
			local cand = Vector3.new(tp.X, gMax(tp) + 0.2, tp.Z)
			local bad = 0
			for t = 0.5, d - 0.5, 0.5 do
				local q = a + dirS * t
				bad = math.max(bad, gMax(q) - (a.Y + (cand.Y - a.Y) * t / d))
			end
			if bad <= 0.3 then
				b, bestBad = cand, bad
				break
			elseif bad < bestBad then
				b, bestBad = cand, bad
			end
		end
		Kit.stairs(lipM, a, b, 5)
		rises[#rises + 1] = string.format("%.1f", b.Y - a.Y)
		-- the rock bulges above the stair line (up to ~3 studs, measured): clear voxels whose centre sits 0-8 studs
		-- above the line inside a 6-stud corridor so there is head room (whole 4-stud voxels, Read/WriteVoxels)
		local lo = Vector3.new(math.min(a.X, b.X) - 6, math.min(a.Y, b.Y) - 4, math.min(a.Z, b.Z) - 6)
		local hi = Vector3.new(math.max(a.X, b.X) + 6, math.max(a.Y, b.Y) + 12, math.max(a.Z, b.Z) + 6)
		local region = Region3.new(lo, hi):ExpandToGrid(4)
		local mats, occ = workspace.Terrain:ReadVoxels(region, 4)
		local dir = Vector3.new(b.X - a.X, 0, b.Z - a.Z)
		local len = dir.Magnitude
		dir = dir.Unit
		local side = Vector3.new(-dir.Z, 0, dir.X)
		local cleared = 0
		local sz = mats.Size
		for ix = 1, sz.X do
			for iy = 1, sz.Y do
				for iz = 1, sz.Z do
					local c = region.CFrame.Position - region.Size / 2 + Vector3.new(ix - 0.5, iy - 0.5, iz - 0.5) * 4
					local rel = Vector3.new(c.X - a.X, 0, c.Z - a.Z)
					local along, across = rel:Dot(dir), math.abs(rel:Dot(side))
					if along >= -1 and along <= len + 1 and across <= 3 then
						local lineY = a.Y + (b.Y - a.Y) * math.clamp(along / len, 0, 1)
						if c.Y - lineY > 0 and c.Y - lineY < 8 and occ[ix][iy][iz] > 0 then
							mats[ix][iy][iz], occ[ix][iy][iz] = Enum.Material.Air, 0
							cleared += 1
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		workspace.Terrain:WriteVoxels(region, 4, mats, occ)
		rises[#rises] ..= string.format("(run %.1f, worst ground above line %.1f, %d vox)", (Vector3.new(b.X, 0, b.Z) - Vector3.new(a.X, 0, a.Z)).Magnitude, bestBad, cleared)
	end
	report.lipStairs = "rises " .. table.concat(rises, " + ")

	------------------------------------------------ shared commons along Shepherd's Road (+ a few uncommons)
	local n, ecos = 0, { "ground", "hopping", "perched" }
	local nextS = 160
	local side = 1
	for _, q in ipairs(shep) do
		if q.s >= nextS and q.s <= P.COMMONS_TO then
			nextS = q.s + P.COMMONS_EVERY
			local _, d = atS(shep, q.s)
			local right = (d.Magnitude > 0 and d.Unit or Vector3.xAxis):Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
			-- the road is cut into steep banks, so spawns sit on the trail edge (either side, must be level with it)
			local x, z, gy, nrm
			for _, sd in ipairs({ side, -side }) do
				local off = right * sd * P.COMMONS_OFF
				local gx, gz = q.p.X + off.X, q.p.Z + off.Z
				local y, nr = ground(gx, gz)
				if nr.Y > 0.8 and math.abs(y - q.p.Y) < 3 then
					x, z, gy, nrm = gx, gz, y, nr
					break
				end
			end
			side = -side
			if x then
				n += 1
				local unc = (n % 5 == 0)
				anchor(spawns, "Common_" .. n, Vector3.new(x, gy + 1.6, z), {
					SpawnId = "shep_" .. n,
					Kind = "creature",
					Rarity = unc and "Uncommon" or "Common",
					Ecology = unc and ((n % 10 == 0) and "hiding" or "floating") or ecos[(n % 3) + 1],
					Region = 1,
					PerPlayer = false,
					Respawn = 90,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	-- a few on the Foothold outskirts so a returning player meets one near home
	for k, pos in ipairs({ Vector3.new(-330, 0, 2010), Vector3.new(310, 0, 2000), Vector3.new(-120, 0, 1890) }) do
		local gy = ground(pos.X, pos.Z)
		anchor(spawns, "Outskirts_" .. k, Vector3.new(pos.X, gy + 1.6, pos.Z), { SpawnId = "out_" .. k, Kind = "creature", Rarity = "Common", Ecology = ecos[k], Region = 1, PerPlayer = false, Respawn = 90 })
	end
	report.commons = n .. " route spawn points + 3 outskirts"
	return report
end

return P

-- Tests (ServerScriptService.CC_CoreServer): scripted A1 acceptance tests for persistence, run on the Server
-- datamodel during a Studio playtest:  require(game.ServerScriptService.CC_CoreServer.Tests).runA1()
-- Every test uses its own in-memory store (Store.memory) and fake user ids, so it never touches a live session.
-- Two Profile services sharing one backend stand in for two game servers. Clock.offset simulates time away.
-- What this proves: server session locks, durable idempotent deposits, failure handling and deliberate hatching.
-- What it cannot prove: real DataStore behavior (UNVERIFIED; the place is unpublished, PlaceId = 0).
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local C = require(RS:WaitForChild("CC_Core"):WaitForChild("CoreConfig"))
local Species = require(RS.CC_Core.Species)
local Store = require(script.Parent.Store)
local Profile = require(script.Parent.Profile)
local Inv = require(script.Parent.Inventory)
local Bank = require(script.Parent.Bank)
local Clock = require(script.Parent.Clock)

local T = {}

local FAST = { lockWait = 0.05, backoff = 0.01, loadTries = 3, saveTries = 4 }
local function svc(store, job, extra)
	local o = { jobId = job }
	for k, v in pairs(FAST) do
		o[k] = v
	end
	for k, v in pairs(extra or {}) do
		o[k] = v
	end
	return Profile.new(store, o)
end
local function creature(rarity, species)
	return Inv.newItem("creature", { species = species or Species.query({ region = 1, rarity = rarity, kind = "creature" })[1].id, rarity = rarity, region = 1, source = "test" })
end
local function heartstone(tier)
	local sp = Bank.rollHatch(tier, 1, Random.new(7))
	return Inv.newItem("heartstone", { tier = tier, species = sp, region = 1, source = "test" })
end
local function fill(uid, items)
	Inv.clear(uid)
	Inv.setCapacity(uid, C.SLOTS_MAX)
	for _, it in ipairs(items) do
		assert(Inv.add(uid, it), "fill failed")
	end
end

local cases = {}
local function case(name, fn)
	cases[#cases + 1] = { name = name, fn = fn }
end

case("rejoin keeps bank (same server and another server)", function(log)
	local store = Store.memory()
	local A, B = svc(store, "srvA"), svc(store, "srvB")
	local uid = 910001
	local s = assert(A:load(uid))
	fill(uid, { creature("Common"), creature("Rare"), heartstone("Common") })
	local r = Bank.deposit(s, uid, "tx-" .. HttpService:GenerateGUID(false))
	assert(r.ok and r.creatures == 2 and r.heartstones == 1, "deposit result")
	local coins, xp, banked = s.data.coins, s.data.xp, #s.data.bank
	assert(A:save(s, true), "release failed")
	local s2 = assert(A:load(uid), "same-server reload failed")
	log(string.format("same server: bank %d->%d coins %d->%d xp %d->%d heartstones %d", banked, #s2.data.bank, coins, s2.data.coins, xp, s2.data.xp, #s2.data.heartstones))
	assert(#s2.data.bank == banked and s2.data.coins == coins and s2.data.xp == xp and #s2.data.heartstones == 1, "same-server mismatch")
	assert(A:save(s2, true))
	local s3 = assert(B:load(uid), "other-server load failed")
	assert(#s3.data.bank == banked and s3.data.coins == coins, "other-server mismatch")
	log(string.format("other server: bank %d coins %d", #s3.data.bank, s3.data.coins))
	B:save(s3, true)
end)

case("double deposit yields once", function(log)
	local store = Store.memory()
	local A = svc(store, "srvA")
	local uid = 910002
	local s = assert(A:load(uid))
	local items = { creature("Common"), creature("Uncommon") }
	fill(uid, items)
	local r1 = Bank.deposit(s, uid, "tx-double-1")
	local r2 = Bank.deposit(s, uid, "tx-double-1") -- same request replayed
	local r3 = Bank.deposit(s, uid, "tx-double-2") -- second press, backpack already empty
	log(string.format("r1 creatures %d coins %d | r2 dup %s creatures %d | r3 creatures %d", r1.creatures, r1.coins, tostring(r2.dup), r2.creatures, r3.creatures))
	assert(r1.creatures == 2 and r2.dup and r2.creatures == 0 and r3.creatures == 0, "replay deposited twice")
	-- replay of the same item uids (forged re-add) must not duplicate bank entries or rewards
	local coins = s.data.coins
	fill(uid, items)
	local r4 = Bank.deposit(s, uid, "tx-double-3")
	assert(r4.creatures == 0 and s.data.coins == coins and #s.data.bank == 2, "same uid banked twice")
	-- two concurrent deposits with different tx ids
	fill(uid, { creature("Common"), creature("Common"), creature("Rare") })
	local results = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		task.spawn(function()
			results[i] = Bank.deposit(s, uid, "tx-par-" .. i)
		end)
	end
	task.wait()
	local total = (results[1] and results[1].creatures or 0) + (results[2] and results[2].creatures or 0)
	log(string.format("concurrent: %d + %d = %d (expected 3); bank %d", results[1].creatures, results[2].creatures, total, #s.data.bank))
	assert(total == 3 and #s.data.bank == 5, "concurrent deposits wrong")
	assert(A:save(s, true))
end)

case("store failure: load refused safely, data untouched, retries on save", function(log)
	local store = Store.memory()
	local A = svc(store, "srvA")
	local uid = 910003
	local s = assert(A:load(uid))
	fill(uid, { creature("Rare") })
	Bank.deposit(s, uid, "tx-fail-1")
	assert(A:save(s, true))
	local _, before = store:read(A:key(uid))
	-- 1) store down at join -> no session, reason "store"; nothing written
	store.failAll = true
	local s2, reason = A:load(uid)
	store.failAll = false
	local _, after = store:read(A:key(uid))
	log(string.format("load while down -> session %s reason %s; stored bank %d -> %d", tostring(s2 ~= nil), tostring(reason), #before.data.bank, #after.data.bank))
	assert(s2 == nil and reason == "store", "load should fail with reason store")
	assert(HttpService:JSONEncode(before.data) == HttpService:JSONEncode(after.data), "data changed during failed load")
	-- 2) deposit with no session -> refused, items stay in the backpack
	fill(uid, { creature("Common") })
	local r = Bank.deposit(nil, uid, "tx-fail-2")
	assert(r.ok == false and r.reason == "unavailable" and Inv.used(uid) == 1, "deposit without session must keep items")
	-- 3) flaky store on release: 2 failures then success (save retries with backoff)
	local s3 = assert(A:load(uid))
	Bank.deposit(s3, uid, "tx-fail-3")
	store.failNext = 2
	local ok = A:save(s3, true)
	log(string.format("release with 2 transient failures -> %s (update calls %d, failed %d)", tostring(ok), store.calls.update, store.calls.failed))
	assert(ok, "release should survive transient failures")
	local s4 = assert(A:load(uid))
	assert(#s4.data.bank == 2, "bank after flaky release")
	A:save(s4, true)
end)

case("Heartstone waits for adventure progress and deliberate hatch across offline gaps", function(log)
	local store = Store.memory()
	local A = svc(store, "srvA")
	local uid = 910004
	local s = assert(A:load(uid))
	fill(uid, { heartstone("Common") })
	local r = Bank.deposit(s, uid, "tx-hs-1")
	local hs = s.data.heartstones[1]
	assert(r.heartstones == 1 and hs and hs.progress == 0 and hs.required > 0, "heartstone not stored")
	assert(A:save(s, true))
	local base = Clock.offset
	Clock.offset = base + 100 -- time alone gives no adventure progress
	local s2 = assert(A:load(uid))
	local early = Bank.ripen(s2)
	local left = s2.data.heartstones[1].required - s2.data.heartstones[1].progress
	assert(#early == 0 and #s2.data.heartstones == 1, "ripened too early")
	assert(A:save(s2, true))
	Clock.offset = base + 400 -- beyond the old timer; explicit progress/hatch still required
	local s3 = assert(A:load(uid))
	local idle = Bank.ripen(s3)
	assert(#idle == 0 and #s3.data.heartstones == 1, "time advanced or hatched a stone")
	s3.data.heartstones[1].progress = s3.data.heartstones[1].required
	s3.data.heartstones[1].ready = true
	s3.data.home.nests[1] = hs.id
	local result = Bank.hatch(s3, 1, "manual-hatch-offline")
	local hatched = result.ok and { result.hatched } or {}
	local again = Bank.ripen(s3)
	Clock.offset = base
	log(string.format("offline 100 s: %d auto-hatched, %.1f adventure remaining | after explicit completion: %d hatched -> %s (%s); repeat auto-pass %d; stored stones %d", #early, left, #hatched, hatched[1] and hatched[1].species or "-", hatched[1] and hatched[1].rarity or "-", #again, #s3.data.heartstones))
	assert(#hatched == 1 and #again == 0 and #s3.data.heartstones == 0, "deliberate hatching wrong")
	assert(s3.data.bank[1].creatureId == hs.id, "hatched creature must keep the Heartstone id")
	assert(A:save(s3, true))
end)

case("session lock: live lock blocks a second server, release unblocks", function(log)
	local store = Store.memory()
	local A, B = svc(store, "srvA"), svc(store, "srvB")
	local uid = 910005
	local s = assert(A:load(uid))
	local sB, reason = B:load(uid)
	log("second server while locked -> " .. tostring(reason))
	assert(sB == nil and reason == "locked", "second load should be blocked")
	assert(A:save(s, true))
	local sB2 = assert(B:load(uid), "load after release failed")
	B:save(sB2, true)
end)

case("session lock: stale lock is taken over; the old server can't overwrite", function(log)
	local store = Store.memory()
	local A, B = svc(store, "srvA"), svc(store, "srvB")
	local uid = 910006
	local base = Clock.offset
	local s = assert(A:load(uid))
	fill(uid, { creature("Common") })
	Bank.deposit(s, uid, "tx-stale-1")
	assert(A:save(s, false)) -- autosave, lock kept; then server A "freezes"
	Clock.offset = base + C.PERSIST.lockTTL + 5
	local sB = assert(B:load(uid), "takeover failed")
	fill(uid, { creature("Uncommon") })
	Bank.deposit(sB, uid, "tx-stale-2")
	assert(B:save(sB, false))
	-- server A wakes up and tries to write its older copy
	fill(uid, { creature("Legendary") })
	Bank.deposit(s, uid, "tx-stale-3")
	local okA, why = A:save(s, true)
	Clock.offset = base
	local _, env = store:read(A:key(uid))
	log(string.format("B stole lock %s; A save -> %s (%s); stored bank %d (expected 2: A's 1st + B's)", tostring(sB.stoleLock), tostring(okA), tostring(why), #env.data.bank))
	assert(sB.stoleLock and okA == false and why == "lost" and s.lost, "old server must stop writing")
	assert(#env.data.bank == 2, "stored data overwritten by the stale server")
	B:save(sB, true)
end)

case("migration + sanitize keep valid data and quarantine junk", function(log)
	local store = Store.memory()
	local A = svc(store, "srvA")
	local uid = 910007
	store.backend[A:key(uid)] = HttpService:JSONEncode({
		data = { coins = "lots", xp = 120, bank = { { creatureId = "c1", species = "stub_common_1", rarity = "Common" }, "junk", { creatureId = "c1", species = "stub_common_1" } }, heartstones = { { id = "h1", tier = "Bogus", readyAt = 5 } } },
	})
	local s = assert(A:load(uid))
	require(script.Parent.Progression).refresh(s.data) -- CC_CoreService does this after every load
	log(string.format("version %d coins %d xp %d level %d bank %d quarantine %d heartstones %d", s.data.version, s.data.coins, s.data.xp, s.data.level, #s.data.bank, #s.data.quarantine, #s.data.heartstones))
	assert(s.data.version == Profile.VERSION and s.data.coins == 0 and s.data.xp == 120 and s.data.level == 2, "migration fields")
	assert(#s.data.bank == 1 and #s.data.quarantine == 3, "sanitize: 1 valid entry, 3 quarantined (junk, duplicate id, bad heartstone)")
	A:save(s, true)
end)

case("UpdateAsync retry semantics: transform runs twice, result applied once", function(log)
	local store = Store.memory()
	local A = svc(store, "srvA")
	local uid = 910008
	store.conflicts = 1
	local s = assert(A:load(uid))
	fill(uid, { creature("Common") })
	Bank.deposit(s, uid, "tx-conf-1")
	store.conflicts = 1
	assert(A:save(s, true))
	local _, env = store:read(A:key(uid))
	log(string.format("bank %d, lock %s, saves %d", #env.data.bank, tostring(env.lock), env.meta.saves))
	assert(#env.data.bank == 1 and env.lock == nil, "conflict replay changed the result")
end)

-- regression tests for the A1 adversarial review (evidence/core_P1/A1_review.md)
case("review: shutdown covers a leave-release already in flight (profiles.active)", function(log)
	local store = Store.memory({ latency = 0.3 })
	local A = svc(store, "srvA")
	local uid = 910009
	local s = assert(A:load(uid))
	fill(uid, { creature("Rare") })
	Bank.deposit(s, uid, "tx-shut-1")
	local leaveDone = false
	task.spawn(function() -- PlayerRemoving release, in flight
		A:save(s, true)
		leaveDone = true
	end)
	task.wait(0.05)
	assert(A.active[uid] == s and s.saving, "in-flight release must still be listed in profiles.active")
	-- BindToClose logic: save every active session and wait
	local ok, why = A:save(s, true)
	local _, env = store:read(A:key(uid))
	log(string.format("shutdown save -> %s (%s); leave done %s; stored bank %d, lock %s", tostring(ok), tostring(why), tostring(leaveDone), #env.data.bank, tostring(env.lock)))
	assert(ok and leaveDone and #env.data.bank == 1 and env.lock == nil, "shutdown did not wait for the release")
end)

case("review: a newer-schema profile is never downgraded by an older server", function(log)
	local store = Store.memory()
	local A = svc(store, "srvA")
	local uid = 910010
	local raw = HttpService:JSONEncode({ data = { version = 99, coins = 5, futureField = { a = 1 } } })
	store.backend[A:key(uid)] = raw
	local s, reason = A:load(uid)
	log("load -> " .. tostring(reason) .. ", stored unchanged " .. tostring(store.backend[A:key(uid)] == raw))
	assert(s == nil and reason == "newer" and store.backend[A:key(uid)] == raw, "newer profile was touched")
end)

case("review: a save queued behind a release does not re-take the lock", function(log)
	local store = Store.memory({ latency = 0.2 })
	local A = svc(store, "srvA")
	local uid = 910011
	local s = assert(A:load(uid))
	task.spawn(function()
		A:save(s, true)
	end)
	task.wait(0.02)
	local ok, why = A:save(s, false) -- autosave arriving while the release is in flight
	local _, env = store:read(A:key(uid))
	log(string.format("queued autosave -> %s (%s), lock %s", tostring(ok), tostring(why), tostring(env.lock)))
	assert(ok and why == "released" and env.lock == nil, "autosave re-took the lock after release")
end)

case("review: no deposit acknowledged while closing; malformed items stay in the pack", function(log)
	local store = Store.memory()
	local A = svc(store, "srvA")
	local uid = 910012
	local s = assert(A:load(uid))
	fill(uid, { creature("Common") })
	s.closing = true
	local r1 = Bank.deposit(s, uid, "tx-close-1")
	s.closing = false
	assert(r1.ok == false and Inv.used(uid) == 1, "deposit acknowledged while closing")
	Inv.bag(uid).items[#Inv.bag(uid).items + 1] = { uid = "bad-1", kind = "creature", species = "stub_common_1", slots = 1 } -- no rarity
	local r2 = Bank.deposit(s, uid, "tx-close-2")
	log(string.format("closing -> %s; malformed: deposited %d, kept %s, left in pack %d", tostring(r1.reason), r2.creatures, tostring(r2.kept), #Inv.bag(uid).items))
	assert(r2.creatures == 1 and r2.kept == 1 and #Inv.bag(uid).items == 1, "malformed item handling")
	local clean = Profile.cleanItem({ uid = "x", kind = "creature", species = "stub_common_1" })
	assert(clean == nil, "cleanItem accepted an item without rarity")
	A:save(s, true)
end)

function T.runA1()
	local lines, pass, fail = {}, 0, 0
	for _, c in ipairs(cases) do
		local logs = {}
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local ok, err = pcall(c.fn, function(s)
			logs[#logs + 1] = s
		end)
		local dt = os.clock() - t0
		if ok then
			pass += 1
		else
			fail += 1
		end
		lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("[%s] %s (%.2f s)", ok and "PASS" or "FAIL", c.name, dt)
		for _, l in ipairs(logs) do
			lines[#lines + 1] = "    " .. l
		end
		if not ok then
			lines[#lines + 1] = "    ERROR: " .. tostring(err)
		end
	end
	Clock.offset = 0
	table.insert(lines, 1, string.format("A1 persistence tests: %d pass, %d fail (store = in-memory mock; real DataStore UNVERIFIED)", pass, fail))
	return table.concat(lines, "\n"), pass, fail
end

return T

-- CC_WeatherClient (StarterPlayerScripts), v4 P4 run 2: draws the server's day/night + weather (Weather module).
-- Concept LOCKED #13: dynamic, with mobile quality tiers, only after a measured cost test (design/v4-run2-log.md).
-- Tiers from the player's graphics level (Automatic counts as mid):
--   low  (1-3): ClockTime + atmosphere only (no particles, only your own headlamp lit)
--   mid  (4-7): + snow / mist particles at 40 % rate, headlamps of players within 120 studs
--   high (8-10): full particle rate
-- Colors are world tokens (design/world-tokens.md). workspace CC_WeatherOff (Studio dev action) = the static
-- LightingSetup look, for perf comparisons.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Run = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local C = require(RS:WaitForChild("CC_Core"):WaitForChild("CoreConfig"))
local W = C.WEATHER

local GOLDEN = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 150) -- goldenDaylight
local MOON = Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 255) -- moonlight
local SAPPHIRE = Color3.fromRGB(30, 62, 140) -- deepSapphire
local STORM = Color3.fromRGB(46, 72, 122) -- stormBlue
local ICE = Color3.fromRGB(196, 232, 255) -- iceBlue

-- the static look (LightingSetup) = the clear-day target
local BASE = {
	Brightness = 2.6,
	OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(128, 120, 112),
	Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(70, 68, 76),
	ColorShift_Top = GOLDEN,
	density = 0.24,
	haze = 1.4,
	atmColor = GOLDEN,
	cover = 0.5,
}
local LOOK = {
	clear = { density = 0.24, haze = 1.4, atmColor = GOLDEN, cover = 0.5, wind = 2 },
	mist = { density = 0.42, haze = 2.6, atmColor = MOON, cover = 0.62, wind = 3 },
	snow = { density = 0.34, haze = 2.2, atmColor = ICE, cover = 0.78, wind = 6 },
	gust = { density = 0.3, haze = 1.9, atmColor = STORM, cover = 0.72, wind = 16 },
}

local function tier()
	local ok, q = pcall(function()
		return UserSettings().GameSettings.SavedQualityLevel.Value
	end)
	q = ok and q or 0
	if q == 0 then
		return "mid"
	end
	return (q <= 3 and "low") or (q <= 7 and "mid") or "high"
end

-- ClockTime from the server's day start (identical on every client)
local function clockNow()
	local start = workspace:GetAttribute("CC_DayStart")
	if not start then
		return 15.4
	end
	local cyc = W.dayMinutes * 60
	local phase = ((workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - start) % cyc) / cyc
	local dayH = W.nightFrom - W.nightTo
	if phase < W.dayShare then
		return W.nightTo + phase / W.dayShare * dayH
	end
	return (W.nightFrom + (phase - W.dayShare) / (1 - W.dayShare) * (24 - dayH)) % 24
end

-- 0 = full day, 1 = full night (an hour of dusk / dawn each side)
local function nightness(h)
	local function ramp(x, a, b)
		return math.clamp((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1)
	end
	if h >= W.nightTo + 1 and h <= W.nightFrom - 1 then
		return 0
	end
	if h > W.nightFrom - 1 and h < 24 then
		return ramp(h, W.nightFrom - 1, W.nightFrom + 0.5)
	end
	return 1 - ramp(h, W.nightTo - 0.5, W.nightTo + 1)
end

-- particles: one emitter box above the camera (snow above snowY; mist anywhere)
local box = Instance.new("Part")
box.Name = "CC_WeatherBox"
box.Anchored, box.CanCollide, box.CanQuery, box.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
box.Transparency = 1
box.Size = Vector3.new(90, 1, 90)
box.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
local snow = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
snow.Name = "Snow"
snow.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
snow.Color = ColorSequence.new(ICE)
snow.LightEmission = 0.2
snow.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.35)
snow.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
snow.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(5, 7)
snow.Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 9)
snow.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
snow.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(20, 20)
snow.Rate = 0
snow.Parent = box
local mist = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
mist.Name = "Mist"
mist.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
mist.Color = ColorSequence.new(MOON)
mist.LightEmission = 0
mist.Size = NumberSequence.new(14, 22)
mist.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, 0.82), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
mist.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(8, 12)
mist.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 2)
mist.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
mist.Rate = 0
mist.Parent = box

local atm = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
local clouds = workspace.Terrain:FindFirstChildOfClass("Clouds")
local cur = { density = BASE.density, haze = BASE.haze, atmColor = BASE.atmColor, cover = BASE.cover, wind = 2 }
local myTier = tier()
local tierAt = 0
local lampAt = 0

local function lerp(a, b, t)
	return a + (b - a) * t
end

Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	if workspace:GetAttribute("CC_WeatherOff") then
		-- static LightingSetup look
		Lighting.ClockTime = 15.4
		snow.Rate, mist.Rate = 0, 0
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - tierAt > 5 then
		tierAt = os.clock()
		myTier = tier()
	end
	local h = clockNow()
	Lighting.ClockTime = h
	local n = nightness(h)
	-- night: moonlit sapphire ambient, cooler top shift, a little less sun brightness (markers still glow)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = BASE.OutdoorAmbient:Lerp(SAPPHIRE, n * 0.7)
	Lighting.ColorShift_Top = GOLDEN:Lerp(MOON, n)
	Lighting.Brightness = lerp(BASE.Brightness, 1.6, n)

	local state = workspace:GetAttribute("CC_Weather") or "clear"
	local look = LOOK[state] or LOOK.clear
	local k = math.min(1, dt / 6) -- ~6 s blend
	cur.density = lerp(cur.density, look.density, k)
	cur.haze = lerp(cur.haze, look.haze, k)
	cur.atmColor = cur.atmColor:Lerp(look.atmColor, k)
	cur.cover = lerp(cur.cover, look.cover, k)
	cur.wind = lerp(cur.wind, look.wind, k)
	if atm then
		atm.Density = cur.density
		atm.Haze = cur.haze
		atm.Color = cur.atmColor:Lerp(SAPPHIRE, n * 0.5)
	end
	if clouds then
		clouds.Cover = cur.cover
	end
	workspace.GlobalWind = Vector3.new(cur.wind, 0, cur.wind * 0.4)

	local camPos = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
	box.CFrame = CFrame.new(camPos + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0))
	local rateMul = (myTier == "high" and 1) or (myTier == "mid" and 0.4) or 0
	snow.Rate = (state == "snow" and camPos.Y > W.snowY) and 260 * rateMul or 0
	mist.Rate = (state == "mist") and 6 * rateMul or 0

	-- headlamps: on at night (low tier: only your own)
	if os.clock() - lampAt > 0.5 then
		lampAt = os.clock()
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local ch = p.Character
			local g = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("CC_Gear")
			local lamp = g and g:FindFirstChild("Headlamp")
			local light = lamp and lamp:FindFirstChild("HeadlampLight")
			if light then
				local near = p == plr or (myTier ~= "low" and ch.PrimaryPart and (ch.PrimaryPart.Position - camPos).Magnitude < 120)
				light.Enabled = ch:GetAttribute("CC_HeadlampActive") == true and near
			end
		end
	end
end)
