-- Behavioral regression tests. Only private mock stores/fake ids; never live player saves.
local F = script.Parent
local P, Store, Inv, Bank = require(F.Profile), require(F.Store), require(F.Inventory), require(F.Bank)
local Clock = require(F.Clock)
local Tests = {}
local function session(id, store)
	local p = P.new(store or Store.memory(), { jobId = "expedition-tests", loadTries = 1, saveTries = 2, backoff = 0.001 })
	local s = assert(p:load(id))
	Inv.clear(id)
	if Inv.bind then Inv.bind(id, s) end
	return p, s, p.store
end
local function item(id, kind)
	local i = Inv.newItem(kind or "creature", { species = "stub_common_1", rarity = "Common", tier = "Common", acquiredAt = Clock.now(), source = "test_nook" })
	i.uid = id
	i.discovery = { id = id, place = "test_nook", method = "encounter", at = i.acquiredAt }
	return i
end
function Tests.run()
	local pass, fail, lines = 0, 0, {}
	local function test(name, fn)
		local ok, err = pcall(fn)
		if ok then pass += 1 else fail += 1 end
		lines[#lines + 1] = (ok and "PASS " or "FAIL ") .. name .. (ok and "" or (": " .. tostring(err)))
	end
	test("bank never acknowledges unavailable storage", function()
		local p, s, store = session(991101)
		Inv.add(s.userId, item("durable-a"))
		store.failAll = true
		local r = Bank.deposit(s, s.userId, "bank-unavailable")
		assert(not r.ok, "bank acknowledged before durable write")
		assert(Inv.used(s.userId) == 1, "unconfirmed bank consumed cargo")
		store.failAll = false
		assert(p:recover(s).ok)
		assert(#s.data.bank == 1 and Inv.used(s.userId) == 0)
	end)
	test("commit then response loss reconciles once", function()
		local p, s, store = session(991102)
		Inv.add(s.userId, item("uncertain-a"))
		store.failAfterCommit = 1
		local r = Bank.deposit(s, s.userId, "bank-uncertain")
		if not r.ok then assert(p:recover(s).ok) end
		local coins = s.data.coins
		assert(#s.data.bank == 1 and Inv.used(s.userId) == 0)
		local again = Bank.deposit(s, s.userId, "bank-uncertain")
		assert(again.ok and again.dup and #s.data.bank == 1 and s.data.coins == coins)
	end)
	test("uncertain bank survives server loss without duplicate cargo or credit", function()
		local p, s, store = session(991106)
		Inv.add(s.userId, item("crash-a"))
		assert(p:save(s, false))
		store.failAfterCommit = 2
		local r = Bank.deposit(s, s.userId, "crash-bank")
		assert(not r.ok and r.pending, "injected response loss did not become uncertain")
		local before = Clock.offset
		Clock.offset += 250
		local other = P.new(store, { jobId = "another-server", loadTries = 1, saveTries = 1, backoff = 0.001 })
		local loaded = other:load(s.userId)
		Clock.offset = before
		assert(loaded, "committed profile could not reconnect")
		Inv.bind(s.userId, loaded)
		assert(#loaded.data.bank == 1 and Inv.used(s.userId) == 0)
		local coins = loaded.data.coins
		assert(Bank.deposit(loaded, s.userId, "crash-bank").dup and loaded.data.coins == coins)
	end)
	test("both previously occupied nests advance; incoming stones stay stored", function()
		local _, s = session(991103)
		s.data.heartstones = {
			{ id = "nest-a", tier = "Common", species = "stub_common_1", progress = 0, required = 4, discovery = { id = "nest-a" } },
			{ id = "nest-b", tier = "Rare", species = "stub_rare_1", progress = 0, required = 9, discovery = { id = "nest-b" } },
		}
		s.data.home.nests = { "nest-a", "nest-b" }
		Inv.add(s.userId, item("new-find"))
		Inv.add(s.userId, item("new-stone", "heartstone"))
		assert(Bank.deposit(s, s.userId, "nest-progress").ok)
		assert(s.data.heartstones[1].progress == 2 and s.data.heartstones[2].progress == 2)
		assert(s.data.heartstones[3].progress == 0 and s.data.home.nests[2] == "nest-b")
		Inv.add(s.userId, item("new-find"))
		assert(Bank.deposit(s, s.userId, "nest-replay").ok)
		assert(s.data.heartstones[1].progress == 2, "rebank manufactured progress")
	end)
	test("legacy stones preserve elapsed progress, ready outcomes, overflow and balances", function()
		local now = Clock.now()
		local old = P.default()
		old.version, old.home, old.coins = 1, nil, 154
		old.heartstones = {
			{ id = "half", tier = "Common", startedAt = now - 150, readyAt = now + 150, species = "stub_common_1", mutation = "glow" },
			{ id = "ready", tier = "Rare", startedAt = now - 1900, readyAt = now - 100, species = "stub_rare_1" },
			{ id = "overflow", tier = "Legendary", startedAt = now, readyAt = now + 14400, species = "stub_legendary_1" },
		}
		local d = P.sanitize(P.migrate(old))
		assert(d.coins == 154 and #d.heartstones == 3)
		assert(d.heartstones[1].progress >= 2 and d.heartstones[1].mutation == "glow")
		assert(d.heartstones[2].ready and d.heartstones[2].species == "stub_rare_1")
		assert(d.home.nests[1] == "" and d.home.nests[2] == "")
	end)
	test("reconnect preserves cargo and original discovery", function()
		local p, s = session(991104)
		Inv.add(s.userId, item("travel-a"))
		assert(p:save(s, true))
		Inv.clear(s.userId)
		local s2 = assert(p:load(s.userId))
		Inv.bind(s.userId, s2)
		assert(Inv.used(s.userId) == 1 and Inv.bag(s.userId).items[1].discovery.place == "test_nook")
	end)
	test("locker and released world manifests retain unique identities on reconnect", function()
		local p, s = session(991107)
		local a, b, c = item("cargo-unique"), item("locker-unique"), item("released-unique")
		s.data.cargo = { a }
		s.data.lockers.Camp1 = { b }
		s.data.drops = { { id = "released:c", reason = "released", expiresAt = 0, pos = { x = 1, y = 2, z = 3 }, items = { c } } }
		assert(p:save(s, true))
		local loaded = assert(p:load(s.userId))
		assert(loaded.data.cargo[1].uid == a.uid and loaded.data.lockers.Camp1[1].uid == b.uid)
		assert(loaded.data.drops[1].items[1].uid == c.uid and loaded.data.drops[1].expiresAt == 0)
		assert(loaded.data.drops[1].items[1].discovery.id == c.discovery.id)
	end)
	test("hatch is deliberate, keeps identity and never advances another nest", function()
		local _, s = session(991105)
		s.data.heartstones = { { id = "hatch-a", tier = "Common", species = "stub_common_1", mutation = "glow", progress = 4, required = 4, ready = true, discovery = { id = "hatch-a", place = "hollow", method = "heartstone", at = 1 } } }
		s.data.home.nests[1] = "hatch-a"
		assert(#Bank.ripen(s) == 0 and #s.data.heartstones == 1, "automatic hatch remains")
		local r = Bank.hatch(s, 1, "hatch-deliberate")
		assert(r.ok and #s.data.heartstones == 0 and s.data.bank[1].creatureId == "hatch-a")
		assert(s.data.bank[1].mutation == "glow" and s.data.bank[1].discovery.place == "hollow")
		assert(Bank.hatch(s, 1, "hatch-deliberate").dup)
	end)
	test("income settles old choices before reassignment and caps offline time", function()
		local Home = require(F.Home)
		local d = P.default()
		d.bank = { { creatureId = "income-a", species = "stub_common_1", rarity = "Common" }, { creatureId = "income-b", species = "stub_legendary_1", rarity = "Legendary" } }
		d.home.assigned = { "income-a" }
		d.home.settledAt = 100
		Home.settle(d, 100 + 24 * 3600)
		assert(math.abs(d.home.uncollected - 8) < 0.001, "offline cap wrong")
		d.home.assigned = { "income-b" }
		Home.settle(d, 100 + 25 * 3600)
		assert(math.abs(d.home.uncollected - 158) < 0.001, "income used new rate retroactively")
	end)
	test("refresh preserves previously earned finite level and pack upgrades", function()
		local d = P.default()
		d.level, d.slots, d.xp = 5, 9, 100
		require(F.Progression).refresh(d)
		assert(d.level == 5 and d.slots == 9, "refresh revoked earned upgrades")
	end)
	test("fall during uncertain commit survives reconnect and consumes exact identities once", function()
		local p, s, store = session(991108)
		local a, b = item("outcome-original"), item("outcome-other")
		Inv.add(s.userId, a); Inv.add(s.userId, b)
		store.failAfterCommit = 2
		local pending = p:transact(s, "outcome-preceding-save", function(d) d.coins += 1; return {} end)
		assert(pending.pending, "commit response loss not exercised")
		P.queueOutcome(s, { id = "queued-fall", selected = { [a.uid] = true }, pos = { x = 4, y = 5, z = 6 }, reason = "fall", at = Clock.now() })
		s.data.highestCamp = 2
		assert(p:recover(s).ok)
		assert(s.outcomePending and #s.data.expedition.outcomes == 1 and s.data.highestCamp == 2, "confirmation lost deferred physical outcome or camp")
		assert(p:save(s, true))
		local loaded = assert(p:load(s.userId))
		Inv.bind(s.userId, loaded)
		assert(loaded.outcomePending, "reconnect did not block economic actions for queued fall")
		local DropPacks = require(F.DropPacks)
		local r = p:transact(loaded, "outcome:queued-fall", function(d) return DropPacks.applyOutcome(d, "queued-fall", Clock.now(), 180) end)
		assert(r.ok and #loaded.data.cargo == 1 and loaded.data.cargo[1].uid == b.uid)
		assert(not loaded.outcomePending and #loaded.data.drops == 1 and loaded.data.drops[1].items[1].uid == a.uid)
		assert(loaded.data.drops[1].items[1].discovery.id == a.discovery.id and loaded.data.stats.shaken == 1)
		assert(p:transact(loaded, "outcome:queued-fall", function(d) return DropPacks.applyOutcome(d, "queued-fall", Clock.now(), 180) end).dup)
		assert(loaded.data.stats.shaken == 1 and #loaded.data.drops == 1)
	end)
	test("departing uncertain claimant cannot strand or immediately reopen a shared occurrence", function()
		local Claims = require(F.Claims)
		local fakePlayer = {}
		local spawn = { id = "test_departure", perPlayer = false, generation = 7, reservedGeneration = 7, reserved = fakePlayer, available = true, respawn = 1 }
		Claims._spawns[spawn.id] = spawn
		Claims.onLeave(fakePlayer)
		assert(spawn.reserved == nil and spawn.available == false, "uncertain reservation remained locked or reopened immediately")
		Claims.onLeave(fakePlayer)
		assert(spawn.available == false, "repeat departure reopened the occurrence")
		-- Prevent this isolated fixture's delayed respawn from entering the actual world.
		spawn.generation = 8
		Claims._spawns[spawn.id] = nil
	end)
	test("physical practice flags and home departure survive uncertain replay and reconnect", function()
		local p, s, store = session(991109)
		s.data.expedition.homeReturn = { x = 1, y = 2, z = 3 }
		store.failAfterCommit = 2
		assert(p:transact(s, "physical-before-replay", function(d) d.coins += 1; return {} end).pending)
		s.data.flags.parachuteIntroduced, s.data.flags.parachutePractice = true, true
		P.clearHomeReturn(s)
		assert(p:recover(s).ok)
		assert(s.data.flags.parachuteIntroduced and s.data.flags.parachutePractice, "confirmation lost physically earned practice")
		assert(s.data.expedition.homeReturn == nil, "confirmation restored an already departed home")
		assert(p:save(s, true))
		local loaded = assert(p:load(s.userId))
		assert(loaded.data.flags.parachuteIntroduced and loaded.data.flags.parachutePractice, "reconnect stripped practice flags")
		assert(loaded.data.expedition.homeReturn == nil)
	end)
	test("binding a deposit never overwrites restored durable cargo with an empty legacy bag", function()
		local p, s = session(991110)
		s.data.cargo = { item("restored-original") }
		assert(p:save(s, true))
		Inv.clear(s.userId)
		local restored = assert(p:load(s.userId))
		assert(Bank.deposit(restored, s.userId, "restored-bank").ok)
		assert(#restored.data.bank == 1 and restored.data.bank[1].creatureId == "restored-original", "deposit binding discarded restored cargo")
		assert(restored.data.bank[1].discovery.place == "test_nook")
	end)
	test("invalid recovery manifests and duplicate bank stone identities are quarantined", function()
		local d = P.default()
		d.bank = { { creatureId = "same-original", species = "stub_common_1", rarity = "Common" } }
		d.heartstones = { { id = "same-original", tier = "Common", species = "stub_common_1" } }
		local malformed = { items = { item("quarantined-original") } }
		d.drops = { malformed, { id = "missing-expiry", pos = { x = 1, y = 2, z = 3 }, items = {} } }
		local clean = P.sanitize(d)
		assert(#clean.bank == 1 and #clean.heartstones == 0, "one identity occupied both bank and stone storage")
		assert(#clean.drops == 0 and #clean.quarantine == 3, "malformed owned record was discarded or exposed to runtime")
		assert(clean.quarantine[2].value.items[1].uid == "quarantined-original", "quarantine lost original cargo")
	end)
	return table.concat(lines, "\n"), pass, fail
end
return Tests
sources.tools/perf_probe.luau:
-- perf_probe (Studio dev tool, Client): samples frame cost at a spot. Paste into execute_luau on the Client
-- during a playtest, then call _G.CC_PERF.run({ name, pos, secs, orbit }) and poll _G.CC_PERF.out[name].
-- Measures (labels: Studio desktop playtest, NOT a phone): per-frame dt, Stats.RenderCPUFrameTime/GPUFrameTime,
-- draw calls, triangles, streamed World instances, client InstanceCount. orbit = Scriptable camera circling the
-- character at avatar scale (worst case for culling/streaming); otherwise the default follow camera.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Run = game:GetService("RunService")
local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
local P = Players.LocalPlayer

local M = _G.CC_PERF or { out = {} }
_G.CC_PERF = M

local function pct(t, q)
	if #t == 0 then
		return 0
	end
	local s = table.clone(t)
	table.sort(s)
	return s[math.clamp(math.ceil(#s * q), 1, #s)]
end

local function sample(secs)
	local dts, cpu, gpu, dc, tri = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local conn = Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		table.insert(dts, dt * 1000)
		table.insert(cpu, Stats.RenderCPUFrameTime * 1000)
		table.insert(gpu, Stats.RenderGPUFrameTime * 1000)
		table.insert(dc, Stats.SceneDrawcallCount)
		table.insert(tri, Stats.SceneTriangleCount)
	end)
	while os.clock() - t0 < secs do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	conn:Disconnect()
	local n, sum, over33, over50 = #dts, 0, 0, 0
	for _, v in ipairs(dts) do
		sum += v
		if v > 33.4 then
			over33 += 1
		end
		if v > 50 then
			over50 += 1
		end
	end
	return {
		frames = n,
		fps = n / secs,
		avgMs = sum / math.max(1, n),
		p95Ms = pct(dts, 0.95),
		worstMs = pct(dts, 1),
		over33 = over33,
		over50 = over50,
		cpuAvg = pct(cpu, 0.5),
		cpuP95 = pct(cpu, 0.95),
		gpuAvg = pct(gpu, 0.5),
		gpuP95 = pct(gpu, 0.95),
		drawcalls = pct(dc, 0.5),
		drawMax = pct(dc, 1),
		tris = pct(tri, 0.5),
		triMax = pct(tri, 1),
	}
end

M.sample = sample

function M.run(o)
	M.out[o.name] = { status = "running" }
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			local ch = P.Character or P.CharacterAdded:Wait()
			local hrp = ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if o.pos then
				pcall(function()
					P:RequestStreamAroundAsync(o.pos, 10)
				end)
				hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(o.pos + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(o.yaw or 0), 0)
				hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				task.wait(o.settle or 4)
			end
			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local res = { static = sample(o.secs or 10) }
			if o.orbit then
				cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
				local c0 = os.clock()
				local spin = Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
					local a = (os.clock() - c0) / (o.secs or 10) * math.pi * 2
					local p = hrp.Position
					cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(p + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 16, 6, math.sin(a) * 16), p + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
				end)
				res.orbit = sample(o.secs or 10)
				spin:Disconnect()
				cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
			end
			local w = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
			res.worldStreamed = w and #w:GetDescendants() or 0
			res.clientInstances = Stats.InstanceCount
			res.memMb = Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb()
			res.pos = tostring(hrp.Position)
			res.status = "done"
			M.out[o.name] = res
		end)
		if not ok then
			M.out[o.name] = { status = "error", err = tostring(err) }
		end
	end)
	return "started " .. o.name
end

return M
sources.src/world/SplineGen.luau:
--!native
-- SplineGen (v5 P1, 2026-10-21): route splines -> 3D trail samples + terrain cross-sections.
-- Data: RouteSpline.ROUTES (nodes with type / width / pieces per segment). Used by MountainGen.computeField
-- (opts.v5) after the base field and water are built:
--   local R = SG.build(def, Gen, pads)   -- samples every STEP studs: pts {x, z, y}, S, ty, w, pieces, wp, rests
--   SG.stamp(F_, R, Gen)                 -- carves the cross-section of every segment type into the heightfield
--   SG.auditJson(R)                      -- segments / hazards / rests for tools/spline_audit.py
-- Segment types (cross-section about the trail line; d > 0 = outer / downhill side):
--   ledge  wall inside (>= WALL above the tread), drop outside (>= DROP below the edge, falling away)
--   slot   walls both sides (cleft, gully, wet slot)          ridge  drops both sides (knife ridge, spine)
--   open   camp / viewpoint ground, blended to the terrain     gap    bridge span: ground kept >= GAP below
--   log    log over shallow water / a creek: terrain left as it is (water stays), the log is the only tread
--   ladder vertical step (foot -> top) against a built face    stair  boulder stair (blocks, twin ladders)
-- v6 (2026-10-21, beat chains: design/v6-trails-plan.md):
--   vertical pieces (SG.VERT; foot node + synthetic top node `run` ahead, `rise` up or down): ladder, pitch (marked
--   rock face), chimney (marked face between two side walls), steps (rock blocks to jump up / down; the terrain under
--   them is the lower end's height)
--   rim / path  tread only: banks above the tread are trimmed (6-stud blend), drops beside it are never filled (a
--           gorge rim, a falls edge, open ground next to a gorge); rim = the drop side is the exposure
--   jump    ledge whose floor SplineKit removes (a gap to jump; rock lips at both ends)
--   traverse ledge whose floor SplineKit removes (a hand traverse on a marked slab along the inner wall)
--   ford    stepping stones over water: terrain left as it is (like log)
--   node drop = n: the outer drop of ledge / rim / ridge segments is at least n deep (exposure; default SG.DROP)
--   SG.gorge(F_, Gen, spec): deepens a stretch of creek into a gorge with near-vertical walls (an enforced obstacle
--   on open ground: the only way across is the route's crossing)
-- All numbers PROPOSED (v5 plan LOCKED rules: 2-5 stud tight trail ~85 %, open <= 15 %).
local SG = {}
SG.VERT = { ladder = true, pitch = true, chimney = true, steps = true }
SG.STEP_H = 3.6 -- steps: max block-to-block rise (a jump clears ~5)
SG.STEP_RUN = 3.4 -- steps: block depth along the line
SG.STEP = 2
SG.WALL = 10 -- min wall above the tread (higher than a jump: 7.2)
SG.DROP = 7 -- min drop right past a ledge edge
SG.GAP = 14 -- min depth under a bridge / log span
SG.SINK = 0.2 -- the terrain IS the walking surface (user 2026-10-21: no plank / tread layer, natural rock)
-- no marked (catchable) rock under ledge edges: walking off an edge is a real fall to the last checkpoint (user
-- 2026-10-21: falls that cost progress keep the routes tense); climbing slips keep the catch window
SG.MARK_EDGES = false
-- terrain tread core reaches hw + EDGE from the line (4-stud voxels: a 5-wide line renders ~7 studs of flat ground),
-- then a SHOULDER studs lip 1.5 lower before the drop
SG.EDGE = 2
SG.SHOULDER = 2
SG.WALL_GAP = 1.5

local sqrt, floor, ceil, min, max, abs, clamp = math.sqrt, math.floor, math.ceil, math.min, math.max, math.abs, math.clamp
local readf32, writef32, writeu8, readu8 = buffer.readf32, buffer.writef32, buffer.writeu8, buffer.readu8

local function smoothstep(e0, e1, x)
	local t = clamp((x - e0) / (e1 - e0), 0, 1)
	return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
end
local function lerp(a, b, t)
	return a + (b - a) * t
end

SG.WALK = { ledge = true, slot = true, ridge = true, open = true, gap = true, log = true, stair = true, rim = true, path = true, jump = true, traverse = true, ford = true }
SG.TIGHT = { ledge = true, slot = true, ridge = true, gap = true, log = true, stair = true, rim = true, path = true, jump = true, traverse = true, ford = true }

-- default run of a vertical piece (foot -> top landing, horizontal)
function SG.pieceRun(pc, w)
	if pc.run then
		return pc.run
	end
	if pc.kind == "steps" then
		return math.ceil(math.abs(pc.rise) / SG.STEP_H) * SG.STEP_RUN + 2
	end
	return pc.inward and (w + 4) or 5
end

-- effective radius (re) on the ray at theta where the natural ground crosses height y (bands fall outward)
function SG.contourRe(Gen, th, y, rLo, rHi)
	local function g(re)
		local x, z = Gen.toWorld(th, re)
		return Gen.baseHeight(x, z)
	end
	local lo, hi = rLo, rHi
	if g(lo) < y then
		return lo, "top"
	end
	if g(hi) > y then
		return hi, "bottom"
	end
	for _ = 1, 22 do
		local m = (lo + hi) / 2
		if g(m) > y then
			lo = m
		else
			hi = m
		end
	end
	return (lo + hi) / 2
end

-- centripetal Catmull-Rom between p1 and p2 (2D), t in [0, 1]
local function cr(p0, p1, p2, p3, t)
	local function tj(ti, a, b)
		local dx, dz = b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]
		return ti + max(1e-3, (dx * dx + dz * dz) ^ 0.25)
	end
	local t0 = 0
	local t1 = tj(t0, p0, p1)
	local t2 = tj(t1, p1, p2)
	local t3 = tj(t2, p2, p3)
	local tt = lerp(t1, t2, t)
	local function L(a, b, ta, tb)
		local k = (tt - ta) / (tb - ta)
		return { lerp(a[1], b[1], k), lerp(a[2], b[2], k) }
	end
	local A1, A2, A3 = L(p0, p1, t0, t1), L(p1, p2, t1, t2), L(p2, p3, t2, t3)
	local B1, B2 = L(A1, A2, t0, t2), L(A2, A3, t1, t3)
	return L(B1, B2, t1, t2)
end

-- resolve every node to world {x, z, y, nd, yd}. yd = design height (explicit y, pads, ladder tops, auto band
-- nodes) or nil (natural ground + dy). A band node without y is AUTO: its height is spread evenly by distance between
-- the neighbouring known heights (minus ladder rises in between), so a ledge leg has one steady grade. A ladder node
-- (the foot) gets a synthetic top landing node `run` ahead toward the next node and `rise` up.
local function resolveNodes(def, Gen, pads, warn)
	local list = {}
	for k, nd in ipairs(def.nodes) do
		local r = { 0, 0, 0, nd = nd, k = k }
		local pad = nd.name and pads[nd.name]
		if pad and nd.pad ~= false then
			r[1], r[2], r[3], r.yd = pad.x, pad.z, pad.y, pad.y
		elseif nd.x then
			r[1], r[2] = nd.x, nd.z
			r.yd = nd.y
		else
			r.yd = nd.y
			r.auto = nd.band and not nd.y
		end
		list[#list + 1] = r
		local pc = nd.piece
		if pc and SG.VERT[pc.kind] then
			list[#list + 1] = { 0, 0, 0, nd = { t = nd.t, w = nd.w, band = nd.band, cut = nd.cut, drop = nd.drop, synthetic = true }, k = k, top = pc, foot = r }
		end
	end
	local function place(r, y)
		local nd = r.nd
		if r.foot then
			return
		end
		if nd.th then
			local re = nd.re
			if nd.band then
				re = SG.contourRe(Gen, nd.th, y + (nd.cut or 4), nd.band[1], nd.band[2])
			end
			r[1], r[2] = Gen.toWorld(nd.th, re)
		end
	end
	local function natural(r)
		return Gen.baseHeight(r[1], r[2]) + (r.nd.dy or 0)
	end
	-- pass 0: provisional heights (auto nodes: linear in node order between known heights)
	for _, r in ipairs(list) do
		if not r.auto and not r.foot then
			if r.yd then
				place(r, r.yd)
				r[3] = r.yd
			else
				place(r, 0)
				r[3] = natural(r)
			end
		end
	end
	local function topsAndAuto(byDist)
		-- ladder tops follow their foot
		local function tops()
			for i, r in ipairs(list) do
				if r.foot then
					local f = r.foot
					local nx = list[i + 1]
					local dx, dz = 1, 0
					if r.top.dir then
						dx, dz = r.top.dir[1], r.top.dir[2]
					elseif r.top.inward then
						dx, dz = -f[1], -f[2]
					elseif nx then
						dx, dz = nx[1] - f[1], nx[2] - f[2]
					end
					local L = math.max(1e-3, sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz))
					local run = SG.pieceRun(r.top, r.nd.w or def.w or 4)
					-- v6: an inward piece on a band lands on the upper ledge's own contour (a landing run w + 4 inward
					-- sat inside the upper ledge's outer drop and was carved out: a hole at the ladder top), but at least
					-- far enough in for the face behind the ladder / pitch
					local fnd = f.nd
					if r.top.inward and not r.top.run and fnd.band and fnd.th and fnd.cut then
						local th = math.atan2(f[1], f[2])
						local re = SG.contourRe(Gen, th, f[3] + r.top.rise + (fnd.cut or 4), fnd.band[1], fnd.band[2])
						local cx, cz = Gen.toWorld(th, re)
						local ex, ez = cx - f[1], cz - f[2]
						local minRun = (r.nd.w or def.w or 4) / 2 + ((r.top.kind == "ladder") and 4.5 or 3)
						-- (capped: a top-out onto a gentle shelf found its contour 50 studs in)
						run = math.clamp(sqrt(ex * ex + ez * ez), minRun, minRun + 5)
					end
					r[1], r[2] = f[1] + dx / L * run, f[2] + dz / L * run
					r[3] = f[3] + r.top.rise
					r.yd = r[3]
				end
			end
		end
		local i = 1
		while i <= #list do
			if list[i].auto then
				local a = i - 1
				local b = i
				while b <= #list and (list[b].auto or list[b].foot) do
					b += 1
				end
				-- run a+1 .. b-1 is auto / ladder tops; anchors a and b (both known)
				local A, Bn = list[a], list[math.min(b, #list)]
				local rises, dist = 0, {}
				local tot = 0
				for j = a + 1, math.min(b, #list) do
					local p, q = list[j - 1], list[j]
					if q.foot then
						rises += q.top.rise
						dist[j] = tot
					else
						local dx, dz = q[1] - p[1], q[2] - p[2]
						tot += (byDist and sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)) or 1
						dist[j] = tot
					end
				end
				local walk = Bn[3] - A[3] - rises
				local passed = 0
				for j = a + 1, b - 1 do
					local r = list[j]
					if r.foot then
						passed += r.top.rise
					else
						r[3] = A[3] + walk * dist[j] / math.max(1e-3, tot) + passed
						r.yd = r[3]
						place(r, r[3])
					end
				end
				i = b
			else
				i += 1
			end
		end
		tops()
	end
	topsAndAuto(false)
	topsAndAuto(true)
	topsAndAuto(true)
	-- checks: contour clamps, and the grade each design segment needs
	for i, r in ipairs(list) do
		local nd = r.nd
		if nd.band and nd.th and not r.foot then
			local _, cl = SG.contourRe(Gen, nd.th, r[3] + (nd.cut or 4), nd.band[1], nd.band[2])
			if cl then
				warn[#warn + 1] = string.format("node %d th %.2f y %.0f: contour clamped at band %s", r.k, nd.th, r[3], cl)
			end
		end
		local q = list[i + 1]
		if q and r.yd and q.yd and not q.foot then
			local dx, dz = q[1] - r[1], q[2] - r[2]
			local L = sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
			local g = math.abs(q[3] - r[3]) / math.max(0.1, L)
			local lim = ((nd.t == "stair") and 1.0 or (def.maxGrade or 0.6)) + 0.02
			if g > lim and L > 6 then
				warn[#warn + 1] = string.format("node %d th %s -> next: grade %.2f over %.0f studs (dy %.0f)", r.k, tostring(nd.th), g, L, q[3] - r[3])
			end
		end
	end
	return list
end

-- one route: nodes -> samples
function SG.build(def, Gen, pads)
	local STEP = SG.STEP
	local warn = {}
	local nodes = resolveNodes(def, Gen, pads, warn)
	local pts, ty, wd, dp, nodeAt = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
	local pieces = {}
	local curDrop
	local function push(x, z, y, t, w)
		pts[#pts + 1] = { x, z, y }
		ty[#pts] = t
		wd[#pts] = w
		dp[#pts] = curDrop
	end
	local curT = def.t or "ledge"
	for k = 1, #nodes - 1 do
		local a, b = nodes[k], nodes[k + 1]
		local nd = a.nd
		curT = nd.t or curT -- a node without t continues the previous segment type
		local t = curT
		local w = nd.w or def.w or 4
		curDrop = nd.drop
		nodeAt[k] = #pts + 1
		local pc = nd.piece
		if pc and SG.VERT[pc.kind] then
			-- foot at the node, top landing `run` ahead toward the next node and `rise` up (the next node is the top)
			push(a[1], a[2], a[3], pc.kind, w)
			pieces[#pieces + 1] = { kind = pc.kind, i = #pts, rise = pc.rise, run = SG.pieceRun(pc, w), spec = pc }
			continue
		end
		if pc then
			pieces[#pieces + 1] = { kind = pc.kind, i = #pts + 1, spec = pc }
		end
		-- dense spline points between a and b (centripetal Catmull-Rom over the node polyline)
		local p0 = nodes[max(1, k - 1)]
		local p3 = nodes[min(#nodes, k + 2)]
		-- a ladder breaks the curve: the trail runs straight into a ladder foot and straight out of a ladder top (a
		-- curve through the top landing bent the approach into the face)
		local bp = b.nd.piece
		if (bp and SG.VERT[bp.kind]) or (k + 1 == #nodes) then
			p3 = { b[1] + (b[1] - a[1]), b[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) }
		end
		if a.foot or k == 1 then
			p0 = { a[1] - (b[1] - a[1]), a[2] - (b[2] - a[2]) }
		end
		local dx, dz = b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]
		local len = sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
		local n = max(2, ceil(len / 0.5))
		local dense = table.create(n + 1)
		for s = 0, n - 1 do
			dense[#dense + 1] = cr(p0, a, b, p3, s / n)
		end
		-- resample to STEP
		local seg = { dense[1] }
		local need, px, pz = STEP, dense[1][1], dense[1][2]
		for i = 2, #dense do
			local q = dense[i]
			local ex, ez = q[1] - px, q[2] - pz
			local L = sqrt(ex * ex + ez * ez)
			while L >= need do
				local f = need / L
				px, pz = px + ex * f, pz + ez * f
				seg[#seg + 1] = { px, pz }
				ex, ez = q[1] - px, q[2] - pz
				L = sqrt(ex * ex + ez * ez)
				need = STEP
			end
			need -= L
			px, pz = q[1], q[2]
		end
		-- heights: band segments (both ends have a design y + band) follow the contour at a linear grade; others
		-- follow the smoothed natural ground (+ dy) and are grade-clamped later
		-- design heights at both ends: linear grade (stairs, band ledges); band ledges also hug the contour
		local lin = a.yd and b.yd
		local band = lin and nd.band and b.nd.band
		local m = #seg
		-- a ledge leaving a ladder top starts at the top landing (cut deeper into the face than its contour) and
		-- blends onto the contour over 40 studs
		local lo, hi = nd.band and min(nd.band[1], (b.nd.band or nd.band)[1]), nd.band and max(nd.band[2], (b.nd.band or nd.band)[2])
		local delta = 0
		if band and a.foot then
			local r0 = sqrt(a[1] * a[1] + a[2] * a[2])
			local reTop = r0 + Gen.rwarp(a[1], a[2], r0)
			delta = reTop - SG.contourRe(Gen, math.atan2(a[1], a[2]), a[3] + (nd.cut or 4), lo, hi)
		end
		for i = 1, m do
			local f = (i - 1) / m
			local x, z = seg[i][1], seg[i][2]
			local y
			if lin then
				y = lerp(a[3], b[3], f)
			end
			if band and i > 1 then
				local th = math.atan2(x, z)
				local re = SG.contourRe(Gen, th, y + (nd.cut or 4), lo, hi)
				re += delta * max(0, 1 - (i - 1) * STEP / 40)
				x, z = Gen.toWorld(th, re)
			end
			push(x, z, y, t, w)
		end
	end
	nodeAt[#nodes] = #pts + 1
	local last = nodes[#nodes]
	push(last[1], last[2], last[3], "end", def.w or 4)

	-- band samples: smooth the contour-projected xz (bisection jitter, rib noise) without moving node samples
	local isNode = {}
	for _, i in pairs(nodeAt) do
		isNode[i] = true
	end
	for _ = 1, 2 do
		local o = table.create(#pts)
		for i = 1, #pts do
			-- v6: the 3 samples before a vertical piece's foot stay raw too (averaged with samples further back only,
			-- they kinked away from the fixed foot into the wall: buried approaches at inward ladders / pitches)
			if isNode[i] or SG.VERT[ty[i]] or SG.VERT[ty[i - 1]] or SG.VERT[ty[i + 1]] or SG.VERT[ty[i + 2]] or SG.VERT[ty[i + 3]] then
				o[i] = pts[i]
			else
				local sx, sz, c = 0, 0, 0
				for d = -4, 4 do
					local j = clamp(i + d, 1, #pts)
					if not SG.VERT[ty[j]] then
						sx += pts[j][1]
						sz += pts[j][2]
						c += 1
					end
				end
				o[i] = { sx / c, sz / c, pts[i][3] }
			end
		end
		pts = o
	end

	-- natural heights (+ node dy, linearly between the two nodes) where no design y was set
	local nodeIdx = {}
	for k, i in pairs(nodeAt) do
		nodeIdx[#nodeIdx + 1] = { k = k, i = i }
	end
	table.sort(nodeIdx, function(p, q)
		return p.i < q.i
	end)
	local raw = table.create(#pts)
	for i = 1, #pts do
		raw[i] = Gen.baseHeight(pts[i][1], pts[i][2])
	end
	for s = 1, #nodeIdx - 1 do
		local A, Bn = nodeIdx[s], nodeIdx[s + 1]
		local na, nb = nodes[A.k].nd, nodes[math.min(Bn.k, #nodes)].nd
		local dyA, dyB = na.dy or 0, nb.dy or 0
		for i = A.i, Bn.i - 1 do
			if not pts[i][3] then
				local f = (i - A.i) / max(1, Bn.i - A.i)
				-- smoothed ground +-12 studs
				local sum, c = 0, 0
				for d = -6, 6 do
					local j = i + d
					if j >= A.i and j < Bn.i then
						sum += raw[j]
						c += 1
					end
				end
				pts[i][3] = sum / c + lerp(dyA, dyB, f)
			end
		end
	end
	-- node samples carry the node's own y (pads, design heights)
	for k, i in pairs(nodeAt) do
		if pts[i] and nodes[k] then
			pts[i][3] = nodes[k][3]
		end
	end
	-- ladder tops: the sample after a ladder foot is the next node (top); make sure it is rise above the foot
	for _, pc in ipairs(pieces) do
		if SG.VERT[pc.kind] then
			local top = pts[pc.i + 1]
			if top then
				top[3] = pts[pc.i][3] + pc.rise
			end
		end
	end

	-- grade clamp on walking samples (pins: node samples and both ends of every ladder)
	local pin = {}
	for i in pairs(isNode) do
		pin[i] = true
	end
	for _, pc in ipairs(pieces) do
		if SG.VERT[pc.kind] then
			pin[pc.i], pin[pc.i + 1] = true, true
		end
	end
	local G = def.maxGrade or 0.6
	for _ = 1, 4 do
		for i = 2, #pts do
			if not pin[i] and not SG.VERT[ty[i - 1]] then
				local g = ((ty[i - 1] == "stair") and 1.0 or G) * STEP
				pts[i][3] = clamp(pts[i][3], pts[i - 1][3] - g, pts[i - 1][3] + g)
			end
		end
		for i = #pts - 1, 1, -1 do
			if not pin[i] and not SG.VERT[ty[i]] then
				local g = ((ty[i] == "stair") and 1.0 or G) * STEP
				pts[i][3] = clamp(pts[i][3], pts[i + 1][3] - g, pts[i + 1][3] + g)
			end
		end
	end

	-- arc length (horizontal), waypoints, worst grade per walking segment
	local S = table.create(#pts)
	S[1] = 0
	for i = 2, #pts do
		local ex, ez = pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1], pts[i][2] - pts[i - 1][2]
		S[i] = S[i - 1] + sqrt(ex * ex + ez * ez)
	end
	local wp = {}
	for k, nr in ipairs(nodes) do
		if nr.nd.name and nodeAt[k] then
			wp[nr.nd.name] = nodeAt[k]
		end
	end
	local worst, worstI = 0, 1
	for i = 2, #pts do
		local ds = S[i] - S[i - 1]
		if ds > 0.5 and not SG.VERT[ty[i - 1]] then
			local g = abs(pts[i][3] - pts[i - 1][3]) / ds
			if g > worst then
				worst, worstI = g, i
			end
		end
	end
	return {
		name = def.name,
		def = def,
		v5 = true,
		pts = pts,
		S = S,
		ty = ty,
		w = wd,
		dp = dp,
		pieces = pieces,
		wp = wp,
		nodeAt = nodeAt,
		worstGrade = worst,
		warn = warn,
		worstGradeS = S[worstI],
	}
end

-- outward unit normal (x, z) at sample i: perpendicular to the trail, on the side away from the summit axis
function SG.normal(R, i)
	local pts, ty = R.pts, R.ty
	-- v6: never across a vertical piece (the first sample on a top landing took its tangent from the ledge below and
	-- turned its cross-section 90 deg: its wall buried the approach to the piece's foot)
	local a0, b0 = max(1, i - 2), min(#pts, i + 2)
	if ty then
		for j = i - 1, a0, -1 do
			if SG.VERT[ty[j]] then
				a0 = j + 1
				break
			end
		end
		for j = i, b0 - 1 do
			if SG.VERT[ty[j]] then
				b0 = j
				break
			end
		end
		if b0 <= a0 then
			a0, b0 = max(1, i - 2), min(#pts, i + 2)
		end
	end
	local a, b = pts[a0], pts[b0]
	local dx, dz = b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]
	local L = sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
	if L < 1e-3 then
		return 1, 0, 0, 1
	end
	dx, dz = dx / L, dz / L
	local nx, nz = dz, -dx
	local p = pts[i]
	if nx * p[1] + nz * p[2] < 0 then
		nx, nz = -nx, -nz
	end
	return nx, nz, dx, dz
end

local function reachOf(t)
	return (t == "gap") and 10 or 18
end

-- cross-section stamp into the field (call after water / chasm carving). For each cell within reach of the route,
-- the nearest sample (perpendicular distance) defines the trail height, type, width and signed offset.
-- F_.TR (u8): 1 = tread cell (trail material), 2 = tread edge over a drop (marked rock: the descend grab catches a
-- walker who steps off), written for MountainGen's surface pass.
function SG.stamp(F_, R, Gen)
	local H = F_.H
	local N, HALF, CELL = Gen.N, Gen.HALF, Gen.CELL
	local cellC = Gen.cellC
	F_.TR = F_.TR or buffer.create(N * N)
	local TR = F_.TR
	local REACH = 30
	local best = {} -- idx -> { dist, d, y, t, w, i, drop }
	local treadClaim = {}
	local pts, ty, wd, dpa = R.pts, R.ty, R.w, R.dp or {}
	local LEDGEY = { ledge = true, jump = true, traverse = true }
	for i = 1, #pts do
		local t = ty[i]
		if t == "end" then
			t = ty[i - 1] or "open"
		end
		local p = pts[i]
		local y = p[3]
		local nx, nz, tx, tz = SG.normal(R, i)
		local ahead = SG.STEP * 0.75 + 0.01
		-- v6: a sample spaced wider than STEP from the next (a top landing, contour re-projection) claims up to it (a
		-- 5-stud gap after the ladder-1 landing left an unclaimed cell that became a 7-high wall bump)
		local nq = pts[i + 1]
		if nq and not SG.VERT[t] then
			local gx, gz = nq[1] - p[1], nq[2] - p[2]
			ahead = max(ahead, sqrt(gx * gx + gz * gz) - 1)
		end
		local stepsDown = false
		if t == "steps" and pts[i + 1] then
			-- steps: blocks from the foot to the top landing; the floor under them is the lower end's height (the
			-- blocks are the only way up or down), in the foot -> top direction
			local q = pts[i + 1]
			local ex, ez = q[1] - p[1], q[2] - p[2]
			local L = math.max(1e-3, sqrt(ex * ex + ez * ez))
			tx, tz = ex / L, ez / L
			nx, nz = tz, -tx
			if nx * p[1] + nz * p[2] < 0 then
				nx, nz = -nx, -nz
			end
			-- the last 3 studs belong to the top landing (up) / the first stud stays the rim (down)
			ahead = (q[3] > p[3]) and (L - 3) or (L - 1.5)
			y = min(p[3], q[3])
			stepsDown = q[3] < p[3]
		elseif SG.VERT[t] and i > 3 then
			-- ladder / pitch / chimney foot: incoming direction only (the next sample is the top landing, often
			-- inward), and the ledge runs 6 studs past the foot (a walker overshooting the foot stepped off the end)
			local q = pts[i - 3]
			local ex, ez = p[1] - q[1], p[2] - q[2]
			local L = math.max(1e-3, sqrt(ex * ex + ez * ez))
			tx, tz = ex / L, ez / L
			nx, nz = tz, -tx
			if nx * p[1] + nz * p[2] < 0 then
				nx, nz = -nx, -nz
			end
			ahead = 6
			-- inward pieces (the top landing is nearer the axis): the upper ledge runs on right above the ground past
			-- the foot, so the lower ledge stops 3 past it (its 6-stud overshoot won those cells and holed the upper
			-- ledge down to the tier below, the tall ladder, v6)
			local q1 = pts[i + 1]
			if q1 and sqrt(q1[1] * q1[1] + q1[2] * q1[2]) < sqrt(p[1] * p[1] + p[2] * p[2]) - 4 then
				ahead = 3
			end
		end
		local reach = (t == "open") and 26 or REACH
		local i0 = max(0, floor((p[1] - reach + HALF) / CELL))
		local i1 = min(N - 1, floor((p[1] + reach + HALF) / CELL))
		local j0 = max(0, floor((p[2] - reach + HALF) / CELL))
		local j1 = min(N - 1, floor((p[2] + reach + HALF) / CELL))
		for j = j0, j1 do
			local cz = cellC(j) - p[2]
			for ii = i0, i1 do
				local cx = cellC(ii) - p[1]
				local along = cx * tx + cz * tz
				-- a ladder / pitch / chimney top landing also claims back across the whole face width (a climber topping
				-- out off-centre had cliff above the head: no mantle, chimney v6)
				local topBack = i > 1 and SG.VERT[ty[i - 1]] and ty[i - 1] ~= "steps"
				local behind = stepsDown and 1 or (topBack and -((wd[i] or 4) / 2 + 5)) or -(SG.STEP * 0.75 + 0.01)
				if (along >= behind and along <= ahead) or (i == 1 and along < 0) or (i == #pts and along > 0) then
					local d = cx * nx + cz * nz
					local dist = abs(d) + abs(along) * 0.25
					if dist <= reach then
						local idx = j * N + ii
						local b = best[idx]
						local e = { dist, d, y, t, wd[i] or 4, i, dpa[i] }
						if not b or dist < b[1] then
							best[idx] = e
						end
						-- tread claims win over walls / drops of other samples (two arms of a ledge pass close at a
						-- ladder turn: the lower arm's wall must not bury the upper arm's footing)
						local hw_ = (wd[i] or 4) / 2
						if math.abs(d) <= hw_ + SG.EDGE and t ~= "gap" and t ~= "log" and t ~= "ford" and t ~= "open" and t ~= "jump" and t ~= "traverse" then
							local c = treadClaim[idx]
							if not c or math.abs(d) < math.abs(c[2]) then
								treadClaim[idx] = e
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if i % 400 == 0 then
			task.wait()
		end
	end
	local n = 0
	for idx, c in pairs(treadClaim) do
		best[idx] = c
	end
	for idx, b in pairs(best) do
		local d, y, t, w = b[2], b[3], b[4], b[5]
		local DROP = b[7] or SG.DROP
		local hw = w / 2
		local h = readf32(H, idx * 4)
		local ad = abs(d)
		local tread = y - SG.SINK
		local nh = h
		if t == "log" or t == "ford" then
			-- nothing: the creek / pond and its banks stay as written
		elseif SG.VERT[t] then
			-- the foot sample: its own cells are the landing at the foot (steps: the floor under the blocks); the face
			-- comes from the next (top) sample
			if ad <= hw + ((t == "steps") and 2.5 or 1.5) then
				nh = tread
				writeu8(TR, idx, 1)
			end
		elseif t == "open" then
			local k = smoothstep(hw + 1, hw + 18, ad)
			nh = lerp(tread, h, k)
			if ad <= hw + 1 then
				writeu8(TR, idx, 1)
			end
		elseif t == "rim" or t == "path" then
			-- v6: tread only; the banks are trimmed where they stand above the tread (6-stud blend) but never filled, so
			-- a gorge, slot or falls edge beside the line keeps its drop
			if ad <= hw + SG.EDGE then
				nh = tread
				writeu8(TR, idx, 1)
			elseif h > tread then
				nh = lerp(tread, h, smoothstep(0, 6, ad - hw - SG.EDGE))
			end
		elseif ad <= hw + SG.EDGE then
			nh = tread
			if t == "gap" or t == "jump" or t == "traverse" then
				-- (v6: jump gaps and hand traverses are open in the field itself, so the voxel writer keeps the cliff's
				-- columns solid around them; a 40-deep FillBlock carve punched through the terrain shell)
				nh = min(h, y - math.max(SG.GAP, DROP))
			else
				writeu8(TR, idx, 1)
				local outerDrop = (LEDGEY[t] and d > 0) or t == "ridge"
				if SG.MARK_EDGES and outerDrop and ad > hw - 2.5 then
					writeu8(TR, idx, 2)
				end
			end
		else
			local e = ad - hw - SG.EDGE -- distance past the tread edge
			local outer = d > 0
			local wall = (t == "slot") or (LEDGEY[t] and not outer) or (t == "stair")
			local drop = (t == "ridge") or (LEDGEY[t] and outer) or (t == "gap")
			if wall and e < SG.WALL_GAP then
				-- the wall foot stays back WALL_GAP studs: voxel rock bulges ~2 proud and nudged walkers off the edge
				nh = tread
				writeu8(TR, idx, 1)
			elseif wall then
				-- wall: at least WALL above the tread for 5 studs, then back to the terrain (steep, >= 50 deg)
				local top = y + SG.WALL + 2
				local tgt = (e < 5 + SG.WALL_GAP) and top or lerp(top, h, smoothstep(5 + SG.WALL_GAP, 14 + SG.WALL_GAP, e))
				nh = max(h, tgt)
			elseif drop then
				-- drop: DROP below the edge (node drop = exposure), falling away at 1.6:1, back to the terrain only if
				-- that is lower; a short shoulder first: a drop right at a 1-2 voxel ledge renders a rounded, tilted
				-- edge (walkers slid off)
				local cut = (e < SG.SHOULDER and t ~= "gap") and (y - 1.5) or (y - DROP - (e - SG.SHOULDER) * 1.6)
				local rf = reachOf(t) + ((DROP > SG.DROP) and 6 or 0)
				local tgt = lerp(cut, h, smoothstep(rf, rf + 6, e))
				nh = min(h, tgt)
			end
		end
		if nh ~= h then
			writef32(H, idx * 4, nh)
			n += 1
		end
	end
	return n
end

-- v6: creek gorge. spec = { th0, th1, depth, hw, wall, taper = { a, b }, rLo, rHi }: every water cell of the creek
-- between th0 and th1 (and rLo..rHi) is a gorge centre; cells within hw of a centre are lowered to that centre's water
-- level - depth (taper: depth ramps from 0 at theta a to full at theta b), the next `wall` studs blend steeply back
-- (near-vertical walls), and the stream runs 1 deep on the gorge floor over the old water cells. Run after
-- the water pass and before route stamps (the route's crossing pieces stand on the gorge floor).
function SG.gorge(F_, Gen, spec)
	local H, W = F_.H, F_.W
	local N, HALF, CELL = Gen.N, Gen.HALF, Gen.CELL
	local cellC = Gen.cellC
	local centres = {}
	local rLo, rHi = spec.rLo or 0, spec.rHi or 1e9
	-- scan the box of the arc for water cells
	local i0, i1, j0, j1 = N, 0, N, 0
	for _, th in ipairs({ spec.th0, spec.th1, (spec.th0 + spec.th1) / 2 }) do
		for _, r in ipairs({ rLo, rHi }) do
			local x, z = r * math.sin(th), r * math.cos(th)
			i0, i1 = min(i0, floor((x + HALF) / CELL)), max(i1, floor((x + HALF) / CELL))
			j0, j1 = min(j0, floor((z + HALF) / CELL)), max(j1, floor((z + HALF) / CELL))
		end
	end
	local pad = ceil((spec.hw + spec.wall) / CELL) + 1
	i0, i1, j0, j1 = max(0, i0 - pad), min(N - 1, i1 + pad), max(0, j0 - pad), min(N - 1, j1 + pad)
	for j = j0, j1 do
		for i = i0, i1 do
			local idx = j * N + i
			local w = readf32(W, idx * 4)
			local h = readf32(H, idx * 4)
			if w > -1000 and w > h + 0.2 then
				local x, z = cellC(i), cellC(j)
				local th, r = math.atan2(x, z), sqrt(x * x + z * z)
				if th >= spec.th0 and th <= spec.th1 and r >= rLo and r <= rHi then
					local dep = spec.depth
					if spec.taper then
						dep *= smoothstep(spec.taper[1], spec.taper[2], th)
					end
					centres[#centres + 1] = { x, z, w, dep }
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local reach = spec.hw + spec.wall
	local newH, newW = {}, {}
	for _, c in ipairs(centres) do
		local ci0, ci1 = max(0, floor((c[1] - reach + HALF) / CELL)), min(N - 1, floor((c[1] + reach + HALF) / CELL))
		local cj0, cj1 = max(0, floor((c[2] - reach + HALF) / CELL)), min(N - 1, floor((c[2] + reach + HALF) / CELL))
		local floorY = c[3] - 1 - c[4]
		for j = cj0, cj1 do
			local dz = cellC(j) - c[2]
			for i = ci0, ci1 do
				local dx = cellC(i) - c[1]
				local dd = sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
				if dd <= reach then
					local idx = j * N + i
					local h = readf32(H, idx * 4)
					local tgt = (dd <= spec.hw) and floorY or lerp(floorY, h, smoothstep(spec.hw, reach, dd))
					if not newH[idx] or tgt < newH[idx] then
						newH[idx] = tgt
					end
					if dd <= 0.5 and c[4] > 0.5 then
						local wl = floorY + 1
						if not newW[idx] or wl < newW[idx] then
							newW[idx] = wl
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local n = 0
	for idx, v in pairs(newH) do
		if v < readf32(H, idx * 4) then
			writef32(H, idx * 4, v)
			n += 1
		end
		local w = readf32(W, idx * 4)
		if newW[idx] then
			writef32(W, idx * 4, newW[idx])
		elseif w > -1000 and w > v + 0.2 then
			-- old creek water above the new floor and outside the stream: removed
			writef32(W, idx * 4, -10000)
		end
	end
	return { centres = #centres, cells = n }
end

-- audit data for tools/spline_audit.py (segments merged by type / width / heading)
function SG.auditJson(R, hazards, rests)
	local segs = {}
	local pts, ty, wd, S = R.pts, R.ty, R.w, R.S
	local cur
	for i = 1, #pts - 1 do
		local t = ty[i]
		local dx, dz = pts[i + 1][1] - pts[i][1], pts[i + 1][2] - pts[i][2]
		local dir = math.deg(math.atan2(dx, dz)) % 360
		local len = S[i + 1] - S[i]
		local turn = cur and abs((dir - cur.dir0 + 180) % 360 - 180) or 0
		if cur and cur.type == t and cur.width == wd[i] and turn < 25 then
			cur.length += len
			cur.dir = dir
		else
			cur = { type = t, width = SG.VERT[t] and 2 or wd[i], length = len, open = (t == "open"), dir = dir, dir0 = dir }
			segs[#segs + 1] = cur
		end
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(segs) do
		s.dir0 = nil
	end
	return { segments = segs, hazards = hazards or {}, rests = rests or {} }
end

return SG

-- Solo, per-player environmental guardian puzzles. One chime interaction; no combat or countdown.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local HS=game:GetService("HttpService")
local Nests={}
local ctx,Prompts,Visuals,folder
local nests,guards={},{}
local function surface(pos,height)
 local rp=RaycastParams.new() rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include rp.FilterDescendantsInstances={workspace.Terrain}
 local h=workspace:Raycast(pos+Vector3.new(0,35,0),Vector3.new(0,-70,0),rp)
 return h and Vector3.new(pos.X,h.Position.Y+height,pos.Z) or pos
end
local function session(plr) return ctx.sessions[plr] end
local function readyAt(plr,kind,id) local s=session(plr) return s and s.data.timers[kind..":"..id] or 0 end
local function ready(plr,kind,id) return ctx.Clock.now()>=readyAt(plr,kind,id) end
local function puzzled(plr,id) local s=session(plr) return s and s.data.expedition.puzzles and s.data.expedition.puzzles[id]==true end
local function near(plr,pos,range)
 local ch=plr.Character local p=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") local h=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 return p and h and h.Health>0 and (p.Position-pos).Magnitude<=range and (not ch:GetAttribute("CC_TraversalState") or ch:GetAttribute("CC_TraversalState")=="ground")
end
local function updateGuard(plr,n)
 local key=plr.UserId.."|"..n.id local g=guards[key]
 if g then
  local state=puzzled(plr,n.id) and "Distracted" or "Watching"
  g.state=state g.model:SetAttribute("State",state)
  local tell=g.model:FindFirstChild("Tell") if tell then tell.Enabled=false end
  local toward=(state=="Distracted" and n.chime.Position or n.hsPos)-g.pos
  if toward.Magnitude>0.01 then g.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(g.pos,g.pos+toward*Vector3.new(1,0,1))) end
 end
end
local function spawnGuard(plr,n)
 local key=plr.UserId.."|"..n.id
 if guards[key] then return guards[key] end
 local pos=surface(n.center+Vector3.new(8,3,7),3)
 local m=Visuals.guardian(n.guardian,pos,n.scale)
 m.Name="Guardian_"..n.id m:SetAttribute("OwnerId",plr.UserId) m:SetAttribute("NestId",n.id) m.Parent=folder
 local g={key=key,plr=plr,nest=n,model=m,pos=pos,state="Watching"}
 guards[key]=g updateGuard(plr,n) return g
end
function Nests.watch(plr,id) local n=nests[id] return n and spawnGuard(plr,n) end
function Nests.alert(plr,id) local n=nests[id] if n then updateGuard(plr,n) end end
local function distract(plr,n,prompt)
 if not Prompts.validate(prompt,plr) or not session(plr) then return end
 if puzzled(plr,n.id) then ctx.toast(plr,"The guardian is already watching the chimes. Approach the pup or Heartstone.","info") return end
 ctx.transaction(plr,"puzzle:"..HS:GenerateGUID(false),function(d)
  d.expedition.puzzles=d.expedition.puzzles or {} d.expedition.puzzles[n.id]=true return {ok=true}
 end,function()
  updateGuard(plr,n)
  ctx.toast(plr,"The chimes caught its attention. You can safely net the pup and take the Heartstone.","good")
  ctx.fx(plr,{kind="guardian",state="Distracted",nest=n.id}) ctx.push(plr)
 end)
end
local function claim(plr,n,prompt,kind)
 if not Prompts.validate(prompt,plr) or not session(plr) or not ready(plr,kind,n.id) then return end
 if not puzzled(plr,n.id) then ctx.toast(plr,"Ring the nearby wind chimes to distract the guardian.","info") return end
 local stone=kind=="nest"
 local species=stone and ctx.Bank.rollHatch(n.tier,n.region) or n.pup
 local item=ctx.Inv.newItem(stone and "heartstone" or "creature",{species=species,tier=stone and n.tier or nil,rarity=not stone and ctx.Species.rarity(species) or nil,region=n.region,mutation=plr:GetAttribute("CC_Mutation") or "",source=stone and n.id or "pup:"..n.id,acquiredAt=ctx.Clock.now()})
 item.discovery=item.discovery or {id=item.uid,at=item.acquiredAt}
 item.discovery.place=n.label item.discovery.method=stone and "guardian distraction" or "net capture"
 local pos=stone and n.hsPos or n.pupPos
 ctx.Cargo.acquire(plr,item,{
  pos=pos,label=n.label,
  valid=function() return near(plr,pos,stone and 13 or 22) and ready(plr,kind,n.id) and puzzled(plr,n.id) end,
  write=function(d)
   if ctx.Clock.now()<(d.timers[kind..":"..n.id] or 0) or not d.expedition.puzzles or not d.expedition.puzzles[n.id] then return false,"unavailable" end
   d.timers[kind..":"..n.id]=ctx.Clock.now()+(stone and ctx.C.NEST_RESPAWN or ctx.C.PUP_COOLDOWN)
   local other=stone and "pup" or "nest"
   if (d.timers[other..":"..n.id] or 0)>ctx.Clock.now() then d.expedition.puzzles[n.id]=false end
   return true
  end,
  commit=function(saved)
   updateGuard(plr,n)
   ctx.toast(plr,stone and ("Found a "..n.tier.." Heartstone. Bank it, then place it in a home nest.") or ("Netted "..(ctx.Species.get(species).name)..". Safe in your backpack."),"good")
   ctx.fx(plr,{kind=stone and "heartstone" or "net",tier=n.tier,from=pos+Vector3.new(0,1,0),to=pos,pos=pos})
   ctx.emit(stone and "heartstone" or "net",plr,n.id,saved)
  end,
 })
end
function Nests.init(c)
 ctx=c Prompts=require(script.Parent.Prompts) Visuals=require(script.Parent.Visuals)
 local core=workspace.World.Core
 folder=Instance.new("Folder") folder.Name="Guardians" folder.Parent=core
 local live=Instance.new("Folder") live.Name="NestFinds" live.Parent=core
 for _,m in ipairs(core.Nests:GetChildren()) do
  local id=m:GetAttribute("NestId")
  if id then
   local region=m:GetAttribute("Region") or 1 local species=ctx.Species.query({region=region,kind="guardian"})[1]
   local n={id=id,model=m,region=region,center=m:GetAttribute("Center"),hsPos=m:GetAttribute("HeartstonePos"),pupPos=m:GetAttribute("PupPos"),tier=m:GetAttribute("Tier") or "Common",label=m:GetAttribute("Label") or id,guardian=species and species.id or "stub_guardian_1",pup=species and species.pup or "stub_epic_1",scale=m:GetAttribute("GuardianScale") or 1}
   n.pupPos=surface(n.pupPos,1.8) n.hsPos=surface(n.hsPos,1.7)
   nests[id]=n
   local chime=Instance.new("Part") chime.Name="WindChimes_"..id chime.Size=Vector3.new(1,2.5,1) chime.Anchored=true chime.CanCollide=false chime.Material=Enum.Material.Metal chime.Color=Color3.fromRGB(213,177,115)
   local at=n.pupPos+Vector3.new(3,4,0)
   local rp=RaycastParams.new() rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include rp.FilterDescendantsInstances={workspace.Terrain}
   local hit=workspace:Raycast(at,Vector3.new(0,-30,0),rp)
   chime.Position=hit and hit.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.5,0) or n.pupPos+Vector3.new(3,1.5,0)
   chime.Parent=live n.chime=chime
   local cp=Prompts.make(chime,{Name="DistractPrompt",ActionText="Ring wind chimes",ObjectText="Distract guardian",HoldDuration=0.5,MaxActivationDistance=12})
   cp.Triggered:Connect(function(plr) distract(plr,n,cp) end)
   local hs=Visuals.heartstone(n.hsPos,n.tier) hs.Name="Heartstone_"..id hs:SetAttribute("NestId",id) hs.Parent=live
   local hp=Prompts.make(hs.PrimaryPart,{Name="HeartstonePrompt",ActionText="Take Heartstone",ObjectText=n.label,HoldDuration=ctx.C.HEARTSTONE_HOLD[n.tier] or 3,MaxActivationDistance=9})
   hp.Triggered:Connect(function(plr) claim(plr,n,hp,"nest") end)
   local pup=Visuals.creature(n.pup,n.pupPos) pup.Name="Pup_"..id pup:SetAttribute("NestId",id) pup:SetAttribute("Pup",true) pup.Parent=live
   local np=Prompts.make(pup.PrimaryPart,{Name="NetPrompt",ActionText="Throw net",ObjectText=ctx.Species.get(n.pup).name,HoldDuration=ctx.C.NET_TIERS.cloth.hold,MaxActivationDistance=ctx.C.NET_TIERS.cloth.range})
   np.Triggered:Connect(function(plr) claim(plr,n,np,"pup") end)
  end
 end
 task.spawn(function()
  while true do task.wait(0.5)
   for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    local root=plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    for _,n in pairs(nests) do
     local key=plr.UserId.."|"..n.id local g=guards[key]
     if root and (root.Position-n.center).Magnitude<130 then spawnGuard(plr,n)
     elseif g then g.model:Destroy() guards[key]=nil end
    end
   end
  end
 end)
end
function Nests.onLeave(plr)
 for key,g in pairs(guards) do if g.plr==plr then g.model:Destroy() guards[key]=nil end end
end
function Nests.state(plr,st)
 st.nests={} st.guardians={}
 for id in pairs(nests) do st.nests[id]={heartstoneAt=readyAt(plr,"nest",id),pupAt=readyAt(plr,"pup",id),distracted=puzzled(plr,id)} end
 for _,g in pairs(guards) do if g.plr==plr then table.insert(st.guardians,{nest=g.nest.id,state=g.state}) end end
end
function Nests.nestPos(id) return nests[id] and nests[id].center end
function Nests.pupPos(id) return nests[id] and nests[id].pupPos end
function Nests.hsPos(id) return nests[id] and nests[id].hsPos end
function Nests.distractionPos(id) return nests[id] and nests[id].chime.Position end
Nests._guards=guards Nests._nests=nests
return Nests

-- Pure, shared rules; the server owns every transition and never accepts client positions/stamina.
local R = {}
function R.finite(n)
	return type(n) == "number" and n == n and math.abs(n) < 1e12
end
function R.step(s, hand, target, now, cfg, assisted)
	if s.mode ~= "climb" and s.mode ~= "rope" then return false, "state" end
	if hand ~= "L" and hand ~= "R" then return false, "input" end
	if not R.finite(now) or now < (s.nextAt or 0) then return false, "early" end
	if not target then return false, "hold" end
	if hand ~= s.hand and not assisted then return false, "hand" end
	local cost = cfg.stepCost * (s.ice and cfg.iceCost or 1) * (s.mode == "rope" and cfg.ropeCost or 1)
	if s.stamina < cost then return false, "tired" end
	return true, cost
end
function R.canDeploy(s, now, airborne, y, launchY, cfg)
	return (s.mode == "ground" or s.mode == "fall") and airborne and s.jumpAt ~= nil and now - s.jumpAt >= 0.08
		and now - s.jumpAt <= cfg.jumpWindow and y > (s.jumpY or y) + 0.4 and launchY ~= nil
end
function R.canLand(sourceOrder, targetOrder, y, launchY)
	return type(targetOrder) == "number" and targetOrder <= sourceOrder and y <= launchY + 5
end
function R.canRemoveRope(rope, now)
	return (rope.retiring or now >= rope.expires) and (rope.occupants or 0) == 0
end
function R.checkpointAllowed(mode, grounded, route, campIndex, highestCamp)
	if mode ~= nil and mode ~= "ground" and mode ~= "none" then return false end
	if not grounded or route == "Ledge" or route == "Spire" then return false end
	return not campIndex or campIndex <= (highestCamp or 0) + 1
end
function R.movementAllowed(horizontal,upward,elapsed)
	return R.finite(horizontal) and R.finite(upward) and R.finite(elapsed)
		and horizontal<=math.max(18,elapsed*42+8) and upward<=math.max(14,elapsed*20+8)
end
-- Static route segments are binned once; runtime queries only inspect the player's cell.
-- Numeric coordinates keep this geometry testable without a Roblox runtime.
function R.routeIndex(paths, padding)
	local index={bins={},cell=96,segments=0}
	padding=padding or 64
	for _,path in ipairs(paths) do
		for i=2,#path.points do
			local a,b=path.points[i-1],path.points[i]
			local dx,dy,dz=b[1]-a[1],b[2]-a[2],b[3]-a[3]
			local segment={a=a,dx=dx,dy=dy,dz=dz,length2=dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz,route=path.route}
			index.segments+=1
			for x=math.floor((math.min(a[1],b[1])-padding)/index.cell),math.floor((math.max(a[1],b[1])+padding)/index.cell) do
				for z=math.floor((math.min(a[3],b[3])-padding)/index.cell),math.floor((math.max(a[3],b[3])+padding)/index.cell) do
					local key=x..":"..z
					index.bins[key]=index.bins[key] or {}
					table.insert(index.bins[key],segment)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return index
end
local function nearestRoute(index,p,radius)
	local best,route=radius*radius,nil
	local key=math.floor(p[1]/index.cell)..":"..math.floor(p[3]/index.cell)
	for _,s in ipairs(index.bins[key] or {}) do
		local x,y,z=p[1]-s.a[1],p[2]-s.a[2],p[3]-s.a[3]
		local t=s.length2>0 and math.clamp((x*s.dx+y*s.dy+z*s.dz)/s.length2,0,1) or 0
		x,y,z=x-s.dx*t,y-s.dy*t,z-s.dz*t
		local d=x*x+y*y+z*z
		if d<best then best,route=d,s.route end
	end
	return route,math.sqrt(best)
end
function R.closedRouteAt(closed,open,p)
	local route,distance=nearestRoute(closed,p,24)
	if not route then return nil end
	-- Shared crossings and nearby open trails take priority over abandoned path data.
	if nearestRoute(open,p,distance+24) then return nil end
	return route
end
function R.closedGateApproach(x,y,z)
	-- Path endpoint radii include the gate's public approach. Only its front may remain open.
	return math.abs(x)<=24 and y>=-6 and y<=12 and z>=0 and z<=32
end
return R

-- Durable cargo ownership and compare/swap offers. Only server-authored items enter this module.
local HS = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Cargo = {}
local ctx
local offers = {}
-- Copy for transport: a Heartstone's stored hatch species stays server-only until deliberate hatching.
-- Banked stones have no kind field, so their view passes isStone explicitly.
function Cargo.clientItem(item,isStone)
	local view=table.clone(item)
	if isStone or item.kind=="heartstone" then view.species=nil end
	return view
end
local function used(items)
	local n=0 for _,it in ipairs(items) do n+=it.slots or 1 end return n
end
local function locate(items,uid)
	for i,it in ipairs(items) do if it.uid==uid then return i,it end end
end
local function result(plr,r)
	if not r.ok then ctx.toast(plr,r.pending and "Saving this find. Please wait while we reconnect." or "Couldn't save the change. Your items remain safe; try again.","warn") end
	ctx.invChanged(plr)
end

function Cargo.acquire(plr,item,opts,replaceUid)
	local s=ctx.sessions[plr]
	if not s or ctx.Inv.locked(plr.UserId) then return {ok=false,reason="busy"} end
	if opts.valid and not opts.valid() then return {ok=false,reason="unavailable"} end
	if not replaceUid and ctx.Inv.free(plr.UserId)<(item.slots or 1) then
		local token=HS:GenerateGUID(false)
		offers[plr]={token=token,item=item,opts=opts,expiresAt=ctx.Clock.now()+90}
		ctx.toast(plr,"Backpack full. Compare this find, swap one, or leave it here.","info")
		ctx.push(plr)
		return {ok=false,reason="full",offered=true}
	end
	if opts.reserve and not opts.reserve() then return {ok=false,reason="claimed"} end
	local tx="acquire:"..item.uid
	local r=ctx.transaction(plr,tx,function(d)
		if locate(d.cargo,item.uid) then return {ok=false,reason="already_owned"} end
		local idx,old
		if replaceUid then idx,old=locate(d.cargo,replaceUid) if not old then return {ok=false,reason="missing"} end end
		if used(d.cargo)-(old and old.slots or 0)+(item.slots or 1)>d.slots then return {ok=false,reason="full"} end
		if opts.write then local ok,why=opts.write(d) if ok==false then return {ok=false,reason=why or "unavailable"} end end
		if old then
			table.remove(d.cargo,idx)
			local at=opts.pos or Vector3.zero
			table.insert(d.drops,{id="released:"..old.uid,items={old},pos={x=at.X,y=at.Y,z=at.Z},expiresAt=0,reason="released"})
		end
		table.insert(d.cargo,item)
		return {ok=true,itemUid=item.uid,replaced=old and old.uid or nil}
	end,function(committed)
		offers[plr]=nil
		if committed.dup then
			if opts.unreserve then opts.unreserve() end
		elseif opts.commit then opts.commit(item) end
		if ctx.DropPacks then ctx.DropPacks.refresh(plr) end
		ctx.invChanged(plr)
		if committed.replaced and not committed.dup then ctx.toast(plr,"Swapped. Your previous find is safely waiting here in the world.","good") end
	end)
	if not r.ok and not r.pending and opts.unreserve then opts.unreserve() end
	result(plr,r)
	return r
end

function Cargo.init(c)
	ctx=c
	ctx.handlers.swapConfirm=function(plr,p)
		local o=offers[plr]
		if not o or p.token~=o.token or type(p.uid)~="string" or #p.uid>128 then return end
		if ctx.Clock.now()>o.expiresAt or (o.opts.valid and not o.opts.valid()) then offers[plr]=nil ctx.toast(plr,"That find is no longer within reach.","info") ctx.push(plr) return end
		Cargo.acquire(plr,o.item,o.opts,p.uid)
	end
	ctx.handlers.swapLeave=function(plr,p)
		local o=offers[plr]
		if o and (p.token==nil or p.token==o.token) then offers[plr]=nil ctx.push(plr) end
	end
end
function Cargo.state(plr,st)
	local o=offers[plr]
	if o and ctx.Clock.now()<=o.expiresAt then st.swapOffer={token=o.token,item=Cargo.clientItem(o.item),sourceName=o.opts.label or "New find",expiresAt=o.expiresAt} end
end
function Cargo.onLeave(plr) offers[plr]=nil end
Cargo.used=used
Cargo.locate=locate
return Cargo

-- Metadata is advisory; only the server may initiate Roblox checkout.
local P={}
function P.new(catalogue,fetch,clock)
 local self={entries={}};clock=clock or os.clock
 function self:get(id)
  local e=self.entries[id]
  return e and e.value and clock()<e.expires and e.value or nil
 end
 function self:refresh(id)
  local o=catalogue.offers[id];if not o or o.platformId<=0 then return nil end
  local e=self.entries[id]
  if e and (e.busy or clock()<e.retry) then return self:get(id) end
  e=e or {};self.entries[id]=e;e.busy=true
  local ok,value=pcall(fetch,o)
  e.busy=false;e.value=ok and type(value)=="number" and value>=0 and value or nil
  e.expires=clock()+60;e.retry=clock()+(e.value and 60 or 5)
  return self:get(id)
 end

end
return P

-- Journal stamps are proximity-validated observations, never an income/adventure reward loop.
local Discovery={}
local ctx
local routes={
	{id="Shepherd",name="Shepherd's Road",status="Open",difficulty="Gentle",pips=1,description="Natural trails, short gaps and protected practice climbs."},
	{id="Waterfall",name="Waterfall Stair",status="Open",difficulty="Moderate",pips=2,description="Falls-side pitches and visible rock holds."},
	{id="Ledge",name="Cliff Ledge Line",status="Coming Soon",difficulty="Hard",pips=3,description="This route is closed."},
	{id="Spire",name="Spire Ridge",status="Coming Soon",difficulty="Expert",pips=4,description="This route is closed."},
}
function Discovery.init(c)
	ctx=c
	local Prompts=require(script.Parent.Prompts)
	local points={}
	for _,t in ipairs(workspace.World.Checkpoints:GetChildren()) do
		local name=t:GetAttribute("Checkpoint")
		if name and (string.match(name,"^Camp%d$") or name=="Summit") then points[name]=t end
	end
	local foothold=workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpawnLocation")
	if foothold then points.Foothold=foothold end
	for id,part in pairs(points) do
		local name=id=="Foothold" and "The mountain from home" or (part:GetAttribute("Label") or id)
		local p=Prompts.make(part,{Name="ViewpointPrompt",ActionText="Stamp viewpoint",ObjectText=name,HoldDuration=0.4,MaxActivationDistance=12})
		p.Triggered:Connect(function(plr)
			local s=ctx.sessions[plr]
			if not s or not Prompts.validate(p,plr) then return end
			if s.data.journal[id] then ctx.toast(plr,"This view is already in your journal.","info") return end
			ctx.transaction(plr,"viewpoint:"..id,function(d)
				d.journal[id]={label=name,at=ctx.Clock.now(),method="viewpoint",region=id}
				return {ok=true}
			end,function() ctx.toast(plr,"Journal stamp: "..name,"good") ctx.push(plr) end)
		end)
	end
end
function Discovery.state(_,st) st.routes=routes st.regions={"Green Valley","Whispering Forest","Broken Cliffs","Storm Ridge","Frozen Summit"} end
return Discovery

			leg3a = { rise = 14, minDeg = 40, foot = "trail", top = "trail", windowLen = 90, label = "Shepherd scramble rest", features = { rest = { 2 }, traverse = { 1 } } },
			leg3b = { rise = 14, minDeg = 40, foot = "trail", top = "trail", windowLen = 90, label = "Shepherd scramble rest", features = { rest = { 2 } } },
			leg4 = { rise = 14, minDeg = 40, foot = "trail", top = "trail", windowLen = 90, label = "Shepherd scramble rest", features = { rest = { 2 } } },
		},
	},
	Waterfall = {
		ledgeMat = Enum.Material.Slate,
		ledgeW = 10,
		faceStyle = "ladder",
		stacks = {
			lip = { rise = 36, label = "Falls ledge rest", features = { rest = { 3 }, traverse = { 4 } } }, -- the one rope-slope crossing
			forest = { rise = 36, label = "Waterfall forest rest", features = { rest = { 3 } } },
			cliffs = { rise = 38, label = "Waterfall cliffs rest", features = { rest = { 3 }, chute = { 5 } } },
			storm = { rise = 38, minDeg = 48, ta = -2.48, tb = -2.30, label = "Waterfall storm rest", features = { rest = { 3 } } },
		},
	},
}

-- opts.rewrite = false: the boxes were already rewritten (BuildAll.allLines)
function RL.build(Kit, routeName, only, opts)
	local R = _G.CC_PATHS and _G.CC_PATHS.routes[routeName]
	assert(R and R.ctrlS, "RouteLines needs _G.CC_PATHS from Gen.computeField (v4 P3 MountainGen)")
	local style = RL.STYLE[routeName]
	assert(style, "no style for " .. tostring(routeName))
	local ck = CK.new(Kit, routeName)
	local out = {}
	for i, ln in ipairs(R.def.lines or {}) do
		local st = style.stacks[ln.band]
		if ln.kind == "stack" and st and (not only or only == ln.band) then
			local rep = ck:stack({
				name = ln.band,
				R = R,
				s0 = R.ctrlS[ln.c0] + (ln.pad0 or 0),
				s1 = R.ctrlS[ln.c1] - (ln.pad1 or 0),
				rise = st.rise,
				minDeg = st.minDeg,
				foot = st.foot,
				top = st.top,
				windowLen = st.windowLen,
				ta = st.ta,
				tb = st.tb,
				features = st.features,
				label = st.label,
				ledgeMat = style.ledgeMat,
				ledgeW = style.ledgeW,
				faceStyle = style.faceStyle,
				guideBase = 100 * i,
				order0 = 10 * i,
				rewrite = not (opts and opts.rewrite == false),
			})
			out[#out + 1] = rep
			task.wait()
		elseif ln.kind == "hang" and (not only or only == ln.band) then
			out[#out + 1] = ck:hang({
				name = ln.band,
				R = R,
				s0 = ln.s0,
				s1 = ln.s1,
				drop = ln.drop,
				outward = ln.outward,
				notch = ln.notch,
				features = ln.features or { traverse = { 0.3 }, chute = { 0.62 }, rest = { 0.47 } },
				label = ln.label or ((R.def.name or "") .. " hang-line rest"),
				ledgeMat = style.ledgeMat,
				guideBase = 100 * i,
				order0 = 10 * i,
				rewrite = not (opts and opts.rewrite == false),
			})
			task.wait()
		end
	end
	if not only then
		local keep = {}
		for _, ln in ipairs(R.def.lines or {}) do
			keep[ln.band] = true
		end
		for _, f in ipairs(ck.lines:GetChildren()) do
			if not keep[f.Name] then
				ck:clearLine(f.Name)
			end
		end
	end
	local segs = ck:export(not only)
	local lines = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(out) do
		local t = {}
		for k, v in pairs(r) do
			t[#t + 1] = k .. "=" .. tostring(v)
		end
		table.sort(t)
		lines[#lines + 1] = table.concat(t, " ")
	end
	lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("parts %d, track segments %d", ck.n, segs)
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

return RL
sources.src/core/shared/Species.luau:
-- Species (ReplicatedStorage.CC_Core): the ONE species table (Codex contract, design/autonomous-build-brief.md §0).
-- Every system refers to species only by snake_case id through this module: id -> name, region, rarity, ecology,
-- kind, stub. Until creatures/roster.json exists, placeholder stubs stand in (stub_common_1, ...). Spawn code
-- asks by query (region + rarity + ecology), never by a hard-coded id, so the roster can replace the stubs
-- without touching gameplay code. To wire the roster: generate a child ModuleScript "Roster" (returns an array
-- of entries in the same shape, optional `replaces = "stub_..."`) with tools/roster_to_luau.py.
-- Kinds: "creature" (collectible), "guardian" (nest guardian, not collectible). The server owns rarity.
local Species = {}

local REGION_COUNT = 5
local ECO_COMMON = { "ground", "hopping", "perched" }
local ECO_UNCOMMON = { "floating", "hiding" }
-- Readable names for the existing fallback artwork; stable stub ids still support roster replacement.
local REGION_NAMES = { "Foothill", "Forest", "Cliffside", "Stormridge", "Frostpeak" }
local COMMON_NAMES = { "Forager", "Hopper", "Lookout" }
local UNCOMMON_NAMES = { "Drifter", "Peeker" }
local WEATHER_NAMES = { "Storm Glider", "Aurora Drifter", "Snowfield Wanderer" }

local list = {}
local function add(e)
	e.stub = e.stub ~= false
	list[#list + 1] = e
end

-- 40 regional stubs (3 Common, 2 Uncommon, 1 Rare, 1 Epic = the guardian's pup, 1 Legendary per region) +
-- 3 weather-linked Legendaries + 1 guardian per region. Split PROPOSED (brief §1, confirmed "as written").
for r = 1, REGION_COUNT do
	for k = 1, 3 do
		local n = (r - 1) * 3 + k
		add({ id = "stub_common_" .. n, name = REGION_NAMES[r] .. " " .. COMMON_NAMES[k], region = r, rarity = "Common", ecology = ECO_COMMON[k], kind = "creature" })
	end
	for k = 1, 2 do
		local n = (r - 1) * 2 + k
		add({ id = "stub_uncommon_" .. n, name = REGION_NAMES[r] .. " " .. UNCOMMON_NAMES[k], region = r, rarity = "Uncommon", ecology = ECO_UNCOMMON[k], kind = "creature" })
	end
	add({ id = "stub_rare_" .. r, name = REGION_NAMES[r] .. " Nookling", region = r, rarity = "Rare", ecology = "hiding", kind = "creature" })
	add({ id = "stub_epic_" .. r, name = REGION_NAMES[r] .. " Pup", region = r, rarity = "Epic", ecology = "pup", kind = "creature", guardian = "stub_guardian_" .. r })
	add({ id = "stub_legendary_" .. r, name = REGION_NAMES[r] .. " Wayfarer", region = r, rarity = "Legendary", ecology = "floating", kind = "creature" })
	add({ id = "stub_guardian_" .. r, name = REGION_NAMES[r] .. " Guardian", region = r, ecology = "guardian", kind = "guardian", pup = "stub_epic_" .. r })
end
for k, w in ipairs({ "Storm", "AuroraNight", "SnowWhiteout" }) do
	local n = REGION_COUNT + k
	add({ id = "stub_legendary_" .. n, name = WEATHER_NAMES[k], region = 0, rarity = "Legendary", ecology = "floating", kind = "creature", weather = w })
end

-- roster merge (by id; `replaces` retires a stub so queries return the real species)
local rosterMod = script:FindFirstChild("Roster")
if rosterMod then
	local ok, roster = pcall(require, rosterMod)
	if ok and type(roster) == "table" then
		local retired = {}
		for _, e in ipairs(roster) do
			if type(e.id) == "string" and e.id:match("^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$") then
				if e.replaces then
					retired[e.replaces] = e.id
				end
				e.stub = false
				list[#list + 1] = e
			end
		end
		local keep = {}
		for _, e in ipairs(list) do
			if not retired[e.id] then
				keep[#keep + 1] = e
			end
		end
		list = keep
		Species.retired = retired
	else
		warn("[CC] Species roster failed to load; using stubs: " .. tostring(roster))
	end
end

local byId = {}
for _, e in ipairs(list) do
	byId[e.id] = e
end

Species.list = list
function Species.get(id)
	return byId[id] or (Species.retired and Species.retired[id] and byId[Species.retired[id]]) or nil
end
function Species.isValid(id)
	return Species.get(id) ~= nil
end
function Species.rarity(id)
	local e = Species.get(id)
	return e and e.rarity or nil
end

-- query { region = n, rarity = "Common", kind = "creature", ecology = "ground" } -> array
function Species.query(q)
	local out = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(list) do
		if (q.region == nil or e.region == q.region) and (q.rarity == nil or e.rarity == q.rarity) and (q.kind == nil or e.kind == q.kind) and (q.ecology == nil or e.ecology == q.ecology) then
			out[#out + 1] = e
		end
	end
	return out
end

return Species
