-- Expedition UI: server snapshots own every inventory, bank, home and travel outcome.
-- Landscape phones use full-size targets and scrolling sheets, never a shrunken desktop canvas.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Run = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local CAS = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local PPS = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local CoreRS = RS:WaitForChild("CC_Core")
local C = require(CoreRS:WaitForChild("CoreConfig"))
local CommerceUI = require(CoreRS:WaitForChild("Client"):WaitForChild("CommerceUI"))
local Species = require(CoreRS:WaitForChild("Species"))
local Net = require(CoreRS:WaitForChild("Net"))
local stateEv, toastEv, fxEv, reqEv = Net.get("CoreState"), Net.get("CoreToast"), Net.get("CoreFx"), Net.get("CoreRequest")
local T = {
	slate = Color3.fromRGB(62, 66, 76), deep = Color3.fromRGB(31, 33, 38),
	golden = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 150), moon = Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 255),
	lantern = Color3.fromRGB(255, 178, 72), meadow = Color3.fromRGB(84, 176, 82),
	aurora = Color3.fromRGB(156, 92, 246), sandstone = Color3.fromRGB(214, 150, 82),
}
local state = { saveState = "loading" }
local preferences = { textScale = 1, reducedMotion = false, timingAssist = true, headlampMode = "auto" }
local clockSkew = 0
local ui = { tab = "Backpack", page = 1, mode = "expedition", device = "keyboard", notices = {}, holding = {}, deferred = {}, renderAt = 0 }
local render, openPanel, closePanel, refreshHud
local function request(action, payload) reqEv:FireServer(action, payload or {}) end
local function now() return os.time() + clockSkew end
local function fmtTime(sec)
	sec = math.max(0, math.floor(sec or 0))
	return sec >= 3600 and string.format("%dh %02dm", sec // 3600, (sec % 3600) // 60) or string.format("%d:%02d", sec // 60, sec % 60)
end
local function safeGround()
	local ch = plr.Character
	local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local traversal = ch and ch:GetAttribute("CC_TraversalState")
	return hum and hum.Health > 0 and hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air and (not traversal or traversal == "ground")
end
local function cancelHolds()
	for prompt in pairs(ui.holding) do pcall(prompt.InputHoldEnd, prompt) end
	table.clear(ui.holding)
end
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.IgnoreGuiInset = "CC_CoreUI", false, false
gui.ScreenInsets, gui.ZIndexBehavior, gui.DisplayOrder = Enum.ScreenInsets.CoreUISafeInsets, Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, 20
gui.Parent = plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local function corner(object)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius, c.Parent = UDim.new(0, 8), object
end
local function stroke(object, color, width)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Color, s.Thickness, s.ApplyStrokeMode, s.Parent = color or T.sandstone, width or 1, Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, object
	return s
end
local function frame(parent, props)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame"); f.BackgroundColor3, f.BorderSizePixel = T.slate, 0
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do f[k] = v end
	corner(f); f.Parent = parent; return f
end
local function label(parent, props)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.BackgroundTransparency, l.Font, l.TextColor3 = 1, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, T.moon
	l.TextSize, l.TextWrapped, l.TextXAlignment, l.TextYAlignment = 16, true, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do l[k] = v end
	l:SetAttribute("BaseTextSize", (props and props.TextSize) or 16)
	l.TextSize = math.floor(l:GetAttribute("BaseTextSize") * preferences.textScale)
	l.Parent = parent; return l
end
local function button(parent, text, props, callback)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Name, b.Text, b.Font = text, text, Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.TextColor3, b.BackgroundColor3, b.BorderSizePixel = T.golden, T.deep, 0
	b.Size, b.TextSize, b.TextWrapped = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 50), 16, true
	b.AutoButtonColor, b.Selectable = true, true
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do b[k] = v end
	b:SetAttribute("BaseTextSize", (props and props.TextSize) or 16)
	b.TextSize = math.floor(b:GetAttribute("BaseTextSize") * preferences.textScale)
	corner(b); local border = stroke(b)
	b.SelectionGained:Connect(function() border.Color, border.Thickness = T.golden, 3 end)
	b.SelectionLost:Connect(function() border.Color, border.Thickness = T.sandstone, 1 end)
	if callback then b.Activated:Connect(callback) end
	b.Parent = parent; return b
end
local function pad(parent, n)
	local p = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	p.PaddingLeft, p.PaddingRight, p.PaddingTop, p.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, n), UDim.new(0, n), UDim.new(0, n), UDim.new(0, n)
	p.Parent = parent
end
local function stack(parent, gap)
	local l = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); l.Padding, l.SortOrder, l.Parent = UDim.new(0, gap or 8), Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, parent
end
local function itemName(it)
	if it.kind == "heartstone" or (it.tier and not it.rarity) then return (it.tier or "") .. " Heartstone" end
	local e = Species.get(it.species); return e and e.name or tostring(it.species or "Expedition find")
end
local function rarity(it)
	local r = it.rarity or it.tier or "Heartstone"
	return string.rep("◆", math.clamp(C.RANK[r] or 1, 1, 6)) .. " " .. r
end
local function discoveryPlace(value)
	if type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" then return nil end
	local id = value:gsub("^spawn:", ""):gsub("^pup:", "")
	local known = { tut_common = "The Foothold", nook_rare_r1 = "Shepherd's hidden nook", nest_r1_hollow = "Hollow nest", nest_r1_lip = "Lip nest" }
	if known[id] then return known[id] end
	if id:match("^shep_%d+$") then return "Shepherd's Road" end
	if id:match("^out_%d+$") then return "Foothold outskirts" end
	return value
end
local function discovery(it)
	local d = it.discovery or {}
	local place = discoveryPlace(d.place or it.place) or (it.region and ({ "Green Valley", "Whispering Forest", "Broken Cliffs", "Storm Ridge", "Frozen Summit" })[it.region]) or discoveryPlace(it.source)
	local method = d.method
	if method then method = ({ encounter = "Encounter", heartstone = "Heartstone", ["net capture"] = "Net capture", ["guardian distraction"] = "Wind chime puzzle" })[method] or method end
	if not method or method == "" then method = (it.kind == "heartstone" or (it.tier and not it.rarity)) and "Heartstone" or (type(it.source) == "string" and it.source:match("^pup:")) and "Net capture" or "Encounter" end
	return (place or "Original discovery preserved") .. " · " .. tostring(method)
end
local function notify(text, kind, seconds, priority)
	if type(text) ~= "string" or text == "" then return end
	for _, n in ipairs(ui.notices) do if n.text == text then return end end
	if ui.currentNotice and ui.currentNotice.text == text then return end
	ui.notices[#ui.notices + 1] = { text = text, kind = kind or "info", duration = seconds or 4.5, priority = priority or (kind == "bad" and 3 or kind == "warn" and 2 or 1) }
	table.sort(ui.notices, function(a, b) return a.priority > b.priority end)
	while #ui.notices > 12 do table.remove(ui.notices) end
end

-- Compact instrument strip. Secondary currencies are in the Backpack tab.
ui.hud = frame(gui, { Name = "ExpeditionHUD", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 8), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(270, 105), BackgroundTransparency = 0.08 })
stroke(ui.hud)
ui.zone = label(ui.hud, { Text = "THE FOOTHOLD", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 5), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 21), TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = T.golden })
ui.staminaText = label(ui.hud, { Text = "Stamina", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 28), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 21), TextSize = 15 })
local staminaRail = frame(ui.hud, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 53), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 7), BackgroundColor3 = T.deep })
ui.staminaFill = frame(staminaRail, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = T.golden })
ui.pack = label(ui.hud, { Text = "Pack — / —", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 64), Size = UDim2.new(0.59, -12, 0, 25), TextSize = 15 })
ui.level = label(ui.hud, { Text = "Level —", Position = UDim2.new(0.59, 0, 0, 64), Size = UDim2.new(0.41, -12, 0, 25), TextSize = 15, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right })
local xpRail = frame(ui.hud, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 94), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 3), BackgroundColor3 = T.deep })
ui.xp = frame(xpRail, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = T.lantern })
ui.menuButton = button(gui, "Expedition [M]", { Name = "OpenExpedition", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 8), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(178, 50) }, function()
	if ui.panel.Visible then closePanel() else openPanel("expedition") end
end)
ui.altitude = frame(gui, { Name = "AltitudeTrack", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 66), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(116, 50), BackgroundTransparency = 0.12 })
ui.altitudeText = label(ui.altitude, { Text = "0 m", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 3), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 25), TextColor3 = T.golden, TextSize = 17 })
local altitudeRail = frame(ui.altitude, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 36), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 4), BackgroundColor3 = T.deep })
ui.altitudeFill = frame(altitudeRail, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = T.sandstone })
for i = 0, 4 do frame(altitudeRail, { Position = UDim2.new(i / 4, -2, 0.5, -3), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 6), BackgroundColor3 = T.golden }) end
ui.save = frame(gui, { Name = "SaveStatus", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 120), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(500, 58), BackgroundColor3 = T.deep })
stroke(ui.save, T.lantern)
ui.saveText = label(ui.save, { Text = "Loading your expedition…", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 4), Size = UDim2.new(1, -115, 1, -8), TextSize = 15 })
ui.retry = button(ui.save, "Retry", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(88, 48), TextSize = 15 }, function()
	if state.bank and state.bank.retryable then request("bankRetry") else request("state") end
	notify("Checking your expedition status…", "info")
end)
ui.notice = frame(gui, { Name = "PriorityMessage", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 120), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(540, 72), BackgroundColor3 = T.deep, Visible = false })
ui.noticeBorder = stroke(ui.notice)
ui.noticeText = label(ui.notice, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -12), TextSize = 16 })

-- One sheet for menus and physical stations. Pinned header / footer, scrolling body.
ui.shadow = frame(gui, { Name = "SheetShadow", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 4, 0.5, 6), BackgroundColor3 = T.deep, BackgroundTransparency = 0.25, ZIndex = 40, Visible = false })
ui.panel = frame(gui, { Name = "ExpeditionPanel", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -16), BackgroundColor3 = T.slate, ZIndex = 41, Visible = false })
stroke(ui.panel, T.golden, 2)
ui.heading = label(ui.panel, { Text = "EXPEDITION", Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne, TextSize = 24, TextColor3 = T.golden, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 5), Size = UDim2.new(1, -86, 0, 45) })
ui.close = button(ui.panel, "×", { Name = "CloseSheet", TextSize = 26, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 4), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 48) }, function() closePanel() end)
ui.tabs = Instance.new("Frame")
ui.tabs.BackgroundTransparency, ui.tabs.Position, ui.tabs.Size, ui.tabs.Parent = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(12, 56), UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 48), ui.panel
ui.tabButtons = {}
for i, name in ipairs({ "Backpack", "Collection", "Routes", "Settings" }) do
	ui.tabButtons[name] = button(ui.tabs, name, { Name = "Tab" .. name, Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) / 4, 3, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.25, -6, 1, 0), TextSize = 16 }, function()
		ui.tab, ui.page, ui.choose = name, 1, nil; render(true)
	end)
end
ui.body = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
ui.body.Name, ui.body.BackgroundTransparency, ui.body.BorderSizePixel = "Content", 1, 0
ui.body.Position, ui.body.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 115), UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, -177)
ui.body.AutomaticCanvasSize, ui.body.CanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, UDim2.new()
ui.body.ScrollBarThickness, ui.body.ScrollBarImageColor3 = 6, T.golden
ui.body.ScrollingDirection, ui.body.ElasticBehavior = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, Enum.ElasticBehavior.WhenScrollable
ui.body.Parent = ui.panel; stack(ui.body, 9)
ui.footer = label(ui.panel, { Name = "LiveWorldNote", Text = "The world keeps moving. Find safe ground to browse.", Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -53), Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 44), TextSize = 13 })
ui.done = button(ui.panel, "Continue", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1), Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -7), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(142, 48) }, function() closePanel() end)
local function fit()
	local sz = gui.AbsoluteSize
	if sz.X <= 0 or sz.Y <= 0 then sz = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize end
	local w, h = math.min(920, sz.X - 24), math.min(650, sz.Y - 16)
	ui.panel.Size, ui.shadow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
	ui.hud.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz.X < 700 and 236 or 270, 105)
	ui.menuButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz.X < 700 and 150 or 178, 50)
	ui.save.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(500, sz.X - 28), 72)

local function action(text, name, payload, enabled) return { label = text, action = name, payload = payload, enabled = enabled } end
local function localAction(text, fn) return { label = text, run = fn } end
local function pageRows(items, fn)
	local size, count = 12, math.max(1, math.ceil(#items / 12))
	ui.page = math.clamp(ui.page, 1, count)
	for i = (ui.page - 1) * size + 1, math.min(#items, ui.page * size) do fn(items[i], i) end
	if count > 1 then row(string.format("Page %d of %d", ui.page, count), "", {
		{ label = "Previous", enabled = ui.page > 1, run = function() ui.page -= 1; render(true) end },
		{ label = "Next", enabled = ui.page < count, run = function() ui.page += 1; render(true) end },
	}) end
end

-- Inventory (ServerScriptService.CC_CoreServer): durable unbanked backpack, bound to profile.cargo.
-- Cargo retains expedition risk until banked; ownership changes use Profile transactions. Item:
--   { uid, kind = "creature" | "heartstone", species, rarity, tier?, mutation, region, slots, acquiredAt, source }
-- Capacity = Progression.slots(profile); a Heartstone takes 2 slots (LOCKED). The client never adds items.
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local C = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("CC_Core"):WaitForChild("CoreConfig"))
local Cargo = require(script.Parent.Cargo)

local Inv = {}
local bags = {} -- [userId] = { items = {}, capacity = n }
local sessions = {}
Inv._bags = bags

function Inv.bag(userId)
	local b = bags[userId]
	if not b then
		b = { items = {}, capacity = C.SLOTS_BASE }
		bags[userId] = b
	end
	local s = sessions[userId]
	if s then
		s.data.cargo = s.data.cargo or {}
		b.items, b.capacity = s.data.cargo, s.data.slots
	end
	return b
end

function Inv.bind(userId, session)
	sessions[userId] = session
	return Inv.bag(userId)
end

function Inv.locked(userId)
	local s = sessions[userId]
	return s and (s.pending ~= nil or s.committing or s.saving or s.outcomePending or s.lost or s.released or s.closing) or false
end

function Inv.session(userId) return sessions[userId] end

local function changed(userId)
	local s = sessions[userId]
	if s then s.dirty = true end
end

function Inv.clear(userId)
	bags[userId] = nil
	sessions[userId] = nil
end

function Inv.used(userId)
	local n = 0
	for _, it in ipairs(Inv.bag(userId).items) do
		n += it.slots
	end
	return n
end

function Inv.setCapacity(userId, cap)
	Inv.bag(userId).capacity = cap
end

function Inv.free(userId)
	local b = Inv.bag(userId)
	return b.capacity - Inv.used(userId)
end

function Inv.newItem(kind, fields)
	local it = {
		uid = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		kind = kind,
		species = fields.species,
		rarity = fields.rarity,
		tier = fields.tier,
		mutation = fields.mutation or "",
		region = fields.region or 1,
		slots = (kind == "heartstone") and C.HEARTSTONE_SLOTS or 1,
		acquiredAt = fields.acquiredAt or os.time(),
		source = fields.source or "",
		discovery = fields.discovery,
	}
	it.discovery = it.discovery or { id = it.uid, place = fields.place or it.source, method = fields.method or (kind == "heartstone" and "heartstone" or "encounter"), at = it.acquiredAt }
	return it
end

-- add(userId, item) -> ok, reason ("full")
function Inv.add(userId, item)
	if Inv.locked(userId) then return false, "pending" end
	if Inv.free(userId) < item.slots then
		return false, "full"
	end
	local b = Inv.bag(userId)
	for _, it in ipairs(b.items) do
		if it.uid == item.uid then
			return false, "duplicate"
		end
	end
	b.items[#b.items + 1] = item
	changed(userId)
	return true
end

function Inv.remove(userId, uid)
	if Inv.locked(userId) then return nil, "pending" end
	local b = Inv.bag(userId)
	for i, it in ipairs(b.items) do
		if it.uid == uid then
			table.remove(b.items, i)
			changed(userId)
			return it
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- atomically take every item (bank deposit / disconnect)
function Inv.takeAll(userId)
	if Inv.locked(userId) then return {} end
	local b = Inv.bag(userId)
	local items = b.items
	b.items = {}
	if sessions[userId] then sessions[userId].data.cargo = b.items end
	changed(userId)
	return items
end

function Inv.value(it)
	if it.kind == "heartstone" then
		return 100 + (C.HEARTSTONE_VALUE[it.tier] or 0)
	end
	return C.RANK[it.rarity] or 0
end

-- the item a guardian hit or a fall shakes loose first: Heartstones (highest tier), then rarity, then newest.
-- skip(it) -> true leaves that item out (protected cargo).
function Inv.mostValuable(userId, skip)
	local best, bv = nil, -1
	for _, it in ipairs(Inv.bag(userId).items) do
		local v = Inv.value(it) + (it.acquiredAt or 0) * 1e-12
		if v > bv and not (skip and skip(it)) then
			best, bv = it, v
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- client view (no uids needed for display, but kept for locker moves)
function Inv.view(userId)
	local out = {}
	for _, it in ipairs(Inv.bag(userId).items) do
		out[#out + 1] = Cargo.clientItem({ uid = it.uid, kind = it.kind, species = it.species, rarity = it.rarity, tier = it.tier, slots = it.slots, mutation = it.mutation, discovery = it.discovery, source = it.source, acquiredAt = it.acquiredAt })
	end
	return out
end

return Inv

sources.src/core/server/Claims.luau:
-- Claims (ServerScriptService.CC_CoreServer): creature spawns and hold-to-claim (LOCKED verb).
-- Spawn anchors come from Workspace.World.Core.Spawns (CoreProps generator). Species are picked server-side by
-- query (region + rarity + ecology) from the one species table, so the Codex roster replaces stubs without code
-- changes. The server owns rarity; the client only holds the prompt.
-- Shared spawns: first valid claim wins, then the spot respawns after `Respawn` s with a re-rolled species.
-- Per-player spawns (tutorial common, guardian-free Rare nook): each player can claim them once per cooldown
-- (0 = once ever); the time is stored in the profile (timers) so a rejoin can't reset it. Others never lose it.
-- Deterministic edge cases (master.md §5): full bag -> refused, nothing lost; competing claimants -> first valid
-- Triggered wins, the other is told; hit during the hold -> refused (Prompts.validate); disconnect -> nothing.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Claims = {}
local ctx, C, Inv, Clock, Species, Visuals, Prompts
local spawns = {} -- [id] = spawn
local folder
local rng = Random.new()
local REGION_NAMES = { "Green Valley", "Whispering Forest", "Broken Cliffs", "Storm Ridge", "Frozen Summit" }
local function discoveryPlace(id, region, authored)
	if type(authored) == "string" and authored:match("%S") then return authored end
	if id == "tut_common" then return "The Foothold" end
	if id == "nook_rare_r1" then return "Shepherd's hidden nook" end
	if id:match("^shep_%d+$") then return "Shepherd's Road" end
	if id:match("^out_%d+$") then return "Foothold outskirts" end
	return (REGION_NAMES[region] or "Mountain") .. " creature nook"
end

local function pickSpecies(sp)
	local pool = Species.query({ region = sp.region, rarity = sp.rarity, kind = "creature", ecology = sp.ecology })
	if #pool == 0 then
		pool = Species.query({ region = sp.region, rarity = sp.rarity, kind = "creature" })
	end
	if #pool == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return sp.perPlayer and pool[1].id or pool[rng:NextInteger(1, #pool)].id
end

local function timerKey(sp)
	return "spawn:" .. sp.id
end

-- is this per-player spawn currently claimed by the player? (profile timers)
local function claimedBy(sp, plr)
	local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
	local t = s and s.data.timers[timerKey(sp)]
	if not t then
		return false
	end
	return sp.respawn == 0 or Clock.now() < t + sp.respawn
end
Claims.claimedBy = claimedBy

local function show(sp)
	sp.generation = (sp.generation or 0) + 1
	sp.species = pickSpecies(sp)
	if not sp.species then
		return
	end
	local m = Visuals.creature(sp.species, sp.pos)
	m.Name = "Creature_" .. sp.id
	m:SetAttribute("SpawnId", sp.id)
	m:SetAttribute("PerPlayer", sp.perPlayer)
	local e = Species.get(sp.species)
	local prompt = Prompts.make(m.PrimaryPart, {
		Name = "ClaimPrompt",
		ActionText = "Claim",
		ObjectText = (e and e.name or sp.species) .. "  " .. Visuals.pips(sp.rarity),
		HoldDuration = C.HOLD_SECONDS[sp.rarity] or 1,
		MaxActivationDistance = C.CLAIM_RANGE,
	})
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(plr)
		Claims.tryClaim(plr, sp, prompt)
	end)
	sp.model, sp.prompt, sp.available = m, prompt, true
	m.Parent = folder
end

-- Consume one authored shared occurrence once. An uncertain departing claimant conservatively consumes the
-- occurrence too: immediately unreserving could award it twice if the durable write already committed.
local function consumeShared(sp, generation)
	if sp.perPlayer or sp.generation ~= generation or not sp.available then return false end
	sp.available, sp.reserved, sp.reservedGeneration = false, nil, nil
	if sp.model then sp.model:Destroy() end
	sp.model, sp.prompt = nil, nil
	task.delay(sp.respawn, function()
		if sp.generation == generation and not sp.available then show(sp) end
	end)
	return true
end

function Claims.tryClaim(plr, sp, prompt)
	local ok, why = Prompts.validate(prompt, plr)
	if not ok then
		if why == "hit" then
			ctx.toast(plr, "Knocked off balance. Try again.", "warn")
		end
		return
	end
	if sp.perPlayer then
		if claimedBy(sp, plr) then
			return
		end
		if not ctx.sessions[plr] then
			ctx.toast(plr, "Wait for your profile to load.", "warn")
			return
		end
	elseif not sp.available then
		ctx.toast(plr, "Someone else claimed it first.", "info")
		return
	end
	local place = sp.label or discoveryPlace(sp.id, sp.region)
	local item = Inv.newItem("creature", { species = sp.species, rarity = sp.rarity, region = sp.region, source = sp.id, acquiredAt = Clock.now(), place = place, method = sp.ecology == "hiding" and "Hidden nook" or "Encounter" })
	local species,generation=sp.species,sp.generation
	ctx.Cargo.acquire(plr,item,{
		pos=sp.pos,label=place,
		valid=function()
			local hrp=plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			return hrp and (hrp.Position-sp.pos).Magnitude<=C.CLAIM_RANGE+4 and sp.generation==generation and sp.species==species and not sp.reserved and (sp.perPlayer and not claimedBy(sp,plr) or not sp.perPlayer and sp.available)
		end,
		reserve=function() if not sp.perPlayer then if sp.reserved or not sp.available or sp.generation~=generation then return false end sp.reserved,sp.reservedGeneration=plr,generation end return true end,
		unreserve=function() if sp.reserved==plr and sp.reservedGeneration==generation then sp.reserved,sp.reservedGeneration=nil,nil end end,
		write=function(d)
			if sp.perPlayer then
				local t=d.timers[timerKey(sp)]
				if t and (sp.respawn==0 or Clock.now()<t+sp.respawn) then return false,"claimed" end
				d.timers[timerKey(sp)]=Clock.now()
			end
			return true
		end,
		commit=function(saved)
			if not sp.perPlayer then
				consumeShared(sp,generation)
			end
			local e=Species.get(saved.species)
			ctx.toast(plr,"Claimed "..(e and e.name or saved.species).."  "..Visuals.pips(sp.rarity),"good")
			ctx.fx(plr,{kind="claim",species=saved.species,rarity=sp.rarity,pos=sp.pos})
			ctx.emit("claim",plr,sp.id,saved)
		end,
	})
end

function Claims.onLeave(plr)
	for _, sp in pairs(spawns) do
		if sp.reserved == plr then consumeShared(sp, sp.reservedGeneration) end
	end
end

function Claims.init(c)
	ctx = c
	C, Inv, Clock, Species = c.C, c.Inv, c.Clock, c.Species
	Visuals = require(script.Parent.Visuals)
	Prompts = require(script.Parent.Prompts)
	ctx.Claims = Claims
	local core = workspace:WaitForChild("World"):WaitForChild("Core", 10)
	if not core or not core:FindFirstChild("Spawns") then
		warn("[CC] Claims: Workspace.World.Core.Spawns missing (run CoreProps.build)")
		return
	end
	folder = core:FindFirstChild("Creatures") or Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Creatures"
	folder.Parent = core
	for _, a in ipairs(core.Spawns:GetChildren()) do
		local id = a:GetAttribute("SpawnId")
		if id then
			local sp = {
				id = id,
				label = discoveryPlace(id, a:GetAttribute("Region") or 1, a:GetAttribute("DiscoveryLabel") or a:GetAttribute("Label")),
				pos = a.Position,
				rarity = a:GetAttribute("Rarity") or "Common",
				ecology = a:GetAttribute("Ecology"),
				region = a:GetAttribute("Region") or 1,
				perPlayer = a:GetAttribute("PerPlayer") == true,
				respawn = a:GetAttribute("Respawn") or 90,
			}
			spawns[id] = sp
			show(sp)
		end
	end
end

-- per-player spawns this player has claimed (client hides them locally)
function Claims.state(plr, st)
	-- per-player spawns this player has claimed, with the time they come back (client hides them until then)
	local hidden = {}
	local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
	for id, sp in pairs(spawns) do
		if sp.perPlayer and claimedBy(sp, plr) then
			local t = s and s.data.timers[timerKey(sp)] or 0
			hidden[#hidden + 1] = { id = id, untilAt = sp.respawn == 0 and math.huge or (t + sp.respawn) }
		end
	end
	st.hiddenSpawns = hidden
end

function Claims.spawnPos(id)
	return spawns[id] and spawns[id].pos or nil
end
Claims._spawns = spawns
return Claims

-- LedgeRoute (v4 P3, run 2): Cliff Ledge Line, full route (master.md §0.8 LOCKED form; placements PROPOSED).
--   require(ServerStorage.CC_Generators:Clone().LedgeRoute).build(Kit)       (after B.camps; needs _G.CC_PATHS
--   from Gen.computeField with the Ledge "lines" unstamped, i.e. the terrain written after WorldConfig's lines)
-- Leg 0 is LedgeP1 (gate -> s 645) + the stamped approach to Camp 1. Every switchback climb through a steep band
-- (WorldConfig Ledge.lines) is rebuilt here as a ClimbKit pitch stack; the shelf traverses between them stay
-- narrow stamped benches (hw 3, drop side natural).
local CK = require(script.Parent.ClimbKit)
local LR = {}

-- per stack: tier rise and which tiers / faces carry a feature (all PROPOSED, tuned from bot times)
-- ta/tb = the tier window (theta, unwrapped around the stack's start): the old switchback window of each band
LR.STACKS = {
	forest = { rise = 40, ta = 1.376, tb = 1.546, label = "Forest band rest", features = { rest = { 3 }, traverse = { 2 }, chute = { 4 }, lunge = { 3 } } },
	cliffs = { rise = 42, ta = 2.536, tb = 2.78, label = "Broken Cliffs rest", features = { rest = { 3, 7 }, traverse = { 5 }, chute = { 2, 6 }, lunge = { 4, 8 } } },
	storm = { rise = 44, ta = -2.229, tb = -1.799, minDeg = 44, label = "Storm band rest", features = { rest = { 3, 8 }, traverse = { 2 }, chute = { 4, 10 }, lunge = { 5 } } },
}

-- the P1 section's bot track, read from the built World.LedgeP1 (same order as tools/ledge_bot.luau): approach
-- flags, trailhead, Face B, L1 east -> west with the chute crossing on the marked panel, the pillar, the exit flag
local function p1Segment()
	local W = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
	local LP = W and W:FindFirstChild("LedgeP1")
	if not LP then
		return nil
	end
	local function v(p)
		return { math.floor(p.X * 10 + 0.5) / 10, math.floor(p.Y * 10 + 0.5) / 10, math.floor(p.Z * 10 + 0.5) / 10 }
	end
	local function flat(p)
		return Vector3.new(p.X, 0, p.Z)
	end
	local nodes = {}
	for _, n in ipairs({ "Flag_1", "Flag_2" }) do
		local f = LP:FindFirstChild(n, true)
		if f then
			nodes[#nodes + 1] = { k = "walk", p = v(f:FindFirstChild("GuideFlag").Position - Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) + Vector3.new(0, 0, 4)) }
		end
	end
	nodes[#nodes + 1] = { k = "walk", p = v(Vector3.new(-482, 101, 1872)) }
	nodes[#nodes + 1] = { k = "walk", p = v(Vector3.new(-488, 101, 1866)) }
	nodes[#nodes + 1] = { k = "climb", into = { 0, 0, -1 }, label = "P1_FaceB" }
	local walkParts = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(LP.L1:GetChildren()) do
		if p.Name == "Ledge" or p.Name == "RestLedge" or p.Name == "FinDeck" then
			walkParts[#walkParts + 1] = p
		end
	end
	table.sort(walkParts, function(a, b)
		return a.Position.X > b.Position.X
	end)
	local panel = LP.L1:FindFirstChild("MarkedPanel")
	local haz = W.Hazards:FindFirstChild("LedgeP1") and W.Hazards.LedgeP1:FindFirstChild("Rockfall_Chute")
	local crossed = false
	for _, p in ipairs(walkParts) do
		local top = p.Position + Vector3.new(0, p.Size.Y / 2, 0)
		if panel and not crossed and top.X < panel.Position.X then
			local o = -panel.CFrame.RightVector
			local prev = nodes[#nodes].p
			if (flat(Vector3.new(prev[1], 0, prev[3])) - flat(panel.Position)):Dot(o) < 0 then
				o = -o
			end
			local along = -panel.CFrame.LookVector
			if along:Dot(Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0)) < 0 then
				along = -along
			end
			along = flat(along).Unit
			local edge = flat(panel.Position) + o * 2.6 - along * 5.2
			nodes[#nodes + 1] = { k = "walk", p = v(Vector3.new(edge.X, top.Y + 3, edge.Z)) }
			if haz then
				nodes[#nodes + 1] = { k = "wait", hz = haz:GetFullName() }
			end
			nodes[#nodes + 1] = { k = "climb", into = v(-o), dir = v(along), label = "P1_panel" }
			crossed = true
		end
		nodes[#nodes + 1] = { k = "walk", p = v(top + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) }
	end
	local grip = LP.Pillar.Ladder.LadderGrip
	local oE = grip.CFrame.LookVector
	nodes[#nodes + 1] = { k = "walk", p = v(grip.Position + oE * 2.5 - Vector3.new(0, grip.Size.Y / 2 - 3, 0)) }
	nodes[#nodes + 1] = { k = "climb", into = v(-flat(oE).Unit), label = "P1_pillar" }
	local ex = LP:FindFirstChild("Flag_9", true)
	if ex then
		local fp = ex:FindFirstChild("GuideFlag").Position
		nodes[#nodes + 1] = { k = "walk", p = v(Vector3.new(grip.Position.X, fp.Y - 3, fp.Z)) }
		nodes[#nodes + 1] = { k = "walk", p = v(fp - Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)) }
	end
	return { id = "p1", s0 = 40, s1 = 645, nodes = nodes }
end

-- opts.rewrite = false: the boxes were already rewritten (BuildAll.allLines)
function LR.build(Kit, only, opts)
	local R = _G.CC_PATHS and _G.CC_PATHS.routes.Ledge
	assert(R and R.ctrlS, "LedgeRoute needs _G.CC_PATHS from Gen.computeField (v4 P3 MountainGen)")
	local ck = CK.new(Kit, "Ledge")
	local out = {}
	for i, ln in ipairs(R.def.lines or {}) do
		local st = LR.STACKS[ln.band]
		if ln.kind == "stack" and st and (not only or only == ln.band) then
			local rep = ck:stack({
				name = ln.band,
				R = R,
				s0 = R.ctrlS[ln.c0] + (ln.pad0 or 0),
				s1 = R.ctrlS[ln.c1] - (ln.pad1 or 0),
				rise = st.rise,
				ta = st.ta,
				tb = st.tb,
				foot = st.foot,
				minDeg = st.minDeg,
				top = st.top,
				features = st.features,
				label = st.label,
				guideBase = 100 * i,
				order0 = 10 * i,
				rewrite = not (opts and opts.rewrite == false),
			})
			out[#out + 1] = rep
			task.wait()
		elseif ln.kind == "hang" and (not only or only == ln.band) then
			out[#out + 1] = ck:hang({
				name = ln.band,
				R = R,
				s0 = ln.s0,
				s1 = ln.s1,
				drop = ln.drop,
				outward = ln.outward,
				notch = ln.notch,
				features = ln.features or { traverse = { 0.3 }, chute = { 0.62 }, rest = { 0.47 } },
				label = ln.label or ((R.def.name or "") .. " hang-line rest"),
				ledgeMat = nil,
				guideBase = 100 * i,
				order0 = 10 * i,
				rewrite = not (opts and opts.rewrite == false),
			})
			task.wait()
		end
	end
	local p1 = p1Segment()
	if p1 then
		table.insert(ck.segments, 1, p1)
	end
	-- a full build also removes lines no longer configured (their parts, hazards, checkpoints)
	if not only then
		local keep = {}
		for _, ln in ipairs(R.def.lines or {}) do
			keep[ln.band] = true
		end
		for _, f in ipairs(ck.lines:GetChildren()) do
			if not keep[f.Name] then
				ck:clearLine(f.Name)
			end
		end
	end
	local segs = ck:export(not only)
	local lines = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(out) do
		local t = {}
		for k, v in pairs(r) do
			t[#t + 1] = k .. "=" .. tostring(v)
		end
		table.sort(t)
		lines[#lines + 1] = table.concat(t, " ")
	end
	lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("parts %d, track segments %d", ck.n, segs)
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

return LR
sources.src/world/ShepherdP2.luau:
-- ShepherdP2 (v4 P2, 2026-10-21): one "gentle but alive" stretch of Shepherd's Road (master.md §0.8, LOCKED #6:
-- rope scrambles, railed ledges, one real view-down moment, ~25 % hands-on). Placements PROPOSED.
--   require(ServerStorage.CC_Generators:Clone().ShepherdP2).build(require(ServerStorage.CC_Generators.Kit))
-- Needs ReplicatedStorage.CC_Route.Shepherd. Tutorial beats 4-5 and the Rare nook (s~840) are untouched: this
-- stretch is s~1390-1500, past everything the tutorial uses. Output: Workspace.World.ShepherdP2.
-- Line: the road narrows to a railed ledge along the drop (a rock band squeezes it to ~5 studs; the road's own
-- drop-side fence is the rail) -> an old rockfall closes the road: a short marked scramble (fixed rope) up its
-- face -> along its top to a lookout jutting over the drop (view-down moment) -> timber stairs back down to the road.
local SP = {}

SP.BAND = { 1392, 1428 } -- railed-ledge squeeze
SP.BARRIER = { 1440, 1458 } -- rockfall across the road (its near face is the scramble)
SP.STAIRS_TO = 1476 -- stairs land on the road here
SP.SCRAMBLE_H = 14 -- barrier height above the road at its near face

local terrainOnly = RaycastParams.new()
terrainOnly.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
terrainOnly.FilterDescendantsInstances = { workspace.Terrain }
local function ground(x, z)
	local r = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, 900, z), Vector3.new(0, -1000, 0), terrainOnly)
	return r and r.Position.Y or 0
end
local function flat(v)
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end

local function routePts(name)
	local out = {}
	local sv = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("CC_Route")
	sv = sv and sv:FindFirstChild(name)
	for tok in string.gmatch(sv and sv.Value or "", "[^;]+") do
		local x, y, z, s = tok:match("([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)")
		out[#out + 1] = { p = Vector3.new(tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z)), s = tonumber(s) }
	end
	return out
end

function SP.build(Kit)
	local COL = Kit.COL
	local world = Kit.folder(workspace, "World")
	local old = world:FindFirstChild("ShepherdP2")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local root = Kit.folder(world, "ShepherdP2")
	local rng = Random.new(1517)
	local n = 0
	local function P(parent, props)
		n += 1
		return Kit.part(parent, props)
	end
	local pts = routePts("Shepherd")
	-- frame at arc length s: road centre (trail height), along-road t, outward o (toward the drop)
	local function frame(s)
		for i = 2, #pts do
			if pts[i].s >= s then
				local a, b = pts[i - 1], pts[i]
				local k = (s - a.s) / math.max(1e-3, b.s - a.s)
				local c = a.p:Lerp(b.p, k)
				local t = flat(b.p - a.p).Unit
				local side = Vector3.new(-t.Z, 0, t.X)
				local o = (ground(c.X + side.X * 20, c.Z + side.Z * 20) < ground(c.X - side.X * 20, c.Z - side.Z * 20)) and side or -side
				return c, t, o
			end
		end
	end
	-- run 2 fix (self-review "boxy striped band"): one rock mass; strata vary in texture and a small shade step
	-- between the lichen-rock and slate tokens, not in hue
	local function band()
		local r = rng:NextNumber()
		return { COL.rock:Lerp(COL.slate, 0.08 + rng:NextNumber() * 0.3), (r < 0.6) and Enum.Material.Rock or Enum.Material.Slate }
	end
	local report = {}

	------------------------------------------------ railed ledge: a rock band squeezes the road to ~5 studs at the drop
	local bandF = Kit.folder(root, "RailedLedge")
	for s = SP.BAND[1], SP.BAND[2], 6 do
		local c, t, o = frame(s)
		-- taper in/out over the first and last 6 studs
		local k = math.clamp(math.min(s - SP.BAND[1], SP.BAND[2] - s) / 6, 0, 1)
		local inner = 1.5 * k + (-7.5) * (1 - k) -- the band's outer face, along o (road hw 7: walkable = inner..7)
		local w = inner + 12
		local h = 9 + rng:NextNumber() * 6
		local b = band()
		local centre = c + o * (inner - w / 2) + Vector3.new(0, h / 2 - 1.5, 0)
		P(bandF, { Name = "RockBand", Size = Vector3.new(w, h, 6.8), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(centre, centre + t) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rng:NextNumber() * 4 - 2), 0, math.rad(rng:NextNumber() * 4 - 2)), Material = b[2], Color = b[1] })
	end
	report.ledge = string.format("railed ledge s %d-%d, walkable ~5.5 studs at the drop-side fence", SP.BAND[1], SP.BAND[2])

	------------------------------------------------ the rockfall barrier; its near face is the marked scramble
	local bar = Kit.model(root, "Rockfall")
	local c0, t0, o0 = frame(SP.BARRIER[1])
	local c1 = frame(SP.BARRIER[2])
	local topY = c0.Y + SP.SCRAMBLE_H
	local len = (flat(c1 - c0)).Magnitude
	local mid = (c0 + c1) / 2
	local tm = flat(c1 - c0).Unit
	-- strata blocks from the bank (o -13) to past the outer edge (o +10), road level -3 to the top
	local y, i = c0.Y - 3, 0
	while y < topY - 0.01 do
		i += 1
		local h = math.min(topY - y, 2.6 + rng:NextNumber() * 2.4)
		if topY - (y + h) < 1.2 then
			h = topY - y
		end
		local b = band()
		local centre = Vector3.new(mid.X, y + h / 2, mid.Z) + o0 * (-1.5 + rng:NextNumber() * 0.6)
		local blk = P(bar, { Name = "MarkedRock", Size = Vector3.new(23 + rng:NextNumber() * 1.5, h, len + rng:NextNumber() * 0.6), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(centre, centre + tm) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(rng:NextNumber() * 2 - 1), 0), Material = b[2], Color = b[1] })
		-- only the near face is meant to be climbed, but every side of marked rock is climbable (simple rule)
		blk:SetAttribute("Climbable", true)
		y += h
	end
	-- a fixed rope down the near face, centred on the road, + pitons
	local face = Vector3.new(c0.X, 0, c0.Z) - tm * 0.4 + o0 * 2
	local ra, rb = Vector3.new(face.X, c0.Y + 0.5, face.Z), Vector3.new(face.X, topY + 0.6, face.Z)
	Kit.decor(P(bar, { Name = "FixedRope", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new((rb - ra).Magnitude, 0.34, 0.34), CFrame = CFrame.new((ra + rb) / 2) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = COL.lantern }))
	for py = c0.Y + 4, topY, 5 do
		Kit.decor(P(bar, { Name = "Piton", Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 1.2), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(face.X, py, face.Z), Vector3.new(face.X, py, face.Z) - tm), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, Color = COL.slate }))
	end
	report.scramble = string.format("scramble %.0f studs up the rockfall at s %d (top y %.0f)", SP.SCRAMBLE_H, SP.BARRIER[1], topY)

	------------------------------------------------ the lookout: a slab jutting out over the drop from the rockfall's top
	local lk = Kit.model(root, "Lookout")
	local lc = Vector3.new(mid.X, topY - 0.6, mid.Z) + o0 * 14
	P(lk, { Name = "LookoutSlab", Size = Vector3.new(10, 1.2, 9), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(lc, lc + tm), Material = Enum.Material.Slate, Color = COL.slate })
	-- timber rail on its three open sides
	local corners = {}
	for _, q in ipairs({ { 5, -4.5 }, { 5, 4.5 }, { -2, 4.5 }, { -2, -4.5 } }) do
		corners[#corners + 1] = lc + o0 * q[1] + tm * q[2] + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
	end
	Kit.fence(lk, { corners[4], corners[1], corners[2], corners[3] }, 3)
	Kit.lantern(lk, lc + o0 * 3.5 + tm * 3.6 + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0), 5, true)
	report.lookout = string.format("lookout at (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f), drop below %.0f studs", lc.X, lc.Y, lc.Z, topY - ground(lc.X + o0.X * 6, lc.Z + o0.Z * 6))

	------------------------------------------------ stairs back down to the road
	local s1c = frame(SP.BARRIER[2])
	local a = Vector3.new(s1c.X, topY, s1c.Z) - tm * 1 - o0 * 0.5
	local sc = frame(SP.STAIRS_TO)
	local bpt = Vector3.new(sc.X, sc.Y, sc.Z) - o0 * 0.5
	-- Kit.stairs climbs from a (bottom) to b (top): bottom = the road, top = the rockfall
	Kit.stairs(root, bpt, a, 6)
	report.stairs = string.format("stairs %.1f studs down over %.0f studs", topY - sc.Y, (flat(a - bpt)).Magnitude)
	report.parts = string.format("%d parts + stairs, %d instances", n, #root:GetDescendants())
	return report
end

return SP
sources.tools/ledge_bot.luau:
-- Ledge P1 bot (dev tool, Client, playtest). Drives CC_ClimbClient through its Studio-only hooks (CC_BotMove /
-- CC_BotJump), i.e. the same controller a player uses; walking uses Humanoid:MoveTo at WalkSpeed 12 (BOT timing).
-- Synced to ReplicatedStorage.CC_DevTools.LedgeBot. Client: _G.CC_LBOT_CFG = { fromGate = true, runs = 1 };
-- require(game.ReplicatedStorage.CC_DevTools.LedgeBot:Clone()); poll _G.CC_LBOT
-- with back-to-back calls (MCP client threads only run during a call). Results per run: total, splits, stuck,
-- grabs/slips/catches/misses/lunges, falls (server CC_Falls), reached.
local PFS = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local cfg = _G.CC_LBOT_CFG or {}
local B = { status = "running", runs = {}, log = {} }
_G.CC_LBOT = B

local function flat(v)
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end

local function run(idx)
	local ch = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local hum, hrp = ch:WaitForChild("Humanoid"), ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	hum.WalkSpeed = 12
	local R = { i = idx, splits = {}, stuck = 0, log = {} }
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local function mark(k)
		R.splits[#R.splits + 1] = string.format("%s %.1f (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)", k, os.clock() - t0, hrp.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y, hrp.Position.Z)
	end
	local function log(s)
		R.log[#R.log + 1] = string.format("%.1f %s", os.clock() - t0, s)
	end
	local function state()
		return ch:GetAttribute("CC_ClimbState") or "none"
	end
	local function walk(p, tmax)
		local t1 = os.clock()
		local d0 = (flat(p) - flat(hrp.Position)).Magnitude
		tmax = tmax or d0 / 12 * 2.2 + 2.5
		while os.clock() - t1 < tmax do
			hum:MoveTo(p)
			if (flat(p) - flat(hrp.Position)).Magnitude < 2.2 then
				return true
			end
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
		R.stuck += 1
		log(string.format("STUCK walking near (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) -> (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)", hrp.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y, hrp.Position.Z, p.X, p.Y, p.Z))
		return false
	end
	-- push into a marked face until grabbed, hold `dir` until the controller leaves the face (mantle/step-off)
	local function climb(into, dir, tmax, label)
		local t1 = os.clock()
		ch:SetAttribute("CC_BotMove", into)
		while state() == "none" and os.clock() - t1 < 3 do
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
		if state() == "none" then
			ch:SetAttribute("CC_BotMove", Vector3.zero)
			R.stuck += 1
			log("NO GRAB at " .. label)
			return false
		end
		mark("grab " .. label)
		ch:SetAttribute("CC_BotMove", dir or into)
		while state() ~= "none" and os.clock() - t1 < tmax do
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
		ch:SetAttribute("CC_BotMove", Vector3.zero)
		if state() ~= "none" then
			R.stuck += 1
			log("STUCK on face " .. label .. string.format(" at y %.0f", hrp.Position.Y))
			return false
		end
		mark("off " .. label)
		return true
	end

	-- the teleport to the start is a client move: clear the server checkpoint first so it isn't judged a fall
	local dev = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CC_Remotes") and game.ReplicatedStorage.CC_Remotes:FindFirstChild("DevRequest")
	if dev then
		dev:FireServer("setCheckpoint", {})
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
	local W = workspace:WaitForChild("World")
	local LP = W:WaitForChild("LedgeP1")
	local fallsBefore = plr:GetAttribute("CC_Falls") or 0
	for _, k in ipairs({ "CC_Grabs", "CC_Slips", "CC_Catches", "CC_Misses", "CC_Lunges" }) do
		R[k .. "0"] = ch:GetAttribute(k) or 0
	end

	-- 1) gate -> trailhead over the foothills (or start at the trailhead)
	local thFlag = LP:FindFirstChild("Flag_3", true)
	local th = thFlag and thFlag:FindFirstChild("GuideFlag").Position - Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
	if cfg.fromGate then
		ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(-82, 52, 1800)))
		task.wait(2)
		t0 = os.clock()
		-- follow the approach flags (guidance layer a), as a player would
		for _, n in ipairs({ "Flag_1", "Flag_2" }) do
			local f = LP:FindFirstChild(n, true)
			if f then
				walk(f:FindFirstChild("GuideFlag").Position - Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) + Vector3.new(0, 0, 4))
			end
		end
		walk(Vector3.new(-482, 101, 1872))
	else
		ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(-482, 104, 1872)))
		task.wait(2)
		t0 = os.clock()
	end
	mark("trailhead")

	-- 2) Face B (faces +z): push north
	walk(Vector3.new(-488, 101, 1866))
	if not climb(Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), nil, 20, "FaceB") then
		R.result = "faceB"
		return R
	end

	-- 3) L1: walk the ledge parts east -> west; cross the chute on the panel when the rockfall is clear
	local walkParts = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(LP.L1:GetChildren()) do
		if p.Name == "Ledge" or p.Name == "RestLedge" or p.Name == "FinDeck" then
			walkParts[#walkParts + 1] = p
		end
	end
	table.sort(walkParts, function(a, b)
		return a.Position.X > b.Position.X
	end)
	local panel = LP.L1:FindFirstChild("MarkedPanel")
	local haz = W.Hazards:FindFirstChild("LedgeP1") and W.Hazards.LedgeP1:FindFirstChild("Rockfall_Chute")
	local crossed = false
	for _, p in ipairs(walkParts) do
		local top = p.Position + Vector3.new(0, p.Size.Y / 2, 0)
		-- walking line: centre of the walkable top, but never hugging the back wall
		if panel and not crossed and top.X < panel.Position.X then
			-- reached the gap: wait for the rock to pass, then grab the panel and traverse west
			local o = -panel.CFrame.RightVector -- panel X axis spans the wall thickness (lookAt along the ledge)
			if (flat(hrp.Position) - flat(panel.Position)):Dot(o) < 0 then
				o = -o
			end
			local along = -panel.CFrame.LookVector
			if along:Dot(Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0)) < 0 then
				along = -along
			end
			along = flat(along).Unit
			-- step to the gap's near edge on the walking line (panel front + 1.6 out, 5 studs before the gap centre)
			local edge = flat(panel.Position) + o * 2.6 - along * 5.2
			walk(Vector3.new(edge.X, hrp.Position.Y, edge.Z))
			mark("chute")
			if haz then
				local per, tell, off = haz:GetAttribute("Period"), haz:GetAttribute("Tell"), haz:GetAttribute("Offset")
				local waited = os.clock()
				while true do
					local ph = (workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + off) % per
					if ph > tell + 1.5 and ph < per - 2.5 then
						break
					end
					task.wait(0.05)
				end
				R.chuteWait = os.clock() - waited
			end

			if not climb(-o, flat(along).Unit, 12, "panel") then
				R.result = "panel"
				return R
			end
			crossed = true
		end
		walk(top + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
	end
	mark("L1 end")

	-- 4) pillar: ladder pitch + marked face, mantle at the old ledge
	local grip = LP.Pillar.Ladder.LadderGrip
	local oE = grip.CFrame.LookVector
	walk(grip.Position + oE * 2.5 - Vector3.new(0, grip.Size.Y / 2 - 3, 0))
	if not climb(-flat(oE).Unit, nil, 25, "pillar") then
		R.result = "pillar"
		return R
	end
	-- 5) straight back over the pillar top onto the old ledge, then to the exit marker
	local ex = LP:FindFirstChild("Flag_9", true)
	if ex then
		local fp = ex:FindFirstChild("GuideFlag").Position
		walk(Vector3.new(grip.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y, fp.Z))
		walk(fp - Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
	end
	mark("exit")
	R.total = os.clock() - t0
	R.reached = ex and (flat(hrp.Position) - flat(ex:FindFirstChild("GuideFlag").Position)).Magnitude < 8
	R.falls = (plr:GetAttribute("CC_Falls") or 0) - fallsBefore
	for _, k in ipairs({ "CC_Grabs", "CC_Slips", "CC_Catches", "CC_Misses", "CC_Lunges" }) do
		R[k] = (ch:GetAttribute(k) or 0) - R[k .. "0"]
		R[k .. "0"] = nil
	end
	R.result = "ok"
	return R
end

task.spawn(function()
	for i = 1, cfg.runs or 1 do
		B.where = "run " .. i
		local ok, r = pcall(run, i)
		B.runs[#B.runs + 1] = ok and r or { i = i, result = "error", err = tostring(r) }
		task.wait(1)
	end
	B.status = "done"
end)
return "ledge bot started"
sources.tools/tutorial_bot.luau:
-- Tutorial bot (dev tool). Lives in Studio as ReplicatedStorage.CC_DevTools.TutorialBot (inert outside Studio: it
-- needs the Studio-only DevRequest remote). In a playtest, execute_luau on the CLIENT:
--   return require(game.ReplicatedStorage.CC_DevTools.TutorialBot:Clone())({ runs = 1, speed = 12, hit = false })
-- Runs the full onboarding with real inputs: Humanoid:MoveTo for walking, ProximityPrompt:InputHoldBegin/End for
-- every claim/net/bank (so the server's hold/range/stagger validation runs exactly as for a player).
-- Config: runs (default 1), speed (12 = timing run; higher = stuck check only, times not comparable), hit (true = on
-- even runs, stay near the nest after netting so the guardian hit + drop pack + recovery path runs).
-- Each run first resets the profile (Studio-only DevRequest "resetProfile"). Poll _G.CC_TBOT for results.
-- Times are BOT times (perfect input): not human times.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotes = RS:WaitForChild("CC_Remotes")
local dev, reqEv, stateEv, fxEv = remotes.DevRequest, remotes.CoreRequest, remotes.CoreState, remotes.CoreFx
local RUNS, SPEED, WANT_HIT = 1, 12, false

local B = { status = "running", runs = {}, log = {} }
_G.CC_TBOT = B
local st = {}
stateEv.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(s)
	st = s
end)
local lastFx = {}
fxEv.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(p)
	if type(p) == "table" and p.kind then
		lastFx[p.kind] = { t = os.clock(), p = p }
	end
end)

local function char()
	local ch = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	return ch, ch:WaitForChild("Humanoid"), ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function flat(v)
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end
local function log(run, s)
	run.log[#run.log + 1] = string.format("%.1f %s", os.clock() - run.t0, s)
end
local function tutStep()
	return plr:GetAttribute("CC_Tutorial") or 0
end
local function waitFor(fn, timeout)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < timeout do
		if fn() then
			return true
		end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	return false
end

-- walk to pos; retries MoveTo, jumps when stalled; returns true/false (stuck)
local function walkTo(run, pos, timeout, tol)
	local _, hum, hrp = char()
	tol = tol or 3
	timeout = timeout or ((flat(pos) - flat(hrp.Position)).Magnitude / SPEED * 2 + 6)
	local t0, lastP, lastT = os.clock(), hrp.Position, os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < timeout do
		if (flat(pos) - flat(hrp.Position)).Magnitude < tol then
			return true
		end
		hum:MoveTo(pos)
		task.wait(0.15)
		if (hrp.Position - lastP).Magnitude > 1.5 then
			lastP, lastT = hrp.Position, os.clock()
		elseif os.clock() - lastT > 1.2 then
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			lastT = os.clock()
		end
	end
	run.stuck += 1
	log(run, string.format("STUCK walking to (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) from (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)", pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z, hrp.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y, hrp.Position.Z))
	return false
end

local routeCache = {}
local function route(name)
	if routeCache[name] then
		return routeCache[name]
	end
	local out = {}
	for tok in string.gmatch(RS.CC_Route[name].Value, "[^;]+") do
		local x, y, z, s = tok:match("([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)")
		out[#out + 1] = { p = Vector3.new(tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z)), s = tonumber(s) }
	end
	routeCache[name] = out
	return out
end
local function followRoute(run, name, s0, s1)
	local pts = route(name)
	local nextS = s0
	for _, q in ipairs(pts) do
		if q.s >= nextS and q.s <= s1 then
			nextS = q.s + 14
			walkTo(run, q.p, nil, 4) -- a stalled waypoint is logged; keep following the road
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- find a prompt by model name under World.Core.<folder> (waits for streaming)
local function findPrompt(folderName, modelName, promptName)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < 8 do
		local core = workspace:FindFirstChild("World") and workspace.World:FindFirstChild("Core")
		local f = core and core:FindFirstChild(folderName)
		local m = f and f:FindFirstChild(modelName)
		local p = m and m:FindFirstChild(promptName, true)
		if p then
			return p, m
		end
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	return nil
end
local function hold(prompt)
	-- prompts only show when their part is on screen: aim the camera at it from behind the character
	local _, _, hrp = char()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local target = prompt.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and prompt.Parent.Position or hrp.Position
	local back = flat(hrp.Position - target)
	back = back.Magnitude > 0.1 and back.Unit or Vector3.zAxis
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position + back * 10 + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), target)
	task.wait(0.35)
	prompt:InputHoldBegin()
	task.wait(prompt.HoldDuration + 0.25)
	prompt:InputHoldEnd()
	task.wait(0.3)
end

local function guardian(nestId)
	local g = workspace.World.Core:FindFirstChild("Guardians")
	for _, m in ipairs(g and g:GetChildren() or {}) do
		if m:GetAttribute("OwnerId") == plr.UserId and m:GetAttribute("NestId") == nestId then
			return m
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function recoverPacks(run)
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		local p = st.packs and st.packs[1]
		if not p then
			return
		end
		log(run, "recovering drop pack")
		-- packs lie where you were hit: sneak back in only while the guardian is away from it
		waitFor(function()
			local gm = guardian("nest_r1_hollow")
			return not gm or (gm:GetAttribute("State") == "Patrol" and (flat(gm:GetPivot().Position) - flat(p.pos)).Magnitude > 22)
		end, 25)
		walkTo(run, p.pos, 25, 4)
		local packs = workspace.World.Core:FindFirstChild("DropPacks")
		for _, m in ipairs(packs and packs:GetChildren() or {}) do
			if m:GetAttribute("OwnerId") == plr.UserId then
				local pr = m:FindFirstChild("RecoverPrompt", true)
				if pr then
					local before = #(st.packs or {})
					hold(pr)
					task.wait(0.4)
					if #(st.packs or {}) < before then
						run.recovered += 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
end

local function oneRun(i)
	local run = { i = i, t0 = os.clock(), stuck = 0, log = {}, marks = {}, hits = 0, recovered = 0, speed = SPEED }
	B.runs[i] = run
	local ch, hum, hrp = char()
	dev:FireServer("resetProfile")
	task.wait(1.5)
	hum.WalkSpeed = SPEED
	reqEv:FireServer("state")
	waitFor(function()
		return tutStep() == 1
	end, 10)
	run.t0 = os.clock()
	local function mark(name)
		run.marks[name] = os.clock() - run.t0
		log(run, "MARK " .. name)
	end

	-- 1 look around: walk toward the plaza
	walkTo(run, hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, -16))
	waitFor(function()
		return tutStep() >= 2
	end, 10)
	-- 2 first common
	local p, m = findPrompt("Creatures", "Creature_tut_common", "ClaimPrompt")
	if p then
		walkTo(run, m.PrimaryPart.Position, nil, 5)
		hold(p)
	end
	if waitFor(function()
		return tutStep() >= 3
	end, 5) then
		mark("common")
	end
	-- 3 bank at the campfire
	local fire = workspace.World.Regions.Foothold.Core.Campfire.Core
	walkTo(run, fire.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 8), nil, 6)
	hold(fire.BankPrompt)
	if waitFor(function()
		return tutStep() >= 4
	end, 5) then
		mark("bank1")
	end
	-- 4 Shepherd's Road to the rope, climb (the gate opens west and is reached from the north-east)
	walkTo(run, Vector3.new(-150, 49, 1880), nil, 6)
	walkTo(run, Vector3.new(-192, 49, 1848), nil, 5)
	walkTo(run, Vector3.new(-222, 49, 1818), nil, 5)
	followRoute(run, "Shepherd", 0, 822)
	local base = st.tut and st.tut.target
	if base then
		walkTo(run, base, 20, 2.5)
	end
	local props = workspace.World.Core.Props
	local top = props.NookTop.Position
	local climbed = false
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		hum:MoveTo(top)
		if waitFor(function()
			hum:MoveTo(top)
			return hrp.Position.Y > top.Y - 3.5
		end, 9) then
			climbed = true
			break
		end
		walkTo(run, base, 10, 2.5)
	end
	if climbed then
		mark("rope")
	else
		run.stuck += 1
		log(run, "STUCK rope climb")
	end
	-- 5 the Rare
	p, m = findPrompt("Creatures", "Creature_nook_rare_r1", "ClaimPrompt")
	if p then
		walkTo(run, m.PrimaryPart.Position, 12, 4)
		hold(p)
	end
	if waitFor(function()
		return tutStep() >= 6
	end, 5) then
		mark("rare")
	end
	-- 6 the pup: get down, cross to the hollow (west of the hide spot), net from near max range
	local SAFE = Vector3.new(-1030, 70, 1990) -- retreat point north-north-west of the nest, open ground
	walkTo(run, Vector3.new(-1045, 111, 1884), 10, 4)
	walkTo(run, SAFE, 30, 5)
	local pupPos = st.tut and st.tut.target
	p, m = findPrompt("NestLive", "Pup_nest_r1_hollow", "NetPrompt")
	local function hasEpic()
		for _, it in ipairs(st.items or {}) do
			if it.rarity == "Epic" then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	for attempt = 1, 4 do
		if not (p and pupPos) or hasEpic() then
			break
		end
		-- wait until the guardian is away from the pup and not checking the nest
		waitFor(function()
			local gm = guardian("nest_r1_hollow")
			return not gm or (gm:GetAttribute("State") == "Patrol" and not gm:GetAttribute("Looking") and (flat(gm:GetPivot().Position) - flat(pupPos)).Magnitude > 16)
		end, 20)
		local stand = pupPos + flat(SAFE - pupPos).Unit * 12
		walkTo(run, stand, 20, 2)
		local dist = (hrp.Position - m.PrimaryPart.Position).Magnitude
		hold(p)
		if waitFor(hasEpic, 2) then
			break
		end
		log(run, string.format("net attempt %d failed (3D distance %.1f, prompt enabled %s)", attempt, dist, tostring(p.Enabled)))
		if lastFx.loss and os.clock() - lastFx.loss.t < 6 then
			run.hits += 1
		end
		walkTo(run, SAFE, 20, 5)
		recoverPacks(run)
		walkTo(run, SAFE, 20, 5)
	end
	if hasEpic() then
		mark("pup")
	end
	-- the guardian wakes: retreat north behind the hide spot until it gives up
	if WANT_HIT and i % 2 == 0 then
		-- walk into the guardian once so the hit + drop pack + recovery path runs
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - t0 < 20 and not (lastFx.loss and lastFx.loss.t > t0) do
			local g = guardian("nest_r1_hollow")
			if g then
				hum:MoveTo(g:GetPivot().Position)
			end
			task.wait(0.2)
		end
		if lastFx.loss and os.clock() - lastFx.loss.t < 15 then
			run.hits += 1
			log(run, "hit by guardian (intended)")
			task.wait(2.5)
			-- run away first, then come back for the pack
			walkTo(run, SAFE, 15, 5)
			waitFor(function()
				local gm = guardian("nest_r1_hollow")
				return not gm or gm:GetAttribute("State") == "Patrol" or gm:GetAttribute("State") == "Retreat"
			end, 15)
			recoverPacks(run)
		end
	end
	walkTo(run, SAFE, 20, 5)
	waitFor(function()
		local gm = guardian("nest_r1_hollow")
		return not gm or gm:GetAttribute("State") == "Patrol"
	end, 20)
	-- 7 Heartstone: go in while it walks the ring (not checking the nest), retry if hit
	local hsP, hsM = findPrompt("NestLive", "Heartstone_nest_r1_hollow", "HeartstonePrompt")
	local function hasHS()
		for _, it in ipairs(st.items or {}) do
			if it.kind == "heartstone" then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	for attempt = 1, 5 do
		if hasHS() then
			break
		end
		-- go in while it walks the far side of its ring and is not checking the nest
		waitFor(function()
			local gm = guardian("nest_r1_hollow")
			if not gm or not hsM then
				return true
			end
			local c = flat(hsM.PrimaryPart.Position)
			local away = (flat(gm:GetPivot().Position) - c):Dot((c - flat(SAFE)).Unit)
			return gm:GetAttribute("State") == "Patrol" and not gm:GetAttribute("Looking") and away > 4
		end, 25)
		if hsP then
			walkTo(run, hsM.PrimaryPart.Position, 15, 5)
			hold(hsP)
		end
		if waitFor(hasHS, 2) then
			break
		end
		log(run, "Heartstone attempt " .. attempt .. " failed")
		if lastFx.loss and os.clock() - lastFx.loss.t < 6 then
			run.hits += 1
		end
		walkTo(run, SAFE, 15, 5)
		recoverPacks(run)
		walkTo(run, SAFE, 15, 5)
	end
	if hasHS() then
		mark("heartstone")
	end
	-- 8 home: cross the foothills east to the campfire
	recoverPacks(run)
	-- home: north of the nest (clear of the guardian's ring and the hide-spot boulders), then east across the foothills
	-- (the last legs avoid the cabin terraces west of the plaza: in by the north-west, as on the way out)
	for _, wp in ipairs({ Vector3.new(-960, 85, 2000), Vector3.new(-880, 80, 2040), Vector3.new(-760, 45, 2110), Vector3.new(-500, 55, 2090), Vector3.new(-330, 50, 2010), Vector3.new(-150, 49, 1880), fire.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 8) }) do
		walkTo(run, wp, nil, 6)
	end
	hold(fire.BankPrompt)
	-- if the Heartstone was shaken into a pack on the way, go back for it and bank again (as a player would)
	for _ = 1, 2 do
		if waitFor(function()
			return tutStep() >= 9
		end, 5) then
			break
		end
		if not (st.packs and #st.packs > 0) then
			break
		end
		log(run, "Heartstone still in a drop pack: going back for it")
		recoverPacks(run)
		for _, wp in ipairs({ Vector3.new(-960, 85, 2000), Vector3.new(-880, 80, 2040), Vector3.new(-760, 45, 2110), Vector3.new(-500, 55, 2090), Vector3.new(-330, 50, 2010), Vector3.new(-150, 49, 1880), fire.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 8) }) do
			walkTo(run, wp, nil, 6)
		end
		hold(fire.BankPrompt)
	end
	if tutStep() >= 9 then
		mark("bank2")
	end
	-- 9 while the Heartstone ripens: two finds on the Foothold outskirts (shared commons; nearest one still there)
	local OUT_WP = { out_3 = { Vector3.new(-150, 49, 1880) }, out_1 = { Vector3.new(-150, 49, 1880), Vector3.new(-330, 50, 2010) } }
	for _ = 1, 2 do
		if tutStep() ~= 9 then
			break
		end
		local best, bd
		for _, m2 in ipairs(workspace.World.Core.Creatures:GetChildren()) do
			local id = string.match(m2.Name, "^Creature_(out_%d)$") or string.match(m2.Name, "^Creature_(shep_1)$")
			if id and m2.PrimaryPart then
				local d = (m2.PrimaryPart.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
				if not bd or d < bd then
					best, bd = m2, d
				end
			end
		end
		if not best then
			break
		end
		local id = string.match(best.Name, "^Creature_(.+)$")
		for _, wp in ipairs(OUT_WP[id] or {}) do
			walkTo(run, wp, nil, 6)
		end
		walkTo(run, best.PrimaryPart.Position, nil, 5)
		local pr = best:FindFirstChild("ClaimPrompt", true)
		if pr then
			hold(pr)
		end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
	if waitFor(function()
		return tutStep() >= 10
	end, 5) then
		mark("outskirts")
	end
	-- 10 bank them
	for _, wp in ipairs({ Vector3.new(-150, 49, 1880), fire.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 8) }) do
		walkTo(run, wp, nil, 6)
	end
	hold(fire.BankPrompt)
	if waitFor(function()
		return tutStep() >= 11
	end, 5) then
		mark("bank3")
	end
	-- 11 cliffhanger plays (~7 s), then done (12)
	if waitFor(function()
		return tutStep() >= 12
	end, 15) then
		mark("done")
	end
	run.level, run.xp = st.level, st.xp
	run.total = os.clock() - run.t0
	run.finalStep = tutStep()
	run.pack = st.used
	run.heartstones = st.heartstones and #st.heartstones or 0
	return run
end

return function(cfg)
	cfg = cfg or {}
	RUNS, SPEED, WANT_HIT = cfg.runs or 1, cfg.speed or 12, cfg.hit == true
	B = { status = "running", runs = {}, log = {}, speed = SPEED }
	_G.CC_TBOT = B
	dev:FireServer("botSpeed", { factor = SPEED / 12 })
task.spawn(function()
	for i = 1, RUNS do
		local ok, err = pcall(oneRun, i)
		if not ok then
			B.log[#B.log + 1] = "run " .. i .. " ERROR " .. tostring(err)
		end
		B.where = "finished run " .. i
	end
	local _, hum = char()
	hum.WalkSpeed = 12
	B.status = "done"
end)
return "tutorial bot started: runs " .. RUNS .. " speed " .. SPEED
end
sources.src/core/server/Clock.luau:
-- Clock (ServerScriptService.CC_CoreServer): the only source of wall time for persistence and timers.
-- os.time() (UTC seconds) in play; tests move `offset` to simulate offline gaps (A1 acceptance).
local Clock = { offset = 0 }

function Clock.now()
	return os.time() + Clock.offset
end

return Clock
sources.src/core/server/Camps.luau:
-- Camps (ServerScriptService.CC_CoreServer): the Foothold bank point, guardian-free safe zones (Foothold + tents),
-- Camp Lockers, highest reached camp and resume (LOCKED: sessions start at the highest reached camp).
-- * Bank: a hold prompt on the existing plaza campfire (no new geometry; the Foothold layout stays frozen).
-- * Safe zones: the Foothold pad and a small radius around each camp (tent tier 1 = 46 studs, PROPOSED);
--   guardians never enter them (Nests asks Camps.isSafe).
-- * Locker: 1 slot at tent tier 1 (LOCKED 1 -> 3 by tier). Locker items are safe from falls and hits, persist in
--   the profile (lockers[camp]), are not banked (no codex/XP/yield) and are moved only by server-validated
--   requests from a player standing at that locker.
-- * Resume: a returning player (highestCamp >= 1) starts at that camp; for the first 60 s, with an empty
--   backpack, "Start at the Foothold" is offered instead (PROPOSED; no cargo can skip the risky return).
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local SS = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local Camps = {}
local ctx, C, Inv, Clock, Prompts
local api
local campPads = {} -- [name] = { name, order, center, label }
local lockerParts = {} -- [name] = BasePart
local resumeWindow = {} -- [plr] = os.clock() deadline
local openLocker = {} -- [plr] = camp name

local function campOfPos(pos)
	for name, cp in pairs(campPads) do
		if (pos - cp.center).Magnitude < 70 then
			return name
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function Camps.safeRadius(name, userIdOrSession)
	local tier = 1
	if type(userIdOrSession) == "table" and userIdOrSession.data then
		tier = userIdOrSession.data.tents[name] or 1
	end
	return C.CAMP_SAFE_RADIUS[tier] or C.CAMP_SAFE_RADIUS[1]
end

-- isSafe(pos) -> true inside the Foothold or any camp's tent radius (guardian-free, LOCKED)
function Camps.isSafe(pos)
	local f = C.FOOTHOLD_SAFE
	if ((pos - f.center) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude < f.radius and pos.Y < f.center.Y + 60 then
		return true
	end
	for name, cp in pairs(campPads) do
		if ((pos - cp.center) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude < Camps.safeRadius(name) and math.abs(pos.Y - cp.center.Y) < 40 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function lockerSlots(s, camp)
	local tier = s.data.tents[camp] or 1
	return C.LOCKER_SLOTS[tier] or 1
end
local function lockerUsed(s, camp)
	local n = 0
	for _, it in ipairs(s.data.lockers[camp] or {}) do
		n += it.slots or 1
	end
	return n
end

local function nearLocker(plr, camp)
	local part = lockerParts[camp]
	local hrp = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return part and hrp and (hrp.Position - part.Position).Magnitude < 16
end

local function lockerView(s, camp)
	local items = {}
	for _, it in ipairs(s.data.lockers[camp] or {}) do
		items[#items + 1] = ctx.Cargo.clientItem({ uid = it.uid, kind = it.kind, species = it.species, rarity = it.rarity, tier = it.tier, slots = it.slots })
	end
	return { camp = camp, label = campPads[camp] and campPads[camp].label or camp, slots = lockerSlots(s, camp), used = lockerUsed(s, camp), items = items }
end

function Camps.state(plr, st)
	local camp = openLocker[plr]
	local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
	if camp and s then
		st.locker = lockerView(s, camp)
	end
 local root=plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local nearby=root and campOfPos(root.Position)
 if nearby then st.travelOffer={camp=nearby,label=campPads[nearby].label,available=true} end
 st.lockers={}
 if s then for name,items in pairs(s.data.lockers) do table.insert(st.lockers,{camp=name,label=campPads[name] and campPads[name].label or name,count=#items}) end end
 st.resumeOffer = resumeWindow[plr] and (os.clock() < resumeWindow[plr]) or false
end

local function teleport(plr, pos)
	if ctx.Traversal then ctx.Traversal.travel(plr,pos+Vector3.new(0,4,0),"resume") return end
	local ch = plr.Character
	if ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		ch.HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)))
	end
end

function Camps.init(c)
	ctx = c
	C, Inv, Clock = c.C, c.Inv, c.Clock
	Prompts = require(script.Parent.Prompts)
	ctx.Camps = Camps
	local world = workspace:WaitForChild("World")
	api = SS:WaitForChild("CC_CheckpointAPI", 10)

	-- camp pads from the checkpoint triggers (Camp1..Camp4); lockers from the built camp props
	local cps = world:WaitForChild("Checkpoints")
	for _, t in ipairs(cps:GetChildren()) do
		local name = t:GetAttribute("Checkpoint")
		if name and table.find(C.RESUME_CAMPS, name) then
			campPads[name] = { name = name, order = t:GetAttribute("Order"), center = t.Position - Vector3.new(0, t.Size.Y / 2, 0), label = t:GetAttribute("Label") or name }
		end
	end
	local campsF = world:FindFirstChild("Camps")
	for name in pairs(campPads) do
		local f = campsF and campsF:FindFirstChild(name)
		local lk = f and f:FindFirstChild("CampLocker")
		local box = lk and lk:FindFirstChild("Box")
		if box then
			lockerParts[name] = box
			local p = Prompts.make(box, { Name = "LockerPrompt", ActionText = "Open locker", ObjectText = campPads[name].label .. " Camp Locker", HoldDuration = 0, MaxActivationDistance = 10 })
			p.Triggered:Connect(function(plr)
				if not Prompts.validate(p,plr) or not ctx.sessions[plr] then
					ctx.toast(plr, "Lockers open once your profile has loaded.", "warn")
					return
				end
				openLocker[plr] = name
				ctx.fx(plr, { kind = "locker", open = true })
				ctx.push(plr)
			end)
		end
	end

	-- the bank: hold on the plaza campfire
	local fire = world:WaitForChild("Regions"):WaitForChild("Foothold"):WaitForChild("Core"):FindFirstChild("Campfire")
	local corePart = fire and fire:FindFirstChild("Core")
	if corePart then
		local p = Prompts.make(corePart, { Name = "BankPrompt", ActionText = "Bank finds", ObjectText = "Expedition campfire", HoldDuration = 0.5, MaxActivationDistance = 14 })
		Camps.bankPart = corePart
		local last = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		p.Triggered:Connect(function(plr)
			if not Prompts.validate(p, plr) then
				return
			end
			if last[plr] and os.clock() - last[plr] < 0.8 then
				return -- double tap: the second trigger would find an empty pack anyway
			end
			last[plr] = os.clock()
			ctx.deposit(plr)
		end)
	else
		warn("[CC] Camps: plaza campfire not found; no bank point")
	end

	-- highest camp (only Camp1..Camp4 count; checkpoint service reports every camp touch)
	if api then
		api:WaitForChild("CampReached").Event:Connect(function(plr, name, order)
			local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
			local cp = campPads[name]
			if s and cp then
				local idx = table.find(C.RESUME_CAMPS, name)
				if idx and idx > s.data.highestCamp then
					s.data.highestCamp = idx
					-- Camp progression is monotonic. A pending candidate must not overwrite a camp reached
					-- while its DataStore request is yielding; Profile merges the live maximum on recovery.
					if s.pending then s.pending.candidate.highestCamp = math.max(s.pending.candidate.highestCamp or 0, idx) end
					s.dirty = true
					if not s.pending then ctx.saveSoon(s) else s.saveAgain = true end
					ctx.toast(plr, "New highest camp: " .. cp.label .. ". Next session starts here.", "good")
					ctx.push(plr)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

 -- Locker transfers commit both locations atomically, preserving item records.
 local function transfer(plr,p,take)
  local session=ctx.sessions[plr]
  local camp=openLocker[plr]
  local hum=plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not session or not camp or not hum or hum.Health<=0 or not nearLocker(plr,camp) or type(p.uid)~="string" or #p.uid>128 then return end
  local tx="locker:"..game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
  local r=ctx.transaction(plr,tx,function(d)
   d.lockers[camp]=d.lockers[camp] or {}
   local from=take and d.lockers[camp] or d.cargo
   local to=take and d.cargo or d.lockers[camp]
   local i,it=ctx.Cargo.locate(from,p.uid)
   if not it then return {ok=false,reason="missing"} end
   local cap=take and d.slots or (C.LOCKER_SLOTS[d.tents[camp] or 1] or 1)
   if ctx.Cargo.used(to)+(it.slots or 1)>cap then return {ok=false,reason="full"} end
   table.remove(from,i) table.insert(to,it)
   return {ok=true}
  end,function() ctx.invChanged(plr) ctx.toast(plr,take and "Retrieved. Carry it to the Foothold bank." or "Stored safely at this camp. Return here to retrieve it.","good") end)
  if not r.ok then ctx.toast(plr,r.reason=="full" and "Not enough room." or "Waiting for saving; the transfer is not confirmed.","warn") end
 end
 ctx.handlers.lockerStore=function(plr,p) transfer(plr,p,false) end
 ctx.handlers.lockerTake=function(plr,p) transfer(plr,p,true) end
 ctx.handlers.shuttle=function(plr)
  local session=ctx.sessions[plr]
  local root=plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local hum=plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local camp=root and campOfPos(root.Position)
  if not session or not camp or not hum or hum.Health<=0 or hum.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air then return end
  local state=plr.Character:GetAttribute("CC_TraversalState")
  if state and state~="ground" then return end
  local sp=workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpawnLocation")
  if not sp or not ctx.Traversal then return end
  -- Arrival is the entrance/spawn terrace. Cargo stays carried; no automatic banking.
  ctx.transaction(plr,"shuttle:"..game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false),function(d)
   d.expedition.returnedAt=Clock.now() d.expedition.returnFrom=camp
   return {ok=true}
  end,function()
   local current=plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   local currentHum=plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
   local currentState=plr.Character and plr.Character:GetAttribute("CC_TraversalState")
   if ctx.sessions[plr]~=session or not current or not currentHum or currentHum.Health<=0 or currentHum.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air or (currentState and currentState~="ground") or campOfPos(current.Position)~=camp then
    ctx.toast(plr,"Shuttle ready. Return to that camp to board.","info")
    return
   end
   if api then api.SetCheckpoint:Invoke(plr,nil) end
   ctx.Traversal.travel(plr,sp.Position+Vector3.new(0,4,0),"shuttle")
   ctx.toast(plr,"Foothold entrance. Your cargo is with you; walk to the campfire bank.","good")
   ctx.push(plr)
  end)
 end
	ctx.handlers.lockerClose = function(plr)
		openLocker[plr] = nil
		ctx.push(plr)
	end
	ctx.handlers.resumeFoothold = function(plr)
		if resumeWindow[plr] and os.clock() < resumeWindow[plr] and Inv.used(plr.UserId) == 0 then
			resumeWindow[plr] = nil
			-- clear the checkpoint first: the move down to the Foothold must not read as a fall
			if api then
				api.SetCheckpoint:Invoke(plr, nil)
			end
			local sp = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpawnLocation")
			if sp then
				teleport(plr, sp.Position)
			end
			ctx.push(plr)
		end
	end

	-- close the locker panel when walking away; camp attribute for the HUD zone name
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.5)
			for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local hrp = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if hrp then
					local camp = campOfPos(hrp.Position)
					local label = camp and ((hrp.Position - campPads[camp].center) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude < Camps.safeRadius(camp) and campPads[camp].label or ""
					if plr:GetAttribute("CC_Camp") ~= label then
						plr:SetAttribute("CC_Camp", label)
					end
					if openLocker[plr] and not nearLocker(plr, openLocker[plr]) then
						openLocker[plr] = nil
						ctx.push(plr)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

function Camps.onLoaded(plr, s)
	local idx = s.data.highestCamp
	local name = C.RESUME_CAMPS[idx]
	if not name or not campPads[name] or not api then
		return
	end
	local pos = api.SetCheckpoint:Invoke(plr, name)
	-- Cargo reconnect and home return own their location. Do not first move them to the highest camp.
	if s.data.expedition.homeReturn or (#s.data.cargo > 0 and s.data.expedition.returnPos) then return end
	if pos then
		resumeWindow[plr] = os.clock() + 60
		local ch = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
		ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
		teleport(plr, pos)
		ctx.fx(plr, { kind = "resume", camp = campPads[name].label })
		ctx.toast(plr, "Resuming at " .. campPads[name].label .. " (your highest camp).", "info")
		ctx.push(plr)
	end
end

function Camps.onLeave(plr)
	openLocker[plr] = nil
	resumeWindow[plr] = nil
end

Camps._pads = campPads
return Camps
