-- Three finite practice lessons, validated by actual authored traversal completions; no countdown.
local HS=game:GetService("HttpService")
local Training={}
local ctx,station,Prompts
local open,active={},{}
local function near(plr)
 local p=plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 return station and p and (p.Position-station.Position).Magnitude<20
end
local function unlocked(d,i)
 local t=d.gear.training
 return i==1 or (t.unlocked and t.unlocked[tostring(i)]==true) or (t.level or 0)>=i
end
function Training.canUseSection(plr,i)
	local s=ctx.sessions[plr]
	return s~=nil and unlocked(s.data,i)
end
local function commitLesson(plr,a)
 if active[plr]~=a or not a.finishing or a.inFlight or a.awaitingConfirmation then return end
 local s=ctx.sessions[plr]
 if s~=a.session then active[plr]=nil return end
 if s.closing or s.lost or s.pending or s.busy or s.saving or s.outcomePending then return end
 a.inFlight=true
 local lesson=a.id
 local r=ctx.transaction(plr,"practicefinish:"..lesson..":"..plr.UserId,function(d)
  if not unlocked(d,lesson) then return {ok=false,reason="locked"} end
  d.gear.training.completed=d.gear.training.completed or {}
  if d.gear.training.completed[tostring(lesson)] then return {ok=true,repeatLesson=true} end
  d.gear.training.completed[tostring(lesson)]=true
  return {ok=true}
 end,function(result)
  if a.confirmed then return end
  a.confirmed=true
  if active[plr]==a then active[plr]=nil end
  if ctx.sessions[plr]~=s or not plr.Parent then return end
  ctx.Gear.dress(plr)
  if not result.dup then
   ctx.toast(plr,result.repeatLesson and "Practice complete. This lesson is already earned." or "Practice complete! Your finite stamina training advanced.","good")
  end
  ctx.push(plr)
 end)
 a.inFlight=false
 if r.pending then
  -- CoreService owns recovery and invokes the original callback after a durable receipt.
  a.awaitingConfirmation=true
 elseif not r.ok and r.reason~="busy" and not a.errorShown then
  a.errorShown=true
  ctx.toast(plr,"Your practice finish is waiting to save. Please keep this session open.","info")
 end
end
function Training.init(c)
 ctx=c Prompts=require(script.Parent.Prompts)
 local yard=workspace.World:FindFirstChild("TrainingYard")
 station=yard and yard:FindFirstChild("StartGate")
 if not station then warn("[CC] Practice station missing") return end
 local pr=Prompts.make(station,{Name="PracticePrompt",ActionText="Practice climbing",ObjectText="Home practice crag",HoldDuration=0,MaxActivationDistance=12})
 pr.Triggered:Connect(function(plr) if Prompts.validate(pr,plr) and ctx.sessions[plr] then open[plr]=true ctx.fx(plr,{kind="practice",open=true}) ctx.push(plr) end end)
 ctx.handlers.practiceClose=function(plr) open[plr]=nil ctx.push(plr) end
 ctx.handlers.practiceBuy=function(plr,p)
  local i=p.id local s=ctx.sessions[plr]
  if type(i)~="number" or i%1~=0 or i<1 or i>3 or not s or not near(plr) then return end
  local r=ctx.transaction(plr,"practicebuy:"..HS:GenerateGUID(false),function(d)
   if unlocked(d,i) then return {ok=false,reason="owned"} end
   if i>1 and not (d.gear.training.completed and d.gear.training.completed[tostring(i-1)]) and (d.gear.training.level or 0)<i-1 then return {ok=false,reason="previous"} end
   local cost=ctx.C.PRACTICE.costs[i]
   if d.coins<cost then return {ok=false,reason="coins"} end
   d.coins-=cost d.gear.training.unlocked=d.gear.training.unlocked or {} d.gear.training.unlocked[tostring(i)]=true
   return {ok=true}
  end,function() ctx.toast(plr,"Practice section unlocked permanently.","good") ctx.push(plr) end)
  if not r.ok and not r.pending then ctx.toast(plr,r.reason=="coins" and "Not enough Cairn Coins." or "Complete the previous section first.","info") end
 end
 ctx.handlers.practiceStart=function(plr,p)
  local i=p.id local s=ctx.sessions[plr]
  if type(i)~="number" or i%1~=0 or i<1 or i>3 or not s or not near(plr) or not unlocked(s.data,i) then return end
  if active[plr] and active[plr].finishing then
   ctx.toast(plr,"Your completed lesson is still saving. Please wait before starting another.","info")
   return
  end
  active[plr]={id=i,next=1,session=s}
  open[plr]=nil
  ctx.toast(plr,"Climb the practice walls in order. Take your time; the bell is your finish.","info")
  ctx.push(plr)
 end
 ctx.on("traversalSection",function(plr,id)
  local s=ctx.sessions[plr] local a=active[plr]
  if not s or not a or a.finishing or id~="Practice:"..a.next then return end
  a.next+=1
  if a.next<=a.id then return end
  a.finishing=true
  ctx.toast(plr,"Practice walls complete. Saving your training…","info")
  commitLesson(plr,a)
 end)
 task.spawn(function()
  while true do
   task.wait(0.5)
   for plr,a in pairs(active) do
    if a.finishing and not a.inFlight and not a.awaitingConfirmation then
     task.spawn(function() commitLesson(plr,a) end)
    end
   end
  end
 end)
end
function Training.state(plr,st)
 local s=ctx.sessions[plr] if not s then return end
 if open[plr] and not near(plr) then open[plr]=nil end
 if open[plr] then
  local sections={}
  for i=1,3 do table.insert(sections,{id=i,label=ctx.C.PRACTICE.labels[i],cost=ctx.C.PRACTICE.costs[i],gain=ctx.C.PRACTICE.gains[i],unlocked=unlocked(s.data,i),complete=s.data.gear.training.completed and s.data.gear.training.completed[tostring(i)] or false}) end
  st.practice={open=true,sections=sections,bonus=ctx.Gear.trainingBonus(s),cap=ctx.C.PRACTICE.staminaCap}
 end
end
function Training.onLeave(plr) open[plr]=nil active[plr]=nil end
return Training

-- CoreConfig (ReplicatedStorage.CC_Core): every core-loop number in one place.
-- LOCKED = user answer (design/core-loop-plan.md, master.md Â§0.7); PROPOSED = brief Â§3 default or a Run 1 choice
-- (logged in design/decision-log.md); ESTIMATE = not measured. Shared by server and client (no secrets here).
local C = {}

-- Rarity (LOCKED: 5 tiers; yield/h; duplicate 25%; mutation +50%)
C.RARITIES = { "Common", "Uncommon", "Rare", "Epic", "Legendary" }
C.RANK = { Common = 1, Uncommon = 2, Rare = 3, Epic = 4, Legendary = 5 }
C.YIELD_PER_HOUR = { Common = 1, Uncommon = 3, Rare = 10, Epic = 35, Legendary = 150 }
C.DUPLICATE_YIELD = 0.25
C.MUTATION_BONUS = 0.5
-- Rarity tint is secondary to pips/border (LOCKED); tints are existing world tokens (PROPOSED mapping).
C.RARITY_TINT = {
	Common = Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 255), -- moonlight
	Uncommon = Color3.fromRGB(84, 176, 82), -- meadowEmerald
	Rare = Color3.fromRGB(92, 184, 245), -- skyBlue
	Epic = Color3.fromRGB(138, 78, 255), -- electricViolet
	Legendary = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 150), -- goldenDaylight
}

-- Progression (PROPOSED, B-polish 2026-10-20): XP on bank, first-of-species x1.5 (floored), cumulative XP to reach
-- L1..L9. Was 10/25/80/250/1000 with x2, which ended the tutorial at L4 (Epic pup alone = 500 XP). Now the tutorial
-- (common + Rare + pup + two outskirts finds) ends at L2 with ~25 XP to spare before L3 (user: "must not end at L4").
C.XP_ON_BANK = { Common = 10, Uncommon = 20, Rare = 40, Epic = 80, Legendary = 300 }
C.FIRST_OF_SPECIES_XP = 1.5
-- The tutorial Rare (guardian-free nook) can't be shaken loose by a guardian or a fall until it has been banked once
-- (user review 2026-10-20, "Protect it"). Matched by the item's spawn source.
C.TUTORIAL_RARE_SOURCE = "nook_rare_r1"
-- Tutorial beat 9 (after the Heartstone is banked): claim two finds on the Foothold outskirts while it ripens.
C.TUT_OUTSKIRTS = { "out_3", "out_1", "out_2", "shep_1" }
C.TUT_OUTSKIRTS_TIMEOUT = 150 -- s: shared commons may be taken by others; the beat never blocks the tutorial
C.LEVEL_XP = { 0, 100, 250, 500, 900, 1500, 2400, 3800, 6000 }
-- Backpack (LOCKED: 4 -> 12; L2-7 +1 each; two major codex milestones +1 each; L8-9 stamina only)
C.SLOTS_BASE = 4
C.SLOTS_MAX = 12
C.SLOT_LEVELS = { 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 }
C.SLOT_MILESTONES = { 10, 25 } -- distinct species in the codex (PROPOSED thresholds)
-- Coins on bank (PROPOSED: equal to the rarity's LOCKED yield/h; real economy is tuned in Phase D/G)
C.COINS_ON_BANK = C.YIELD_PER_HOUR

-- Heartstone (LOCKED: 2 slots, ripen Common 5 min / Rare 30 min / Legendary 4 h)
C.HEARTSTONE_SLOTS = 2
C.HEARTSTONE_TIERS = { "Common", "Rare", "Legendary" }
C.RIPEN_SECONDS = { Common = 300, Rare = 1800, Legendary = 14400 }
-- What a ripe Heartstone becomes (PROPOSED): rarity weights by tier, species from the nest's region.
C.HATCH_WEIGHTS = {
	Common = { Common = 70, Uncommon = 30 },
	Rare = { Rare = 100 },
	Legendary = { Legendary = 100 },
}
C.HEARTSTONE_VALUE = { Common = 30, Rare = 60, Legendary = 100 } -- shake order: above any carried creature

-- Claims (PROPOSED): hold seconds by rarity; Heartstone hold 3 s (brief Â§3.4), longer by tier
C.HOLD_SECONDS = { Common = 1.0, Uncommon = 1.5, Rare = 2.0, Epic = 2.0, Legendary = 3.0 }
C.HEARTSTONE_HOLD = { Common = 3.0, Rare = 4.0, Legendary = 5.0 }
C.CLAIM_RANGE = 10 -- prompt MaxActivationDistance (studs)
C.HOLD_TOLERANCE = 0.3 -- seconds of network slack accepted on a hold
-- Net (LOCKED: 3 tiers set throw range and interaction time only; cloth free). Numbers PROPOSED.
C.NET_TIERS = {
	cloth = { order = 1, range = 18, hold = 1.5 },
	rope = { order = 2, range = 24, hold = 1.2, level = 4 },
	aurora = { order = 3, range = 30, hold = 1.0 },
}
C.PUP_COOLDOWN = 600 -- one pup per guardian per cooldown (LOCKED rule, 10 min PROPOSED = nest respawn)

-- Bank travel check (PROPOSED, anti-exploit): a find must have been carried at least
-- distance(origin, bank) / (WalkSpeed * TRAVEL_SLACK) - 2 s before it can be banked; faster = it stays in the pack.
C.WALK_SPEED = 12
C.TRAVEL_SLACK = 1.5

-- Risk (LOCKED: drop pack 3 min; hit = stagger + one unbanked item; no shake in R1 before first bank)
C.DROP_PACK_SECONDS = 180
C.STAGGER_SECONDS = 1.2 -- brief Â§3.3
C.STAGGER_IMMUNE = 2.0
C.FALL_SHAKES = 1 -- items moved to the drop pack per accepted fall (PROPOSED; partial loss)

-- Nests + guardians (brief Â§3.3/Â§3.4; PROPOSED within the brief's ranges; R1 = gentle)
C.NEST_RESPAWN = 600
C.GUARDIAN = {
	tell = 1.6, -- Alert tell >= 1.5 s
	loseYou = 3.0, -- search time before retreat
	leash = 110, -- max distance from its nest
	reach = 3.5, -- hit distance added to its half size
	region = { -- speed as a fraction of WalkSpeed 12, sense range in studs, size factor
		[1] = { speed = { 0.55, 0.7 }, sense = { 25, 34 }, size = { 0.8, 1.0 }, weakness = { "height" } },
	},
	tierStep = 0.10, -- +10% sense/speed per nest value tier (and per region step)
	maxSpeed = 1.15, -- never faster than 1.15x run speed (fairness)
}

-- Camps (LOCKED: tents are guardian-free; small safe radius; locker 1 -> 3 by tent tier)
C.CAMP_SAFE_RADIUS = { 46, 52, 58 } -- by tent tier (PROPOSED)
C.FOOTHOLD_SAFE = { center = Vector3.new(0, 48, 2160), radius = 330 } -- whole Foothold pad + amphitheater
C.LOCKER_SLOTS = { 1, 2, 3 } -- by tent tier
C.RESUME_CAMPS = { "Camp1", "Camp2", "Camp3", "Camp4" }

-- Persistence (brief Â§3.9: autosave 60 s + on leave, retry with backoff, session lock)
C.PERSIST = {
	dataStore = "CC_Profiles_v1",
	keyPrefix = "p_",
	autosave = 60,
	lockTTL = 240, -- a lock older than this (no autosave refresh) is considered dead
	loadTries = 6,
	lockWait = 5,
	saveTries = 4,
	txKeep = 32,
	maxBytes = 3500000,
}

C.REGIONS = { "GreenValley", "WhisperingForest", "BrokenCliffs", "StormRidge", "FrozenSummit" }

-- v4 climb state (LOCKED: marked faces, stamina, auto-grab, Jump = lunge, slide + catch window, fall -> last
-- checkpoint; numbers PROPOSED, v4-climb-concept Â§3: ~25-35 s per bar, refill ~5-8 s, catch ~1.5-2 s)
C.CLIMB = {
	speed = 7, -- studs/s on a face (walk is 12)
	grabDist = 2.6, -- auto-grab when pushed into a marked face within this distance of the root
	holdDist = 1.55, -- root distance kept from the face while climbing
	lungeDist = 8, -- Jump on a face = lunge this far in the stick direction (up when idle)
	lungeTime = 0.32,
	lungeCost = 12,
	stamina = 100,
	drainMove = 3.3, -- ~30 s of continuous climbing per bar
	drainHold = 1.4,
	regenGround = 12.5, -- full in 8 s on any ground
	regenRest = 25, -- full in 4 s on a rest ledge (parts with RestLedge = true)
	catchWindow = 1.75, -- seconds to re-grab after a slip
	catchStamina = 15, -- a caught slip leaves this much grip (one catch per slip)
	slideSpeed = 14,
	releaseCooldown = 0.45,
	fov = 80, -- camera FOV while on a face (auto-frame; the player can still orbit)
	cameraOffset = Vector3.new(0, -1.2, 3.2), -- character space: out from the face and a little down
	steepNormalY = 0.66, -- no jumping while standing on ground steeper than ~49 deg (jump-spam would climb any slope)
	-- v4 P3 (run 2): marked faces can also be terrain of this material (used nowhere else in the terrain), so pitch
	-- stacks cost no instances; ledges on rest spots are terrain too, so rest is by a RestZone part/attribute
	terrainMaterial = Enum.Material.Asphalt,
	descendGrab = 0.7, -- s after walking off an edge in which a marked face behind/below is auto-grabbed (two-way lines)
 -- Surface equipment multipliers are owned by TraversalConfig (no altitude survival rules).
 cramponDrain = 0.8,
 ropeDrain = 0.5,
}

-- v4 P4 (run 2): currencies + gear shop (user: "Both" currencies, "Mid 150-1,200" prices; items, prices and
-- unlock levels PROPOSED). Cairn Coins = existing coins (banking, yield). Summit Points = expedition currency:
-- camps and summits reached (first time per route pays more). Shop = cosmetics only (master.md Â§0.7: currency never
-- buys creatures or Heartstones; nothing sold gives a competitive claim advantage). Colors = world tokens.
C.POINTS = {
	camp = 10, -- each camp touch (once per camp per trip: a trip resets at the Foothold)
	summit = 60, -- reaching the Summit
	firstSummitRoute = 140, -- extra, the first summit by each route (Shepherd, Waterfall, Ledge, Spire)
}
C.SHOP = {
	{ id = "cap_trail", slot = "head", name = "Trail Cap", price = 150, cur = "coins", color = { 214, 150, 82 }, color2 = { 62, 66, 76 } }, -- sandstoneAmber / charcoalSlate
	{ id = "helm_climb", slot = "head", name = "Climber Helmet", price = 400, cur = "coins", color = { 255, 178, 72 }, color2 = { 62, 66, 76 } }, -- lanternGold
	{ id = "helm_storm", slot = "head", name = "Storm Helm", price = 900, cur = "points", color = { 46, 72, 122 }, color2 = { 62, 224, 255 } }, -- stormBlue / electricCyan
	{ id = "gog_glacier", slot = "eyes", name = "Glacier Goggles", price = 300, cur = "coins", color = { 196, 232, 255 }, color2 = { 62, 66, 76 } }, -- iceBlue
	{ id = "gog_aurora", slot = "eyes", name = "Aurora Goggles", price = 750, cur = "points", color = { 156, 92, 246 }, color2 = { 220, 230, 255 } }, -- auroraPurple / moonlight
	{ id = "suit_wool", slot = "body", name = "Shepherd Wool", price = 250, cur = "coins", color = { 192, 166, 96 }, color2 = { 150, 82, 54 } }, -- dryGrass / redEarth
	{ id = "suit_ledge", slot = "body", name = "Ledge Shell", price = 600, cur = "coins", color = { 38, 112, 98 }, color2 = { 255, 178, 72 } }, -- forestTeal / lanternGold
	{ id = "suit_summit", slot = "body", name = "Summit Down Suit", price = 1200, cur = "points", color = { 30, 62, 140 }, color2 = { 196, 232, 255 } }, -- deepSapphire / iceBlue
}
-- earned kit (concept Â§4: changes route choices, not raw power; visible on the avatar). Level or Forge purchase.
C.KIT = {
	headlamp = { name = "Headlamp", level = 2, forge = 150, info = "Lights the rock at night." },
	axe = { name = "Ice Axe", level = 3, forge = 400, info = "A second catch when you slip." },
	crampons = { name = "Crampons", level = 5, forge = 800, info = "Less grip lost on snow and ice faces." },
}
-- Legacy canister counts remain in profile migration only; there is no consumable survival system.
C.SHOP_SITES = {} -- shops postponed; legacy cosmetic definitions preserve existing owned appearances.

-- Training Yard annex (concept LOCKED #10: outside the frozen Foothold, capped diminishing gains; numbers PROPOSED)
C.TRAINING = {
	gains = { 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 }, -- + max stamina per level (100 -> 120)
	cooldown = 600, -- s between counted laps (real time; can't be ground)
	parMin = 14, -- s: a lap faster than this is refused (BOT lap ~22 s)
	parMax = 120, -- s: slower laps don't count
}

-- Rescue assist + party ropes (concept LOCKED #14: shared fixed ropes + rescue assist, no tether; numbers PROPOSED)
C.COOP = {
	rescueRange = 14, -- helper within this distance of the climber
	rescueAbove = 2, -- helper standing at least this much higher (a hand up, never a pull from below)
	rescueStamina = 40,
	rescueCooldown = 30, -- per climber
	ropeSeconds = 120,
	ropeCooldown = 45, -- per placer
	ropeMax = 2, -- live party ropes per server per player
	ropeLen = 44,
}

-- Day/night + weather (concept LOCKED #13: dynamic with mobile quality tiers, only after a measured cost test)
C.WEATHER = {
	dayMinutes = 18, -- real minutes per full day
	dayShare = 0.78, -- share of the cycle that is daytime (nightTo -> nightFrom): ~14 min day, ~4 min night
	nightFrom = 19.5, -- ClockTime
	nightTo = 5.5,
	states = { "clear", "mist", "snow", "gust" },
	minHold = 150, -- s a weather state lasts at least
	maxHold = 330,
	snowY = 1700, -- snowfall shows above this height only
}

C.PRACTICE = {
 costs = { 0, 25, 60 },
 gains = { 6, 7, 7 },
 staminaCap = 140,
 labels = { "Rhythm & footholds", "Anchors & recovery", "Fork choices" },

-- Input/presentation for the single server traversal machine. No local climbing physics.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CAS=game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local Run=game:GetService("RunService")
local HS=game:GetService("HttpService")
local plr=Players.LocalPlayer
local Net=require(RS:WaitForChild("CC_Core"):WaitForChild("Net"))
local K=require(RS.CC_Core:WaitForChild("TraversalConfig"))
local request=Net.get("CoreRequest")
local fx=Net.get("CoreFx")
local sections={}
local function V(a) return Vector3.new(a[1],a[2],a[3]) end
local folder=RS:WaitForChild("CC_TraversalDefs",30)
if folder then
 for _,sv in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
  local ok,s=pcall(function() return HS:JSONDecode(sv.Value) end)
  if ok then s.entry,s.exit=V(s.entry),V(s.exit); for _,h in ipairs(s.holds) do h.pos=V(h.p); if h.alternative then h.alternative.pos=V(h.alternative.p) end end; sections[s.id]=s end
 end
end
local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name="CC_TraversalUI"; gui.ResetOnSpawn=false; gui.IgnoreGuiInset=false; gui.ScreenInsets=Enum.ScreenInsets.CoreUISafeInsets; gui.DisplayOrder=15; gui.Parent=plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local panel=Instance.new("Frame")
panel.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,1); panel.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,0,1,-18); panel.Size=UDim2.new(0.52,0,0,122)
panel.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(35,44,51); panel.BackgroundTransparency=0.08; panel.BorderSizePixel=0; panel.Parent=gui
local limit=Instance.new("UISizeConstraint"); limit.MinSize=Vector2.new(310,122); limit.MaxSize=Vector2.new(580,140); limit.Parent=panel
Instance.new("UICorner",panel).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,12)
local border=Instance.new("UIStroke"); border.Color=Color3.fromRGB(171,135,88); border.Thickness=1; border.Parent=panel
local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,4); label.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,44); label.BackgroundTransparency=1
label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium; label.TextSize=16; label.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(244,232,210); label.TextWrapped=true; label.Parent=panel
local function button(name,x,w)
 local b=Instance.new("TextButton"); b.Name=name; b.Position=UDim2.new(x,4,0,52); b.Size=UDim2.new(w,-8,0,58)
 b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(62,75,84); b.BorderSizePixel=0; b.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,235,196)
 b.TextSize=17; b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold; b.TextWrapped=true; b.Selectable=true; b.Parent=panel
 Instance.new("UICorner",b).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,8)
 return b
end
local left=button("Left",0,0.29)
local right=button("Right",0.29,0.29)
local choice=button("FootholdChoice",0.58,0.22)
local release=button("Release",0.80,0.20)
local context=button("Context",0,0.58)
local secondary=button("Secondary",0.58,0.42)
local device="keyboard"
local focused=true
local alternate=false
local jumpAt=-100
local lastSent={}
local contextAction,secondaryAction,mode="clip",nil,"ground"
local function blocked() return not focused or plr:GetAttribute("CC_MenuOpen")==true or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox()~=nil end
local function send(action,extra)
 if blocked() then return end
 local now=os.clock(); if now-(lastSent[action] or -10)<0.12 then return end; lastSent[action]=now
 local p=extra or {}; p.action=action; request:FireServer("traversal",p)
end
local function hand(side) send("step",{hand=side,choice=alternate and "stable" or "direct"}) end
left.Activated:Connect(function() hand("L") end)
right.Activated:Connect(function() hand("R") end)
release.Activated:Connect(function() send("release") end)
choice.Activated:Connect(function() alternate=not alternate end)
context.Activated:Connect(function() if contextAction then send(contextAction) end end)
secondary.Activated:Connect(function() if secondaryAction then send(secondaryAction) end end)
local function setDevice(t)
 device=t==Enum.UserInputType.Touch and "touch" or tostring(t):find("Gamepad") and "gamepad" or "keyboard"
 alternate=false; lastSent={}
	if mode=="flight" then request:FireServer("traversal",{action="steer",x=0,z=0}) end
end
setDevice(UIS:GetLastInputType())
UIS.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(setDevice)
UIS.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function() focused=false; alternate=false; lastSent={}; if mode=="flight" then request:FireServer("traversal",{action="steer",x=0,z=0}) end end)
UIS.WindowFocused:Connect(function() focused=true end)
plr:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CC_MenuOpen"):Connect(function() alternate=false; lastSent={}; if mode=="flight" then request:FireServer("traversal",{action="steer",x=0,z=0}) end end)
local function held() return mode=="climb" or mode=="rope" end
local function bind(name,callback,keys)
 CAS:BindActionAtPriority(name,function(_,state)
  if blocked() then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
  if state==Enum.UserInputState.Begin and callback() then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
  return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
 end,false,2100,table.unpack(keys))
end
bind("CC_LeftHand",function() if held() then hand("L"); return true end end,{Enum.KeyCode.Q,Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1})
bind("CC_RightHand",function() if held() then hand("R"); return true end end,{Enum.KeyCode.R,Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1})
bind("CC_Release",function() if held() or mode=="hanging" then send("release"); return true end end,{Enum.KeyCode.X,Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB})
bind("CC_Choice",function() if held() then alternate=not alternate; return true end end,{Enum.KeyCode.Tab,Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight})
-- F / Y matches traversal anchors; global creature/station prompts retain E / X.
-- Bind the visible contextual action too, so an off-screen native prompt cannot make the HUD key inert.
bind("CC_TraversalContext",function() if contextAction then send(contextAction); return true end end,{Enum.KeyCode.F,Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY})
bind("CC_Descend",function() if mode=="ground" and secondaryAction=="descend" then send("descend"); return true end end,{Enum.KeyCode.C,Enum.KeyCode.DPadDown})
UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
 local ch=plr.Character; local h=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not blocked() and mode=="ground" and h and h.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air and os.clock()-jumpAt>0.5 then jumpAt=os.clock(); send("jump") end
end)
local markers={}
for i=1,2 do
 local part=Instance.new("Part"); part.Name="NextFoothold"; part.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball; part.Size=Vector3.new(0.55,0.55,0.55)
 part.Anchored,part.CanCollide,part.CanQuery,part.CanTouch,part.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,false
 part.Material=Enum.Material.Neon; part.Color=Color3.fromRGB(244,194,107); part.Transparency=1; part.Parent=workspace.CurrentCamera
 local tag=Instance.new("BillboardGui"); tag.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(104,34); tag.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,1.1,0); tag.AlwaysOnTop=true; tag.MaxDistance=55; tag.Enabled=false; tag.Parent=part
 local text=Instance.new("TextLabel"); text.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1); text.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(32,42,49); text.BackgroundTransparency=0.1; text.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,236,199); text.TextSize=14; text.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; text.Parent=tag
 Instance.new("UICorner",text).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)
 markers[i]={part=part,tag=tag,text=text}
end
local cueUntil,cueText=0,nil
fx.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(p)
 if type(p)=="table" and p.kind=="traversalCue" then cueText=tostring(p.text); cueUntil=os.clock()+1.3 end
end)
local function nearest(pos,top)
 local best,dist
 for _,s in pairs(sections) do
  local d=(pos-(top and s.exit or s.entry)).Magnitude
  if d<(top and K.topRange or K.entryRange)+1 and (not dist or d<dist) then best,dist=s,d end
 end
 return best
end
local function campNear(pos)
 local world=workspace:FindFirstChild("World"); local cps=world and world:FindFirstChild("Checkpoints")
 for _,p in ipairs(cps and cps:GetChildren() or {}) do
  if p:GetAttribute("Camp") and tostring(p:GetAttribute("Checkpoint")):match("^Camp[1-4]$") and (pos-p.Position).Magnitude<K.flightLaunchRadius then return true end
 end
 return false
end
local acc,steerAt,grabAt=0,0,0
local animationCharacter,climbTrack
local function animate(ch,h)
	if animationCharacter ~= ch then
		if climbTrack then climbTrack:Stop(0); climbTrack:Destroy() end
		animationCharacter,climbTrack=ch,nil
	end
	local active=held() or mode=="hanging"
	if active and not climbTrack then
		local stock=ch:FindFirstChild("Animate")
		local folder=stock and stock:FindFirstChild("climb")
		local asset=folder and folder:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animation")
		local animator=h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
		if asset and animator then
			local ok,track=pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(asset) end)
			if ok then climbTrack=track; track.Priority=Enum.AnimationPriority.Action; track.Looped=true end
		end
	end
	if climbTrack then
		if active then
			if not climbTrack.IsPlaying then climbTrack:Play(0.15) end
			climbTrack:AdjustSpeed(held() and workspace:GetServerTimeNow()<(ch:GetAttribute("CC_RhythmAt") or 0) and 0.8 or 0)
		elseif climbTrack.IsPlaying then climbTrack:Stop(0.15) end
	end
end
Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 acc+=dt; if acc<0.1 then return end; acc=0
 local ch=plr.Character; local h=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); local r=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not r or not h then panel.Visible=false; return end
 local nextMode=ch:GetAttribute("CC_TraversalState") or "ground"
 if nextMode~=mode then mode=nextMode; alternate=false; lastSent={} end
	animate(ch,h)
	if mode=="ground" and ch:GetAttribute("CC_CramponsActive") and h.MoveDirection.Magnitude<0.1 then
		local v=r.AssemblyLinearVelocity; r.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(v.X*0.3,v.Y,v.Z*0.3)
	end
 for _,m in ipairs(markers) do m.part.Transparency=1; m.tag.Enabled=false end
 local active=held()
 left.Visible=active; right.Visible=active; choice.Visible=active; release.Visible=active or mode=="hanging"
 context.Visible=not active; secondary.Visible=not active and mode~="hanging"
 contextAction,secondaryAction=nil,nil
 panel.Visible=not blocked()
 local scale=math.clamp(tonumber(plr:GetAttribute("CC_TextScale")) or 1,0.9,1.35)
 label.TextSize=16*scale
	left.TextSize=17*scale; right.TextSize=17*scale
	choice.TextSize=14*scale; release.TextSize=14*scale
	context.TextSize=16*scale; secondary.TextSize=16*scale
	for _,m in ipairs(markers) do m.text.TextSize=14*scale end
 local lh=device=="gamepad" and "L1" or device=="keyboard" and "Q" or "Left"
	local rh=device=="gamepad" and "R1" or device=="keyboard" and "R" or "Right"
 local use=device=="gamepad" and "Y" or device=="keyboard" and "F" or "Tap"
 local stop=device=="gamepad" and "B" or device=="keyboard" and "X" or "Release"
 release.Text=stop.."\nLet go"
 if active then
  local nextHand=ch:GetAttribute("CC_NextHand") or "L"
  local ready=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()>=(ch:GetAttribute("CC_RhythmAt") or 0)
  label.Text=(mode=="rope" and "SHARED ROPE  •  " or "CLIPPED  •  ")..(ready and ("Next: "..(nextHand=="L" and "LEFT" or "RIGHT").."  •  No hurry") or "Moving to your foothold…")
  left.Text=device=="touch" and "LEFT" or lh.."  LEFT"; right.Text=device=="touch" and "RIGHT" or rh.."  RIGHT"
  left.BackgroundColor3=nextHand=="L" and Color3.fromRGB(120,91,54) or Color3.fromRGB(62,75,84)
  right.BackgroundColor3=nextHand=="R" and Color3.fromRGB(120,91,54) or Color3.fromRGB(62,75,84)
  local sec=sections[ch:GetAttribute("CC_SectionId")]
  local index=(ch:GetAttribute("CC_HoldIndex") or 1)+(ch:GetAttribute("CC_ClimbDirection") or 1)
  local nextHold=sec and sec.holds[index]
  choice.Visible=nextHold~=nil and nextHold.alternative~=nil
  choice.Text=alternate and "2\nSTABLE" or "1\nCHOICE"
  if nextHold then
   for i,hold in ipairs({nextHold,nextHold.alternative}) do
    local m=markers[i]; m.part.Position=hold.pos; m.part.Transparency=0.15; m.tag.Enabled=true
    m.text.Text=(i==1 and "1 • " or "2 • ")..(hold.stable and "STABLE" or (nextHand=="L" and "LEFT" or "RIGHT"))
   end
  else label.Text="One more rhythm input to step onto the landing." end
 elseif mode=="hanging" then
  contextAction="recover"; context.Size=UDim2.new(0.8,-8,0,58)
  local can=ch:GetAttribute("CC_CanRecover")
  context.Text=can and (use.."  Regain hold") or "Resting • grip recovering"
  label.Text="Harness caught you • finds safe"
 elseif mode=="flight" then
  context.Text="Steer with movement controls"; context.Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,58); secondary.Visible=false
  label.Text="PARACHUTE  •  Land at a camp below or the Foothold"
  if os.clock()-steerAt>0.42 and not blocked() then steerAt=os.clock(); send("steer",{x=h.MoveDirection.X,z=h.MoveDirection.Z}) end
 else
  context.Size=UDim2.new(0.58,-8,0,58)
  local near=nearest(r.Position,false); local top=nearest(r.Position,true)
  if os.clock()-jumpAt<K.jumpWindow and h.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air and campNear(r.Position) then
   contextAction="parachute"; context.Text=use.."  Open parachute"; secondary.Visible=false; label.Text="Intentional camp jump • safe parachute practice"
  elseif near then
   contextAction="clip"; context.Text=use.."  Clip & climb"; secondary.Visible=false
   label.Text=near.tutorial and "First protected climb • clip once at the marked anchor" or "Marked anchor • harness protects this climb"
   if os.clock()-grabAt>0.7 and h.MoveDirection:Dot(V(near.into))>0.5 then grabAt=os.clock(); send("grab") end
  elseif top then
   contextAction="rope"; secondaryAction="descend"; context.Text=use.."  Shared rope"
   secondary.Text=(device=="gamepad" and "↓" or device=="keyboard" and "C" or "Tap").."  Climb down"
   label.Text="Top anchor • share this existing route with other climbers"
  elseif campNear(r.Position) then
   context.Text="Jump, then "..use.." to deploy"; secondary.Visible=false
   label.Text="Parachute practice • return areas only; cargo stays carried"
  else panel.Visible=false end
 end
 if cueText and os.clock()<cueUntil then label.Text=cueText end
 -- Native truss climbing is retired even though its tutorial art is preserved.
 h:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing,false)
end)
plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
 mode="ground"; alternate=false; jumpAt=-100; lastSent={}
 task.spawn(function()
  local root=ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",10); local p=root and root:WaitForChild("RescuePrompt",10)
  if p then p.Enabled=false; p:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function() if p.Enabled then p.Enabled=false end end) end
