-- Meaningful pure-rule checks plus authored graph invariants, runnable on the Studio server.
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local R=require(RS.CC_Core.TraversalRules)
local K=require(RS.CC_Core.TraversalConfig)
local Tests={}
function Tests.run()
	local passed=0
	local function check(name,fn)
		local ok,err=pcall(fn)
		assert(ok,name..": "..tostring(err)); passed+=1
	end
	check("one wrong hand is a recoverable error",function()
		local s={mode="climb",hand="L",stamina=50,nextAt=0}
		local ok,why=R.step(s,"R",{},1,K,false)
		assert(not ok and why=="hand" and s.stamina==50)
	end)
	check("no time deadline while waiting",function()
		assert(R.step({mode="climb",hand="L",stamina=50,nextAt=0},"L",{},1790000000,K,false))
	end)
	check("timing assistance preserves cost and progress",function()
		local s={mode="climb",hand="L",stamina=50,nextAt=0}
		local a,cost=R.step(s,"L",{},1,K,false)
		local b,assisted=R.step(s,"R",{},1,K,true)
		assert(a and b and cost==assisted)
	end)
	check("ice rope effects depend on actual state",function()
		local _,base=R.step({mode="climb",hand="L",stamina=50,nextAt=0},"L",{},1,K,false)
		local _,ice=R.step({mode="climb",hand="L",stamina=50,nextAt=0,ice=true},"L",{},1,K,false)
		local _,rope=R.step({mode="rope",hand="L",stamina=50,nextAt=0},"L",{},1,K,false)
		assert(ice<base and rope<base)
	end)
	check("walkoffs and slips cannot open parachute",function()
		assert(not R.canDeploy({mode="ground"},1,true,12,10,K))
		assert(not R.canDeploy({mode="climb",jumpAt=0,jumpY=10},0.4,true,12,10,K))
		assert(not R.canDeploy({mode="ground",jumpAt=0,jumpY=10},0.4,true,9,10,K))
		assert(R.canDeploy({mode="ground",jumpAt=0,jumpY=10},0.4,true,12,10,K))
		assert(R.canDeploy({mode="fall",jumpAt=0,jumpY=10},0.4,true,12,10,K))
	end)
	check("parachute cannot advance camps",function()
		assert(not R.canLand(1,2,500,600)); assert(not R.canLand(2,1,700,600)); assert(R.canLand(2,1,300,600))
	end)
	check("occupied ropes survive expiry and departure",function()
		assert(not R.canRemoveRope({expires=1,occupants=1,retiring=true},10))
		assert(R.canRemoveRope({expires=1,occupants=0,retiring=true},10))
	end)
	check("flight and closed route checkpoints reject",function()
		assert(not R.checkpointAllowed("flight",true,"Shepherd",1,0))
		assert(not R.checkpointAllowed("ground",true,"Spire",nil,0))
		assert(not R.checkpointAllowed("ground",true,"Shepherd",3,0))
		assert(R.checkpointAllowed("ground",true,"Shepherd",1,0))
	end)
	check("remote numeric validation rejects NaN infinity",function()
		assert(not R.finite(0/0) and not R.finite(math.huge) and not R.finite("3") and R.finite(3))
	end)
	local graphCount=0
	check("authored graphs have unique identities and bounded steps",function()
		local folder=assert(RS:FindFirstChild("CC_TraversalDefs"),"missing authoring")
		local ids={}
		for _,sv in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
			local s=game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(sv.Value)
			assert(K.launchRoutes[s.route] and #s.holds>=2)
			local last
			for _,h in ipairs(s.holds) do
				assert(not ids[h.id],"duplicate "..h.id); ids[h.id]=true
				local p=Vector3.new(table.unpack(h.p)); if last then assert((p-last).Magnitude<=8,"disconnected "..s.id) end; last=p
				if h.alternative then assert(not ids[h.alternative.id]); ids[h.alternative.id]=true; assert(h.alternative.stable) end
			end
			graphCount+=1
		end
		assert(folder:FindFirstChild("Tutorial:RareNook"),"missing tutorial")
		for i=1,3 do assert(folder:FindFirstChild("Practice:"..i),"missing practice "..i) end
	end)
	return {passed=passed,sections=graphCount,kind="pure rules + authored graph invariants; not human feel test"}
end
return Tests
sources.tools/route_climb_bot.luau:
-- Route climb bot (dev tool, Client, playtest; v4 P3 run 2). Follows ReplicatedStorage.CC_Track.<route> (JSON
-- segments written by ClimbKit / LedgeP1) and walks ReplicatedStorage.CC_Route.<route> between segments. Drives
-- CC_ClimbClient through its Studio-only hooks (CC_BotMove / CC_BotJump), i.e. the same controller a player uses;
-- walking = Humanoid:MoveTo at WalkSpeed 12. All times are BOT times (perfect input).
-- Synced to ReplicatedStorage.CC_DevTools.RouteClimbBot. Client:
--   _G.CC_RBOT_CFG = { route = "Ledge", seg = "forest" }          -- one segment (teleport to its start)
--   _G.CC_RBOT_CFG = { route = "Ledge", s0 = 0, s1 = 12286 }      -- a stretch of the route incl. walking
--   _G.CC_RBOT_CFG = { ..., runs = 5, descend = true }            -- descend = also climb the segment back down
--   require(game.ReplicatedStorage.CC_DevTools.RouteClimbBot:Clone()); poll _G.CC_RBOT (back-to-back calls:
--   MCP client threads only run while a call is active)
local HS = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local cfg = _G.CC_RBOT_CFG or {}
local B = { status = "running", runs = {} }
_G.CC_RBOT = B

local function flat(v)
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end
local function V(t)
	return Vector3.new(t[1], t[2], t[3])
end

local function loadRoute(name)
	local sv = RS:WaitForChild("CC_Route"):FindFirstChild(name)
	local pts = {}
	for tok in string.gmatch(sv and sv.Value or "", "[^;]+") do
		local x, y, z, s = tok:match("([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)")
		pts[#pts + 1] = { p = Vector3.new(tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z)), s = tonumber(s) }
	end
	return pts
end
local function loadTrack(name)
	local sv = RS:WaitForChild("CC_Track"):FindFirstChild(name)
	return sv and HS:JSONDecode(sv.Value) or {}
end

local function run(idx)
	local ch = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local hum, hrp = ch:WaitForChild("Humanoid"), ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	hum.WalkSpeed = 12
	local R = { i = idx, splits = {}, stuck = 0, log = {}, handsOn = 0, rest = 0, lunges = 0 }
	B.cur = R
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local function log(s)
		R.log[#R.log + 1] = string.format("%.1f %s (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)", os.clock() - t0, s, hrp.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y, hrp.Position.Z)
	end
	local function mark(k)
		R.splits[#R.splits + 1] = string.format("%s %.1f", k, os.clock() - t0)
	end
	local function state()
		return ch:GetAttribute("CC_ClimbState") or "none"
	end
	local fall0 = plr:GetAttribute("CC_Falls") or 0
	local dropped = false
	-- same rule as CC_CheckpointService: a landing more than 24 studs below the last grounded height (0.25 s
	-- samples) is a fall, whether or not a checkpoint is set (walking down a slope is not)
	local lastG, acc = nil, 0
	local armed = false -- off during start-up teleports
	local fallConn = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		-- v6: time on a face / ladder / slab (the controller's climb state), the "hands-on" share's strict half
		if armed and (ch:GetAttribute("CC_ClimbState") or "none") ~= "none" then
			R.face = (R.face or 0) + dt
		end
		acc += dt
		if acc < 0.25 or not armed then
			return
		end
		acc = 0
		if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air and (ch:GetAttribute("CC_ClimbState") or "none") == "none" then
			local y = hrp.Position.Y
			if lastG and lastG - y > 24 then
				dropped = true
				R.log[#R.log + 1] = string.format("%.1f FALL %.0f (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)", os.clock() - t0, lastG - y, hrp.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y, hrp.Position.Z)
			end
			lastG = y
		elseif (ch:GetAttribute("CC_ClimbState") or "none") ~= "none" then
			lastG = nil -- climbing moves are not falls; the next grounded sample starts fresh
		end
	end)
	local function fell()
		return dropped or (plr:GetAttribute("CC_Falls") or 0) > fall0
	end
	local function walk(p, tmax)
		local t1 = os.clock()
		local d0 = (flat(p) - flat(hrp.Position)).Magnitude
		tmax = tmax or d0 / 12 * 2.2 + 3
		local jumped = false
		local lastP, lastT = hrp.Position, os.clock()
		while os.clock() - t1 < tmax do
			if state() ~= "none" then
				-- grabbed something on the way (a marked wall beside the path): let go and keep walking
				ch:SetAttribute("CC_BotRelease", (ch:GetAttribute("CC_BotRelease") or 0) + 1)
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
			hum:MoveTo(p)
			if (flat(p) - flat(hrp.Position)).Magnitude < 2.2 then
				return true
			end
			if os.clock() - lastT > 1.2 then
				if (hrp.Position - lastP).Magnitude < 1 and not jumped and hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
					hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
					jumped = true
				end
				lastP, lastT = hrp.Position, os.clock()
			end
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
		R.stuck += 1
		log(string.format("STUCK walking -> (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)", p.X, p.Y, p.Z))
		return false
	end
	-- push into the face until grabbed; hold dir (default: into = up) until the controller lets go (mantle / step off)
	local function climb(into, dir, tmax, label, canLunge, at)
		local t1 = os.clock()
		ch:SetAttribute("CC_BotMove", into)
		while state() == "none" and os.clock() - t1 < 3 do
			-- push into the face from the approach point (re-centres on narrow faces such as ladders)
			local base = at and Vector3.new(at.X, hrp.Position.Y, at.Z) or hrp.Position
			hum:MoveTo(base + into * 3)
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
		if state() == "none" then
			ch:SetAttribute("CC_BotMove", Vector3.zero)
			R.stuck += 1
			log("NO GRAB " .. label)
			return false
		end
		-- sideways moves are projected onto the face plane each tick (a slight "away from the wall" component reads
		-- as stepping off when there is floor right below)
		local function onFace(d)
			-- the face's own normal from the track (the character's look lags the grab by a few frames)
			local look = Vector3.new(into.X, 0, into.Z).Unit
			local p = d - look * d:Dot(look)
			return (p.Magnitude > 0.1) and p.Unit or d
		end
		ch:SetAttribute("CC_BotMove", dir and onFace(dir) or into)
		local lastY, lastT = hrp.Position, os.clock()
		local grabT = os.clock()
		-- stalled on the face: Jump = lunge, as a player would (at a marked blank band after 0.6 s, anywhere else
		-- only after 1.5 s without progress; an eager lunge near a top edge throws the climber off the line)
		local wait = canLunge and 0.6 or 1e9 -- only marked lunge faces get a lunge
		local ticks = 0
		local rpL = RaycastParams.new()
		rpL.FilterDescendantsInstances = { ch }
		while state() ~= "none" and os.clock() - t1 < (tmax or 40) do
			task.wait(0.05)
			if dir then
				ch:SetAttribute("CC_BotMove", onFace(dir))
			else
				-- on a ladder, steer back toward its centre line (a grab at the grip's side edge stalled the climb;
				-- a player steers the same way)
				local f = Vector3.new(into.X, 0, into.Z).Unit
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position, f * 4, rpL)
				local mv = into
				if hit and hit.Instance.Name == "LadderGrip" then
					local x = hit.Instance.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(hrp.Position).X
					if math.abs(x) > 0.8 then
						mv = (into + hit.Instance.CFrame.RightVector * (-math.sign(x) * 0.6)).Unit
					end
				end
				ch:SetAttribute("CC_BotMove", mv)
			end
			ticks += 1
			if cfg.debug and ticks <= 3 then
				local lv = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
				log(string.format("dbg %s t%d st=%s move=%s look=(%.2f,%.2f) why=%s", label, ticks, state(), tostring(ch:GetAttribute("CC_BotMove")), lv.X, lv.Z, tostring(ch:GetAttribute("CC_DetachWhy"))))
			end
			if os.clock() - lastT > wait then
				if state() == "climb" and os.clock() - grabT > 1 and (hrp.Position - lastY).Magnitude < 0.3 then
					ch:SetAttribute("CC_BotJump", (ch:GetAttribute("CC_BotJump") or 0) + 1)
					R.lunges += 1
				end
				lastY, lastT = hrp.Position, os.clock()
			end
		end
		ch:SetAttribute("CC_BotMove", Vector3.zero)
		if state() ~= "none" then
			R.stuck += 1
			log("STUCK on face " .. label)
			return false
		end
		if cfg.verbose then
			log(string.format("off %s after %.1f s (%s)", label, os.clock() - t1, tostring(ch:GetAttribute("CC_DetachWhy"))))
		end
		return true
	end
	-- v6: jump to p (gap jumps, rock steps, stepping stones): walk toward p and jump when grounded with no floor 1.3
	-- ahead (a gap's lip) or a block at knee height ahead (a step), as a player would
	local rpJ = RaycastParams.new()
	rpJ.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	rpJ.FilterDescendantsInstances = { ch }
	local function jumpTo(p)
		local t1 = os.clock()
		local lastJ = 0
		local d0 = (flat(p) - flat(hrp.Position)).Magnitude
		while os.clock() - t1 < d0 / 12 * 2 + 4 do
			if fell() then
				return false
			end
			hum:MoveTo(p)
			local pos = hrp.Position
			local hd = (flat(p) - flat(pos)).Magnitude
			local grounded = hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
			if grounded and hd < 1.8 and math.abs(pos.Y - p.Y) < 3 then
				return true
			end
			if grounded and os.clock() - lastJ > 0.45 then
				local dir = flat(p - pos)
				dir = (dir.Magnitude > 0.1) and dir.Unit or Vector3.zero
				local edge = not workspace:Raycast(pos + dir * 1.3, Vector3.new(0, -5, 0), rpJ)
				local wall = workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, -1.6, 0), dir * 2.4, rpJ)
				if edge or wall or (p.Y > pos.Y + 1.5 and hd < 4.5) then
					hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
					lastJ = os.clock()
					R.jumps = (R.jumps or 0) + 1
				end
			end
			task.wait(0.03)
		end
		R.stuck += 1
		log(string.format("STUCK jump -> (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)", p.X, p.Y, p.Z))
		return false
	end
	local function hazardWait(path)
		local m = workspace
		for seg in string.gmatch(path, "[^%.]+") do
			if m ~= workspace or seg ~= "Workspace" then
				m = m and m:FindFirstChild(seg)
			end
		end
		if not m then
			return 0
		end
		local per, tell, off = m:GetAttribute("Period"), m:GetAttribute("Tell"), m:GetAttribute("Offset") or 0
		local w0 = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - w0 < per + 1 do
			local ph = (workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + off) % per
			if ph > tell + 1.5 and ph < per - 2.5 then
				break
			end
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
		return os.clock() - w0
	end
	local function restIfLow()
		local st = ch:GetAttribute("CC_Stamina") or 100
		if st < 35 then
			local w0 = os.clock()
			while (ch:GetAttribute("CC_Stamina") or 100) < 85 and os.clock() - w0 < 12 do
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
			R.rest += os.clock() - w0
		end
	end
	local lastWalk
	local function doNodes(seg, from)
		local ns = seg.nodes
		for ni = from or 1, #ns do
			local n = ns[ni]
			if fell() then
				log("fell before node " .. ni)
				return false
			end
			if n.k == "walk" then
				lastWalk = V(n.p)
				local y0 = hrp.Position.Y
				walk(V(n.p))
				if cfg.verbose and hrp.Position.Y < y0 - 6 then
					log(string.format("DROP %.0f at node %d", y0 - hrp.Position.Y, ni))
				end
			elseif n.k == "climb" then
				restIfLow()
				if not climb(V(n.into), n.dir and V(n.dir) or nil, 45, n.label, n.lunge, lastWalk) then
					return false
				end
			elseif n.k == "jump" then
				lastWalk = V(n.p)
				if not jumpTo(V(n.p)) then
					return false
				end
			elseif n.k == "wait" then
				R.waits = (R.waits or 0) + hazardWait(n.hz)
			elseif n.k == "descend" then
				-- hang lines: walk off the face top (the controller's descend grab takes the face), then pull away from
				-- the wall (= climb down) until the controller steps off onto the ledge
				local at, out = V(n.at), V(n.out)
				walk(at)
				local t1 = os.clock()
				ch:SetAttribute("CC_BotMove", Vector3.zero)
				while state() == "none" and os.clock() - t1 < 3 do
					hum:MoveTo(at + out * 8)
					task.wait(0.05)
				end
				if state() == "none" then
					R.stuck += 1
					log("NO DESCEND GRAB " .. n.label)
					return false
				end
				ch:SetAttribute("CC_BotMove", out)
				while state() ~= "none" and os.clock() - t1 < 30 do
					task.wait(0.05)
				end
				ch:SetAttribute("CC_BotMove", Vector3.zero)
				if state() ~= "none" then
					R.stuck += 1
					log("STUCK descending " .. n.label)
					return false
				end
				if cfg.verbose then
					log(string.format("down %s after %.1f s (%s)", n.label, os.clock() - t1, tostring(ch:GetAttribute("CC_DetachWhy"))))
				end
			end
		end
		return not fell()
	end
	local function walkRoute(pts, s0, s1)
		local lastS = -1e9
		for _, q in ipairs(pts) do
			if q.s >= s0 and q.s <= s1 and q.s - lastS >= (cfg.routeStep or 6) then
				lastS = q.s
				walk(q.p + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
				if fell() then
					return false
				end
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	local dev = RS:FindFirstChild("CC_Remotes") and RS.CC_Remotes:FindFirstChild("DevRequest")
	if dev then
		dev:FireServer("setCheckpoint", {})
		task.wait(0.4)
	end
	local route = cfg.route or "Ledge"
	local pts = loadRoute(route)
	local track = loadTrack(route)
	local ctr0 = {}
	for _, k in ipairs({ "CC_Grabs", "CC_Slips", "CC_Catches", "CC_Misses", "CC_Lunges", "CC_DescendGrabs" }) do
		ctr0[k] = ch:GetAttribute(k) or 0
	end
	local ok = true
	if cfg.seg then
		local seg
		for _, s in ipairs(track) do
			if s.id == cfg.seg then
				seg = s
			end
		end
		assert(seg, "no segment " .. tostring(cfg.seg))
		if cfg.fromLabel then
			for i, n in ipairs(seg.nodes) do
				if n.label == cfg.fromLabel then
					cfg.from = i - 1
					if n.k == "climb" and seg.nodes[i - 1] and seg.nodes[i - 1].k == "wait" then
						cfg.from = i - 2
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local first = seg.nodes[cfg.from or 1]
		local start = cfg.at and V(cfg.at) or V(first.p) + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
		ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(start))
		task.wait(1.5)
		lastG, armed = nil, true
		t0 = os.clock()
		ok = doNodes(seg, cfg.from)
		mark("seg " .. seg.id)
		R.handsOn = os.clock() - t0
	else
		local s0, s1 = cfg.s0 or 0, cfg.s1 or 1e9
		local startP
		for _, q in ipairs(pts) do
			if q.s >= s0 then
				startP = q.p
				break
			end
		end
		ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(startP + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)))
		task.wait(2)
		lastG, armed = nil, true
		t0 = os.clock()
		local cur = s0
		for _, seg in ipairs(track) do
			if ok and seg.s1 > s0 and seg.s0 < s1 then
				ok = walkRoute(pts, cur, seg.s0)
				mark("at " .. seg.id)
				local h0 = os.clock()
				ok = ok and doNodes(seg)
				R.handsOn += os.clock() - h0
				mark("done " .. seg.id)
				cur = seg.s1
			end
		end
		if ok then
			ok = walkRoute(pts, cur, s1)
		end
	end
	fallConn:Disconnect()
	R.total = os.clock() - t0
	R.result = ok and "ok" or (fell() and "fell" or "failed")
	R.falls = (plr:GetAttribute("CC_Falls") or 0) - fall0
	for k, v in pairs(ctr0) do
		R[k] = (ch:GetAttribute(k) or 0) - v
	end
	R.endAt = string.format("(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)", hrp.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y, hrp.Position.Z)
	return R
end

-- floor audit (cfg.audit = "<segment id>"): every 2 studs between consecutive walk nodes, the floor under the
-- walking line and 1.5 studs either side of it; reports holes (no floor within 6 below) and drops (> 2.5 below
-- the node height). Run in a playtest (edit-mode raycasts lag behind fresh voxel writes).
if cfg.audit then
	local ch = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local rp = RaycastParams.new()
	rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { ch, workspace.CurrentCamera }
	local bad, n = {}, 0
	local dev = RS:FindFirstChild("CC_Remotes") and RS.CC_Remotes:FindFirstChild("DevRequest")
	for _, seg in ipairs(loadTrack(cfg.route or "Ledge")) do
		if seg.id == cfg.audit or cfg.audit == "*" then
			-- stream the segment in (StreamingEnabled): stand at its first node for a few seconds
			if dev then
				dev:FireServer("setCheckpoint", {})
			end
			ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(V(seg.nodes[1].p) + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
			task.wait(cfg.streamWait or 5)
			local prev
			for ni, nd in ipairs(seg.nodes) do
				if nd.k == "walk" then
					local p = V(nd.p)
					if prev and (p - prev).Magnitude < 40 and math.abs(p.Y - prev.Y) < 2 then
						local d = (p - prev).Magnitude
						local side = flat(p - prev).Magnitude > 0.1 and flat(p - prev).Unit:Cross(Vector3.yAxis) or Vector3.xAxis
						for k = 0, math.floor(d / 2) do
							local q = prev:Lerp(p, k * 2 / math.max(d, 0.01))
							for _, off in ipairs({ -1.5, 0, 1.5 }) do
								local qq = q + side * off
								local r = workspace:Raycast(qq + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -9, 0), rp)
								n += 1
								local fy = r and r.Position.Y
								-- a ray that starts inside the wall finds nothing: not a hole
								local inWall = not r and workspace:Raycast(q + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), side * off * 1.1, rp) ~= nil
								if not inWall and (not fy or fy < q.Y - 3 - 2.5) then
									bad[#bad + 1] = string.format("%s n%d off%.1f (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) %s", seg.id, ni, off, qq.X, qq.Y, qq.Z, fy and string.format("floor %.1f", fy) or "HOLE")
								end
							end
						end
					end
					prev = p
				elseif nd.k == "climb" then
					prev = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
	B.audit = { samples = n, bad = bad }
	B.status = "done"
	return "audit done"
end

task.spawn(function()
	for i = 1, cfg.runs or 1 do
		B.where = "run " .. i
		local ok, r = pcall(run, i)
		B.runs[#B.runs + 1] = ok and r or { i = i, result = "error", err = tostring(r) }
		task.wait(1)
	end
	B.status = "done"
end)
return "route climb bot started"

-- Durable banking and deliberate Heartstone hatching. Adventure credit follows original discovery identity.
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local C = require(RS:WaitForChild("CC_Core"):WaitForChild("CoreConfig"))
local H = require(RS.CC_Core:WaitForChild("HomeConfig"))
local Species = require(RS.CC_Core:WaitForChild("Species"))
local Clock, Inv, Prog, Profile = require(script.Parent.Clock), require(script.Parent.Inventory), require(script.Parent.Progression), require(script.Parent.Profile)
local CommerceRules = require(script.Parent.CommerceRules)
local Bank = {}
local function find(list, key, id)
	for _, entry in ipairs(list) do if entry[key] == id then return entry end end
	return nil
end
local function collect(data, item, award)
	if find(data.bank, "creatureId", item.uid) then return nil end
	local discovery = Profile.discovery(item, item.uid)
	data.bank[#data.bank + 1] = { creatureId = item.uid, species = item.species, rarity = item.rarity, mutation = item.mutation or "", acquiredAt = item.acquiredAt or discovery.at, source = item.source or "", discovery = discovery }
	local first = (data.codex[item.species] or 0) == 0
	data.codex[item.species] = (data.codex[item.species] or 0) + 1
	if not data.memories[item.species] then data.memories[item.species] = Profile.deepCopy(discovery) end
	local xp = award and math.floor((C.XP_ON_BANK[item.rarity] or 0) * (first and C.FIRST_OF_SPECIES_XP or 1)) or 0
	if xp > 0 then Prog.addXp(data, xp) end
	return xp, first
end
function Bank._collect(data, id, species, rarity, mutation, at, source)
	return collect(data, { uid = id, species = species, rarity = rarity, mutation = mutation, acquiredAt = at, source = source }, true)
end
function Bank.deposit(session, userId, txId)
	if not session or not session.owner or session.lost or session.released or session.closing then return { ok = false, reason = "unavailable" } end
	if session.userId ~= userId then return { ok = false, reason = "invalid" } end
	if type(txId) ~= "string" or #txId < 4 or #txId > 64 then return { ok = false, reason = "badtx" } end
	-- Isolated old tools use unbound bags; runtime binds on load.
	if Inv.session(userId) ~= session and not session.pending then
		-- A restored profile already owns its cargo. An empty/stale compatibility bag cannot replace it,
		-- nor may cargo from a different session be copied into a newer owner of the same profile.
		if not Inv.session(userId) and #session.data.cargo == 0 then
			session.data.cargo = Profile.deepCopy(Inv.bag(userId).items)
		end
		Inv.bind(userId, session)
	end
	local result = session.owner:transact(session, txId, function(data)
		local now = Clock.now()
		local res = { creatures = 0, heartstones = 0, coins = 0, xp = 0, items = {}, firsts = 0, adventure = 0 }
		local occupied, keep = table.clone(data.home.nests), {}
		for _, raw in ipairs(data.cargo) do
			local it = Profile.cleanItem(raw)
			if not it then
				keep[#keep + 1] = raw
				res.kept = (res.kept or 0) + 1
			elseif not find(data.bank, "creatureId", it.uid) and not find(data.heartstones, "id", it.uid) then
				local discovery = it.discovery
				local newDiscovery = not data.discoveryCredited[discovery.id]
				if it.kind == "heartstone" then
					data.heartstones[#data.heartstones + 1] = { id = it.uid, tier = it.tier, mutation = it.mutation, species = it.species, region = it.region, progress = 0, required = H.stoneProgress[it.tier], ready = false, acquiredAt = it.acquiredAt, source = it.source, discovery = discovery }
					res.heartstones += 1
					res.items[#res.items + 1] = { kind = "heartstone", id = it.uid, tier = it.tier }
				else
					local xp, first = collect(data, it, newDiscovery)
					if xp then
						local coins = newDiscovery and (C.COINS_ON_BANK[it.rarity] or 0) * CommerceRules.multiplier(data) or 0
						data.coins += coins
						res.coins += coins
						res.xp += xp
						res.creatures += 1
						res.firsts += first and 1 or 0
						res.items[#res.items + 1] = { kind = "creature", id = it.uid, species = it.species, rarity = it.rarity, first = first }
					end
				end
				if newDiscovery then data.discoveryCredited[discovery.id] = true; res.adventure += 1 end
			end
		end
		data.cargo = keep
		local efficiency = H.progressEfficiency[data.home.upgrade + 1] or 1
		for _, id in ipairs(occupied) do
			local stone = find(data.heartstones, "id", id)
			if stone and not stone.ready then
				stone.progress = math.min(stone.required, stone.progress + res.adventure * efficiency)
				stone.ready = stone.progress >= stone.required
			end
		end
		if res.creatures + res.heartstones > 0 then
			if data.flags.firstBankAt == 0 then data.flags.firstBankAt = now end
			data.stats.banked += res.creatures + res.heartstones
		end
		data.tx[#data.tx + 1] = txId
		while #data.tx > C.PERSIST.txKeep do table.remove(data.tx, 1) end
		Prog.refresh(data)
		return res
	end)
	if result.dup then result.creatures, result.heartstones, result.coins, result.xp, result.items = 0, 0, 0, 0, {} end
	return result
end
function Bank.rollHatch(tier, region, rng)
	rng = rng or Random.new()
	local weights = C.HATCH_WEIGHTS[tier] or C.HATCH_WEIGHTS.Common
	local total = 0
	for _, weight in pairs(weights) do total += weight end
	local pick, roll = nil, rng:NextNumber(0, total)
	for _, rarity in ipairs(C.RARITIES) do
		if weights[rarity] then roll -= weights[rarity]; if roll <= 0 and not pick then pick = rarity end end
	end
	local pool = Species.query({ region = region, rarity = pick or "Common", kind = "creature" })
	if #pool == 0 then pool = Species.query({ rarity = pick or "Common", kind = "creature" }) end
	local e = pool[rng:NextInteger(1, #pool)]
	return e.id, e.rarity
end
function Bank.hatchData(data, slot)
		if type(slot) ~= "number" or slot % 1 ~= 0 or slot < 1 or slot > H.nestCount then return { ok = false, reason = "invalid" } end
		local id = data.home.nests[slot]
		local stone = find(data.heartstones, "id", id)
		if not stone or not stone.ready then return { ok = false, reason = "notReady" } end
		local species = stone.species
		if species == "" then
			local seed = 1
			for i = 1, #stone.id do seed = (seed * 31 + string.byte(stone.id, i)) % 2147483647 end
			species = Bank.rollHatch(stone.tier, stone.region, Random.new(seed))
		end
		local rarity = Species.rarity(species) or "Common"
		collect(data, { uid = stone.id, species = species, rarity = rarity, mutation = stone.mutation, acquiredAt = stone.acquiredAt, source = stone.source, discovery = stone.discovery }, false)
		for i, h in ipairs(data.heartstones) do if h.id == id then table.remove(data.heartstones, i); break end end
		data.home.nests[slot] = ""
		Prog.refresh(data)
		return { hatched = { id = id, species = species, rarity = rarity }, creatures = 1 }
end
function Bank.hatch(session, slot, txId)
	if not session or not session.owner then return { ok = false, reason = "invalid" } end
	return session.owner:transact(session, txId, function(data) return Bank.hatchData(data, slot) end)
end
-- Time never hatches or advances stones. Kept for existing service/tool compatibility.
function Bank.ripen(_session) return {} end
return Bank
sources.src/world/FootholdV3.luau:
-- FootholdV3: the home base on the dry foothills (V3 plan P3; master.md §0.6, all placements PROPOSED).
-- Summit-view amphitheater spawn, central campfire plaza (r 125), Route Board, 4 trailhead gates styled by route,
-- Lookout Tower landmark, decorative cable-car station, Hall of Wonders, Gear Forge, Provisions Market, Garage +
-- ATV trail start, Base Pad, Hatchery, 9 terraced player cabins with habitat yards.
-- Layout is relative to the Foothold pad: f = toward the summit, r = right when facing it.
local C = require(script.Parent.WorldConfig)
local V = {}

local UP = Vector3.yAxis
local function flat(v)
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end

-- route identity (PROPOSED): colors are existing tokens tied to each route's character, intensity as pips
local ROUTE_STYLE = {
	Shepherd = { col = "meadow", pips = 1 },
	Waterfall = { col = "turquoise", pips = 2 },
	Ledge = { col = "sandstone", pips = 3 },
	Spire = { col = "ice", pips = 4 },
}
V.ROUTE_STYLE = ROUTE_STYLE

local function stall(Kit, parent, cf, awning)
	local COL = Kit.COL
	local m = Kit.model(parent, "MarketStall")
	for _, x in ipairs({ -5, 5 }) do
		for _, z in ipairs({ -3, 3 }) do
			local h = (z < 0) and 9 or 7.5
			Kit.part(m, { Name = "Post", Size = Vector3.new(0.8, h, 0.8), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(x, h / 2, z), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
		end
	end
	Kit.part(m, { Name = "Counter", Size = Vector3.new(11, 3.2, 2.4), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 1.6, -2.6), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
	for k = 0, 4 do
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Awning", Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 0.4, 8.4), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(-4.8 + k * 2.4, 8.4, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(10), 0, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = (k % 2 == 0) and awning or COL.moon })
	end
	for k = 0, 2 do
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Crate", Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(-3.5 + k * 3.5, 4.2, -2.6) * CFrame.Angles(0, k * 0.3, 0), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
	end
	return m
end

-- pips: small stone blocks on a gate/board, one per intensity step (shape, not only color)
local function pips(Kit, parent, cf, n, col)
	for k = 1, 4 do
		local on = k <= n
		local p = Kit.part(parent, {
			Name = on and "Pip" or "PipOff",
			Size = Vector3.new(1.4, 1.4, 0.6),
			CFrame = cf * CFrame.new((k - 2.5) * 2, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)),
			Material = on and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.Slate,
			Color = on and col or Kit.COL.slate,
		})
		Kit.decor(p)
	end
end

-- trailhead gate, styled per route so they read apart by silhouette
local function gate(Kit, parent, name, pos, facing, label)
	local COL = Kit.COL
	local st = ROUTE_STYLE[name]
	local col = COL[st.col]
	local m = Kit.model(parent, "Gate_" .. name)
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + facing)
	if name == "Shepherd" then
		-- wide, low timber arch with flower boxes: welcoming
		for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			Kit.part(m, { Name = "Post", Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 12, 1.6), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(s * 9, 6, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
			Kit.part(m, { Name = "FlowerBox", Size = Vector3.new(4, 1.6, 2.4), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(s * 11.5, 0.8, 0), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
			Kit.place(m, "FlowersGold", (cf * CFrame.new(s * 11.5, 1.4, 0)).Position, 0, 0.6)
		end
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Beam", Size = Vector3.new(22, 1.6, 2), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 12.4, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timber })
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Board", Size = Vector3.new(14, 2.6, 0.5), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 10.2, -0.6), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = col })
	elseif name == "Waterfall" then
		-- round stone arch with a turquoise banner
		for k = 0, 12 do
			local a = math.pi * k / 12
			Kit.part(m, { Name = "Voussoir", Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 2.4, 3), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(math.cos(a) * 8, 6 + math.sin(a) * 9, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, a), Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone, Color = COL.masonry })
		end
		for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			Kit.part(m, { Name = "Pier", Size = Vector3.new(3, 6, 3.4), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(s * 8, 3, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone, Color = COL.masonry })
		end
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Banner", Size = Vector3.new(3, 7, 0.3), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 9, 0.4), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = col })
	elseif name == "Ledge" then
		-- narrow timber frame with a gold fixed rope (wayfinding token) and a warning cairn
		for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			Kit.part(m, { Name = "Post", Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 16, 1.2), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(s * 3.2, 8, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-s * 4)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
		end
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Lintel", Size = Vector3.new(9, 1.2, 1.2), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 15.6, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Rope", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(14, 0.35, 0.35), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(-3.6, 8, -6) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = COL.lantern })
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Board", Size = Vector3.new(6, 2.4, 0.4), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 13.4, -0.7), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = col })
		Kit.place(m, "Cairn", (cf * CFrame.new(5.5, 0, -2)).Position, 0, 1)
	else
		-- Spire Ridge: tall dark slate monolith pair with an ice crystal: expert, stark
		for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			Kit.part(m, { Name = "Monolith", Size = Vector3.new(2.6, 22, 3), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(s * 4, 11, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-s * 6)), Material = Enum.Material.Slate, Color = COL.slate })
		end
		Kit.place(m, "CrystalIce", (cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1.5)).Position, 0, 0.8)
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Board", Size = Vector3.new(6, 2.4, 0.4), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 17, -1.2), Material = Enum.Material.Slate, Color = col })
	end
	pips(Kit, m, cf * CFrame.new(0, 3.5, -2.2), st.pips, col)
	-- name + warning sign beside the gate (hard routes are optional and marked, LOCKED decision 14)
	local lines = { { label, 0 } }
	if st.pips >= 3 then
		lines[2] = { (st.pips == 4) and "EXPERT - exposed ridge" or "HARD - exposed ledges", 0 }
	else
		lines[2] = { (st.pips == 1) and "Beginner friendly" or "Moderate - stairs", 0 }
	end
	Kit.sign(m, cf * CFrame.new(-8, 0, -4) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0), lines, 11)
	m:SetAttribute("Route", name)
	-- 1.6x so the four silhouettes read from the plaza (scaled about the gate base)
	m.WorldPivot = cf
	m:ScaleTo(1.6)
	return m
end

function V.build(Kit, Gen)
	local COL = Kit.COL
	local P = _G.CC_PATHS
	local pad = P.pads.Foothold
	local C0 = Vector3.new(pad.x, pad.y, pad.z)
	local f = flat(-C0).Unit -- toward the summit
	local r = f:Cross(UP).Unit
	local function at(df, dr)
		local p = C0 + f * df + r * dr
		return Vector3.new(p.X, Gen.heightAt(p.X, p.Z), p.Z)
	end
	local function face(p, q)
		return flat(q - p).Unit
	end
	local root = Kit.folder(Kit.folder(Kit.folder(workspace, "World"), "Regions"), "Foothold")
	for _, c in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
		c:Destroy()
	end
	local core = Kit.folder(root, "Core")
	local dist = Kit.folder(root, "Districts")
	-- paint a path into the foothill surface (dry grass / red earth / grass) between two ground points
	local function paintPath(a, b, width, mat)
		local T0 = workspace.Terrain
		local d = Vector3.new(b.X - a.X, 0, b.Z - a.Z)
		local n = math.max(1, math.floor(d.Magnitude / 4))
		for i = 0, n do
			local p = a:Lerp(b, i / n)
			local reg = Region3.new(p - Vector3.new(width / 2, 6, width / 2), p + Vector3.new(width / 2, 3, width / 2)):ExpandToGrid(4)
			for _, from in ipairs({ Enum.Material.Salt, Enum.Material.Mud, Enum.Material.Grass, Enum.Material.LeafyGrass, Enum.Material.Ground }) do
				if from ~= mat then
					T0:ReplaceMaterial(reg, 4, from, mat)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- central campfire plaza (radius 125: >= 3x the V2 plaza footprint)
	local plaza = at(10, 0)
	local T = workspace.Terrain
	for ring = 0, 125, 4 do
		local n = math.max(6, math.floor(ring * 0.8))
		for k = 0, n - 1 do
			local a = k / n * math.pi * 2
			local p = plaza + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * ring, 0, math.sin(a) * ring)
			T:ReplaceMaterial(Region3.new(p - Vector3.new(3, 6, 3), p + Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)):ExpandToGrid(4), 4, Enum.Material.Salt, Enum.Material.Cobblestone)
		end
	end
	Kit.campfire(core, plaza)
	for k = 0, 5 do
		local a = k / 6 * math.pi * 2
		local bp = plaza + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 9, 0, math.sin(a) * 9)
		Kit.bench(core, CFrame.lookAt(bp, plaza) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0))
	end
	for k = 0, 11 do
		local a = k / 12 * math.pi * 2
		Kit.lantern(core, plaza + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 118, 0, math.sin(a) * 118), 8, k % 3 == 0)
	end

	-- summit-view amphitheater spawn: 6 curved stone tiers rising away from the mountain, spawn on top
	local amph = Kit.folder(core, "Amphitheater")
	local ac = at(-120, 0)
	for tier = 0, 5 do
		local rad = 40 + tier * 9
		for k = -7, 7 do
			local a = k / 7 * math.rad(65)
			local dir = (-f * math.cos(a) + r * math.sin(a))
			local p = ac + dir * rad
			local w = rad * math.rad(65) / 7 * 1.08
			Kit.part(amph, {
				Name = "Tier",
				Size = Vector3.new(w, 2.4 + tier * 2.4, 9.2),
				CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(p.X, ac.Y + (2.4 + tier * 2.4) / 2 - 1, p.Z), Vector3.new(ac.X, ac.Y + (2.4 + tier * 2.4) / 2 - 1, ac.Z)),
				Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone,
				Color = COL.masonry,
			})
		end
	end
	local spawnPos = ac - f * 86 + Vector3.new(0, 14.4, 0)
	local sp = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpawnLocation") or Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
	sp.Size = Vector3.new(10, 1, 10)
	sp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(spawnPos, spawnPos + f)
	sp.Anchored = true
	sp.Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone
	sp.Color = COL.masonry
	sp.Transparency = 0
	sp.Duration = 0
	sp.Parent = workspace
	Kit.sign(amph, CFrame.lookAt(ac - f * 70 + r * 12 + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0), ac - f * 70 + r * 12 + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0) + r), { { "Foothold", 0 }, { "Summit 3,200 up", 0 } }, 9)
	paintPath(ac, plaza, 14, Enum.Material.Cobblestone)

	-- Route Board: stepped relief of the mountain on a round stone table, one pip row per route
	local board = Kit.folder(core, "RouteBoard")
	local bp = at(70, 0)
	Kit.part(board, { Name = "Table", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(3, 26, 26), CFrame = CFrame.new(bp + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone, Color = COL.masonry })
	local tiers = { { 11, "golden" }, { 9.5, "meadow" }, { 8, "forestTeal" }, { 6.5, "sandstone" }, { 5, "slate" } }
	for k, t in ipairs(tiers) do
		Kit.part(board, { Name = "Relief", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(1.2, t[1] * 2, t[1] * 2), CFrame = CFrame.new(bp + Vector3.new(0, 3 + k * 1.2, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Color = COL[t[2]] })
	end
	local spire = Kit.part(board, { Name = "ReliefSpire", Size = Vector3.new(3, 9, 3), CFrame = CFrame.new(bp + Vector3.new(0, 13.4, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0), Material = Enum.Material.Glass, Color = COL.ice })
	Kit.decor(spire)
	local order = { "Shepherd", "Waterfall", "Ledge", "Spire" }
	for i, name in ipairs(order) do
		local st = ROUTE_STYLE[name]
		local cf = CFrame.lookAt(bp - f * 14 + r * ((i - 2.5) * 6) + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), bp - f * 30 + r * ((i - 2.5) * 6) + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
		pips(Kit, board, cf * CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0), st.pips, COL[st.col])
	end
	local function tile(nm, label, stars)
		return { label .. "  " .. stars .. (P.routes[nm] and "" or "  (coming soon)"), 0 }
	end
	Kit.sign(board, CFrame.lookAt(bp - f * 18 - r * 16, bp - f * 18 - r * 16 - f), { { "Route Board", 0 }, tile("Shepherd", "Shepherd's Road", "*"), tile("Waterfall", "Waterfall Stair", "**"), tile("Ledge", "Cliff Ledge Line", "***"), tile("Spire", "Spire Ridge", "****") }, 13)

	-- trailhead gates at each route's start, avenues from the plaza
	local gates = Kit.folder(core, "Gates")
	local labels = { Shepherd = "Shepherd's Road", Waterfall = "Waterfall Stair", Ledge = "Cliff Ledge Line", Spire = "Spire Ridge" }
	for _, name in ipairs(order) do
		local R = P.routes[name]
		local gp, dir
		if R then
			local g0 = R.pts[1]
			local g1 = R.pts[math.min(#R.pts, 12)]
			gp = Vector3.new(g0[1], g0[3], g0[2])
			dir = flat(Vector3.new(g1[1], 0, g1[2]) - Vector3.new(g0[1], 0, g0[2])).Unit
		else
			-- v5 gated route (not built): the gate stands at its V3 trailhead, closed
			for _, d in ipairs(C.ROUTES) do
				if d.name == name then
					local x0, z0 = Gen.toWorld(d.ctrl[1][1], d.ctrl[1][2])
					local x1, z1 = Gen.toWorld(d.ctrl[2][1], d.ctrl[2][2])
					gp = Vector3.new(x0, Gen.heightAt(x0, z0), z0)
					dir = flat(Vector3.new(x1 - x0, 0, z1 - z0)).Unit
				end
			end
		end
		local gm = gate(Kit, gates, name, gp, dir, labels[name])
		if not R then
			-- "Coming soon" (v5 first publish, user 2026-10-21): rope across the gate, timber barrier, sign
			local cf = CFrame.lookAt(gp, gp + dir)
			local cm = Kit.model(gm, "ComingSoon")
			for _, sg in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
				Kit.part(cm, { Name = "BarrierPost", Size = Vector3.new(1, 5, 1), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(sg * 6, 2.5, -3), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
			end
			Kit.part(cm, { Name = "BarrierRail", Size = Vector3.new(13, 1, 0.6), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 3.8, -3), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
			Kit.part(cm, { Name = "BarrierRail", Size = Vector3.new(13, 1, 0.6), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 1.8, -3), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
			Kit.sign(cm, cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, -5) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0), { { labels[name], 0 }, { "Coming soon", 0 } }, 10)
			gm:SetAttribute("ComingSoon", true)
		end
		paintPath(plaza + flat(gp - plaza).Unit * 100, gp, (name == "Shepherd") and 12 or 8, Enum.Material.Cobblestone)
	end

	-- Lookout Tower: the landmark (stone shaft, timber crown, lantern) north-west of the plaza
	local tw = Kit.folder(dist, "LookoutTower")
	local tp = at(60, -150)
	for k = 0, 5 do
		local w = 16 - k * 1.2
		Kit.part(tw, { Name = "Shaft", Size = Vector3.new(w, 8, w), CFrame = CFrame.new(tp + Vector3.new(0, 4 + k * 8, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45 * (k % 2)) * 0.15, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone, Color = COL.masonry })
	end
	Kit.part(tw, { Name = "Deck", Size = Vector3.new(18, 1.2, 18), CFrame = CFrame.new(tp + Vector3.new(0, 49, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
	for _, x in ipairs({ -8, 8 }) do
		for _, z in ipairs({ -8, 8 }) do
			Kit.part(tw, { Name = "CrownPost", Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 9, 1.2), CFrame = CFrame.new(tp + Vector3.new(x, 54, z)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
		end
	end
	Kit.part(tw, { Name = "Roof", Size = Vector3.new(14, 14, 14), CFrame = CFrame.new(tp + Vector3.new(0, 62, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(45), math.rad(45), 0), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timberDark })
	local beacon = Kit.part(tw, { Name = "Beacon", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * 4, CFrame = CFrame.new(tp + Vector3.new(0, 52, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = COL.lantern })
	Kit.decor(beacon)
	local bl = Instance.new("PointLight")
	bl.Color, bl.Range, bl.Brightness = COL.lantern, 40, 2
	bl.Parent = beacon

	-- cable-car station (decorative landmark only; PROPOSED): station hut + two cables up toward Camp 1
	local cc = Kit.folder(dist, "CableCar")
	local cs = at(150, -95)
	local ccf = CFrame.lookAt(cs + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), Vector3.new(P.pads.Camp1.x, cs.Y + 1.4, P.pads.Camp1.z))
	Kit.cabin(cc, ccf, 22, 16, 10, { name = "CableStation", doorWidth = 8, roofColor = COL.slate })
	local top = Vector3.new(P.pads.Camp1.x - 70, P.pads.Camp1.y + 30, P.pads.Camp1.z + 40)
	local a0 = (ccf * CFrame.new(0, 14, -9)).Position
	for _, s in ipairs({ -2.5, 2.5 }) do
		local a = a0 + ccf.RightVector * s
		local b = top + ccf.RightVector * s
		local n = 12
		for k = 0, n - 1 do
			local p0, p1 = a:Lerp(b, k / n), a:Lerp(b, (k + 1) / n)
			local sag0 = -math.sin(math.pi * k / n) * 18
			local sag1 = -math.sin(math.pi * (k + 1) / n) * 18
			p0 += Vector3.new(0, sag0, 0)
			p1 += Vector3.new(0, sag1, 0)
			local cable = Kit.part(cc, { Name = "Cable", Size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, (p1 - p0).Magnitude), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((p0 + p1) / 2, p1), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, Color = COL.slate })
			Kit.decor(cable)
		end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs({ 0.33, 0.66 }) do
		local p = a0:Lerp(top, t)
		local gy = Gen.heightAt(p.X, p.Z)
		local h = p.Y - gy - math.sin(math.pi * t) * 18 + 3
		if h > 4 then
			Kit.part(cc, { Name = "Pylon", Size = Vector3.new(2.4, h, 2.4), CFrame = CFrame.new(p.X, gy + h / 2, p.Z), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, Color = COL.slate })
			Kit.part(cc, { Name = "PylonArm", Size = Vector3.new(8, 1, 1.4), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(p.X, gy + h, p.Z), Vector3.new(p.X, gy + h, p.Z) + ccf.RightVector), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, Color = COL.slate })
		end
	end
	local car = Kit.part(cc, { Name = "Gondola", Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 6), CFrame = CFrame.new(a0:Lerp(top, 0.2) - Vector3.new(0, math.sin(math.pi * 0.2) * 18 + 4, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.lantern })
	Kit.decor(car)
	Kit.sign(cc, ccf * CFrame.new(13, -1.4, -4), { { "Cable Car (closed)", 0 } }, 10)

	-- Hall of Wonders (east, facing the plaza): stone hall with portico and 8 display plinths
	local how = Kit.folder(dist, "HallOfWonders")
	local hp = at(0, 180) + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0)
	local hcf = CFrame.lookAt(hp, Vector3.new(plaza.X, hp.Y, plaza.Z))
	local hall = Kit.cabin(how, hcf, 56, 34, 18, { name = "HallOfWonders", doorWidth = 10, roofRise = 18, roofColor = COL.slate })
	for _, w in ipairs(hall:GetChildren()) do
		if w.Name:match("^Wall") or w.Name == "Lintel" or w.Name == "Gable" then
			w.Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone
			w.Color = COL.masonry
		end
	end
	for k = -2, 2 do
		local cp = (hcf * CFrame.new(k * 9.5, 0, -22)).Position
		Kit.part(how, { Name = "Column", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(20, 3.4, 3.4), CFrame = CFrame.new(cp + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Material = Enum.Material.Limestone, Color = COL.moon })
	end
	Kit.part(how, { Name = "Portico", Size = Vector3.new(50, 2, 10), CFrame = hcf * CFrame.new(0, 21, -21), Material = Enum.Material.Limestone, Color = COL.moon })
	for _, x in ipairs({ -18, -6, 6, 18 }) do
		for _, z in ipairs({ -4, 8 }) do
			local pp = (hcf * CFrame.new(x, 2.4, z)).Position
			Kit.part(how, { Name = "Plinth", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(3, 5, 5), CFrame = CFrame.new(pp) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Material = Enum.Material.Limestone, Color = COL.moon })
		end
	end
	Kit.sign(how, hcf * CFrame.new(28, -1.4, -26), { { "Hall of Wonders", 0 } }, 10)
	paintPath(plaza + flat(hp - plaza).Unit * 120, hp, 10, Enum.Material.Cobblestone)

	-- Gear Forge (north-east)
	local forge = Kit.folder(dist, "GearForge")
	local fp = at(95, 165) + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0)
	local fcf = CFrame.lookAt(fp, Vector3.new(plaza.X, fp.Y, plaza.Z))
	Kit.cabin(forge, fcf, 30, 22, 12, { name = "GearForge", doorWidth = 8, roofColor = COL.slate })
	local hearth = (fcf * CFrame.new(-10, 0, -15)).Position
	Kit.part(forge, { Name = "Hearth", Size = Vector3.new(8, 6, 6), CFrame = CFrame.new(hearth + Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone, Color = COL.masonry })
	local coals = Kit.part(forge, { Name = "Coals", Size = Vector3.new(5, 2, 1), CFrame = CFrame.new(hearth + Vector3.new(0, 4.4, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = COL.lantern })
	Kit.decor(coals)
	Kit.sign(forge, fcf * CFrame.new(-18, -1.4, -10), { { "Gear Forge", 0 } }, 8)

	-- Provisions Market: four stalls on the south-east arc of the plaza
	local market = Kit.folder(dist, "ProvisionsMarket")
	local awn = { COL.golden, COL.turquoise, COL.meadow, COL.lantern }
	for k = 0, 3 do
		local a = math.rad(110 + k * 14)
		local p = plaza + (f * math.cos(a) + r * math.sin(a)) * 108
		p = Vector3.new(p.X, Gen.heightAt(p.X, p.Z), p.Z)
		stall(Kit, market, CFrame.lookAt(p, Vector3.new(plaza.X, p.Y, plaza.Z)), awn[k + 1])
	end

	-- Garage + ATV trail start (south-east, toward the open foothills)
	local garage = Kit.folder(dist, "Garage")
	local gp = at(-110, 200)
	local gcf = CFrame.lookAt(gp, Vector3.new(plaza.X, gp.Y, plaza.Z))
	Kit.part(garage, { Name = "Slab", Size = Vector3.new(34, 1, 22), CFrame = gcf * CFrame.new(0, 0.1, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Concrete, Color = COL.masonry })
	Kit.part(garage, { Name = "BackWall", Size = Vector3.new(34, 12, 1), CFrame = gcf * CFrame.new(0, 6.5, 11), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		Kit.part(garage, { Name = "SideWall", Size = Vector3.new(1, 12, 22), CFrame = gcf * CFrame.new(s * 17, 6.5, 0), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
	end
	Kit.part(garage, { Name = "Roof", Size = Vector3.new(37, 1.2, 26), CFrame = gcf * CFrame.new(0, 13.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(6), 0, 0), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timberDark })
	Kit.sign(garage, gcf * CFrame.new(14, 0, -16), { { "Garage / ATV", 0 } }, 8)
	paintPath(gp, at(-250, 330), 9, Enum.Material.Ground)

	-- Base Pad (helicopter arrival, auto-bank) south-west
	local padf = Kit.folder(dist, "BasePad")
	local hp2 = at(-150, -190)
	Kit.part(padf, { Name = "Pad", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(1.4, 50, 50), CFrame = CFrame.new(hp2 + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Material = Enum.Material.Concrete, Color = COL.slate })
	Kit.part(padf, { Name = "Ring", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 44, 44), CFrame = CFrame.new(hp2 + Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Color = COL.golden })
	Kit.part(padf, { Name = "RingInner", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 40, 40), CFrame = CFrame.new(hp2 + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Material = Enum.Material.Concrete, Color = COL.slate })
	for _, d in ipairs({ 0, -5.5, 5.5 }) do
		Kit.part(padf, { Name = "H", Size = (d == 0) and Vector3.new(11, 1.7, 2.8) or Vector3.new(2.8, 1.7, 17), CFrame = CFrame.new(hp2 + Vector3.new(d, 0.5, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Color = COL.golden })
	end
	Kit.sign(padf, CFrame.new(hp2 + r * 30), { { "Base Pad", 0 } }, 7)

	-- Hatchery (west): round stone nursery with four nests
	local hat = Kit.folder(dist, "Hatchery")
	local hc = at(-10, -180)
	for k = 0, 15 do
		local a0, a1 = k / 16 * math.pi * 2, (k + 1) / 16 * math.pi * 2
		if k ~= 4 then
			local p0 = hc + Vector3.new(math.cos(a0) * 14, 0, math.sin(a0) * 14)
			local p1 = hc + Vector3.new(math.cos(a1) * 14, 0, math.sin(a1) * 14)
			local mid = (p0 + p1) / 2
			Kit.part(hat, { Name = "Wall", Size = Vector3.new(1.4, 10, (p1 - p0).Magnitude + 0.4), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(mid + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), p1 + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone, Color = COL.masonry })
		end
	end
	for k = 0, 5 do
		local rr = 17 - k * 2.8
		Kit.part(hat, { Name = "Roof", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(1.6, rr * 2, rr * 2), CFrame = CFrame.new(hc + Vector3.new(0, 10.5 + k * 1.5, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = (k % 2 == 0) and COL.timberDark or COL.timber })
	end
	local eggCols = { COL.turquoise, COL.indigo, COL.golden, COL.violet }
	for k = 0, 3 do
		local a = (k + 0.5) / 4 * math.pi * 2
		local np = hc + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 7, 0, math.sin(a) * 7)
		local egg = Kit.part(hat, { Name = "Egg", Size = Vector3.new(3, 3.8, 3), CFrame = CFrame.new(np + Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Color = eggCols[k + 1] })
		local sm = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
		sm.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Sphere
		sm.Parent = egg
		Kit.decor(egg, true)
	end
	Kit.sign(hat, CFrame.new(hc + r * 18 - f * 10), { { "Hatchery", 0 } }, 7)
	paintPath(plaza + flat(hc - plaza).Unit * 120, hc, 8, Enum.Material.Cobblestone)

	-- 9 terraced player cabins with habitat yards on the outer ring (south-east and south-west arcs)
	local cabins = Kit.folder(dist, "Cabins")
	local slots = { -150, -132, -114, -96, 96, 114, 132, 150, 168 }
	local n = 0
	for i, deg in ipairs(slots) do
		local a = math.rad(deg)
		local p = C0 + (f * math.cos(a) + r * math.sin(a)) * 235
		local pos = Vector3.new(p.X, Gen.heightAt(p.X, p.Z), p.Z)
		local facing = face(pos, plaza)
		local m = Kit.model(cabins, "PlayerCabin_" .. i)
		local tcf = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + facing)
		local th = 2.5 + (i % 2) * 2.5
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Terrace", Size = Vector3.new(30, th + 2, 26), CFrame = tcf * CFrame.new(0, th / 2 - 1, 2), Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone, Color = COL.masonry })
		local top = pos + Vector3.new(0, th, 0)
		Kit.cabin(m, CFrame.lookAt(top + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0) - facing * 2, top + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0) - facing * 2 + facing), 16, 13, 8, { name = "Cabin", doorWidth = 4 })
		local yc = pos - facing * 30
		local pts = {}
		for k = 0, 10 do
			local aa = math.pi * (k / 10) - math.pi / 2
			local rr = facing:Cross(UP).Unit
			local q = yc + rr * math.sin(aa) * 15 - facing * math.cos(aa) * 12
			pts[#pts + 1] = Vector3.new(q.X, Gen.heightAt(q.X, q.Z), q.Z)
		end
		Kit.fence(m, pts, 3)
		m:SetAttribute("CabinSlot", i)
		n += 1
		paintPath(plaza + flat(pos - plaza).Unit * 122, pos + facing * 14, 6, Enum.Material.Mud)
	end

	-- dry-foothill planting kept out of the summit sightline: scrub bushes, a few shade trees
	local green = Kit.folder(dist, "Greenery")
	local rng = Random.new(5)
	for k = 0, 23 do
		local a = k / 24 * math.pi * 2
		local dirv = f * math.cos(a) + r * math.sin(a)
		if math.cos(a) < 0.55 then -- skip the arc toward the summit
			local p = plaza + dirv * (140 + rng:NextNumber(-8, 8))
			p = Vector3.new(p.X, Gen.heightAt(p.X, p.Z), p.Z)
			if k % 3 == 0 then
				Kit.place(green, "TreeRound", p - Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0), a, rng:NextNumber(1.3, 1.7), C.DRY.scrub)
			else
				Kit.place(green, "Bush", p - Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0), a, rng:NextNumber(1.2, 1.8), C.DRY.scrub)
			end
		end
	end
	return { cabins = n, spawn = spawnPos }
end

return V

-- Progression (ServerScriptService.CC_CoreServer): XP -> level, backpack slots (LOCKED 4 -> 12: levels 2-7 +1 each,
-- two codex milestones +1 each). Pure functions over profile data.
local C = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("CC_Core"):WaitForChild("CoreConfig"))

local Prog = {}

function Prog.levelFor(xp)
	local lv = 1
	for i, need in ipairs(C.LEVEL_XP) do
		if xp >= need then
			lv = i
		end
	end
	return lv
end

function Prog.speciesCount(data)
	local n = 0
	for _, c in pairs(data.codex) do
		if c > 0 then
			n += 1
		end
	end
	return n
end

function Prog.slots(data)
	local s = C.SLOTS_BASE
	for _, lv in ipairs(C.SLOT_LEVELS) do
		if data.level >= lv then
			s += 1
		end
	end
	local species = Prog.speciesCount(data)
	for _, m in ipairs(C.SLOT_MILESTONES) do
		if species >= m then
			s += 1
		end
	end
	return math.min(s, C.SLOTS_MAX)
end

-- add XP; recompute level and slots; returns levelsGained
function Prog.addXp(data, amount)
	local before = data.level
	data.xp += math.max(0, math.floor(amount))
	data.level = math.max(data.level or 1, Prog.levelFor(data.xp))
	data.slots = math.min(C.SLOTS_MAX, math.max(data.slots or C.SLOTS_BASE, Prog.slots(data)))
	return data.level - before
end

function Prog.refresh(data)
	-- A rebalance/migration cannot revoke previously earned levels or backpack upgrades.
	data.level = math.max(data.level or 1, Prog.levelFor(data.xp))
	data.slots = math.min(C.SLOTS_MAX, math.max(data.slots or C.SLOTS_BASE, Prog.slots(data)))
end

-- XP still needed for the next level (nil at max)
function Prog.nextLevelXp(data)
	return C.LEVEL_XP[data.level + 1]
end

return Prog

-- RouteSpline (v5 P1, 2026-10-21): v5 route data. One spline per route; each node sets the segment that leaves it.
-- Node: polar { th, re } (shelf: y = natural ground + dy), or a band node { th, y, band = { reLo, reHi } } (the
-- trail sits on the band face where the natural ground is `cut` (4) above it: re is solved on the contour; without y
-- the height is AUTO, spread evenly by distance between the neighbouring known heights), or a
-- fixed { x, z } (pinned tutorial anchors). name = waypoint (Gate, Camp1..Camp4, Merge snap to their pads).
--   t      segment type: ledge | slot | ridge | open | gap | log | stair   (SplineGen header)
--   w      tread width (2-5 tight; open up to 10)
--   piece  set piece at this node: { kind = "ladder", rise, run, inward } (vertical step to a top landing `run`
--          ahead, or toward the summit axis with inward = true: a ledge that reverses at a ladder face),
--          { kind = "rest", style = "pavilion"|"tent" } (stamina refill + checkpoint), { kind = "cairn" }
--          (checkpoint only), { kind = "log" } / { kind = "ropebridge" } on a gap segment, { kind = "cleft" }
--          (boulders + slabs in a slot), { kind = "stairs", rise } (boulder stair blocks + twin ladders),
--          { kind = "tear" } (fog tear viewpoint)
-- First publish (user, 2026-10-21): Shepherd + Waterfall on this kit; Ledge + Spire gated "Coming soon".
-- Placements PROPOSED (route sequences: design/v5-trails-and-mountain-plan.md round 3).
local S = {}

S.LIVE = { "Shepherd", "Waterfall" }
S.GATED = { Ledge = true, Spire = true }

local LIP = { 1840, 2140 }
local FOREST = { 1480, 1660 }
local CLIFFS = { 1000, 1300 }
local STEPB = { 845, 970 }
local STORM = { 520, 820 }
local SPIRE = { 300, 490 }
S.BANDS = { lip = LIP, forest = FOREST, cliffs = CLIFFS, step = STEPB, storm = STORM, spire = SPIRE }

-- v6: world-polar node helper (theta, world radius; the band nodes use effective radius + contour solving instead)
local function WP(th, r, t)
	t = t or {}
	t.x, t.z = r * math.sin(th), r * math.cos(th)
	return t
end
-- v6: contour search window for the forest-band tiers (wider than FOREST: the band swings out to r ~1700 at th 1.0)
local BAND6 = { 1440, 1800 }
-- v6: creek gorge from the falls chute to the band foot (Shepherd leg 2): the only crossing of the creek on the open
-- shelf is the route's (steps down, stepping stones, pitch up). Water level - depth = gorge floor. hw is measured from
-- every creek water cell (the creek is ~10 wide), so floor half-width ~7 and walls to ~10 from the creek centre.
-- Full depth from th 0.448 (a taper to 0.495 left the chute crossable with a 20-stud drop at th 0.45-0.47: bypass
-- test, v6); below 0.44 the falls slot itself is the barrier.
S.GORGES = {
	{ name = "CreekGorge", th0 = 0.432, th1 = 0.668, depth = 26, hw = 2, wall = 3, taper = { 0.432, 0.448 }, rLo = 1520, rHi = 1760 },
}

S.ROUTES = {
	{
		-- no rails (user 2026-10-21: falls and lost progress keep it tense; supersedes the "railed ledges" in decision 3)
		name = "Shepherd", label = "Shepherd's Road", w = 5, rail = "none", maxGrade = 0.6,
		nodes = {
			-- leg 1: Foothold gate -> tutorial lowland (pinned: the Rare nook rope is beside the s 840 road point) ->
			-- railed ledge up the lip band -> lip nest lower shelf -> pavilion -> Camp 1
			{ x = -227.2, z = 1812.2, y = 48, name = "Gate", t = "open", w = 8 },
			{ x = -610.6, z = 1908.5, t = "open", w = 8 },
			{ x = -1047.2, z = 1879.6, name = "Nook", t = "ledge" },
			{ th = -0.42, band = LIP, piece = { kind = "cairn" } },
			{ th = -0.30, band = LIP },
			{ th = -0.20, band = LIP, t = "slot", piece = { kind = "cleft" } },
			{ th = -0.16, y = 340, band = LIP, t = "ledge" },
			{ x = -175, z = 1648, name = "LipShelf", t = "slot", dy = -3 },
			{ th = 0.00, re = 1845, piece = { kind = "rest", style = "pavilion" } },
			{ th = 0.05, re = 1790, t = "open", w = 8 },
			-- leg 2 (v6 beat chain, 2026-10-21): Camp 1 -> cleft -> shelf -> cleft 2 -> falls overlook -> creek-gorge
			-- west rim -> steps down into the gorge, stepping stones, pitch up the far wall -> band foot -> the forest band
			-- climbed in 10 eastward tiers (pitch, ladders, chimney, rock steps, jump gaps, pinches, a hand traverse,
			-- rope bridges, the tall ladder) -> top-out pitch -> upper shelf cleft -> Camp 2. Checkpoints: band foot,

-- BuildAll (V3 Ascent): reproducible rebuild of the world from the generator modules.
-- Run in edit mode via execute_luau, one step per call (each stays under a few seconds):
--   local B = require(ServerStorage.CC_Generators:Clone().BuildAll)
--   B.clearWorld()            -- removes Workspace.World (V2 content lives in checkpoint PreV3_2026-10-20)
--   B.terrain(1, opts) ; B.terrain(2) ; B.terrain(3)
--   (terrain(1) also rebuilds _G.CC_PATHS; every later step depends on it. opts.routes = false = P1 terrain only)
--   ... B.player() ; B.foothold() ; B.camps() ; B.route(name) ... ; B.ledgeP1() (v4 P1, after B.camps) ; B.shepherdP2()
--   ; B.ledgeRoute() (v4 P3)
local B = {}
local folder = script.Parent

local function mods()
	return {
		Gen = require(folder.MountainGen),
		Kit = require(folder.Kit),
	}
end

function B.clearWorld()
	local w = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
	if w then
		for _, c in ipairs(w:GetChildren()) do
			c:Destroy()
			task.wait()
		end
	end
	return true
end

function B.terrain(part, opts)
	local m = mods()
	local rows = m.Gen.BLOCK_ROWS
	local third = math.ceil(rows / 3)
	if part == 1 then
		local res = m.Gen.computeField(opts)
		_G.CC_Gen = m.Gen
		workspace.Terrain:Clear()
		m.Gen.applyColors()
		m.Gen.writeRows(0, third - 1)
		return res
	elseif part == 2 then
		_G.CC_Gen.writeRows(third, 2 * third - 1)
		return true
	end
	_G.CC_Gen.writeRows(2 * third, rows - 1)
	return _G.CC_Gen.writeCrown()
end

-- player movement settings + route export for runtime code (bots now, objective pointer later)
function B.player()
	local TK = require(folder.TraverseKit)
	TK.applyPlayer()
	TK.exportRoute()
	-- every route (and the shared summit stair) as "x,y,z,s;..." for bots and runtime code
	local f = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("CC_Route")
	for _, R in pairs(_G.CC_PATHS.routes) do
		local t = {}
		for i = 1, #R.pts, 3 do
			local q = R.pts[i]
			t[#t + 1] = string.format("%.1f,%.1f,%.1f,%.1f", q[1], q[3], q[2], R.S[i])
		end
		local sv = f:FindFirstChild(R.name) or Instance.new("StringValue")
		sv.Name = R.name
		sv.Value = table.concat(t, ";")
		sv.Parent = f
	end
	return true
end

-- V3 P3: Foothold home base
function B.foothold()
	local m = mods()
	return require(folder.FootholdV3).build(m.Kit, _G.CC_Gen)
end

-- V3 P4/P5: camps, then per route: bridges, checkpoints, wayfinding, hazards
function B.camps()
	local m = mods()
	local RK = require(folder.RouteKit)
	local cp = workspace:FindFirstChild("World") and workspace.World:FindFirstChild("Checkpoints")
	if cp then
		cp:Destroy()
	end
	return RK.camps(m.Kit, _G.CC_Gen)
end

function B.route(name)
	local m = mods()
	local RK = require(folder.RouteKit)
	return { RK.route(m.Kit, _G.CC_Gen, name), RK.hazards(m.Kit, _G.CC_Gen, name) }
end

-- v4 P1: Cliff Ledge Line first climb section (after B.camps; the terrain already carries the route's stampSkip)
function B.ledgeP1()
	local m = mods()
	return require(folder.LedgeP1).build(m.Kit)
end

-- v4 P3: Cliff Ledge Line pitch stacks (after B.camps; terrain written with WorldConfig Ledge.lines unstamped)
function B.ledgeRoute(only)
	local m = mods()
	return require(folder.LedgeRoute).build(m.Kit, only)
end

-- v4 P3: Spire Ridge / Waterfall Stair pitch stacks (after B.route(name))
function B.routeLines(name, only)
	local m = mods()
	return require(folder.RouteLines).build(m.Kit, name, only)
end

-- v4 P3 (run 2): every pitch stack of every route. Rewrites all stack boxes from the generated field first, then
-- builds them all: a single-route rebuild rewrites its boxes, which overlap neighbouring routes' stacks (Waterfall /
-- Ledge / Spire cliffs) and erased their ledges. Use this after any stack change.
function B.allLines()
	local m = mods()
	local CK = require(folder.ClimbKit)
	local LR = require(folder.LedgeRoute)
	for _, name in ipairs({ "Ledge", "Spire", "Waterfall", "Shepherd" }) do
		local R = _G.CC_PATHS.routes[name]
		for _, ln in ipairs((R and not R.v5 and R.def.lines) or {}) do
			if ln.kind == "stack" and (name ~= "Ledge" or LR.STACKS[ln.band]) then
				CK.rewrite(R, R.ctrlS[ln.c0] + (ln.pad0 or 0), R.ctrlS[ln.c1] - (ln.pad1 or 0))
			elseif ln.kind == "hang" then
				CK.rewrite(R, ln.s0, ln.s1)
			end
		end
	end
	local out = {}
	if _G.CC_PATHS.routes.Ledge then
		out[#out + 1] = "Ledge:\n" .. LR.build(m.Kit, nil, { rewrite = false })
	end
	task.wait()
	for _, name in ipairs({ "Spire", "Waterfall", "Shepherd" }) do
		local R = _G.CC_PATHS.routes[name]
		if R and not R.v5 then
			out[#out + 1] = name .. ":\n" .. require(folder.RouteLines).build(m.Kit, name, nil, { rewrite = false })
			task.wait()
		end
	end
	return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

-- v4 P2: one "gentle but alive" Shepherd's Road stretch (after B.route("Shepherd"))
-- v4 P4 (run 2): the Training Yard annex outside the Foothold (after the terrain + routes: it avoids route paths)
function B.trainingYard()
	local m = mods()
	return require(folder.TrainingYard).build(m.Kit, m.Gen)
end

-- v5 P1: a spline route's world pieces (after the terrain with opts.v5 and B.player / B.camps)
function B.v5Route(name)
	local m = mods()
	return require(folder.SplineKit).build(m.Kit, m.Gen, name)
end

-- v5: whole world in order (P1: v5 Shepherd + v4 Waterfall). opts = computeField opts; returns a report
function B.v5All(opts)
	opts = opts or { routes = true, v5 = true }
	local out = {}
	B.clearWorld()
	B.terrain(1, opts)
	task.wait()
	B.terrain(2)
	task.wait()
	B.terrain(3)
	B.player()
	B.foothold()
	B.camps()
	for _, name in ipairs({ "Shepherd", "Waterfall", "Ledge", "Spire" }) do
		local R = _G.CC_PATHS.routes[name]
		if R and not R.v5 then
			B.route(name)
		end
		task.wait()
	end
	B.route("SummitStair")
	local m = mods()
	local cp = require(folder.CoreProps).build(m.Kit)
	out[#out + 1] = "CoreProps: " .. tostring(cp.commons) .. " | " .. tostring(cp.nook)
	B.allLines()
	-- v6: spline routes after the v4 lines: allLines rewrites terrain boxes +-70 around every v4 stack from the field,
	-- which erased spline-kit terrain pieces (the Shepherd gorge pitch's marked face, beside Waterfall's forest stack)
	for _, name in ipairs({ "Shepherd", "Waterfall", "Ledge", "Spire" }) do
		local R = _G.CC_PATHS.routes[name]
		if R and R.v5 then
			out[#out + 1] = B.v5Route(name)
		end
		task.wait()
	end
	B.trainingYard()
	out[#out + 1] = "World " .. #workspace.World:GetDescendants()
	return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

function B.shepherdP2()
	local m = mods()
	return require(folder.ShepherdP2).build(m.Kit)
end

return B

-- Canonical ownership is the union of verified pass records; tier activation is contiguous.
local C=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.CC_Core.CommerceConfig)
local R={}
function R.default() return {tier=0,owned={},equipped={},passOwned={},processedPurchases={},pendingReveals={}} end
function R.activeTier(c)
 local tier=0
 for i=0,5 do if not c.passOwned["upgrade"..i] then break end; tier=i+1 end
 return tier
end
function R.applyOwnership(d)
 local c=d.commerce
 for id,v in pairs(c.passOwned) do
  local o=C.offers[id]
  if v==true and o and o.items then for _,item in ipairs(o.items) do c.owned[item]=true end end
 end
 c.tier=R.activeTier(c)
end
function R.multiplier(d) return C.tiers[d.commerce and d.commerce.tier or 0] or 1 end
function R.offerState(d,id)
 local o=C.offers[id]; if not o then return {status="unavailable"} end
 local c=d.commerce or R.default()
 if o.tier then
  if o.tier<=c.tier then return {status="owned"} end
  if c.passOwned[id] then return {status="pending",nextTier=c.tier+1} end
  return {status=o.tier==c.tier+1 and "next" or "locked",nextTier=c.tier+1}
 end
 if o.items then
  local count,missing=0,nil
  for _,item in ipairs(o.items) do if c.owned[item] then count+=1 else missing=item end end
  return {status=count==#o.items and "owned" or count>0 and "partial" or "available",missingItem=count>0 and missing or nil}
 end
 return {status="available"}
end
function R.coinPackForShortfall(n)
 if type(n)~="number" or n<=0 then return nil end
 for _,v in ipairs({100,350,900,2000}) do if v>=n then return "coins"..v end end
 return "coins2000"
end
function R.sanitize(raw)
 local c=R.default(); raw=type(raw)=="table" and raw or {}
 for id,v in pairs(type(raw.passOwned)=="table" and raw.passOwned or {}) do if C.offers[id] and C.offers[id].kind=="pass" and v==true then c.passOwned[id]=true end end
 -- Never synthesize verified ownership from a client-supplied or stale tier number.
 local d={commerce=c}; R.applyOwnership(d)
 for id,v in pairs(type(raw.equipped)=="table" and raw.equipped or {}) do if c.owned[id] and v==true then c.equipped[id]=true end end
 -- Paid IDs are NEVER trimmed. The Profile byte budget fails closed before new grants.
 for id,v in pairs(type(raw.processedPurchases)=="table" and raw.processedPurchases or {}) do if type(id)=="string" and v==true then c.processedPurchases[id]=true end end
 for id,v in pairs(type(raw.pendingReveals)=="table" and raw.pendingReveals or {}) do
  if type(id)=="string" and type(v)=="table" and C.offers[v.offerId] then c.pendingReveals[id]={offerId=v.offerId,grantId=id} end
 end
 return c
end
return R

-- Personal home courts use the existing cabin doors. No terrain/world rebuild; only visited courts exist.
-- Economic actions run against the owner's durable profile and require its physical station.
local Players, RS, Http = game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), game:GetService("HttpService")
local C, H = require(RS.CC_Core.CoreConfig), require(RS.CC_Core.HomeConfig)
local Profile, Clock, Bank = require(script.Parent.Profile), require(script.Parent.Clock), require(script.Parent.Bank)
local CommerceRules = require(script.Parent.CommerceRules)
local Home = {}
local ctx, folder
local portals, directory, visits, rooms, roomSlots, opened, companions, petAt = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
local function bankItem(data, id)
	for _, b in ipairs(data.bank) do if b.creatureId == id then return b end end
	return nil
end
local function stoneItem(data, id)
	for _, s in ipairs(data.heartstones) do if s.id == id then return s end end
	return nil
end
function Home.rate(data)
	local rate, seen = 0, {}
	for i = 1, H.baseSpaces + data.home.upgrade do
		local b = bankItem(data, data.home.assigned[i])
		if b then
			local multiplier = (b.mutation and b.mutation ~= "") and (1 + C.MUTATION_BONUS) or 1
			rate += (C.YIELD_PER_HOUR[b.rarity] or 0) * multiplier * (seen[b.species] and C.DUPLICATE_YIELD or 1)
			seen[b.species] = true
		end
	end
	return rate * CommerceRules.multiplier(data)
end
function Home.settle(data, now)
	local home = data.home
	local elapsed = math.clamp(now - (home.settledAt or now), 0, H.offlineCap)
	home.uncollected = math.max(0, home.uncollected or 0) + elapsed * Home.rate(data) / 3600
	home.settledAt = now
	return home.uncollected
end
function Home.best(data)
	local chosen, used, species = {}, {}, {}
	for _ = 1, H.baseSpaces + data.home.upgrade do
		local best, score
		for _, b in ipairs(data.bank) do
			if not used[b.creatureId] then
				local value = (C.YIELD_PER_HOUR[b.rarity] or 0) * ((b.mutation and b.mutation ~= "") and 1 + C.MUTATION_BONUS or 1) * (species[b.species] and C.DUPLICATE_YIELD or 1)
				if not score or value > score or (value == score and b.creatureId < best.creatureId) then best, score = b, value end
			end
		end
		chosen[#chosen + 1] = best and best.creatureId or ""
		if best then used[best.creatureId], species[best.species] = true, true end
	end
	return chosen
end
local function pos(plr)
	local ch = plr.Character
	local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return root and root.Position
end
local function near(plr, point, range)
	local p = pos(plr)
	return p and (p - point).Magnitude <= (range or H.stationRange)
end
local function atHomeStation(plr, room)
	local visit, p = visits[plr], pos(plr)
	local hum = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not visit or visit.returning or rooms[visit.owner] ~= room or not room or not room.occupants[plr]
		or not p or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
	local offset = p - room.center
	-- Both side nests show prompts out to their outer edges. Use the same 32-stud station reach for
	-- opening, actions and closing, bounded to this visited 58x60 court rather than nearby world space.
	return math.abs(offset.X) <= 29 and math.abs(offset.Z) <= 30 and offset.Y >= -1 and offset.Y <= 16
		and (p - room.station.Position).Magnitude <= 32
end

end

local function travel(plr, destination, reason)
	if ctx.Traversal and ctx.Traversal.travel then return ctx.Traversal.travel(plr, destination, reason) end

end
local function redraw(owner)
	local room, s = rooms[owner], ctx.sessions[owner]
	if not room or not s then return end
	if ctx.CommerceCosmetics then ctx.CommerceCosmetics.home(room,s.data) end
	room.display:ClearAllChildren()
	for i = 1, H.baseSpaces + s.data.home.upgrade do
		local x, z = ((i - 1) % 3 - 1) * 12, 3 + math.floor((i - 1) / 3) * 12
		local at = room.center + Vector3.new(x, 0.6, z)
		local b = bankItem(s.data, s.data.home.assigned[i])
		local e = b and ctx.Species.get(b.species)
		local habitat = part(room.display, "Habitat_" .. i, Vector3.new(9, 0.6, 9), at, Enum.Material.Grass, Color3.fromRGB(84, 112, 78))
		habitat:SetAttribute("HomeOwnerId", owner.UserId)
		habitat:SetAttribute("HabitatEcology", e and e.ecology or "adaptable")
		label(habitat, b and ((e and e.name or b.species) .. "\n" .. (e and e.ecology or "habitat")) or ("Earning space " .. i .. "\nAssign at the home station"))
		if b and ctx.Visuals then
			local m = ctx.Visuals.creature(b.species, at + Vector3.new(0, 2.1, 0))
			m:SetAttribute("HomeOwnerId", owner.UserId)
			m:SetAttribute("CreatureId", b.creatureId)
			for _, desc in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
				if desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Beam") then desc.Enabled = false end
				if desc:IsA("BasePart") then desc.CanCollide, desc.CanTouch = false, false end
			end
			m.Parent = room.display
		end
	end
	for i, nest in ipairs(room.nests) do
		local stone = stoneItem(s.data, s.data.home.nests[i])
		nest:SetAttribute("StoneId", stone and stone.id or "")
		local old = nest:FindFirstChild("HomeLabel")
		if old then old:Destroy() end
		label(nest, stone and (stone.tier .. " Heartstone\n" .. (stone.ready and "Ready to hatch" or string.format("Adventure %.1f / %d", stone.progress, stone.required))) or ("Heartstone nest " .. i .. "\nPlace a banked stone"))
	end
end
local function openStation(plr)
	local visit = visits[plr]
	local room = visit and rooms[visit.owner]
	if room and atHomeStation(plr, room) then
		opened[plr] = true
		ctx.fx(plr, { kind = "home", open = true })
