	end
end
local function roomFor(owner)
	if rooms[owner] then return rooms[owner] end
	local slot = 1
	while roomSlots[slot] do slot += 1 end
	roomSlots[slot] = owner
	local center = Vector3.new(12000 + (slot % 6) * H.roomSpacing, H.roomY, math.floor(slot / 6) * H.roomSpacing)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Home_" .. owner.UserId
	model.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic
	model:SetAttribute("HomeOwnerId", owner.UserId)
	local slate, warm = Color3.fromRGB(62, 66, 76), Color3.fromRGB(182, 143, 89)
	part(model, "Court", Vector3.new(58, 3, 60), center - Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), Enum.Material.Slate, slate)
	-- Visible stone parapets keep this separate safe home court contained; mountain edges remain untouched.
	for _, wall in ipairs({ { Vector3.new(58, 5, 2), Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 29) }, { Vector3.new(58, 5, 2), Vector3.new(0, 2.5, -29) }, { Vector3.new(2, 5, 56), Vector3.new(28, 2.5, 0) }, { Vector3.new(2, 5, 56), Vector3.new(-28, 2.5, 0) } }) do
		part(model, "StoneWall", wall[1], center + wall[2], Enum.Material.Rock, slate)
	end
	local station = part(model, "HomeStation", Vector3.new(8, 3, 3), center + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, -15), Enum.Material.Wood, warm)
	label(station, owner.DisplayName .. "'s home\nNests · habitats · collection")
	local display = Instance.new("Folder"); display.Name, display.Parent = "Displays", model
	local room = { slot = slot, center = center, model = model, station = station, display = display, nests = {}, occupants = {} }
	rooms[owner] = room
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local nest = part(model, "HeartstoneNest_" .. i, Vector3.new(5, 1.4, 5), center + Vector3.new(i == 1 and -17 or 17, 0.7, -15), Enum.Material.Slate, warm)
		room.nests[i] = nest
		prompt(nest, "NestPrompt", "Manage nests", "Heartstone nest", openStation)
	end
	local collectPad = part(model, "CollectPad", Vector3.new(6, 0.35, 6), center + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, -5), Enum.Material.Slate, warm)
	label(collectPad, "Collect home income")
	prompt(collectPad, "CollectPrompt", "Collect income", "Home earnings", function(plr)
		if plr == owner then ctx.handlers.homeCollect(plr, {}) else ctx.toast(plr, "This is your host's collect pad.", "info") end
	end)
	prompt(station, "HomePrompt", "Manage home", "Home station", openStation)
	local exitPad = part(model, "ReturnDoor", Vector3.new(7, 5, 1), center + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, -25), Enum.Material.Wood, warm)
	label(exitPad, "Return to the same cabin entrance")
	prompt(exitPad, "ReturnPrompt", "Return to Foothold", "Cabin entrance", function(plr) Home.returnHome(plr) end)
	model.Parent = folder
	redraw(owner)
	return room
end
local function cleanRoom(owner)
	local room = rooms[owner]
	if room and next(room.occupants) == nil then
		room.model:Destroy(); roomSlots[room.slot], rooms[owner] = nil, nil
	end
end
function Home.returnHome(plr, force)
	local visit, s = visits[plr], ctx.sessions[plr]
	if not visit or not s or visit.returning then return end
	if s.pending and not force then ctx.toast(plr, "Your last change is still saving. Please retry shortly.", "warn"); return end
	visit.returning = true
	if not travel(plr, visit.entrance, "homeReturn") then visit.returning = nil; return end
	if visits[plr] ~= visit or ctx.sessions[plr] ~= s then return end
	local room = rooms[visit.owner]
	if room then room.occupants[plr] = nil end
	visits[plr], opened[plr] = nil, nil
	plr:SetAttribute("CC_InHome", false)
	if plr.Character then plr.Character:SetAttribute("CC_HomeVisit", false) end
	Profile.clearHomeReturn(s)
	ctx.saveSoon(s)
	ctx.push(plr)
	cleanRoom(visit.owner)
end
local function enter(plr, owner)
	local door, s = directory[plr], ctx.sessions[plr]
	if not door or not s or not ctx.sessions[owner] or not near(plr, door.Position, 18) or visits[plr] then return end
	local entrance = door.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
	local res = ctx.transaction(plr, "home-enter:" .. Http:GenerateGUID(false), function(d)
		d.expedition.homeReturn = { x = entrance.X, y = entrance.Y, z = entrance.Z }
		return { ok = true }
	end, function()
		if ctx.sessions[plr] ~= s then return end
		if not plr.Parent or not owner.Parent or not ctx.sessions[owner] or not near(plr, door.Position, 18) then
			Profile.clearHomeReturn(s); ctx.saveSoon(s); return
		end
		local room = roomFor(owner)
		-- Reserve occupancy before destination streaming yields. A departing host can now return this
		-- visitor, and Traversal's travel token cancels the superseded entry without leaving a void court.
		local visit = { owner = owner, entrance = entrance }
		visits[plr], room.occupants[plr], directory[plr] = visit, true, nil
		if plr.Character then plr.Character:SetAttribute("CC_HomeVisit", true) end
		if not travel(plr, room.center + Vector3.new(0, 4, -20), "homeEnter") then
			if visits[plr] ~= visit or visit.returning then return end
			visits[plr], room.occupants[plr] = nil, nil
			if plr.Character then plr.Character:SetAttribute("CC_HomeVisit", false) end
			Profile.clearHomeReturn(s); ctx.saveSoon(s)
			cleanRoom(owner); return
		end
		if visits[plr] ~= visit or visit.returning or ctx.sessions[plr] ~= s then return end
		if not owner.Parent or not ctx.sessions[owner] then Home.returnHome(plr, true); return end
		plr:SetAttribute("CC_InHome", true)
		ctx.toast(plr, owner == plr and "Welcome home. Nests and habitats are at the stone station." or ("Visiting " .. owner.DisplayName .. ". Your host's home is read-only."), "info")
		opened[plr] = true
		ctx.fx(plr, { kind = "home", open = true })
		ctx.push(plr)
	end)
	if not res.ok then ctx.toast(plr, "Home travel is waiting for saving. Retry when connected.", "warn") end
	ctx.push(plr)
end
local function physicalOwner(plr)
	local v, s = visits[plr], ctx.sessions[plr]
	local room = v and rooms[v.owner]
	if not s or not room or v.owner ~= plr or not atHomeStation(plr, room) then return nil end
	return s
end
local errors = { pending = "Your last change is still saving.", store = "Saving is unavailable. Your change will be reconciled before another action.", notReady = "This stone needs more newly discovered expedition finds.", funds = "You need more Cairn Coins.", unavailable = "Your profile is not ready.", full = "That nest or space is occupied.", invalid = "That choice is no longer available." }
local function mutate(plr, payload, kind, fn, anywhere)
	local s = anywhere and ctx.sessions[plr] or physicalOwner(plr)
	if not s then ctx.toast(plr, "Use your own physical home station for that action.", "warn"); return end
	local tx = type(payload.txId) == "string" and #payload.txId <= 80 and payload.txId or (kind .. ":" .. Http:GenerateGUID(false))
	local result = ctx.transaction(plr, tx, fn, function(committed)
		if committed.message and not committed.dup then ctx.toast(plr, committed.message, "good") end
		redraw(plr)
		ctx.invChanged(plr)
	end)
	if not result.ok then ctx.toast(plr, errors[result.reason] or "That action couldn't be completed. Try again.", "warn") end
	ctx.invChanged(plr)
	return result
end

 d.coins-=H.lampCost;d.home.decorations.lamp=true;d.home.decorEquipped.lamp=true
 return {ok=true,message="Sunbeam lamp set installed. 1,500 Cairn Coins spent."}

 local room,s=rooms[plr],ctx.sessions[plr]
 if room and s and ctx.CommerceCosmetics then ctx.CommerceCosmetics.home(room,s.data) end

 ctx.handlers.homeDecorBuy=function(plr,p)

 ctx.handlers.homeDecorEquip=function(plr,p)

 end
	folder = Instance.new("Folder"); folder.Name, folder.Parent = "CC_ActiveHomes", workspace

		end)
		if not r.ok then ctx.toast(plr, errors[r.reason] or "Hatching is waiting for saving.", "warn") end

	ctx.handlers.homeAssign = function(plr, p)

			if p.creatureId ~= "" and not bankItem(d, p.creatureId) then return { ok = false, reason = "invalid" } end
			Home.settle(d, Clock.now())
			for i, id in ipairs(d.home.assigned) do if id == p.creatureId and id ~= "" then d.home.assigned[i] = "" end end
			for i = 1, H.baseSpaces + d.home.upgrade do d.home.assigned[i] = d.home.assigned[i] or "" end

		end)
	end
	ctx.handlers.homeEquipBest = function(plr, p)
		mutate(plr, p, "home-best", function(d) Home.settle(d, Clock.now()); d.home.assigned = Home.best(d); return { message = "Best earning creatures assigned. Your choices stay until you change them." } end)

	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		local nextRefresh = 0
		while true do
			task.wait(0.25)
			local refresh = os.clock() >= nextRefresh
			if refresh then nextRefresh = os.clock() + 5 end
			for plr, s in pairs(ctx.sessions) do
				local ch = plr.Character
				local root, hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

				end
				if refresh and (opened[plr] or directory[plr]) then ctx.push(plr) end
			end
		end
	end)

function Home.onLoaded(plr, s)
	Home.settle(s.data, Clock.now())
	s.dirty = true
	-- A crash in a temporary home always resumes from the saved cabin doorway, never from a vanished court.
	local ret = s.data.expedition.homeReturn
	if type(ret) == "table" and type(ret.x) == "number" and type(ret.y) == "number" and type(ret.z) == "number" then
		task.delay(1, function()
			if ctx.sessions[plr] == s and travel(plr, Vector3.new(ret.x, ret.y, ret.z), "homeReturn") then Profile.clearHomeReturn(s); ctx.saveSoon(s) end
		end)
	end
end
function Home.onCharacter(plr)
	if visits[plr] then
		task.delay(1, function() if plr.Parent then Home.returnHome(plr, true) end end)
	end
end
function Home.onLeave(plr)
	local visit = visits[plr]
	if visit and rooms[visit.owner] then rooms[visit.owner].occupants[plr] = nil; cleanRoom(visit.owner) end
	visits[plr], directory[plr], opened[plr], petAt[plr] = nil, nil, nil, nil
	if companions[plr] then companions[plr]:Destroy(); companions[plr] = nil end
	local room = rooms[plr]
	if room then
		local guests = {}
		for guest in pairs(room.occupants) do guests[#guests + 1] = guest end
		for _, guest in ipairs(guests) do Home.returnHome(guest, true) end
		cleanRoom(plr)
	end
end
function Home.state(plr, st)
	local s = ctx.sessions[plr]
	if not s then return end
	st.collection, st.memories, st.journal, st.settings = {}, s.data.memories, s.data.journal, s.data.settings
	for _, b in ipairs(s.data.bank) do
		local row = Profile.deepCopy(b)
		row.favorite, row.companion = s.data.home.favorites[b.creatureId] == true, s.data.home.companion == b.creatureId
		st.collection[#st.collection + 1] = row
	end
	st.inHome = visits[plr] ~= nil
	if directory[plr] then
		st.homeDirectory = { title = "Cabin visits", owners = {} }
		for owner in pairs(ctx.sessions) do st.homeDirectory.owners[#st.homeDirectory.owners + 1] = { ownerId = owner.UserId, name = owner.DisplayName } end
	end
	local visit = visits[plr]
	local owner = opened[plr] and visit and visit.owner
	local os = owner and ctx.sessions[owner]
	if not os then return end
	local d = os.data
	local preview = Profile.deepCopy(d)
	Home.settle(preview, Clock.now())
	local stones = {}
	for _, stone in ipairs(d.heartstones) do stones[#stones + 1] = ctx.Cargo.clientItem(stone, true) end
	st.home = { decorations = d.home.decorations, decorEquipped = d.home.decorEquipped, lampCost = H.lampCost, ownerId = owner.UserId, ownerName = owner.DisplayName, readOnly = owner ~= plr, station = "Home station", nests = {}, stones = stones, spaces = H.baseSpaces + d.home.upgrade, assigned = table.clone(d.home.assigned), income = preview.home.uncollected, rate = Home.rate(d), upgrades = { level = d.home.upgrade, max = H.maxUpgrade, cost = H.upgradeCosts[d.home.upgrade + 1] }, favorites = d.home.favorites, companion = d.home.companion, collection = Profile.deepCopy(d.bank), efficiency = H.progressEfficiency[d.home.upgrade + 1], offlineHours = H.offlineCap / 3600 }
	for i = 1, H.nestCount do
		local h = stoneItem(d, d.home.nests[i])
		st.home.nests[i] = { slot = i, id = h and h.id, progress = h and h.progress or 0, required = h and h.required or 0, ready = h and h.ready or false, tier = h and h.tier }
	end
end
return Home
sources.src/world/RouteKit.luau:
-- RouteKit (V3 Ascent, P4/P5): builds the route network's world pieces from _G.CC_PATHS.
--   RK.camps(Kit, Gen)                 camps 1-4 + merge: lodge, campfire, locker, beacon, route signpost, trigger
--   RK.route(Kit, Gen, name)           one route: bridges at its crossings, checkpoint markers + triggers,
--                                      route-style wayfinding (Shepherd: lanterns + fences on drop sides)
--   RK.hazards(Kit, Gen, name)         hazard models (attributes drive the client cycle; see runtime/AscentClient)
-- Triggers live in Workspace.World.Checkpoints and carry attributes the CheckpointService reads:
--   Checkpoint (name), Route ("*" for camps), Order (index along the route), Camp (bool).
-- All placements PROPOSED; colors are Kit.COL tokens.
local C = require(script.Parent.WorldConfig)
local RK = {}

local UP = Vector3.yAxis
local function flat(v)
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end

local STYLE = {
	Shepherd = { col = "meadow", bridgeW = 10, rail = "fence" },
	Waterfall = { col = "turquoise", bridgeW = 8, rail = "lantern" },
	Ledge = { col = "sandstone", bridgeW = 5, rail = "rope" },
	Spire = { col = "ice", bridgeW = 4, rail = "cairn" },
	SummitStair = { col = "ice", bridgeW = 8, rail = "rope" },
}
RK.STYLE = STYLE

local function pt(R, i)
	local p = R.pts[math.clamp(i, 1, #R.pts)]
	return Vector3.new(p[1], p[3], p[2])
end
local function dirAt(R, i)
	return flat(pt(R, i + 3) - pt(R, i - 3)).Unit
end
-- unit vector across the route pointing downhill (away from the summit axis)
local function outward(R, i)
	local r = dirAt(R, i):Cross(UP)
	return (r:Dot(flat(pt(R, i))) > 0) and r or -r
end
RK.pt, RK.dirAt, RK.outward = pt, dirAt, outward

local function trigger(parent, name, pos, size, attrs)
	local t = Instance.new("Part")
	t.Name = name
	t.Anchored = true
	t.CanCollide = false
	t.CanQuery = false
	t.CanTouch = true
	t.Transparency = 1
	t.Size = size
	t.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2 - 1, 0))
	for k, v in pairs(attrs) do
		t:SetAttribute(k, v)
	end
	t.Parent = parent
	return t
end

local function cpFolder(Kit)
	return Kit.folder(Kit.folder(workspace, "World"), "Checkpoints")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- camps
local CAMP_NAMES = { Camp1 = "Meadow Lodge", Camp2 = "Rootgate", Camp3 = "Chasm Hut", Camp4 = "Stormwatch", Merge = "Crown Approach" }
RK.CAMP_NAMES = CAMP_NAMES

function RK.camps(Kit, Gen)
	local COL = Kit.COL
	local P = _G.CC_PATHS
	local root = Kit.folder(Kit.folder(workspace, "World"), "Camps")
	for _, c in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
		c:Destroy()
	end
	local cps = cpFolder(Kit)
	for i, name in ipairs({ "Camp1", "Camp2", "Camp3", "Camp4", "Merge" }) do
		local pad = P.pads[name]
		local c0 = Vector3.new(pad.x, pad.y, pad.z)
		-- v5: the camp's props cluster on the side of the pad no trail uses (trails crossed the fire / bench ring)
		local dirs = {}
		for _, R in pairs(P.routes) do
			local wi = R.wp and R.wp[name]
			if wi then
				for _, o in ipairs({ -20, 20 }) do
					local q = pt(R, wi + o)
					local v = flat(q - c0)
					if v.Magnitude > 3 then
						dirs[#dirs + 1] = v.Unit
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if name == "Merge" and P.routes.SummitStair then
			local v = flat(pt(P.routes.SummitStair, 12) - c0)
			if v.Magnitude > 3 then
				dirs[#dirs + 1] = v.Unit
			end
		end
		local out = flat(c0).Unit
		if #dirs > 0 then
			local best, bestA = -1, 0
			for k = 0, 71 do
				local a = k * math.pi / 36
				local v = Vector3.new(math.sin(a), 0, math.cos(a))
				local worst = math.huge
				for _, dv in ipairs(dirs) do
					worst = math.min(worst, math.acos(math.clamp(v:Dot(dv), -1, 1)))
				end
				if worst > best then
					best, bestA = worst, a
				end
			end
			out = Vector3.new(math.sin(bestA), 0, math.cos(bestA))
		end
		local side = out:Cross(UP).Unit
		local m = Kit.folder(root, name)
		local fireP = c0 + out * 16
		Kit.campfire(m, fireP)
		if name ~= "Merge" then
			local lp = c0 + out * (pad.radius - 22) - side * 12
			lp = Vector3.new(lp.X, pad.y + 1.4, lp.Z)
			Kit.cabin(m, CFrame.lookAt(lp, lp - out), 22, 16, 10, { name = "Lodge", doorWidth = 6 })
			Kit.locker(m, CFrame.lookAt(c0 + out * 24 + side * 10, c0 + out * 24))
			for k = 0, 3 do
				Kit.bench(m, CFrame.lookAt(fireP + Vector3.new(math.cos(k * 1.57) * 8, 0, math.sin(k * 1.57) * 8), fireP) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0))
			end
		end
		-- beacon: tall pole with a lantern-gold glow, visible from below (camp beacons stay in the world)
		local bp = c0 + out * (pad.radius - 6) + side * 18
		bp = Vector3.new(bp.X, pad.y, bp.Z)
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "BeaconPole", Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 26, 1.2), CFrame = CFrame.new(bp + Vector3.new(0, 13, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
		local g = Kit.part(m, { Name = "Beacon", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * 3.4, CFrame = CFrame.new(bp + Vector3.new(0, 27, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = COL.lantern })
		Kit.decor(g)
		local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
		l.Color, l.Range, l.Brightness, l.Shadows = COL.lantern, 30, 1.6, false
		l.Parent = g
		-- signpost: camp name + the routes that leave it
		local lines = { { CAMP_NAMES[name], 0 } }
		if name ~= "Merge" then
			for _, rn in ipairs({ "Shepherd", "Waterfall", "Ledge", "Spire" }) do
				local R = P.routes[rn]
				local wi = R and R.wp[name]
				if wi then
					local ahead = pt(R, wi + 25)
					local d = flat(ahead - c0)
					local yaw = math.atan2(-d.X, -d.Z) - math.atan2(-out.X, -out.Z)
					lines[#lines + 1] = { R.def.label, yaw }
				end
			end
		else
			lines[2] = { "Summit stair", 0 }
		end
		Kit.sign(m, CFrame.lookAt(c0 + out * 12 - side * 16, c0 + out * 12 - side * 16 - out), lines, 11)
		trigger(cps, "CP_" .. name, c0, Vector3.new(pad.radius * 1.6, 14, pad.radius * 1.6), {
			Checkpoint = name,
			Label = CAMP_NAMES[name],
			Route = "*",
			Order = i,
			Camp = true,
		})
	end
	-- summit: the last checkpoint for everyone
	local sc = P.pads.SummitCrown
	trigger(cps, "CP_Summit", Vector3.new(sc.x, sc.y, sc.z), Vector3.new(36, 14, 36), { Checkpoint = "Summit", Label = "Summit", Route = "*", Order = 9, Camp = true })
	return true
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- one route
function RK.route(Kit, Gen, name)
	local COL = Kit.COL
	local P = _G.CC_PATHS
	local R = P.routes[name]
	local st = STYLE[name]
	local root = Kit.folder(Kit.folder(workspace, "World"), "Routes")
	local old = root:FindFirstChild(name)
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local f = Kit.folder(root, name)
	local counts = { bridges = 0, markers = 0, lanterns = 0, fenceRuns = 0, ropeRuns = 0, cairns = 0 }
	-- v4: stretches the route does NOT stamp (R.skips, authored climbs: LedgeP1, ClimbKit stacks) get none of this
	local function skipped(i)
		local s0 = R.S[math.clamp(i, 1, #R.S)]
		for _, r in ipairs(R.skips or {}) do
			if s0 >= r[1] - 12 and s0 <= r[2] + 12 then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	RK.skipped = skipped
	-- hang lines keep their lane (stamped) but close it with notches: no checkpoint or hazard on the closed lane
	-- (a respawn there would be stranded between the notches)
	local function inHang(i)
		local s0 = R.S[math.clamp(i, 1, #R.S)]
		for _, ln in ipairs(R.def.lines or {}) do
			if ln.kind == "hang" and ln.s0 and s0 >= ln.s0 - 30 and s0 <= ln.s1 + 30 then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	RK.inHang = inHang

	-- bridges at this route's crossings (water, chasm, dips the trail can't stand on)
	local bf = Kit.folder(f, "Bridges")
	local onBridge = {}
	for _, cr in ipairs(P.crossings) do
		if cr.path == name and not skipped(cr.i0) and not skipped(cr.i1) then
			local a, b = pt(R, cr.i0 - 2), pt(R, cr.i1 + 2)
			local span = flat(b - a).Magnitude
			Kit.bridge(bf, a, b, st.bridgeW, math.min(3, span * 0.03), "Bridge_" .. cr.i0)
			for i = cr.i0 - 3, cr.i1 + 3 do
				onBridge[i] = true
			end
			counts.bridges += 1
		end
	end

	-- built stone ramps where the trail is steeper than 0.5 or its ground is past the 45 deg slope limit:
	-- smooth parts at <= 38.7 deg are walkable where 4-stud voxel faces are not (P2 bot: summit stair)
	local rf = Kit.folder(f, "Ramps")
	local rpar = RaycastParams.new()
	rpar.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	rpar.FilterDescendantsInstances = { workspace.Terrain }
	local rampW = math.max(5, (R.def.hw or 4) * 2 + 1)
	local i = 2
	while i < #R.pts - 4 do
		local a, b = pt(R, i), pt(R, i + 4)
		local g = math.abs(b.Y - a.Y) / math.max(0.1, flat(b - a).Magnitude)
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(a + Vector3.new(0, 20, 0), Vector3.new(0, -40, 0), rpar)
		if not onBridge[i] and not skipped(i) and not skipped(i + 4) and (g > 0.5 or (hit and hit.Normal.Y < 0.74)) then
			local mid = (a + b) / 2
			local rcf = CFrame.lookAt(mid, b) * CFrame.new(0, -0.9, 0)
			local len = (b - a).Magnitude + 1.2
			-- clear voxels poking through the ramp top (P4a bot stucks on the summit stair)
			workspace.Terrain:FillBlock(rcf * CFrame.new(0, 4.6, 0), Vector3.new(rampW - 1, 7, len), Enum.Material.Air)
			Kit.part(rf, {
				Name = "Ramp",
				Size = Vector3.new(rampW, 2, len),
				CFrame = rcf,
				Material = Enum.Material.Slate,
				Color = COL.masonry,
			})
			counts.ramps = (counts.ramps or 0) + 1
		end
		i += 4
	end

	-- checkpoint markers: cairn + pennant pole + glow; trigger box across the trail
	local cps = cpFolder(Kit)
	for _, t in ipairs(cps:GetChildren()) do
		if t:GetAttribute("Route") == name then
			t:Destroy() -- re-running a route replaces its own triggers
		end
	end
	local mf = Kit.folder(f, "Checkpoints")
	if R.checkpoints then
		local order = 0
		for _, cp in ipairs(R.checkpoints) do
			order += 1
			if not cp.camp and not skipped(cp.i) and not inHang(cp.i) then
				local p = pt(R, cp.i)
				local o = outward(R, cp.i)
				local mp = p - o * ((R.def.hw or 4) + 3)
				mp = Vector3.new(mp.X, Gen.heightAt(mp.X, mp.Z), mp.Z)
				Kit.place(mf, "Cairn", mp, 0, 1.2)
				Kit.part(mf, { Name = "PennantPole", Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 9, 0.5), CFrame = CFrame.new(mp + Vector3.new(0, 4.5, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
				local pen = Kit.part(mf, { Name = "Pennant", Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 1.8, 3), CFrame = CFrame.new(mp + Vector3.new(0, 8, 1.5)), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = COL[st.col] })
				Kit.decor(pen, true)
				local glow = Kit.part(mf, { Name = "CheckpointGlow", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * 1.2, CFrame = CFrame.new(mp + Vector3.new(0, 9.4, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = COL.lantern })
				Kit.decor(glow)
				trigger(cps, "CP_" .. cp.name, p, Vector3.new(20, 14, 20), { Checkpoint = cp.name, Label = R.def.label .. " checkpoint", Route = name, Order = order, Camp = false })
				counts.markers += 1
			end
		end
	end

	-- wayfinding by route style
	local wf = Kit.folder(f, "Wayfinding")
	local hw = R.def.hw or 4
	local n = #R.pts
	if st.rail == "fence" or st.rail == "rope" then
		-- rails on the drop side wherever the ground 4 studs past the trail edge falls away by > 5 studs
		local run = {}
		local function flush()
			if #run >= 3 then
				if st.rail == "fence" then
					Kit.fence(wf, run, 3.4)
					counts.fenceRuns += 1
				else
					-- fixed rope: posts every ~18 studs, one rope span per post pair, lantern-gold rope (wayfinding
					-- token). Was a post every ~9 and a rope part per sample (~1,150 parts on Ledge alone; run 2
					-- instance budget)
					local m = Kit.model(wf, "FixedRope")
					local last
					for k = 1, #run do
						if k % 6 == 1 or k == #run then
							Kit.part(m, { Name = "RopePost", Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 4, 0.5), CFrame = CFrame.new(run[k] + Vector3.new(0, 1.8, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
							if last then
								local a, b = last + Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0), run[k] + Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0)
								local rope = Kit.part(m, { Name = "Rope", Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, (b - a).Magnitude + 0.2), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = COL.lantern })
								Kit.decor(rope)
							end
							last = run[k]
						end
					end
					counts.ropeRuns += 1
				end
			end
			run = {}
		end
		local oPrev
		for i = 6, n - 6, 3 do
			local p = pt(R, i)
			local o = outward(R, i)
			-- around a hairpin tip "outward" flips sides; end the run there so no rail crosses the trail
			if oPrev and o:Dot(oPrev) < 0.7 then
				flush()
			end
			oPrev = o
			local edge = p + o * (hw + 1.5)
			local far = p + o * (hw + 5.5)
			local drop = p.Y - Gen.heightAt(far.X, far.Z)
			if drop > 5 and not onBridge[i] and not skipped(i) then
				run[#run + 1] = Vector3.new(edge.X, math.max(Gen.heightAt(edge.X, edge.Z), p.Y - 1), edge.Z)
				if #run >= 24 then
					local last = run[#run]
					flush()
					run[1] = last
				end
			else
				flush()
			end
		end
		flush()
	end
	if st.rail == "fence" or st.rail == "lantern" then
		local every = (st.rail == "fence") and 50 or 84 -- samples (x3 studs)
		local k = 0
		for i = 20, n - 20, every do
			if not onBridge[i] then
				k += 1
				local p = pt(R, i)
				local lp = p - outward(R, i) * (hw + 2.5)
				lp = Vector3.new(lp.X, Gen.heightAt(lp.X, lp.Z), lp.Z)
				Kit.lantern(wf, lp, 7, k % 3 == 0) -- every third lantern carries a light (mobile budget)
				counts.lanterns += 1
			end
		end
	end
	if st.rail == "cairn" or st.rail == "rope" then
		for i = 40, n - 40, 66 do
			if skipped(i) then
				continue
			end
			local p = pt(R, i)
			local cp2 = p - outward(R, i) * (hw + 2)
			cp2 = Vector3.new(cp2.X, Gen.heightAt(cp2.X, cp2.Z), cp2.Z)
			Kit.place(wf, "Cairn", cp2, i, 0.9)
			counts.cairns += 1
		end
	end
	return counts
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- hazards
-- Hazard definitions per route (PROPOSED): kind, where (fraction of the sample range whose trail height lies in
-- [y0, y1]), and cycle. Tells: easy route 3 s, hard routes 2 s (LOCKED decision 10). Strength = knockback speed.
local HAZ = {
	Shepherd = {
		{ kind = "TreeFall", y0 = 700, y1 = 1100, at = 0.30, period = 12, tell = 3, strength = 30 },
		{ kind = "TreeFall", y0 = 700, y1 = 1100, at = 0.70, period = 14, tell = 3, strength = 30, offset = 5 },
		{ kind = "Rockfall", y0 = 1200, y1 = 1550, at = 0.55, period = 11, tell = 3, strength = 34 },
		{ kind = "Gust", y0 = 1850, y1 = 2230, at = 0.50, period = 10, tell = 3, strength = 7, length = 150 }, -- mild: slower than walking
	},
	Waterfall = {
		{ kind = "TreeFall", y0 = 700, y1 = 1100, at = 0.5, period = 10, tell = 2.5, strength = 40 },
		{ kind = "Rockfall", y0 = 1200, y1 = 1550, at = 0.5, period = 9, tell = 2.5, strength = 44 },
		{ kind = "Gust", y0 = 1850, y1 = 2230, at = 0.5, period = 9, tell = 2.5, strength = 22, length = 120 },
	},
	Ledge = {
		{ kind = "Rockfall", y0 = 1150, y1 = 1600, at = 0.35, period = 8, tell = 2, strength = 55 },
		{ kind = "Rockfall", y0 = 1150, y1 = 1600, at = 0.75, period = 9, tell = 2, strength = 55, offset = 3 },
		{ kind = "Gust", y0 = 1800, y1 = 2240, at = 0.5, period = 8, tell = 2, strength = 30, length = 140 },
		{ kind = "Avalanche", y0 = 2260, y1 = 2560, at = 0.5, period = 13, tell = 2, strength = 60 },
	},
	Spire = {
		{ kind = "TreeFall", y0 = 600, y1 = 1100, at = 0.5, period = 9, tell = 2, strength = 55 },
		{ kind = "Rockfall", y0 = 1150, y1 = 1650, at = 0.5, period = 7, tell = 2, strength = 60 },
		{ kind = "Gust", y0 = 1800, y1 = 2250, at = 0.4, period = 7, tell = 2, strength = 34, length = 120 },
		{ kind = "Avalanche", y0 = 2260, y1 = 2560, at = 0.5, period = 11, tell = 2, strength = 70 },
		{ kind = "Gust", y0 = 2260, y1 = 2560, at = 0.7, period = 7, tell = 2, strength = 34, length = 80, offset = 3 },
	},
}
RK.HAZ = HAZ

local function pickSample(R, h)
	local idx = {}
	for i = 30, #R.pts - 30 do
		local y = R.pts[i][3]
		if y >= h.y0 and y <= h.y1 then
			idx[#idx + 1] = i
		end
	end
	if #idx == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return idx[math.clamp(math.floor(#idx * h.at + 0.5), 1, #idx)]
end

function RK.hazards(Kit, Gen, name)
	local COL = Kit.COL
	local P = _G.CC_PATHS
	local R = P.routes[name]
	local root = Kit.folder(Kit.folder(workspace, "World"), "Hazards")
	local old = root:FindFirstChild(name)
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local f = Kit.folder(root, name)
	local out = {}
	local function skippedH(i)
		local s0 = R.S[math.clamp(i, 1, #R.S)]
		for _, r in ipairs(R.skips or {}) do
			if s0 >= r[1] - 30 and s0 <= r[2] + 30 then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	for n, h in ipairs(HAZ[name] or {}) do
		local i = pickSample(R, h)
		local inHang = false
		for _, ln in ipairs(i and R.def.lines or {}) do
			local si = R.S[math.clamp(i, 1, #R.S)]
			if ln.kind == "hang" and ln.s0 and si >= ln.s0 - 30 and si <= ln.s1 + 30 then
				inHang = true
			end
		end
		if i and not skippedH(i) and not inHang then
			local p = pt(R, i)
			local d = dirAt(R, i)
			local o = outward(R, i)
			local hw = R.def.hw or 4
			local m = Kit.model(f, string.format("%s_%d", h.kind, n))
			m:SetAttribute("Kind", h.kind)
			m:SetAttribute("Route", name)
			m:SetAttribute("Period", h.period)
			m:SetAttribute("Tell", h.tell)
			m:SetAttribute("Offset", h.offset or 0)
			m:SetAttribute("Strength", h.strength)
			m:SetAttribute("Center", p)
			m:SetAttribute("TrailDir", d)
			m:SetAttribute("Outward", o)
			if h.kind == "TreeFall" then
				-- a tall tree on the uphill side falls across the trail (hinge at its base, falls outward)
				local base = p - o * (hw + 5)
				base = Vector3.new(base.X, Gen.heightAt(base.X, base.Z) - 0.5, base.Z)
				local tree = Kit.place(m, "TreeTall", base, math.atan2(o.X, o.Z), 1.7, COL.forestTeal)
				tree.Name = "FallTree"
				for _, q in ipairs(tree:GetDescendants()) do
					if q:IsA("BasePart") then
						q.CanCollide = false
					end
				end
				m:SetAttribute("Hinge", base)
				m:SetAttribute("FallLen", hw * 2 + 16)
				-- dodge marker: a cut stump on the far side shows where the trunk lands
			elseif h.kind == "Rockfall" or h.kind == "Avalanche" then
				-- lane across the trail from uphill (top) to downhill; a rut marks it, an alcove is beside it
				local top = p - o * (hw + 26)
				top = Vector3.new(top.X, Gen.heightAt(top.X, top.Z) + 3, top.Z)
				local bot = p + o * (hw + 20)
				bot = Vector3.new(bot.X, Gen.heightAt(bot.X, bot.Z) + 2, bot.Z)
				m:SetAttribute("Top", top)
				m:SetAttribute("Bottom", bot)
				m:SetAttribute("Radius", (h.kind == "Avalanche") and 9 or 4)
				local rut = Kit.part(m, { Name = "LaneRut", Size = Vector3.new((h.kind == "Avalanche") and 18 or 9, 0.3, (top - bot).Magnitude), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((top + bot) / 2 - Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0), bot - Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0)), Material = (h.kind == "Avalanche") and Enum.Material.Snow or Enum.Material.Slate, Color = (h.kind == "Avalanche") and COL.moon or COL.slate, Transparency = 0.2 })
				Kit.decor(rut)
				-- shelter alcove: low stone wall on the uphill side, 14 studs before the lane
				local ap = p - d * 16 - o * (hw + 1)
				ap = Vector3.new(ap.X, Gen.heightAt(ap.X, ap.Z), ap.Z)
				Kit.part(m, { Name = "Alcove", Size = Vector3.new(8, 6, 2), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(ap + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), ap + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) + d), Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone, Color = COL.masonry })
			elseif h.kind == "Gust" then
				m:SetAttribute("Length", h.length or 120)
				m:SetAttribute("HalfWidth", hw + 10)
				-- windbreak shelters every ~40 studs on the uphill side (stand behind one during the gust)
				local L = h.length or 120
				for s2 = -L / 2, L / 2, 40 do
					local wp = p + d * s2 - o * (hw - 0.5)
					wp = Vector3.new(wp.X, Gen.heightAt(wp.X, wp.Z), wp.Z)
					Kit.part(m, { Name = "Windbreak", Size = Vector3.new(7, 5, 1.6), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(wp + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0) + o * 2.4, wp + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0) + o * 2.4 + d), Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone, Color = COL.masonry })
				end
				-- flags show the wind: they whip during the tell
				for s2 = -L / 2, L / 2, 60 do
					local fp = p + d * s2 - o * (hw + 3)
					fp = Vector3.new(fp.X, Gen.heightAt(fp.X, fp.Z), fp.Z)
					Kit.part(m, { Name = "FlagPole", Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 8, 0.4), CFrame = CFrame.new(fp + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
					local flag = Kit.part(m, { Name = "WindFlag", Size = Vector3.new(0.15, 1.6, 3.2), CFrame = CFrame.new(fp + Vector3.new(0, 7.2, 0) + o * 1.6) * CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, d), Material = Enum.Material.Fabric, Color = COL.lantern })
					Kit.decor(flag)
				end
			end
			out[#out + 1] = string.format("%s@s%.0f(y%.0f)", h.kind, R.S[i], p.Y)
		end
	end
	return out
end

return RK
sources.src/world/Kit.luau:
-- Kit: parametric prop builders for CLIMB & COLLECT (PROPOSED art, colors from design/world-tokens.md).
-- Prototypes (trees, bushes, flower patches) are CSG unions built once into ServerStorage.CC_Prototypes
-- and cloned with scale/rotation/colour variation, so each plant costs 1-2 instances.
local Kit = {}
local GS = game:GetService("GeometryService")
local SS = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

Kit.COL = {
	timber = Color3.fromRGB(140, 96, 60), -- §3 "timber"
	timberDark = Color3.fromRGB(98, 66, 42), -- shaded timber (roofs, beams)
	masonry = Color3.fromRGB(150, 146, 132), -- §3 "ruin masonry"
	lantern = Color3.fromRGB(255, 178, 72), -- §3/§4 lantern gold
	golden = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 150), -- §3 "golden daylight"
	meadow = Color3.fromRGB(84, 176, 82), -- §4 "meadow emerald"
	leafLight = Color3.fromRGB(118, 194, 92), -- §3 "lush saturated greens" (lit tone)
	forestTeal = Color3.fromRGB(38, 112, 98), -- §3 "deep forest teal"
	turquoise = Color3.fromRGB(46, 196, 182), -- §3 "clear turquoise falls"
	moon = Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 255), -- §3 "moonlight"
	indigo = Color3.fromRGB(92, 76, 220), -- §4 "luminous indigo"
	sandstone = Color3.fromRGB(214, 150, 82),
	slate = Color3.fromRGB(62, 66, 76),
	ice = Color3.fromRGB(196, 232, 255),
	cyan = Color3.fromRGB(62, 224, 255),
	violet = Color3.fromRGB(138, 78, 255),
	rock = Color3.fromRGB(120, 128, 108), -- §3 "lichen-covered rock" (terrain Rock)
}
local COL = Kit.COL
Kit.SIGN_FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne -- OPEN: master.md names no typeface; provisional

---------------------------------------------------------------- basics
function Kit.part(parent, props)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = true
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	for k, v in pairs(props) do
		p[k] = v
	end
	if parent then
		p.Parent = parent
	end
	return p
end

function Kit.wedge(parent, props)
	local p = Instance.new("WedgePart")
	p.Anchored = true
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	for k, v in pairs(props) do
		p[k] = v
	end
	if parent then
		p.Parent = parent
	end
	return p
end

-- non-colliding, non-queryable decoration
function Kit.decor(p, shadow)
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CastShadow = shadow == true
	return p
end

function Kit.model(parent, name)
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = name
	if parent then
		m.Parent = parent
	end
	return m
end

function Kit.folder(parent, name)
	local f = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not f then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = name
		f.Parent = parent
	end
	return f
end

function Kit.union(parts, usePartColor)
	local base = table.remove(parts, 1)
	local holder = Instance.new("Model")
	base.Parent = holder
	for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
		p.Parent = holder
	end
	holder.Parent = workspace -- UnionAsync needs parts in the DataModel
	local res = GS:UnionAsync(base, parts, {
		CollisionFidelity = Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box,
		RenderFidelity = Enum.RenderFidelity.Automatic,
		SplitApart = false,
	})
	local u = res[1]
	u.UsePartColor = usePartColor ~= false
	u.Anchored = true
	u.Parent = nil
	holder:Destroy()
	return u
end

local function cyl(len, d, cf)
	return Kit.part(nil, { Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(len, d, d), CFrame = cf })
end
local function ball(d, pos)
	return Kit.part(nil, { Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(d, d, d), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) })
end
-- cylinder from a to b (Roblox cylinders run along X)
local function cylAB(a, b, d)
	local v = b - a
	local dir = v.Unit
	-- fromMatrix keeps vertical cylinders well-defined (lookAt degenerates when dir is parallel to Y)
	local ref = (math.abs(dir.Y) < 0.9) and Vector3.yAxis or Vector3.xAxis
	local up = dir:Cross(ref).Unit
	return cyl(v.Magnitude, d, CFrame.fromMatrix((a + b) / 2, dir, up))
end
Kit.cylAB = cylAB

---------------------------------------------------------------- prototypes
local PROTO
local function protoFolder()
	if PROTO and PROTO.Parent then
		return PROTO
	end
	PROTO = SS:FindFirstChild("CC_Prototypes")
	if not PROTO then
		PROTO = Instance.new("Folder")
		PROTO.Name = "CC_Prototypes"
		PROTO.Parent = SS
	end
	return PROTO
end

-- trunk + canopy unions in a Model whose pivot sits at ground level
local function makeTree(name, trunkParts, canopyParts, leafMat)
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = name
	local trunk = Kit.union(trunkParts)
	trunk.Name = "Trunk"
	trunk.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
	trunk.Color = COL.timberDark
	trunk.Parent = m
	local canopy = Kit.union(canopyParts)
	canopy.Name = "Canopy"
	canopy.Material = leafMat or Enum.Material.LeafyGrass
	canopy.Color = COL.meadow
	Kit.decor(canopy, true)
	canopy.CanQuery = false
	canopy.Parent = m
	-- no PrimaryPart: a union's frame follows its first part, which would tilt the pivot
	m.WorldPivot = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
	return m
end

local builders = {}

builders.TreeRound = function()
	local t = {
		cylAB(Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), Vector3.new(0.6, 12, 0.3), 2.4),
		cylAB(Vector3.new(0.4, 8, 0.2), Vector3.new(3.6, 12.5, 1.2), 1.1),
		cylAB(Vector3.new(0.3, 9, 0.1), Vector3.new(-2.8, 13, -1.4), 1.0),
	}
	local c = {
		ball(11, Vector3.new(0.5, 15.5, 0)),
		ball(8.5, Vector3.new(4.2, 14, 1.5)),
		ball(8, Vector3.new(-3.6, 14.3, -1.6)),
		ball(7.5, Vector3.new(0.8, 13.5, -4)),
		ball(7, Vector3.new(-0.5, 19, 1)),
	}
	return makeTree("TreeRound", t, c)
end

builders.TreeTall = function()
	local t = {
		cylAB(Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), Vector3.new(-0.4, 16, 0.4), 2.2),
		cylAB(Vector3.new(-0.2, 10, 0.2), Vector3.new(2.6, 14, 0.6), 0.9),
	}
	local c = {
		ball(8.5, Vector3.new(-0.3, 15, 0.2)),
		ball(9, Vector3.new(0, 19.5, 0)),
		ball(7.5, Vector3.new(0.5, 23.5, -0.3)),
		ball(6.5, Vector3.new(2.6, 16.5, 1.2)),
	}
	return makeTree("TreeTall", t, c)
end

builders.Pine = function()
	local t = { cylAB(Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), Vector3.new(0, 10, 0), 1.8) }
	local c = {}
	-- four overlapping stepped cones (no cone primitive): each tier is a stack of shrinking discs
	local tiers = { { 4, 14, 8 }, { 9.5, 11.5, 7 }, { 14.5, 8.5, 6 }, { 19, 5.5, 5 } }
	for _, tr in ipairs(tiers) do
		local y0, R, H = tr[1], tr[2], tr[3]
		for k = 0, 5 do
			local f = 1 - k / 6
			c[#c + 1] = cyl(H / 6 + 0.05, R * f, CFrame.new(0, y0 + k * H / 6, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)))
		end
	end
	c[#c + 1] = ball(1.8, Vector3.new(0, 24.2, 0))
	return makeTree("Pine", t, c)
end

builders.Bush = function()
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = "Bush"
	local u = Kit.union({
		ball(5, Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)),
		ball(4, Vector3.new(2.2, 1.2, 0.6)),
		ball(3.6, Vector3.new(-2, 1.1, -0.5)),
		ball(3.2, Vector3.new(0.4, 1, 2)),
	})
	u.Name = "Leaves"
	u.Material = Enum.Material.LeafyGrass
	u.Color = COL.leafLight
	Kit.decor(u, false)
	u.Parent = m
	m.WorldPivot = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
	return m
end

-- flower patch: stems + heads unioned with original colours kept
local function flowerPatch(name, colors, seed)
	local rng = Random.new(seed)
	local parts = {}
	for i = 1, 14 do
		local a = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
		local r = rng:NextNumber(0, 5.5)
		local x, z = math.cos(a) * r, math.sin(a) * r
		local h = rng:NextNumber(1.6, 3.2)
		local stem = cylAB(Vector3.new(x, -0.3, z), Vector3.new(x, h, z), 0.3)
		stem.Color = COL.meadow
		parts[#parts + 1] = stem
		local head = ball(rng:NextNumber(1.3, 1.9), Vector3.new(x, h + 0.3, z))
		head.Color = colors[(i % #colors) + 1]
		head.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		parts[#parts + 1] = head
	end
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = name
	local u = Kit.union(parts, false)
	u.Name = "Flowers"
	Kit.decor(u, false)
	u.Parent = m
	m.WorldPivot = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
	return m
end
builders.FlowersGold = function()
	return flowerPatch("FlowersGold", { COL.golden, COL.lantern, COL.golden }, 11)
end
builders.FlowersTurq = function()
	return flowerPatch("FlowersTurq", { COL.turquoise, COL.moon, COL.golden }, 23)
end
builders.FlowersMoon = function()
	return flowerPatch("FlowersMoon", { COL.moon, COL.indigo, COL.moon }, 37)
end

-- Whispering Forest: iridescent mushroom cluster (§3 "iridescent mushrooms"), caps in turquoise/indigo/violet
builders.Mushrooms = function()
	local parts = {}
	local specs = { { 0, 0, 5.5, 4.6, COL.turquoise }, { 3.4, 1.2, 3.6, 3.2, COL.indigo }, { -2.6, 2, 2.6, 2.4, COL.violet }, { 1, -3, 2.2, 2, COL.turquoise } }
	for _, s in ipairs(specs) do
		local x, z, h, r, c = s[1], s[2], s[3], s[4], s[5]
		local stem = cylAB(Vector3.new(x, -0.4, z), Vector3.new(x, h, z), r * 0.35)
		stem.Color = COL.moon
		parts[#parts + 1] = stem
		local cap = cyl(r * 0.25, r * 2, CFrame.new(x, h, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)))
		cap.Color = c
		parts[#parts + 1] = cap
		local dome = ball(r * 1.9, Vector3.new(x, h + r * 0.05, z))
		dome.Color = c
		parts[#parts + 1] = dome
	end
	-- keep only the upper half of each dome by unioning with the cap disc (domes sit on the caps)
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = "Mushrooms"
	local u = Kit.union(parts, false)
	u.Name = "Caps"
	u.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	Kit.decor(u, false)
	u.Parent = m
	m.WorldPivot = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
	return m
end

-- Frozen Summit / Storm Ridge: crystal cluster (§3 "icy crystal facets", "controlled crystalline magical structures")
local function crystalCluster(name, color)
	local parts = {}
	local rng = Random.new(#name * 7)
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local h = rng:NextNumber(4, 11)
		local w = rng:NextNumber(1.2, 2.4)
		local a = i / 6 * math.pi * 2
		local tilt = rng:NextNumber(0.15, 0.45)
		local base = Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 1.2, 0, math.sin(a) * 1.2)
		local cf = CFrame.new(base) * CFrame.Angles(0, a, 0) * CFrame.Angles(tilt, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, h / 2 - 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0)
		parts[#parts + 1] = Kit.part(nil, { Size = Vector3.new(w, h, w), CFrame = cf })
	end
	parts[#parts + 1] = Kit.part(nil, { Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 13, 2.4), CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 6, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0) })
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = name
	local u = Kit.union(parts)
	u.Name = "Crystal"
	u.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
	u.Color = color
	u.Transparency = 0.15
	u.Reflectance = 0.1
	Kit.decor(u, true)
	u.Parent = m
	m.WorldPivot = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
	return m
end
builders.CrystalIce = function()
	return crystalCluster("CrystalIce", COL.ice)
end
builders.CrystalAurora = function()
	return crystalCluster("CrystalAurora", Color3.fromRGB(156, 92, 246))
end

-- Storm Ridge: snow-dusted pine (tiers with white caps, original colours kept)
builders.SnowPine = function()
	local t = { cylAB(Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), Vector3.new(0, 10, 0), 1.8) }
	local c = {}
	local tiers = { { 4, 13, 7 }, { 9, 10.5, 6 }, { 13.5, 8, 5 }, { 17.5, 5.5, 4.5 } }
	for _, tr in ipairs(tiers) do
		local y0, R, H = tr[1], tr[2], tr[3]
		for k = 0, 5 do
			local f = 1 - k / 6
			local d = cyl(H / 6 + 0.05, R * f, CFrame.new(0, y0 + k * H / 6, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)))
			d.Color = (k >= 4) and COL.moon or COL.forestTeal
			c[#c + 1] = d
		end
	end
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = "SnowPine"
	local trunk = Kit.union(t)
	trunk.Name = "Trunk"
	trunk.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
	trunk.Color = COL.timberDark
	trunk.Parent = m
	local canopy = Kit.union(c, false)
	canopy.Name = "Canopy"
	canopy.Material = Enum.Material.LeafyGrass
	Kit.decor(canopy, true)
	canopy.Parent = m
	m.WorldPivot = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
	return m
end

-- Storm Ridge: wind-scarred dead tree (bare, leaning branches)
builders.DeadTree = function()
	local p = {
		cylAB(Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), Vector3.new(1.2, 14, 0.3), 1.6),
		cylAB(Vector3.new(0.6, 7, 0.1), Vector3.new(5, 11, 1), 0.7),
		cylAB(Vector3.new(0.9, 10, 0.2), Vector3.new(4.6, 15, -0.8), 0.6),
		cylAB(Vector3.new(0.8, 9, 0.2), Vector3.new(-2.2, 12.5, 1.6), 0.55),
	}
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = "DeadTree"
	local u = Kit.union(p)
	u.Name = "Trunk"
	u.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
	u.Color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 104, 100)
	u.Parent = m
	m.WorldPivot = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
	return m
end

-- trail cairn: stacked flat stones as wayfinding in high, low-visibility terrain
builders.Cairn = function()
	local p = {}
	local y = 0
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local s = 3.6 - i * 0.6
		local h = 1.1 - i * 0.08
		p[#p + 1] = Kit.part(nil, { Size = Vector3.new(s, h, s * 0.85), CFrame = CFrame.new(math.sin(i) * 0.2, y + h / 2, math.cos(i) * 0.2) * CFrame.Angles(0, i * 0.7, 0) })
		y += h * 0.9
	end
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = "Cairn"
	local u = Kit.union(p)
	u.Name = "Stones"
	u.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
	u.Color = COL.masonry
	u.Parent = m
	m.WorldPivot = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
	return m
end

function Kit.proto(name)
	local f = protoFolder()
	local p = f:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not p then
		p = builders[name]()
		p.Parent = f
	end
	return p
end

-- place a prototype clone: ground position, yaw, uniform scale, optional leaf colour
function Kit.place(parent, name, pos, yaw, scale, leafColor, tilt)
	local m = Kit.proto(name):Clone()
	if scale and scale ~= 1 then
		m:ScaleTo(scale)
	end
	local cf = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw or 0, 0)
	if tilt then
		cf *= CFrame.Angles(tilt.X, 0, tilt.Z)
	end
	m:PivotTo(cf)
	if leafColor then
		local c = m:FindFirstChild("Canopy") or m:FindFirstChild("Leaves")
		if c then
			c.Color = leafColor
		end
	end
	m.Parent = parent
	return m
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- small props
function Kit.lantern(parent, pos, height, withLight)
	local m = Kit.model(parent, "Lantern")
	height = height or 7
	Kit.part(m, { Name = "Post", Size = Vector3.new(0.7, height, 0.7), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, height / 2, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
	Kit.part(m, { Name = "Arm", Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 0.4, 0.4), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0.9, height - 0.3, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
	local cage = Kit.part(m, { Name = "Cage", Size = Vector3.new(1.1, 1.4, 1.1), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(1.7, height - 1.3, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, Color = COL.timberDark, Transparency = 0.15 })
	Kit.decor(cage)
	local glow = Kit.part(m, { Name = "Glow", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8), CFrame = cage.CFrame, Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = COL.lantern })
	Kit.decor(glow)
	if withLight ~= false then
		local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
		l.Color = COL.lantern
		l.Range = 16
		l.Brightness = 1.2
		l.Shadows = false
		l.Parent = glow
	end
	return m
end

function Kit.sign(parent, cf, lines, width)
	width = width or 7
	local m = Kit.model(parent, "Sign")
	Kit.part(m, { Name = "Post", Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 7, 0.8), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 3.5, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
	for i, line in ipairs(lines) do
		local text, dir = line[1], line[2] or 0
		-- boards don't collide: stacked boards formed a ladder the Humanoid climbed (Camp 2 sign on the Waterfall line, run 2)
		local board = Kit.part(m, { Name = "Board", Size = Vector3.new(width, 1.5, 0.35), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 6.6 - (i - 1) * 1.8, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, dir, 0) * CFrame.new(width / 2 - 0.6, 0, 0), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber, CanCollide = false })
		for _, face in ipairs({ Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.NormalId.Back }) do
			local g = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
			g.Face = face
			g.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(width * 40, 60)
			g.LightInfluence = 1
			g.Parent = board
			local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			t.Text = text
			t.Font = Kit.SIGN_FONT
			t.TextScaled = true
			t.TextColor3 = COL.golden
			t.Parent = g
		end
	end
	return m
end

function Kit.bench(parent, cf)
	local m = Kit.model(parent, "Bench")
	Kit.part(m, { Name = "Seat", Size = Vector3.new(6, 0.5, 1.8), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 1.8, 0), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
	for _, x in ipairs({ -2.4, 2.4 }) do
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Leg", Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 1.6, 1.6), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(x, 0.8, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
	end
	return m
end

function Kit.campfire(parent, pos)
	local m = Kit.model(parent, "Campfire")
	local rng = Random.new(math.floor(pos.X + pos.Z))
	for i = 1, 9 do
		local a = i / 9 * math.pi * 2
		local s = rng:NextNumber(1.2, 1.7)
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Stone", Size = Vector3.new(s, s * 0.8, s), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 3, 0.4, math.sin(a) * 3)) * CFrame.Angles(rng:NextNumber(-0.3, 0.3), a, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Slate, Color = COL.masonry })
	end
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local a = i / 3 * math.pi * 2
		local log = Kit.part(m, { Name = "Log", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(3.6, 0.8, 0.8), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.7, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, a, math.rad(25)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
		Kit.decor(log, true)
	end
	local core = Kit.part(m, { Name = "Core", Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0)), Transparency = 1 })
	Kit.decor(core)
	local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
	fire.Size = 5
	fire.Heat = 9
	fire.Color = COL.lantern
	fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 40)
	fire.Parent = core
	local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
	l.Color = COL.lantern
	l.Range = 26
	l.Brightness = 2
	l.Shadows = true
	l.Parent = core
	return m
end

-- Camp Locker (1-3 safe slots per master.md §0.5): sturdy chest with lantern-gold trim
function Kit.locker(parent, cf)
	local m = Kit.model(parent, "CampLocker")
	Kit.part(m, { Name = "Box", Size = Vector3.new(5, 3, 3), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
	Kit.part(m, { Name = "Lid", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(5, 3, 3), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timberDark })
	for _, x in ipairs({ -1.8, 1.8 }) do
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Band", Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 3.2, 3.1), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(x, 1.6, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, Color = COL.lantern })
	end
	local lock = Kit.part(m, { Name = "Lock", Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.9, 0.3), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 2.6, -1.6), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = COL.lantern })
	Kit.decor(lock)
	m:SetAttribute("CampLocker", true)
	return m
end

-- fence along points {Vector3}; posts every ~6 studs, two rails
function Kit.fence(parent, pts, height)
	height = height or 3.4
	local m = Kit.model(parent, "Fence")
	for i = 1, #pts - 1 do
		local a, b = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
		local len = (b - a).Magnitude
		local n = math.max(1, math.floor(len / 6))
		for k = 0, n - 1 do
			local p = a:Lerp(b, k / n)
			Kit.part(m, { Name = "Post", Size = Vector3.new(0.6, height + 1, 0.6), CFrame = CFrame.new(p + Vector3.new(0, (height + 1) / 2 - 1, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
		end
		for _, h in ipairs({ height * 0.45, height * 0.9 }) do
			local r = cylAB(a + Vector3.new(0, h, 0), b + Vector3.new(0, h, 0), 0.45)
			r.Name = "Rail"
			r.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
			r.Color = COL.timber
			r.Parent = m
		end
	end
	Kit.part(m, { Name = "Post", Size = Vector3.new(0.6, height + 1, 0.6), CFrame = CFrame.new(pts[#pts] + Vector3.new(0, (height + 1) / 2 - 1, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
	return m
end

-- straight wooden stair from a (bottom) to b (top), with side stringers
function Kit.stairs(parent, a, b, width)
	width = width or 10
	local m = Kit.model(parent, "Stairs")
	local flat = Vector3.new(b.X - a.X, 0, b.Z - a.Z)
	local rise = b.Y - a.Y
	local steps = math.max(2, math.floor(math.abs(rise) / 1.2))
	local dir = flat.Unit
	local run = flat.Magnitude / steps
	local cf0 = CFrame.lookAt(a, a + dir)
	for i = 0, steps - 1 do
		local y = rise * (i + 0.5) / steps
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Step", Size = Vector3.new(width, 1.2, run + 0.6), CFrame = cf0 * CFrame.new(0, y - 0.6, -(i + 0.5) * run), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
	end
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		local p0 = (cf0 * CFrame.new(s * (width / 2 + 0.3), 0, 0)).Position
		local p1 = (cf0 * CFrame.new(s * (width / 2 + 0.3), rise, -flat.Magnitude)).Position
		local str = cylAB(p0 + Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0), p1 + Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0), 0.5)
		str.Name = "Handrail"
		str.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
		str.Color = COL.timberDark
		str.Parent = m
		local n = math.max(2, math.floor(flat.Magnitude / 7))
		for k = 0, n do
			local p = p0:Lerp(p1, k / n)
			Kit.part(m, { Name = "Baluster", Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 3, 0.5), CFrame = CFrame.new(p + Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
		end
	end
	return m
end

-- arched plank bridge between a and b (deck surface points), stone abutments
function Kit.bridge(parent, a, b, width, arch, name)
	width = width or 12
	arch = arch or 6
	local m = Kit.model(parent, name or "Bridge")
	local flat = Vector3.new(b.X - a.X, 0, b.Z - a.Z)
	local dir = flat.Unit
	local len = flat.Magnitude
	local n = math.max(6, math.floor(len / 3))
	local function deckPoint(t)
		local p = a:Lerp(b, t)
		return p + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(t * math.pi) * arch, 0)
	end
	for i = 0, n - 1 do
		local p0, p1 = deckPoint(i / n), deckPoint((i + 1) / n)
		local mid = (p0 + p1) / 2
		local seg = (p1 - p0)
		local plank = Kit.part(m, { Name = "Plank", Size = Vector3.new(width, 0.9, seg.Magnitude + 0.15), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(mid, p1) * CFrame.new(0, -0.45, 0), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = (i % 2 == 0) and COL.timber or COL.timberDark })
		plank.Name = "Plank"
	end
	-- rails and posts
	local right = dir:Cross(Vector3.yAxis).Unit
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		local prev
		for i = 0, n, 2 do
			local p = deckPoint(i / n) + right * s * (width / 2 - 0.4)
			Kit.part(m, { Name = "Post", Size = Vector3.new(0.7, 4, 0.7), CFrame = CFrame.new(p + Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
			if prev then
				local r = cylAB(prev + Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0), p + Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0), 0.5)
				r.Name = "Rail"
				r.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
				r.Color = COL.timber
				r.Parent = m
			end
			prev = p
		end
	end
	-- abutments
	for _, e in ipairs({ { a, -1 }, { b, 1 } }) do
		local p, s = e[1], e[2]
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Abutment", Size = Vector3.new(width + 3, 8, 5), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(p, p + dir) * CFrame.new(0, -4.6, s * -1.5), Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone, Color = COL.masonry })
	end
	return m
end

-- timber cabin: plank walls, gable roof with overhang, stone chimney, warm windows
function Kit.cabin(parent, cf, w, d, h, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local m = Kit.model(parent, opts.name or "Cabin")
	-- stone plinth
	Kit.part(m, { Name = "Plinth", Size = Vector3.new(w + 1.2, 2.4, d + 1.2), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, -0.4, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone, Color = COL.masonry })
	-- walls (hollow box: floor, four walls with a door gap at the front)
	Kit.part(m, { Name = "Floor", Size = Vector3.new(w, 0.6, d), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 1.1, 0), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timberDark })
	local wallT = 0.9
	local door = opts.doorWidth or 4
	Kit.part(m, { Name = "WallBack", Size = Vector3.new(w, h, wallT), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 0.8 + h / 2, d / 2 - wallT / 2), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "WallSide", Size = Vector3.new(wallT, h, d), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(s * (w / 2 - wallT / 2), 0.8 + h / 2, 0), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
		local seg = (w - door) / 2
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "WallFront", Size = Vector3.new(seg, h, wallT), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(s * (door / 2 + seg / 2), 0.8 + h / 2, -d / 2 + wallT / 2), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
		-- corner logs
		for _, z in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			Kit.part(m, { Name = "Corner", Size = Vector3.new(1.4, h + 0.6, 1.4), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(s * w / 2, 0.8 + h / 2, z * d / 2), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
		end
	end
	Kit.part(m, { Name = "Lintel", Size = Vector3.new(door + 0.4, h - 7, wallT), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 0.8 + 7 + (h - 7) / 2, -d / 2 + wallT / 2), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
	-- windows (warm glow) on sides and front
	local wins = {}
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		wins[#wins + 1] = cf * CFrame.new(s * (w / 2 + 0.05), 0.8 + h * 0.55, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
		wins[#wins + 1] = cf * CFrame.new(s * (door / 2 + (w - door) / 4), 0.8 + h * 0.55, -d / 2 - 0.05)
	end
	for _, wcf in ipairs(wins) do
		local g = Kit.part(m, { Name = "Window", Size = Vector3.new(2.6, 2.4, 0.3), CFrame = wcf, Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Color = COL.golden, Transparency = 0.15 })
		Kit.decor(g)
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Frame", Size = Vector3.new(3.2, 0.4, 0.5), CFrame = wcf * CFrame.new(0, -1.4, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Frame", Size = Vector3.new(3.2, 0.4, 0.5), CFrame = wcf * CFrame.new(0, 1.4, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
	end
	-- gable roof (two slabs) + ridge beam + gable infills
	local rise = opts.roofRise or (w * 0.42)
	local over = 1.8
	local halfW = w / 2 + over
	local slope = math.atan2(rise, halfW)
	local slabLen = math.sqrt(halfW * halfW + rise * rise)
	local top = 0.8 + h
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		Kit.part(m, { Name = "Roof", Size = Vector3.new(slabLen + 0.6, 1.1, d + over * 2), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(s * halfW / 2, top + rise / 2 - 0.2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s * slope), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = opts.roofColor or COL.timberDark })
	end
	Kit.part(m, { Name = "Ridge", Size = Vector3.new(1.4, 1.4, d + over * 2 + 0.6), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, top + rise + 0.2, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timber })
	for _, z in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			Kit.wedge(m, { Name = "Gable", Size = Vector3.new(wallT, rise, w / 2), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(s * w / 4, top + rise / 2, z * (d / 2 - wallT / 2)) * CFrame.Angles(0, s * math.rad(90), 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
		end
	end
	-- chimney
	if opts.chimney ~= false then
		local chim = Kit.part(m, { Name = "Chimney", Size = Vector3.new(3, h + rise + 3, 3), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(w / 2 - 2.5, 0.8 + (h + rise + 3) / 2, d / 4), Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone, Color = COL.masonry })
		local smoke = Instance.new("Smoke")
		smoke.Size = 3
		smoke.RiseVelocity = 4
		smoke.Opacity = 0.08
		smoke.Color = COL.moon
		local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
		att.Position = Vector3.new(0, chim.Size.Y / 2 + 0.5, 0)
		att.Parent = chim
		smoke.Parent = chim
	end
	-- warm interior light
	local core = Kit.part(m, { Name = "InteriorLight", Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 0.8 + h * 0.7, 0), Transparency = 1 })
	Kit.decor(core)
	local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
	l.Color = COL.lantern
	l.Range = math.max(w, d) * 0.9
	l.Brightness = 1.4
	l.Shadows = false
	l.Parent = core
	return m
end

-- wooden viewing deck with rails; legs reach down to legY
function Kit.deck(parent, cf, w, d, legY, openSide)
	local m = Kit.model(parent, "Deck")
	Kit.part(m, { Name = "Floor", Size = Vector3.new(w, 1, d), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0), Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color = COL.timber })
	local top = cf.Position.Y
	for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		for _, sz in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			local p = (cf * CFrame.new(sx * (w / 2 - 0.6), 0, sz * (d / 2 - 0.6))).Position
			local len = top - (legY or (top - 8))
			if len > 1 then
				Kit.part(m, { Name = "Leg", Size = Vector3.new(1.2, len, 1.2), CFrame = CFrame.new(p.X, top - len / 2 - 1, p.Z), Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Color = COL.timberDark })
			end
		end
	end
	local sides = {
		{ Vector3.new(-w / 2, 0, -d / 2), Vector3.new(w / 2, 0, -d / 2), "front" },
		{ Vector3.new(w / 2, 0, -d / 2), Vector3.new(w / 2, 0, d / 2), "right" },
		{ Vector3.new(w / 2, 0, d / 2), Vector3.new(-w / 2, 0, d / 2), "back" },
		{ Vector3.new(-w / 2, 0, d / 2), Vector3.new(-w / 2, 0, -d / 2), "left" },
	}
	for _, s in ipairs(sides) do
		if s[3] ~= openSide then
			Kit.fence(m, { (cf * CFrame.new(s[1])).Position, (cf * CFrame.new(s[2])).Position }, 3.4)
		end
	end
	return m
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- water FX
local SMOKE_TEX = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
local SPARK_TEX = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"

-- waterfall curtain: scrolling beams down a lip, plus mist and splash at the pool
function Kit.waterfall(parent, lipCenter, outward, width, bottomY)
	local m = Kit.model(parent, "WaterfallFX")
	local right = outward:Cross(Vector3.yAxis).Unit
	local drop = lipCenter.Y - bottomY
	local anchor = Kit.part(m, { Name = "Anchor", Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), CFrame = CFrame.new(lipCenter), Transparency = 1 })
	Kit.decor(anchor)
	local strands = math.max(3, math.floor(width / 7))
	for i = 0, strands - 1 do
		local off = (i / (strands - 1) - 0.5) * width
		-- parent before setting WorldPosition (otherwise it is stored as a local offset)
		local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
		a0.Parent = anchor
		a0.WorldPosition = lipCenter + right * off + outward * 8.5
		local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
		a1.Parent = anchor
		a1.WorldPosition = lipCenter + right * off * 1.06 + outward * 12 - Vector3.new(0, drop, 0)
		-- orient attachments so the beam faces outward
		a0.WorldAxis = outward
		a1.WorldAxis = outward
		local bm = Instance.new("Beam")
		bm.Attachment0, bm.Attachment1 = a0, a1
		bm.Texture = SMOKE_TEX
		bm.TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Wrap
		bm.TextureLength = 18
		bm.TextureSpeed = -2.2
		bm.Width0 = width / strands * 1.9
		bm.Width1 = width / strands * 2.3
		bm.FaceCamera = true -- ribbons stay visible from any angle (fixed-plane beams vanish edge-on)
		bm.LightEmission = 0.5
		bm.LightInfluence = 0.6
		bm.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(235, 252, 250), COL.turquoise)
		bm.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.05),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.85, 0.2),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.5),
		})
		bm.Segments = 4
		bm.CurveSize0 = 3
		bm.Parent = anchor
	end
	-- mist + splash at the base
	local base = Kit.part(m, { Name = "Splash", Size = Vector3.new(width, 1, 6), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(lipCenter.X, bottomY + 1, lipCenter.Z) + outward * 8, Vector3.new(lipCenter.X, bottomY + 1, lipCenter.Z) + outward * 9), Transparency = 1 })
	Kit.decor(base)
	local mist = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	mist.Texture = SMOKE_TEX
	mist.Rate = 14
	mist.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(3, 5)
	mist.Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 6)
	mist.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(40, 40)
	mist.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 8), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 22) })
	mist.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.7), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	mist.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(240, 252, 252))
	mist.LightEmission = 0.2
	mist.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	mist.Parent = base
	local splash = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	splash.Texture = SPARK_TEX
	splash.Rate = 22
	splash.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2)
	splash.Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 18)
	splash.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(35, 35)
	splash.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.2) })
	splash.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	splash.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(240, 255, 255))
	splash.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -30, 0)
	splash.Parent = base
	return m
end

return Kit

-- Studio SERVER only. Uses the actual Core service bridge and real authored tutorial section.
-- Returns observed transitions; this is a scripted smoke test, not a human/device playtest.
return function()
	assert(game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio())
	local HS=game:GetService("HttpService")
	local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local bridge=game:GetService("ServerStorage"):WaitForChild("CC_DevBridge")
	local plr=game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()[1]
	assert(plr and plr.Character,"player missing")
	local ch=plr.Character
	local root=ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local start=root.Position
	local function call(action,p)
		p=p or {}; p.name=plr.Name
		return HS:JSONDecode(bridge:Invoke(action,p)).result
	end
	local function request(action,p)
		p=p or {}; p.action=action
		return call("request",{action="traversal",payload=p})
	end
	local function move(pos) call("move",{x=pos.X,y=pos.Y,z=pos.Z}) end
	local function mode() return ch:GetAttribute("CC_TraversalState") end
	local observations={}
	local function record(name,ok,detail)
		observations[#observations+1]={name=name,pass=ok,detail=detail}
		assert(ok,name..": "..tostring(detail))
	end
	local function cargo()
		local st=call("snapshot"); local ids={}
		for _,it in ipairs(st.items or {}) do ids[#ids+1]=it.uid end
		table.sort(ids); return table.concat(ids,",")
	end
	local before=cargo()
	local originalAssist=plr:GetAttribute("CC_TimingAssist")
	plr:SetAttribute("CC_TimingAssist",false)
	local falls=plr:GetAttribute("CC_Falls") or 0
	local sec=HS:JSONDecode(RS.CC_TraversalDefs["Tutorial:RareNook"].Value)
	local ok,err=pcall(function()
		move(Vector3.new(table.unpack(sec.entry)))
		task.wait(1)
		request("clip"); task.wait(0.6)
		record("clip starts authored section",mode()=="climb",mode())
		local i=ch:GetAttribute("CC_HoldIndex")
		request("step",{hand="R"}); task.wait(0.2)
		record("single wrong hand does not slip",mode()=="climb" and ch:GetAttribute("CC_HoldIndex")==i,mode())
		request("step",{hand="L"}); task.wait(0.55)
		record("correct rhythm advances exactly one hold",ch:GetAttribute("CC_HoldIndex")==i+1,ch:GetAttribute("CC_HoldIndex"))
		request("slip"); task.wait(0.4)
		record("protected slip hangs",mode()=="hanging",mode())
		record("harness preserves cargo and fall count",cargo()==before and (plr:GetAttribute("CC_Falls") or 0)==falls,cargo())
		request("recover"); task.wait(0.55)
		record("hanging recovery regains hold",mode()=="climb",mode())
		for _=1,#sec.holds+2 do
			if mode()~="climb" then break end
			request("step",{hand=ch:GetAttribute("CC_NextHand")}); task.wait(0.55)
		end
		record("authored final transition lands",mode()=="ground",mode())
		record("landing preserves cargo",cargo()==before,cargo())
		request("rope"); task.wait(0.1)
		move(Vector3.new(table.unpack(sec.entry))); task.wait(0.8)
		request("grab"); task.wait(0.4)
		record("shared rope attaches without personal clip",mode()=="rope" and ch:GetAttribute("CC_Clipped")==false,mode())
		request("parachute"); task.wait(0.1)
		record("climb cannot deploy emergency parachute",mode()=="rope",mode())
	end)
	move(start)
	plr:SetAttribute("CC_TimingAssist",originalAssist)
	return {ok=ok,error=not ok and tostring(err) or nil,observations=observations,kind="Studio scripted live traversal smoke"}
end
